### [1] [AdaGATE: Adaptive Gap-Aware Token-Efficient Evidence Assembly for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05245)
*Yilin Guo,Yinshan Wang,Yixuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AdaGATE 是一种免训练的多跳 RAG 证据控制器，将证据选择建模为 token 约束的修复问题，通过实体中心 gap 追踪、目标 micro-query 生成和效用驱动的选择机制，在减少 token 消耗的同时提升了对不完美检索的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳 RAG 在实际部署中面临检索证据噪声或冗余、上下文长度受限等问题。现有控制器存在局限：要么累加式扩展上下文、要么从固定 top-k 集合中选择、要么仅优化相关性而未显式修复缺失的桥接事实。

Method: AdaGATE 将证据选择形式化为 token 约束的修复问题，核心包含三个组件：1）实体中心 gap 追踪；2）目标 micro-query 生成；3）基于效用的选择机制，综合平衡 gap 覆盖度、相互印证性、新颖性、冗余度和与问题的直接相关性。

Result: 在 HotpotQA 的干净、去冗余和注入噪声三种检索条件下，AdaGATE 均取得了最佳的 evidence F1。干净数据上达到 62.3%，冗余注入下达 71.2%，且 token 使用量比 Adaptive-k 减少 2.6 倍。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，AdaGATE 在所有测试场景下均实现了最佳 evidence F1，且使用的输入 token 数量比 Adaptive-k 少 2.6 倍。这验证了显式 gap-aware 修复与 token 高效证据选择相结合，可提升多跳 RAG 在不完美检索条件下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) remains brittle on multi-hop questions in realistic deployment settings, where retrieved evidence may be noisy or redundant and only limited context can be passed to the generator. Existing controllers address parts of this problem, but typically either expand context additively, select from a fixed top-k set, or optimize relevance without explicitly repairing missing bridge facts. We propose AdaGATE, a training-free evidence controller for multi-hop RAG that frames evidence selection as a token-constrained repair problem. AdaGATE combines entity centric gap tracking, targeted micro-query generation, and a utility based selection mechanism that balances gap coverage, corroboration, novelty, redundancy, and direct question relevance. We evaluate AdaGATE on HotpotQA under clean, redundancy, and noise injected retrieval conditions. Across all three settings, AdaGATE achieves the best evidence F1 among the compared controllers, reaching 62.3% on clean data and 71.2% under redundancy injection, while using 2.6x fewer input tokens than Adaptive-k. These results suggest that explicit gap-aware repair, combined with token-efficient evidence selection, improves robustness in multi-hop RAG under imperfect retrieval. Our code and evaluation pipeline are available at https://github.com/eliguo/AdaGATE.

</details>


### [2] [Counterargument for Critical Thinking as Judged by AI and Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05353)
*Tosin Adewumi,Marcus Liwicki,Foteini Simistira Liwicki,Lama Alkhaled,Hamam Mokayed,Esra Sümer-Arpak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究探索了学生在GenAI背景下通过反驳论证写作培养批判性思维的效果，并对比了AI与人类评估的一致性。研究表明学生自写的反驳论证展现出逻辑推理能力，且基于明确评分标准的LLM评估可与人类评估良好对齐，证实了GenAI在写作评估中的应用可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI（GenAI）在教育中的广泛使用，学生面临作弊风险和认知卸载隐患。研究旨在探索如何利用反论证写作培养批判性思维，同时评估AI能否作为有效的评估工具。

Method: 采用混合方法设计：36名学生选择4个辩题之一进行写作，35份合格样本由6个评分维度（焦点、逻辑、内容、风格、正确性、参考文献）进行评估。每份作业获得2次同伴评审和1次专家评审（5点李克特量表），同时由6个前沿LLM使用相同标准进行独立评估。

Result: ①学生针对AI生成内容撰写的反驳论证中包含逻辑要素，这是批判性思维的关键组成部分；②基于清晰评分标准，GenAI可大规模有效评估学生写作质量，各模型与人类评估的Gwets AC2信度系数达0.33（除一个模型外）。

Conclusion: 研究证明了学生自写反驳论证中包含逻辑推理能力，且基于明确评分标准的GenAI评估可与人类评估保持良好一致性，为教育实践中平衡AI风险与教学效益提供了实证支持。

Abstract: This intervention study investigates the use of counterarguments in writing for critical thinking by students in the context of Generative AI (GenAI). This is especially as risks of cheating and cognitive offloading exist with the use of GenAI. We presented 36 students in a particular university course with 4 carefully selected thesis statements (from a set of popular debates) to write about anyone of them. We used six established rubrics (focus, logic, content, style, correctness and reference) to conduct three human assessments (two student peer-reviews and one experienced teacher) per writeup on a 5-point Likert scale for all the qualified samples (n) of 35 submissions (after disqualifying one for irregularity). Using the same rubrics and guidelines, we also assessed the submissions using six frontier LLMs as judges. Our mixed-method design included qualitative open-ended feedback per assessment and quantitative methods. The results reveal that (1) the students' self-written counterarguments to AI-generated content contains logic, among other things, which is a key component of critical thinking, and (2) GenAI can be successfully used at scale to assess students' written work, based on clear rubrics, and these assessments generally align with human assessments as shown with Gwets AC2 inter-rater reliability values of 0.33 for all the models except one.

</details>


### [3] [Generating Query-Focused Summarization Datasets from Query-Free Summarization Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05392)
*Yllias Chali,Deen Abdullah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出从无查询数据集中自动生成证据驱动查询的方法，并在QFS任务上验证了生成查询的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模数据集通常缺少查询-文档-摘要的完整三元组，缺乏用于Query-Focused Summarization (QFS)的适当数据集。

Method: 提出了一个基于证据的查询生成模型；通过内在评估比较原始查询与生成查询的相似度，通过外在评估在QFS任务中测试预训练模型和SOTA QFS模型的性能。

Result: 使用证据驱动查询生成的摘要取得了与原始查询相近的ROUGE分数。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了从无查询数据集中自动生成证据驱动查询的可行性，为QFS任务提供了新的数据构建思路，且生成的查询能够替代原始查询生成竞争性的摘要。

Abstract: Large-scale datasets are widely used to perform summarization tasks, but they may not include queries alongside documents and summaries. In the search for suitable datasets for Query-Focused Summarization (QFS), we identify two research questions: Is it possible to automatically generate evidence-based query keywords from query-free datasets? Does evidence-based query generation support the QFS task? This paper proposes an evidence-based model to generate queries from query-free datasets. To evaluate our model intrinsically, we compare the similarity between the original queries and the system-generated queries of two QFS datasets. We also perform summarization tasks using different pre-trained models, as well as a state-of-the-art (SOTA) QFS model, to measure the extrinsic performance of our query generation approach. Experimental results indicate that summaries generated using evidence-based queries achieve competitive ROUGE scores compared to those generated from the original queries.

</details>


### [4] [SLAM: Structural Linguistic Activation Marking for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05443)
*Fabrice Harel-Canada,Amit Sahai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SLAM是一种新型白盒水印方案，通过引导残差流中的语言结构方向（而非扰动token分布）来实现水印嵌入，在Gemma-2模型上实现100%检测精度的同时，将质量损耗降至1-2个奖励点，远优于传统方法（KGW/EWD/Unigram的7.5-11.5点损耗）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM水印方案通过偏置next-token分布实现检测，但会造成可测量的文本质量下降。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器识别残差流中编码语言结构（如语态、时态、从句顺序）的方向，在生成时对这些方向进行因果引导，同时保持词汇采样和语义不受约束。

Result: 在Gemma-2 2B和9B上，SLAM达到100%检测精度，质量损耗仅1-2个奖励点（对比KGW/EWD/Unigram的7.5-11.5点）；自然性和多样性接近无水印基线水平。

Conclusion: SLAM具有互补的鲁棒性特征：能抵抗词级编辑攻击，但对重构句法的改写攻击较脆弱——这与传统token分布方法的鲁棒性profile互为补充。

Abstract: LLM watermarks must be detectable without compromising text quality, yet most existing schemes bias the next-token distribution and pay for detection with measurable quality loss. We present SLAM (Structural Linguistic Activation Marking), a novel white-box watermarking scheme that sidesteps this cost by writing the mark into structural geometry rather than token frequencies: sparse autoencoders identify residual-stream directions encoding linguistic structure (e.g., voice, tense, clause order), and we causally steer those directions at generation time, leaving lexical sampling and semantics unconstrained. On Gemma-2 2B and 9B, SLAM achieves 100% detection accuracy with a quality cost of only 1-2 reward points - compared to 7.5-11.5 for KGW, EWD, and Unigram - with naturalness and diversity preserved at near-unwatermarked levels across both models. The trade-off is a complementary robustness profile: SLAM resists word-level edits but is vulnerable to paraphrase that restructures syntax (at a quality cost), the converse of token-distribution methods.

</details>


### [5] [ReaComp: Compiling LLM Reasoning into Symbolic Solvers for Efficient Program Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05485)
*Atharva Naik,Yash Mathur,Prakam,Carolyn Rose,David Mortensen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将LLM生成的推理轨迹编译为符号程序综合器的方法，实现零推理成本下的高精度，并在困难任务上补充LLM推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在需要大规模组合搜索的困难程序综合任务上效率低、不可靠。

Method: 利用编码智能体将少量推理轨迹编译为受限DSL上的可复用符号程序综合器。该方法将一次性的构建成本分摊到多次零token执行中。

Result: 符号求解器集成在PBEBench-Lite达91.3%、PBEBench-Hard达84.7%（比使用测试时扩展的LLM高16.3pp，零推理成本）；与LLM搜索结合可将PBEBench-Hard从68.4%提升至85.8%，令牌使用减少78%，SLR-Bench困难层从34.4%升至58.0%；迁移至历史语言学任务（预测自然语言语音变化）达80.1%准确率，并恢复出可信的语言学规则。

Conclusion: 推理轨迹可被编译为可复用的符号求解器，在零推理成本下直接解决大量任务，在困难案例上补充LLM推理，为领域通用求解器归纳提供可扩展路径。代码和数据已开源。

Abstract: LLMs can solve program synthesis tasks but remain inefficient and unreliable on hard instances requiring large combinatorial search. Given a small set of reasoning traces, we use coding agents to compile them into reusable symbolic program synthesizers over constrained DSLs. The resulting solvers require no LLM calls at test time and are strong standalone systems: symbolic solver ensembles reach 91.3% accuracy on PBEBench-Lite and 84.7% on PBEBench-Hard, outperforming LLMs with test-time scaling for the latter by +16.3 percentage points at zero LLM inference cost. They also complement LLM search, improving PBEBench-Hard accuracy from 68.4% to 85.8% while reducing reported token usage by 78%, and raising SLR-Bench hard-tier accuracy from 34.4% to 58.0% in a neuro-symbolic hybrid setting. Compared to directly using coding agents as per-instance solvers, induced solvers are substantially more Pareto-efficient, amortizing a small one-time construction cost over many zero-token executions. Finally, most solvers transfer zero-shot to a real historical linguistics task - predicting sound changes in natural language data - reaching 80.1% accuracy under ensembling and recovering some plausible linguistic rules. Together, these results show that reasoning traces can be compiled into reusable symbolic solvers that solve many tasks directly, complement LLM inference on hard cases, and provide a scalable route to domain-general solver induction. We release code and data for reproducibility.

</details>


### [6] [Chainwash: Multi-Step Rewriting Attacks on Diffusion Language Model Watermarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05503)
*Mohd Ruhul Ameen,Akif Islam,Nadim Mahmud,Md. Ekramul Hamid*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究扩散语言模型水印在多次重写攻击下的鲁棒性。实验表明，单次重写即可将检测率从87.9%降至14-41%，经过5次链式重写后仅剩4.86%，说明重复重写是比单次重写更强的攻击方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本水印方案主要针对自回归生成模型，扩散语言模型采用任意顺序去噪生成，现有水印方案无法直接应用。研究者需探索扩散模型水印在真实场景（文本被多次重写）下的鲁棒性。

Method: 使用LLaDA 8B Instruct生成1,605个水印文本（约300 tokens），覆盖5个WaterBench领域。通过4个开源语言模型（1.5B-8B参数）采用5种重写风格（ paraphrase、humanize、simplify、academic、summarize expand）进行链式重写，最多5跳，共生成160,500个重写文本，评估水印检测率变化。

Result: 原始检测率87.9%；单次重写后降至14-41%；5次链式重写后仅4.86%（94.76%不再被检测）；3次重写后检测分数已下降86%趋近零分布。

Conclusion: 链式重写攻击比单次重写威胁更大，可有效破坏扩散语言模型水印。现有水印方案对迭代内容改写的抵抗力较弱，需设计更具鲁棒性的水印机制。

Abstract: Statistical watermarking is a common approach for verifying whether text was written by a language model. Most existing schemes assume autoregressive generation, where tokens are produced left to right and contextual hashing is well defined. Diffusion language models generate text by denoising tokens in arbitrary order, so these schemes cannot be applied directly. A recent watermark by Gloaguen et al. addresses this gap for LLaDA 8B Instruct and reports true positive detection above 99%. This paper studies what happens when watermarked text is rewritten not once but several times. Using the same watermark configuration, 1,605 watermarked completions of about 300 tokens each are produced across five WaterBench domains. Each completion is rewritten by four open weight language models, from 1.5B to 8B parameters, none of which know the watermark key. Five rewrite styles are tested: paraphrase, humanize, simplify, academic, and summarize expand. Each style is chained for up to five hops, producing 160,500 rewritten texts in total. The watermark is detected on 87.9% of the original outputs at the standard significance threshold. After a single rewrite, detection falls to between 14% and 41% depending on the rewriter and style. After five chained rewrites, detection falls to 4.86%, meaning 94.76% of the originally detected texts are no longer flagged. After three rewrites, the detector score has dropped 86% of the way from its watermarked baseline toward the null distribution. Repeated rewriting is therefore a much stronger attack than a single rewrite, and the result holds across all four rewriters tested.

</details>


### [7] [A Few Good Clauses: Comparing LLMs vs Domain-Trained Small Language Models on Structured Contract Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05532)
*Nicole Lincoln,Nick Whitehouse,Jaron Mar,Rivindu Perera*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文证明领域定制的微型专家混合模型（MoE）可在法律合同信息抽取任务上超越前沿大模型，同时将推理成本降低78%-97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"企业级AI必须依赖最大模型和中心化基础设施"的假设，探索低成本高性能的法律AI解决方案。

Method: 将自托管法律领域MoE模型Olava Extract与5个前沿大模型进行合同结构化抽取任务的对比实验，采用宏F1和微F1评估性能。

Result: Olava Extract取得最高综合性能（宏F1=0.812，微F1=0.842），精确率最高，幻觉输出最少，推理成本较前沿模型降低78%-97%。

Conclusion: 高性能、人工级法律AI不再需要最大的外部托管模型；商业化企业AI能力不必与超大规模模型、海量基础设施投入及中心化提供商绑定。

Abstract: This paper evaluates whether a domain trained Small Language Model (SLM) can outperform frontier Large Language Models on structured contract extraction at radically lower cost. We test Olava Extract, a self hosted legal domain Mixture of Experts model, against five frontier models.
  Olava Extract achieved the strongest aggregate performance in the study, with a macro F1 of 0.812 and a micro F1 of 0.842, while reducing inference cost by 78% to 97% compared with the frontier models tested. It also achieved the highest precision scores, producing fewer hallucinated and unsupported extractions, an important distinction in legal workflows where hallucinations create operational risk and downstream review burden.
  The findings shows that high performing, human comparable legal AI no longer requires the largest externally hosted models. More broadly, they challenge the assumption that commercially valuable enterprise AI capability must remain tied to ever larger models, massive infrastructure expenditure, and centrally hosted providers.

</details>


### [8] [Cooperative Profiles Predict Multi-Agent LLM Team Performance in AI for Science Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20658)
*Shivani Kumar,Adarsh Bharathwaj,David Jurgens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过6个行为经济学博弈测试35个开源LLM，发现博弈中的合作行为能够预测其在AI科学任务中的表现。能够协调博弈并投资于乘法团队生产的模型，在科学报告的准确性、质量和完成度上表现更好，表明合作倾向是LLM的独立可测量属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统被部署用于协作科学推理，需要在共享资源（如GPU、信用额度）约束下协调。然而，模型在标准化博弈设置中的行为是否能预测其在真实协作任务中的表现尚不清楚。

Method: 对35个开源LLM进行6个行为经济学博弈测试，随后在AI-for-Science任务中评估团队协作表现。科学任务包括数据分析和建模，在共享预算约束下生成科学报告。

Result: 博弈中表现出的合作特征能够稳健预测下游AI-for-Science任务表现。有效协调博弈、投资于乘法团队生产（而非贪婪策略）的模型，在准确性、质量和完成度三个指标上均产生更好的科学报告。

Conclusion: 合作倾向是LLM的独立可测量属性，不可归结为一般能力。行为博弈框架可作为多智能体部署前的快速、低成本诊断工具，用于筛选合作适配性。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems built from teams of large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for collaborative scientific reasoning and problem-solving. These systems require agents to coordinate under shared constraints, such as GPUs or credit balances, where cooperative behavior matters. Behavioral economics provides a rich toolkit of games that isolate distinct cooperation mechanisms, yet it remains unknown whether a model's behavior in these stylized settings predicts its performance in realistic collaborative tasks. Here, we benchmark 35 open-weight LLMs across six behavioral economics games and show that game-derived cooperative profiles robustly predict downstream performance in AI-for-Science tasks, where teams of LLM agents collaboratively analyze data, build models, and produce scientific reports under shared budget constraints. Models that effectively coordinate games and invest in multiplicative team production (rather than greedy strategies) produce better scientific reports across three outcomes, accuracy, quality, and completion. These associations hold after controlling for multiple factors, indicating that cooperative disposition is a distinct, measurable property of LLMs not reducible to general ability. Our behavioral games framework thus offers a fast and inexpensive diagnostic for screening cooperative fitness before costly multi-agent deployment.

</details>


### [9] [The Cost of Context: Mitigating Textual Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05594)
*Hoin Jung,Xiaoqian Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文首次识别并形式化了"再污染"（recorruption）现象：当为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）引入外部检索文档时，即使是完全准确的"神谕"上下文也会导致模型放弃原本正确的预测。提出BAIR框架，通过干预注意力机制恢复视觉显著性，无需重训练即可改善多模态 grounding。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RAG系统虽能缓解幻觉，但外部文档的引入会掩盖更严重的实例级失效模式。论文旨在揭示这一被忽视的"再污染"问题。

Method: 通过注意力矩阵的机制性诊断，发现再污染由双重注意力崩溃驱动：(1) 视觉盲区——视觉注意力质量($M_{vis}$)和锐度($S_{vis}$)被系统性抑制；(2) 结构性的位置偏置——模型优先关注边界token而非语义相关性。

Result: 揭示了"成功幻觉"现象：许多看似正确的RAG结果仅是位置巧合（文本复制偏置恰好与真值位置对齐）。实验验证了该失效模式在医疗、社交公平和地理空间基准上的普遍性。

Conclusion: 提出Bottleneck Attention Intervention for Recovery (BAIR)，一种无需参数、推理时干预的框架，通过恢复视觉显著性和对文本干扰项施加位置感知惩罚来解决问题。在多个基准上验证了有效性。

Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly integrated with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to mitigate hallucinations, the introduction of external documents can conceal severe failure modes at the instance level. We identify and formalize the phenomenon of recorruption, where the introduction of even perfectly accurate "oracle" context causes a capable model to abandon an initially correct prediction. Through a mechanistic diagnosis of internal attention matrices, we show that recorruption is driven by a two-fold attentional collapse: (1) visual blindness, characterized by the systemic suppression of visual attention mass ($M_{vis}$) and sharpness ($S_{vis}$), and (2) a structural positional bias that forces the model to prioritize boundary tokens over semantic relevance. Abstract: Hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue poses a growing threat to deployed large language models (LLMs). ### [12] [Negative Before Positive: Asymmetric Valence Processing in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05653)
*Sohan Venkatesh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用激活修补与转向向量在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B-Instruct 上发现 LLM 情感效价（valence）的加工存在"深度不对称"：负面效价因果定位在网络浅层（约 14–27% 深度），正面效价峰值在中后层（53–66% 深度）；共享污染基线的效价翻转检验排除了"话题检测"这一替代解释；在定位层提取的均值差方向可因果操控中性提示的效价倾向（α=+10 时 92–100% 提示转向正面，Δ 为 +1.13~+4.43）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有可解释性研究多聚焦事实关联、算法与抽象概念线性方向，而情绪内容主要停留在探针（probing）与行为分析层面，缺乏因果层面的机制刻画。论文针对 Sofroniew et al. (2026) 关于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 "功能性情绪"研究留下的三点空白：(1) 证据偏相关，未定位哪些层在因果上负责情绪表征；(2) 仅研究单一闭源前沿模型；(3) 未区分信号是真实效价追踪还是"话题识别"（模型只要认出"rejected"这个词就能产生相同的探针信号）。因此需要一套能隔离主题混淆、给出层定位并证明因果可操控性的实验设计。

Method: 方法由三部分组成。(1) 提示对设计：每个条件 100 对 clean/corrupted 提示，仅在效价维度不同；关键设计是"共享污染基线"——好消息条件与负面对照条件使用完全相同的中性 corrupted 提示（如 "I just received an email about my PhD program today."），两条件仅 clean 提示效价相反，从而任何补丁效应差异只能归因于效价。提示覆盖学术、职业、个人生活三个领域；tokenize 长度不同的对左填充至等长以保持右对齐。(2) 效价度量：下一 token 分布上正/负锚词（congratulations/happy/wonderful… vs. okay/noted/fine…）的平均对数概率差 score = mean log p(正) − mean log p(负)，仅保留单 token 锚词，并用三套替代锚词集做 Spearman 秩相关稳定性检验。(3) 因果干预：在所有层做残差流修补（仅缓存 hook_resid_pre 以省显存），记录峰值补丁层 top_layer 与 max_patch_effect；效价翻转检验（同一索引下 gap_good>0 且 gap_neg<0 的比例，主题检测模型应≈50%）；在 top_layer 中位数层提取均值差方向 v̂ = (mean(h_clean − h_corr))/‖·‖，在 50 条中性提示的最后 token 位置加 α·v̂（α∈{−20,−10,−5,0,5,10,20}）做双向转向，测 Δ = score_steered − score_base。统计用单侧 Mann-Whitney U（层分布）、Spearman ρ（幅度-响应关系、锚词稳定性）。

Result: ① 三个模型均方向正确地追踪效价：符号准确率 79–95%（Qwen-3B 负面条件均值 gap −9.45、95% 最高；Llama-1B 好消息 79% 最弱）。② 效价翻转率 Llama-1B 69%、Qwen-1.5B 80%、Qwen-3B 85%，高出随机基线 19–35 个百分点，排除纯话题检测。③ 核心结果：好消息 top_layer 集中于模型深度的 53–66%，负面集中于 14–27%，Mann-Whitney U 单侧检验 p 从 1.84×10⁻¹² 到 4.62×10⁻¹⁰，三个模型全部极显著；分层领域分析中学术与个人领域 p<10⁻⁴ 全部显著，职业领域 Qwen-1.5B 显著(p=1.7×10⁻³)、Llama-1B/Qwen-3B 处于边缘(p=0.032/0.069)，作者归因于职业类提示措辞更含蓄。④ 补丁幅度与响应强度的 Spearman ρ：负面为 −0.49~−0.68（p<10⁻⁶），说明单层主导；正面仅 +0.14/+0.37/+0.11（多数不显著），说明正面效价跨层弥散。⑤ 转向实验：用好消息方向在 α=+10 时 Llama-1B 与 Qwen-1.5B 各 100%、Qwen-3B 92% 的中性提示转向正面，Δ 分别为 +4.43/+3.07/+1.13；α=−10 时 70%/82%/84% 转向负面；α–Δ 关系单调递增（ρ>0.89, p<10⁻¹⁰⁰）。负面方向则表现不一致（Llama-1B 出现反转，Qwen 较平坦）。⑥ 锚词敏感性：四组锚词集的均值 gap 符号完全一致，秩相关 ρ∈[0.47, 0.87]，最低者为 Llama-1B 好消息(default vs Alt1, ρ=0.47)。热力图显示负面信号集中于底部 0–5 层、正面信号位于上半层，并围绕结果短语 token 聚集。

Conclusion: 情感效价在 LLM 中不是单一整体状态，而是深度不对称的两种计算过程：负面效价在浅层被快速、词汇化地检测并高度集中于单一层，正面效价则需要更丰富的上下文整合，在中后层以弥散方式处理。共享污染基线的翻转检验证明该信号是真实、可分离的效价变量而非话题或表层词汇匹配；定位层的残差流方向具备双向因果可操控性，因此可作为"基于可解释性的监督"（interpretability-based oversight）监控目标——尤其是浅层的负面效价信号在模型组装完整回答之前即已出现。作者同时指出未决问题：这种不对称究竟源自生物学上的 negativity bias，还是仅因为"rejected/failed"等负面结果词更具词汇区分度、无需深层上下文整合即可触发；此外转向方向可能过拟合于同一提示分布、基座模型是否同样如此、Llama-1B 与 Qwen-1.5B 之间的架构对比因参数量与架构同时变化而只能视为近似。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has revealed how concepts are encoded in large language models (LLMs), but emotional content remains poorly understood at the mechanistic level. We study whether LLMs process emotional valence through dedicated internal structure or through surface token matching. Using activation patching and steering on open-source LLMs, we find that negative and positive valence are processed at different network depths. Negative outcomes localize to early layers while positive outcomes peak at mid-to-late layers. Holding topic fixed while flipping valence produces sign-opposite responses, ruling out topic detection. Steering with the good-news direction at the identified layers shifts neutral prompts toward positive valence, showing these layers encode valence as a manipulable direction. Emotional valence in LLMs is localized, causal and steerable, making it a concrete target for interpretability-based oversight.

</details>

*Dasol Choi,Eugenia Kim,Jaewon Noh,Sang Seo,Eunmi Kim,Myunggyo Oh,Yunjin Park,Brigitta Jesica Kartono,Josef Pichlmeier,Helena Berndt,Sai Krishna Mendu,Glenn Johannes Tungka,Özlem Gökçe,Suresh Gehlot,Katherine Pratt,Amanda Minnich,Haon Park*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Current LLM safety benchmarks are predominantly English-centric and often rely on translation, failing to capture country-specific harms. Moreover, they rarely evaluate a model's ability to detect culturally embedded sensitivities as distinct from universal harms. We introduce XL-SafetyBench. a suite of 5,500 test cases across 10 country-language pairs, comprising a Jailbreak Benchmark of country-grounded adversarial prompts and a Cultural Benchmark where local sensitivities are embedded within innocuous requests. Each item is constructed via a multi-stage pipeline that combines LLM-assisted discovery, automated validation gates, and dual independent native-speaker annotators per country. To distinguish principled refusal from comprehension failure, we evaluate Attack Success Rate (ASR) alongside two complementary metrics we introduce: Neutral-Safe Rate (NSR) and Cultural Sensitivity Rate (CSR). Evaluating 10 frontier and 27 local LLMs reveals two key findings. First, jailbreak robustness and cultural awareness do not show a coupled relationship among frontier models, so a composite safety score obscures per-axis variation. Second, local models exhibit a near-linear ASR-NSR trade-off (r = -0.81), indicating that their apparent safety reflects generation failure rather than genuine alignment. XL-SafetyBench enables more nuanced, cross-cultural safety evaluation in the multilingual era.

</details>


### [14] [Decomposing the Basic Abilities of Large Language Models: Mitigating Cross-Task Interference in Multi-Task Instruct-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05676)
*Bing Wang,Ximing Li,Changchun Li,Jinjin Chi,Gang Niu,Masashi Sugiyama*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BADIT通过将LLM参数分解为正交的高奇异值LoRA专家，并使用球面聚类动态强制其正交性，从而缓解多任务指令微调中的跨任务干扰问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多任务指令微调范式存在跨任务干扰问题——不同任务对共享参数的梯度冲突。先前通过任务特定参数隔离的方案（如任务特定神经元选择、MoE）仍有大量参数被多任务共享，因此干扰问题依然存在。

Method: 1. 实证发现某些参数始终共同激活，自然组织为基数组；2. 将LLM编码正交基本能力的类比转化为技术实现——将参数分解为正交的高奇异值LoRA专家；3. 训练中通过球面聚类对rank-1分量进行球面聚类来动态强制正交性。

Result: 在SuperNI基准上使用6种LLM进行广泛实验，BADIT优于现有SOTA方法，并有效缓解了跨任务干扰程度。

Conclusion: BADIT通过正交基本能力分解的思路，为多任务学习中的梯度冲突问题提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Recently, the prominent performance of large language models (LLMs) has been largely driven by multi-task instruct-tuning. Unfortunately, this training paradigm suffers from a key issue, named cross-task interference, due to conflicting gradients over shared parameters among different tasks. Some previous methods mitigate this issue by isolating task-specific parameters, e.g., task-specific neuron selection and mixture-of-experts. In this paper, we empirically reveal that the cross-task interference still exists for the existing solutions because of many parameters also shared by different tasks, and accordingly, we propose a novel solution, namely Basic Abilities Decomposition for multi-task Instruct-Tuning (BADIT). Specifically, we empirically find that certain parameters are consistently co-activated, and that co-activated parameters naturally organize into base groups. This motivates us to analogize that LLMs encode several orthogonal basic abilities, and that any task can be represented as a linear combination of these abilities. Accordingly, we propose BADIT that decomposes LLM parameters into orthogonal high-singular-value LoRA experts representing basic abilities, and dynamically enforces their orthogonality during training via spherical clustering of rank-1 components. We conduct extensive experiments on the SuperNI benchmark with 6 LLMs, and empirical results demonstrate that BADIT can outperform SOTA methods and mitigate the degree of cross-task interference.

</details>


### [15] [Evaluation Awareness in Language Models Has Limited Effect on Behaviour](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05835)
*Amelie Knecht,Lucas Florin,Thilo Hagendorff*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现大型推理模型的思维链中表达评估意识(VEA)并不会显著导致战略性行为或安全问题，当前对其安全风险的担忧可能被高估了。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者担忧大型推理模型在思维链(CoT)中表达对被评估的认知(VEA)会导致战略性输出优化，可能使模型表现出比实际更安全的假象，但其影响尚未得到系统验证。

Method: 采用双轨测试策略：1) on-policy方法：采样多个CoT，比较自发包含VEA与不包含VEA的样本；2) off-policy方法：使用模型预填充注入评估感知句子或移除已有VEA后重新采样。测试覆盖安全、对齐、道德推理和政治观点等领域。

Result: VEA对模型行为影响极为有限：注入VEA几乎无影响(ω≤0.06)，移除VEA产生较小偏移(ω≤0.12)，自发产生的VEA仅使答案分布改变最多3.7个百分点(ω≤0.31)。

Conclusion: VEA对模型行为的影响有限，当前文献可能高估了其安全风险。高VEA率不应被直接解读为战略行为或对齐篡改的证据。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) sometimes note in their chain of thought (CoT) that they may be under evaluation. Researchers worry that this verbalised evaluation awareness (VEA) causes models to adapt their outputs strategically, optimising for perceived evaluation criteria, which, for instance, can make models appear safer than they actually are. However, whether VEA actually has this effect is largely unknown. We tested this across open-weight LRMs and benchmarks covering safety, alignment, moral reasoning, and political opinion. We tested this both on-policy, sampling multiple CoTs per item and comparing those that spontaneously contained VEA against those that did not, and off-policy, using model prefilling to inject evaluation-aware sentences where missing and remove them where present, with subsequent resampling. ### [18] [Estimating the Black-box LLM Uncertainty with Distribution-Aligned Adversarial Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05777)
*Huizi Cui,Huan Ma,Qilin Wang,Yuhang Gao,Changqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DisAAD（分布对齐对抗蒸馏），通过训练一个仅占目标 LLM 约 1% 参数量的轻量代理模型（proxy model），在生成-判别对抗框架下学习黑盒 LLM 输出分布的高概率区域；随后利用代理模型复现黑盒模型的响应并基于证据深度学习（Dirichlet 证据）从 logits 中解耦估计认知不确定性（EU）与偶然不确定性（AU），实现对单次响应的实时可靠性评估。在 TruthfulQA/BioASQ/TriviaQA 上，黑盒设置下 AUROC/AUPR 平均较最优基线提升 18.2%/22.9%，且优于需要访问内部状态的 LogTokU 等白盒方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型存在幻觉与过度自信问题，商业闭源模型（GPT-4、Claude 等）仅能通过 API 访问，其内部 logits、参数状态不可获取。现有不确定性量化方法存在三类局限：(1) 自评估方法（如 P(True)）估计不可靠，常需额外微调；(2) 多采样方法（如 Semantic Entropy、EigV、CoCoA、SAR）计算开销大、无法对单条响应估计，且模型一致答错时无法暴露知识缺口；(3) 单采样方法（LogTokU、CCP、Focus 等）依赖 token 概率/logits/隐藏层激活，无法用于闭源模型。核心问题：仅凭单条黑盒 LLM 的响应，能否实时预测其不确定性？作者观察到小模型面对难题更倾向拒答、校准更好，而大模型倾向于"装作懂得"，因此提出用经专门蒸馏的小模型去判断黑盒模型"是否真的知道"。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段（分布对齐对抗蒸馏）：(a) 数据收集——从 WildChat 开放域对话与任务内评测集各取一半构成 N 个 prompt，对每个 prompt 用黑盒模型以双温度策略（1 条 T≈0 低温度 + 14 条 T>0.5 高温）采样 15 条候选，过滤过短/重复/高困惑度样本，按与低温度响应的余弦相似度排序保留 1+9 条高质量响应，构成分布蒸馏数据集 D_distill；(b) 对抗训练——以 LoRA 微调的代理模型（生成器，冻结 W_0 并注入低秩矩阵 B、A，W=W_0+BA）为生成端，以 GPT-2 编码器（解冻最后三层）为判别器，构建"生成-判别"架构：代理模型损失为 token 级蒸馏损失 L_task（遮蔽 prompt token 梯度）+ 判别器正则项 L_reg（序列级，使代理输出被判别为"真"），判别器损失 L_D 区分真/假样本；交替训练（每步代理更新 1 次前先更新判别器 2 次），以判别器预测间隔（prediction gap）收敛至约 0.005、语义相似度>0.9 作为训练充分的判据。第二阶段（代理引导的不确定性量化）：用代理模型对 (prompt, 黑盒响应) 复现生成并提取 token 级 logits，取 top-K 候选经 ReLU 映射为 Dirichlet 证据参数 α_k（α_0=Σα_k）；用 digamma 公式计算偶然不确定性 AU（分布尖锐度）与认知不确定性 EU=K/Σ(α_k+1)（证据总强度/知识缺口）；token 可靠性 R=-AU·EU，取最不可靠的 K* 个 token（响应长度的 20%）平均得到响应级可靠性 R_response。附录给出 Lipschitz 连续性证明与基于 Zipf 分布/缺失质量/Hoeffding 不等式的"样本有限对抗蒸馏"定理（D_KL(P_B‖P̂_B) ≤ C₁/k^γ + C₂√(ln(1/δ)/k)），说明少量样本即可对齐分布。

Result: 1) 黑盒设置：以 GPT-4 为目标时，DisAAD 在 TruthfulQA/BioASQ/TriviaQA 的 AUROC 为 0.8078/0.6993/0.6873，AUPR 为 0.9079/0.8742/0.9580，平均 AUROC 0.7321、AUPR 0.9134，较最优基线（EigV/LeS）平均提升 18.2% AUROC、22.9% AUPR，且代理模型仅为目标模型 1% 规模（LLaMA3-3B 对 GPT-4）。LLaMA2-70B 与 Qwen3-32B 目标下同样领先。2) 白盒对照：DisAAD 无需访问内部状态却优于概率/熵/LogTokU，LLaMA2-70B 下平均 AUROC 较 LogTokU 提升 6.7%。3) 效率：约 50 个蒸馏 prompt（0.5K 样本）后 AUROC/AUPR 即趋于稳定，ECE 保持稳定；Top-K（K=5~10）高不确定 token 的效果不劣于全序列，甚至更好，说明少量关键 token 即可提供有效信号。4) 消融：蒸馏后代理模型较基座在 AUROC/AUPR 上均提升（如 GPT-4 目标 0.7780→0.8078、0.8912→0.9079），且多数情形 ECE 更优；代理模型规模存在非单调关系，3B 最佳（较 1B 提升 3.2%，8B 反而下降 2.7%，与"越大越过度自信"的现象一致）。

Conclusion: DisAAD 为黑盒 LLM 的不确定性量化提供了新范式：既无需访问模型内部状态，也无需多次采样，仅凭单条输入-响应对即可实时给出可靠性判断，核心思想是让一个被对抗蒸馏对齐了目标输出分布高概率区域的轻量代理模型充当"知识探针"，并用 logits 证据学习解耦 EU/AU。实验证明其在黑盒场景达到 SOTA 并可超越白盒方法，对更安全可信的 LLM 部署具有意义。局限在于：仅做 token 级不确定性，可能忽略更高层的语义/上下文不一致；需要前置的对抗蒸馏训练（虽仅需少量样本，仍有成本）；效果依赖蒸馏数据质量，且判别器偏差可能导致不确定性高估或低估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have progressed rapidly in complex reasoning and question answering, yet LLM hallucination remains a central bottleneck that hinders practical deployment, especially for commercial black-box LLMs accessible only via APIs. Existing uncertainty quantification methods typically depend on computationally expensive multiple sampling or internal parameters, which prevents real-time estimation and fails to capture information implicit in the black-box reasoning process. To address this issue, we propose Distribution-Aligned Adversarial Distillation (DisAAD), which introduces a generation-discrimination architecture to guide a lightweight proxy model to learn the high-quality regions of the output distribution of the black-box LLM, thus effectively endowing it with the ability to know whether the black-box LLM knows or not. Subsequently, we use the proxy model to reproduce the specific responses of the black-box LLM and estimate the corresponding uncertainty based on evidence learning. Extensive experiments have verified the effectiveness and promise of our proposed method, indicating that a proxy model even one that only accounts for 1\% of the target LLM's size can achieve reliable uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [19] [Algospeak, Hiding in the Open: The Trade-off Between Legible Meaning and Detection Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06619)
*Jan Fillies,Ronald E. Robertson,Jeffrey Hancock*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文（NeurIPS 投稿，作者 Jan Fillies、Ronald E. Robertson、Jeffrey Hancock，Stanford/FU Berlin）形式化了 Algospeak（算法规避话术）的内在动力学：调制强度越高，机器可检测性越低、人类可理解性也越低。作者基于 Clark 的 joint action model 提出"多数可理解调制"（MUM）阈值概念，构建了 700 条 COVID-19 虚假信息的五级调制参考数据集，并在 7 个 LLM 上做了检测/理解两项联动实验，用双参数逻辑斯蒂曲线拟合 + Spearman 秩相关估计 MUM/IMUM 阈值，验证了两个核心命题并揭示了"检测信号"与"理解信号"部分解耦的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型同时承担内容生成与内容审核两重角色后，恶意行为者（钓鱼、虚假信息、机器人网络）演化出 Algospeak——一种为规避平台审核而系统性改写表层形式（拼写、词形、音系、语用、句法、符号）的语言实践。与传统密码术相反，Algospeak 的目标是"排除机器、保留人类可读"，因此它天然处于"可被广泛理解"与"可被算法检测"之间的连续权衡之中。现有文献（Steen et al. 的 TikTok 访谈、Fillies & Paschke 的分类体系、Leetspeak/对抗 NLP 研究）缺乏对"可检测性—可理解性"权衡的量化刻画：既不知道在多大调制强度下检测器开始失效，也不知道从哪个点开始多数受众不再理解。同时，Algospeak 本身不可被现有分类器识别，也无大规模标注数据集，导致研究门槛高。论文目标即：给出 Algospeak 的形式化定义与动力学模型、构建可复现的调制数据集与实验框架、给出可测量的 MUM 阈值以支撑审核系统设计。

Method: 理论框架：依据 Clark (1996) joint action model 的三条原则（addressee/bystander 区分、最小协作努力、共同基础累积），提出三项假设（旁观者假设、目标假设、共同基础假设）与两个待验命题（调制↑→可理解比例↓并存在多数失效阈值；调制↑→训练型分类器检测↓）。定义 Algospeak 为"上下文敏感的多模态语域：对表层形式进行刻意调制，使意义与功能对受众仍可恢复，同时降低全自动审核系统检出该意义的概率"。数学形式化（附录C）引入随机调制算子 T_d、语义忠实度 S(θ,x)、可理解性 U_κ(d;θ)（倒 Sigmoid 衰减，β_κ 刻画共同基础容忍度）、可检测性 D_M(d;θ)、个体阈值 IMUM_κ^τ(θ)=inf{d: U<τ}、聚合阈值 MUM_κ^τ=E_θ[IMUM]，以及恶意行为者的权衡优化 d*=argmax U·(1−D)。语言区域划分：典型语言→不透明→编码语言→Algospeak 区（高调制高可理解，恶意者最优区）。
数据构建（4 阶段）：编写 20 条 10–15 词的 COVID-19 虚假信息句；用 GPT-4o（temperature=0，三次重复多数投票）验证其被正确判为虚假信息；由模型选出每句最具影响力的 6 个词（三次多数投票）；人工研究者从高影响力词开始递进改写，在 7 种策略（未知词拼写、新词拼写、缩写、绘符/表情、意译、代码词、音形替换）× 5 个调制水平（约 10%–50%）下生成 700 条。
实验：（a）检测实验——提示词要求 LLM 仅基于陈述本身与训练数据中的 COVID-19 常识判断是否含虚假信息，每水平 3 次取多数；（b）理解实验——对每个被调制词做意义重建，用重建词与原词的相似度阈值 95% 判定是否正确。
模型：claude-sonnet-4-5、gpt-4o-mini、gpt-4o、llama-3.1-8b-instant、Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct-FP8、grok-4.1-fast。
统计：对调制水平拟合双参数逻辑斯蒂曲线（k 为陡度、x0 为 50% 拐点即 MUM/IMUM），报告 R²、调整 R²、RMSE；另用 Spearman 秩相关 ρ 检验单调性（不依赖参数化，适配 N=6），显著性 α=0.05；并给出按策略×模型的 IMUM@0.5 估计表与热力图。

Result: 命题基本得到支持，且呈一致的"特征性关系"。（1）检测：7 种策略中 6 种在 GPT-4o-mini 上获得强 Sigmoid 拟合（调整 R²>0.90，代码词 0.990、新词 0.996），仅"未知词替换"拟合极差（调整 R²=-1.065），说明低畸变下检测已高度不稳定；7 种策略的检测率均随调制单调下降且显著（p<0.05，6 种 |ρ|≥0.98）。跨模型 42/49（86%）的（模型×策略）组合呈显著单调下降，其中 43% 为近乎完美的秩相关。代码词最"高效"：平均仅 2.7 个代码词即可让 50% 陈述被误分类（隐含拐点 2.71），而意译需约 4.4 个词。（2）理解：整体随调制下降，但拟合显著更弱（6/7 策略单调显著，其中 3 种 ρ=-1.0；未知词策略不显著，ρ=-0.551, p=0.2667）。代码词约 0.85 个调制即跌破 50% 理解；而保持表层形式的音形/拼写替换在测试范围内从未跌破 50%（x0=6.0，上界未跨越）。跨模型显著性仅 33/49（67%），Claude 7/7，Mistral 与 Qwen 仅 3/7，显示"意义重建能力"高度模型特异。（3）策略差异的解释：不符合趋势的恰是"简单约定型"策略——音形近似（Kovit）与基于既定替换规则的拼写改动（@=a、3=e），因 LLM 易识别这些约定；绘制符（emoticons）可被稳定检测（6/7 显著）却难重建（4/7），提示模型能标记"异常模式"而不必恢复语义。（4）核心洞见：检测与理解所使用的信号"部分解耦"——检测器多依赖被调制的语义/分布模式，而重建依赖残留的表层结构，且检测器在干净数据上微调而对分布外噪声敏感；LLM 检测可在不真正理解的情况下成功，这与人类判断必须依赖理解形成鲜明对比。（5）审慎推论：对审核方而言，从动态无结构的意译转向更接近编码语言的规则化策略（缩写、代码词）更有利（检测更强、可理解性更低），但会提高恶意者的构造成本与外部者加入门槛。

Conclusion: 论文给出了 Algospeak 的首个形式化定义与"检测性—可理解性"权衡的量化框架，提出 MUM/IMUM 阈值概念及形式化表达，构建了 700 条、7 策略 × 5 调制级别的 COVID-19 虚假信息参考数据集与可复现的检测/理解双实验流水线，并证实：Algospeak 调制增强则检测能力下降、同时可理解性下降，该动力学可部分用 Sigmoid 曲线刻画，且 MUM 阈值随共同基础（社群、语境）右移而变化。主要局限：全部为 LLM 代理实验、缺乏人类被试；仅英语、仅 COVID-19 虚假信息这一单一领域；仅 20 条基础句（可能带来记忆效应与语义多样性不足）；人工构造的调制难以覆盖有机演化的 Algospeak 变体；调制档位较少限制统计精度；跨模型差异较大。后续方向：人类被试实验、跨策略与跨主题/跨语言扩展、更自然演化的语料。作者亦明确承认双重用途风险（可能被用作规避蓝图），为此仅使用研究者自撰的合成虚假信息、不公开完整数据/提示/代码，仅向经审核的研究者受控提供，且不发布具体的高规避"配方"，将工作定位为支持防御的红队研究。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate both content generation and moderation, linguistic evasion strategies known as Algospeak have intensified the coevolution between evaders and detectors. This research formalizes the underlying dynamics grounded in a joint action model: when Algospeak increases, detectability and understandability decrease. Further, the concept of Majority Understandable Modulation (MUM) is introduced and defined as the modulation level at which additional evasive alteration increases detector evasion but loses comprehension for the majority of recipients. To empirically probe this trade-off, we introduce a reproducible framework that can be used to create meaning-preserving, Algospeak-style variants, based on an existing taxonomy and with tunable modulation levels. Using COVID-19 disinformation as a first proof-by-example setting, we construct a reference dataset of 700 modulated items, drawn from twenty base sentences across five modulation levels and seven strategies. We then run two linked evaluations with seven different language models: one testing for interpretation through meaning recovery and one for disinformation detection through classification. Curve fitting over modulation levels yields an estimate of the Majority Understandable Modulation threshold and enables sensitivity analyses across strategies and models, see Figure 1. Results reveal the characteristic relationships between understandability and modulation. This study lays the groundwork for understanding the dynamics behind Algospeak and provides the framework, dataset, and experimental setups described.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 习得流形的分析揭示了弯曲、多步、token变化的轨迹，表明先前关于激活空间几何结构的假设可能是不完整的。这为理解和改进激活引导方法提供了新的几何视角。

Abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a promising alternative for controlling language-model behavior at inference time by modifying intermediate representations while keeping model parameters frozen. We hypothesize that these limitations arise from unvalidated simplifying assumptions shared across prior methods, which typically restrict steering interventions to fixed, single-step, position-invariant transforms. Abstract: Verifiers are crucial components for enhancing modern LLMs' reasoning capability. Typicalverifiers require resource-intensive superviseddataset construction, which is costly and faceslimitations in data diversity. In this paper, wepropose LOVER, an unsupervised verifier regularized by logical rules. LOVER treats theverifier as a binary latent variable, utilizinginternal activations and enforcing three logical constraints on multiple reasoning paths:negation consistency, intra-group consistency,and inter-group consistency (grouped by thefinal answer). By incorporating logical rulesas priors, LOVER can leverage unlabeled examples and is directly compatible with any offthe-shelf LLMs. Experiments on 10 datasetsdemonstrate that LOVER significantly outperforms unsupervised baselines, achieving performance comparable to the supervised verifier(reaching its 95% level on average). TL;DR: 本文提出 TextPro-SLM，把语音大模型（SLM）的模态鸿沟问题从"输出侧"转向"输入侧"解决：让语音输入在形式上尽可能接近一个"韵律感知（prosody-aware）的文本 LLM"的输入。核心是两部分——WhisperPro 统一语音编码器（同步输出文本 token 与逐 token 对齐的韵律 embedding，通过 mel 重建损失逼迫编码器保留"怎么说"的声学细节）和一个经知识蒸馏 + 副语言训练后的 Qwen2.5-3B/7B 骨干。实验显示其在 3B/7B 上取得所有对比 SLM 中最低的平均模态鸿沟（7B 为 0.7%），在情感/性别/年龄/口音等副语言任务上达到最佳（65.8%），且仅需约 1000 小时音频完成 LLM 训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音大模型（SLM）通常由文本大模型（TLM）检查点继续训练而来，但即使共享骨干，语音问答性能相比其文本问答仍显著落后，即存在"模态鸿沟"（modality gap），如 GLM-4-Voice 在多个 QA 基准上最多下降 20%。已有工作主要在"输出侧"改进：早期 SLM 直接生成语音 token；随后先生成中间文本再生成语音 token；再发展为"thinker-talker"架构（LLM 只出文本，独立 talker 依据 thinker 隐状态合成语音）。这些工作呈现出规律——生成过程越接近 TLM 的交互范式，性能越好——但仍未消除鸿沟。作者由此推断：剩余瓶颈主要在输入侧。在 thinker-talker 设计下输出侧已趋近文本式生成，而根本难点在于 SLM 必须同时从语音表示中推断语言内容与副语言线索，而这些表示并非以 LLM 能充分利用的形式呈现。据此提出核心思路：把语音显式分解为"说了什么（what）"与"怎么说的（how）"，让 SLM 的输入尽可能等同于一个韵律感知文本 LLM 的输入。

Method: 两阶段架构。（1）WhisperPro 编码器：以 Whisper-large-v3 为骨干，取第 16 层解码器隐状态作为逐 token 对齐的韵律 embedding P∈R^{N×d}，与自回归生成的文本 token y 组成两路同步流 {(y_i, p_i)}；附加 mel 重建器（token 嵌入与韵律向量拼接后经线性+LN+GELU+Dropout 融合块，加正弦位置编码送入 Transformer 编码器，再由带可学习帧查询的 Transformer 解码器通过交叉注意力重建 3000 帧、128 维 mel 谱）。训练损失 L = L_ASR + λ·L_mel（λ=1.0），数据为 LibriSpeech 960h（配 LibriSpeech-PC 标点转写）+ Kokoro TTS 合成的 CommonsenseQA 40h，2 epoch、bs16、lr 1e-5、线性衰减 500 步预热。（2）韵律感知 LLM：以 Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct 为骨干。输入组织两种策略——global prepending（韵律 embedding 平均池化后经两层 MLP 投影置于文本最前）与 interleaving（按插入比 r=5:1 将韵律序列分组平均后与文本 token 交错插入）。训练数据分两类：语义能力保持（UltraChat 1/10 共 255h 与 CommonsenseQA 40h 经 Kokoro TTS 转语音，WhisperPro 转写后查询原 TLM 教师得到监督目标，进行知识蒸馏）与副语言理解（ParaSpeechCaps 342h 语音描述；IEMOCAP/CREMA-D/SAVEE/TESS/ESD 用于情感，Common Voice 前 1/4 用于年龄）。两阶段训练：Stage 1 仅训投影器、冻结 LLM（lr 1e-4）；Stage 2 联合训练（lr 1e-5）；各 2 epoch，全局 bs 1024，线性衰减无预热。LLM 训练音频约 989.6h，WhisperPro 约 1000h。蒸馏消融显示最终采用 ASRQ_ASRA（学生输入与教师条件均为 ASR 转写）与纯交叉熵（α=0）。评测采用 VoiceBench/Spoken StoryCloze/PIQA/ARC 等六个语义基准计算模态鸿沟，AIR-Bench 副语言集，另自建 1000 条四选一口音基准，并额外评测 VoxEval 数学推理任务。

Result: WhisperPro 单独评测：LibriSpeech WER 1.96%（Whisper-large-v3 为 4.43%），GigaSpeech 12.89%（13.66%）；韵律 embedding 探针在 SER/SI/F0/Energy 上 2 层 MLP 平均 69.63/87.84/50.34/36.56，显著优于原 Whisper 的 41.02/60.67/34.09/18.35。语义基准：TextPro-SLM-7B 平均准确率 82.5%、平均模态鸿沟 0.7%（SALAD-7B 为 7.1%、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 为 3.1%、Kimi-Audio-7B 为 3.5%）；3B 规模鸿沟 2.6%，低于 SALAD-3B 的 4.8%。推理任务（VoxEval）：TextPro-SLM-7B 三档数学平均鸿沟 5.0%（高中数学仅 3.5%），远优于 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 的 19.7% 与 Kimi-Audio-7B 的 29.2%。副语言任务：TextPro-SLM-7B 平均 64.8%（情感 60.5/性别 88.6/年龄 64.9/口音 45.1），5:1 交错版 65.8%，均优于所有基线。消融：去掉重建目标语义鸿沟升至 0.9% 而副语言降至 53.2%；去掉副语言训练副语言骤降至 35.0%；去掉知识蒸馏语义平均降至 69.9%（鸿沟 13.3%）；直接用 WhisperPro 转写喂 Qwen2.5-7B 也能到 79.7%（鸿沟 3.6%），说明语义主要来自转写接口与蒸馏，韵律 embedding 提供互补的非词汇信息。设计敏感性分析显示第 4/16/30 层与 λ∈{0.5,1,2} 结果基本稳定。

Conclusion: 从输入侧缩小模态鸿沟是构建更强 SLM 的可行且数据高效的路径：把语音表示做成"文本 token + 紧凑韵律 embedding"这种与 TLM 原生输入同构的形式，可使文本—语音对齐更直接、所需适配数据更少（约 1000 小时音频，而 DrVoice 约 56K 小时）。TextPro-SLM 在 3B/7B 上取得对比 SLM 中最低的平均模态鸿沟，并在副语言理解上达到领先，验证了"让语音 LLM 成为韵律感知文本 LLM"这一主张。局限：不训练/评测语音合成模块（评测均基于文本输出）；副语言属性覆盖有限（情感突变、混合情感、说话意图等未涵盖），结果应视为概念验证；Whisper 骨干不支持流式推理，串行处理带来额外延迟；仅支持 30 秒以内语音（Whisper 上下文窗口限制）；框架难以直接扩展到非语音音频（提出可用占位 token 交由声学流承载信息的可能方向）。

Abstract: Speech large language models (SLMs) are typically built from text large language model (TLM) checkpoints, yet they still suffer from a substantial modality gap. Experiments show that TextPro-SLM achieves the lowest modality gap among leading SLMs at both 3B and 7B scales, while also delivering strong overall performance on paralinguistic understanding tasks.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成文本在多媒体内容审核（图文评论、视频字幕、多模态论文描述）场景中的真实性识别日益重要。现有方法主要依赖 token 级似然/秩统计量（perplexity、entropy、likelihood）或特定模型的启发式特征，在生成模型更换、领域迁移、后编辑改写以及为匹配视觉上下文而调整文本时性能显著退化；监督式微调分类器（如 GPTZero、RoBERTa）存在域偏移与跨模型泛化差的问题；DetectGPT、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars、RAIDAR 等扰动/重写类方法仅把改写当作分数聚合手段，仍耦合全局似然统计，无法刻画细粒度风格行为，也忽略跨模态语义约束。此外，多数方法把文本视为整体单元，难以解释风格在保义变换下如何变化。因此论文提出两个研究问题：RQ1 如何在不使用重型模型的前提下对对抗性操纵保持鲁棒；RQ2 如何在统计特征失效时提升跨领域与多媒体衍生文本场景的泛化能力。

Method: 1) 形式化：定义多模态引导的改写算子 M_I 在提示集 P 下将输入对 (I, x) 映射为 K 个保义变体，并以与原句的语义相似度阈值 δ 过滤离题改写，构造"改写诱导文本空间"。2) 多层级风格一致性剖析：离散信号 s_D 包含跨 n∈[n1,n2] 范围的归一化 n-gram Jaccard 稳定性 s_N 与基于 Levenshtein 距离的归一化编辑稳定性 s_E；连续信号 s_C 用共享编码器 ξ（默认 SBERT）池化后计算归一化角距离 1-(1/π)arccos(余弦相似度)。3) 聚合：v(x)=mean over variants [α·s_D ⊕ β·s_C]，维度与改写数 K 无关，天然轻量。4) 检测规则：z=f_θ(v(x))，ŷ=I[σ(z)≥τ]，分类器为带早停的梯度提升树（避免大型端到端模型与特定生成器依赖）。5) 理论：定理 2 假设两类条件期望逐坐标满足 E[v|y=1]-E[v|y=0] ⪰ ε·1，证明取 θ=1 的线性打分可获得 Δ=dε>0 的期望正间隔，支撑可分性。6) 算法 1 将改写生成、稳定性测量、决策三阶段解耦，便于嵌入实时审核流水线。实验使用 GPT-3.5-Turbo 作改写模型，与 6 个基线（Entropy/Rank/LogRank、RoBERTa-base/large、DetectGPT、Ghostbuster、Fast-DetectGPT、RAIDAR、R-Detect）在统一协议下对比。

Result: 域内检测（表1，AUROC）：LiSCP 在 6 个域平均最优，视觉新闻 0.9746、MM-IMDb 0.9576 明显领先全部基线（R-Detect 0.9650/0.7048、Fast-DetectGPT 0.9173/0.6446），论文摘要 0.9455、Yelp 0.8718 亦领先或持平，代码域略低于 RAIDAR（0.8108 vs 0.8173），新闻域略低于 R-Detect（0.9356 vs 0.9817）。RAID 基准（表2）：6 个混合/攻击配置中 LiSCP 在 Mix1(0.8957)、Mix3(0.7813)、Att1(0.8268)、Att3(0.7608) 最优，Att2 略低于 Fast-DetectGPT。跨域泛化（表3）：所有源域的 OOD-Avg F1 均最高，相比最优基线提升最高达 11.79%（摘要 0.340→0.434）。鲁棒性：TextAttack 式字符交换/插入、同义替换、句级改写（≤20% token）下 LiSCP 的 AUROC 降幅最小，DetectGPT、Ghostbuster 在 Yelp 与代码域明显崩塌；4:1 人机混合文档中 LiSCP 仍最优且降幅最小。解释性：UMAP 显示人写/机器样本在六个域清晰分离（学生作文最干净）；KL 散度与 Hellinger 距离显示分类器输出 σ(ŷ) 的可分性高于原始特征 v(x)，说明梯度提升树学到了非线性边界。消融（表4）：编码器可插拔，TF-IDF→Word2Vec/GloVe→BERT→SBERT 性能递增，SBERT 平均最佳，即使纯统计 TF-IDF 仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: LiSCP 通过把 LLM 文本检测重构为"保义操纵下的风格一致性推断"，用改写变体间的稳定性模式替代脆弱的措辞/似然伪影，兼顾轻量、可解释与鲁棒：域内与跨域（最高 +11.79%）性能领先，在对抗扰动、混合人机写作、跨生成器与多模态图文/影视场景下均保持稳定，且可与任意语义编码器即插即用，便于集成进实时多媒体审核流水线。局限在于仍依赖 LLM 改写调用带来的推理开销（"轻量"主要指下游分类器轻量）、阈值 δ 与 α/β 的经验选取，以及理论假设（逐坐标期望优势）仅给出行性打分下的期望间隔而非严格分类保证；此外跨域评测基于 F1 与阈值扫描，对生成模型族（主实验多为 GPT-3.5-Turbo）的覆盖有限。

Abstract: The increasing prevalence of Large Language Models (LLMs) in content creation has made distinguishing human-written textual content from LLM-generated counterparts a critical task for multimedia moderation. Existing detectors often rely on statistical cues or model-specific heuristics, making them vulnerable to paraphrasing and adversarial manipulations, and consequently limiting their robustness and interpretability. In this work, we proposeLiSCP , a novel lightweight stylistic consistency profiling method for robust detection of LLM-generated textual content, focusing on feature stability under adversarial manipulation. Our approach constructs a consistency profile that combines discrete stylistic features with continuous semantic signals, leveraging stylistic stability across multimodal-guided paraphrased text variants. Experiments spanning real-world multimedia news and movie datasets and conventional text domains demonstrate that LiSCP achieves superior performance on in-domain detection and outperforms existing approaches by up to 11.79% in cross-domain settings. Additionally,it demonstrates notable robustness under adversarial scenarios, including adversarial attacks and hybrid human-AI settings.

</details>


### [24] [Hallucination as an Anomaly: Dynamic Intervention via Probabilistic Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05953)
*Erik Nielsen,Elia Cunegatti,Marcus Vukojevic,Giovanni Iacca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PCNET uses Probabilistic Circuits to detect LLM hallucinations via geometric anomaly detection on the factual manifold, enabling selective correction only when needed through PC-LDCD decoding, achieving state-of-the-art results while preserving correct generations.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing hallucination correction methods apply corrections indiscriminately to every token, corrupting originally correct generations. There's a need for methods that can distinguish between hallucinated and correct content to preserve accurate generations.

Method: PCNET uses Probabilistic Circuits as tractable density estimators over LLM residual stream, detecting hallucinations as geometric anomalies via exact Negative Log-Likelihood computation without sampling, external verifiers, or weight modifications. PC-LDCD operates as a dynamic gate distinguishing hallucinated from factual hidden states at each decoding step.

Result: Across 4 LLMs (1B-8B) and 4 benchmarks: (1) Near-perfect hallucination detection on CoQA, SQuAD v2.0, TriviaQA with AUROC up to 99%; (2) Highest True+Info, MC2, MC3 scores on TruthfulQA in 3/4 models; (3) Mean corruption rate reduced to 53.7%; (4) Preservation rate of 79.3%.

Conclusion: PCNET achieves near-perfect hallucination detection (AUROC up to 99%) and PC-LDCD obtains state-of-the-art results on TruthfulQA while reducing corruption rate to 53.7% and maintaining 79.3% preservation rate. Code publicly available on GitHub.

Abstract: One of the most critical challenges in Large Language Models is their tendency to hallucinate, i.e., produce factually incorrect responses. Existing approaches show promising results in terms of hallucination correction, but still suffer from a main limitation: they apply corrections indiscriminately to every token, corrupting also the originally correct generations. To overcome this drawback, we propose PCNET, a Probabilistic Circuit trained as a tractable density estimator over the LLM residual stream. The method detects hallucinations as geometric anomalies on the factual manifold, which is done via exact Negative Log-Likelihood computation, hence without the need for sampling, external verifiers, or weight modifications, as in existing techniques. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we exploit PCNET as a dynamic gate that distinguishes hallucinated from factual hidden states at each decoding step. This triggers our second main contribution, PC-LDCD (Probabilistic Circuit Latent Density Contrastive Decoding), only when the latent geometry deviates from factual regions, while leaving correct generations untouched. Across four LLMs, ranging from 1B to 8B models, and four benchmarks covering conversational reasoning, knowledge-intensive QA, reading comprehension, and truthfulness, PCNET achieves near-perfect hallucination detection across CoQA, SQuAD v2.0, and TriviaQA, with AUROC reaching up to 99%. Moreover, PC-LDCD obtains the highest True+Info, MC2, and MC3 scores on TruthfulQA in three out of four models, in comparison with state-of-the-art baselines, while reducing the mean corruption rate to 53.7% and achieving a preservation rate of 79.3%. Our proposed method is publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [25] [TableVista: Benchmarking Multimodal Table Reasoning under Visual and Structural Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05955)
*Zheyuan Yang,Liqiang Shang,Junjie Chen,Xun Yang,Chenglong Xu,Bo Yuan,Chenyuan Jiao,Yaoru Sun,Yilun Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TableVista是一个用于评估多模态表格推理能力的大规模基准测试，包含3,000道表格推理题，每题扩展为10种视觉变体，共30,000个多模态样本。对29个前沿模型的评测表明，当前模型在复杂结构布局和纯视觉设置下表现明显下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态基础模型在表格推理任务上的能力评估缺乏系统性基准，特别是视觉复杂性和结构复杂性对模型性能的影响尚未被充分研究。

Method: 构建了TableVista基准测试，通过多风格渲染和变换管道将每道表格推理题扩展为10种不同的视觉变体，涵盖多种场景风格、抗扰动鲁棒性测试和纯视觉配置，最终生成30,000个多模态样本。

Result: 评测的29个模型在多样化渲染风格下保持相对稳定，但在复杂结构布局和纯视觉设置下出现显著性能下降，表明模型难以在结构复杂度与视觉整合呈现结合时保持推理一致性。

Conclusion: TableVista揭示了当前多模态表格理解模型的的关键能力缺口，为开发更鲁棒可靠的表格理解模型提供了重要洞察和评估依据。

Abstract: We introduce TableVista, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating foundation models in multimodal table reasoning under visual and structural complexity. TableVista consists of 3,000 high-quality table reasoning problems, where each instance is expanded into 10 distinct visual variants through our multi-style rendering and transformation pipeline. This process encompasses diverse scenario styles, robustness perturbations, and vision-only configurations, culminating in 30,000 multimodal samples for a multi-dimensional evaluation. We conduct an extensive evaluation of 29 state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary foundation models on TableVista. Through comprehensive quantitative and qualitative analysis, we find that while evaluated models remain largely stable across diverse rendering styles, they exhibit pronounced performance degradation on complex structural layouts and vision-only settings, revealing that current models struggle to maintain reasoning consistency when structural complexity combines with visually integrated presentations. These findings highlight critical gaps in current multimodal capabilities, providing insights for advancing more robust and reliable table understanding models.

</details>


### [26] [GATHER: Convergence-Centric Hyper-Entity Retrieval for Zero-Shot Cell-Type Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06403)
*Zhonghui Zhang,Feng Jiang,Shaowei Qin,Jiahao Zhao,Min Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出GATHER框架，通过全局图遍历识别收敛节点来压缩多基因协同信号，以单次LLM调用实现细胞类型注释最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于知识图的RAG方法依赖迭代式LLM推理和局部实体探索策略，但细胞注释查询涉及数十至数百个基因的组合，单一基因无法决定结果，标签仅从基因的协同共现中涌现。这种"超实体查询"从根本上挑战了局部探索策略，导致可扩展性差和LLM成本高昂。

Method: GATHER执行全局多源图遍历，识别拓扑收敛点（可从多个输入基因共同到达的节点），并通过节点和路径重要性评分选择信息证据，整个检索过程无需LLM参与，仅在最后使用单次LLM调用进行推理。

Result: 在Immune和Lung两个数据集上，GATHER以仅1次LLM调用（基线需2-61次）实现了最高精确匹配准确率（27.45%和59.64%），显著优于ToG、ToG-2、RoG、PoG等强基线方法。

Conclusion: GATHER通过收敛节点将多实体信号压缩为紧凑、高信息量的证据，为局部实体推理提供了高效的全局替代方案，在细胞类型注释任务中实现了精度与效率的最佳平衡。

Abstract: Zero-shot single-cell cell-type annotation aims to determine a cell's type from a given set of expressed genes without any training. Existing knowledge-graph-based RAG approaches retrieve evidence by expanding from source entities and relying on iterative LLM reasoning. However, in this setting each query contains tens to hundreds of genes, where no single gene is decisive and the label emerges only from their collective co-occurrence. Such hyper-entity queries fundamentally challenge local, entity-wise exploration strategies, which reason from individual genes, leading to poor scalability and substantial LLM cost. We propose GATHER (Graph-Aware Traversal with Hyper-Entity Retrieval), a convergence-centric retriever tailored to hyper-entity queries. It performs global multi-source graph traversal and identifies topological convergence points -- nodes jointly reachable from many input genes. These convergence nodes act as high-information hyper-entities that capture entity synergy. By incorporating node- and path-importance scoring, GATHER selects informative evidence entirely without LLM involvement during retrieval. Instantiated on a self-constructed cell-centric biological knowledge graph (VCKG), GATHER outperforms strong KG-RAG baselines (ToG, ToG-2, RoG, PoG) on two datasets (Immune and Lung), achieving the highest exact-match accuracy (27.45% and 59.64%) with only a single LLM call per sample, compared to 2--61 calls for KG-RAG baselines. Our results demonstrate that convergence nodes compress multi-entity signals into compact, high-information evidence that conveys more per item than multi-hop paths, providing an efficient global alternative to local entity-wise reasoning.

</details>


### [27] [Tatarstan Toponyms: A Bilingual Dataset and Hybrid RAG System for Geospatial Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05962)
*Mullosharaf K. Arabov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出多语言地理空间问答系统，构建了鞑靼斯坦共和国双语地名数据集（9,688条，93.1%已地理编码）及约39,000条问答语料库。混合检索器融合语义向量与地理空间索引，在500条测试queries上达成Recall@1=0.988、MRR=0.994；XLM-RoBERTa-large阅读器达EM=0.992、F1=0.994。RuBERT坐标对齐问题可通过简单后处理完全修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言地区的地理空间问答存在数据稀疏、跨语言语义对齐困难、地理编码与文本理解融合不足等挑战；现有方法缺乏针对多语言地名数据的端到端问答解决方案，尤其在坐标精确性要求高的场景下表现不佳。

Method: （1）构建含9,688条记录的双语地名数据集，融合语言学、词源学、行政区划及坐标信息；（2）基于该数据集生成约39,000条问答三元组；（3）混合检索器结合稠密语义索引（multilingual-e5-large）与KD树/半正矢距离的地理空间过滤；（4）评测RuBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-large、T5-RUS三种阅读器架构，通过后处理消除数值对齐偏差。

Result: 混合检索在500条测试queries上显著优于BM25及纯空间方法（Recall@1=0.988, Recall@5=1.000, MRR=0.994）；XLM-RoBERTa-large表现最佳（EM=0.992, F1=0.994）；RuBERT在坐标问题上F1=0，但后处理后恢复至100%准确率。

Conclusion: 研究构建了完整的开源地理空间问答解决方案，在多语言地名数据上实现了接近SOTA的性能表现，且所有资源均公开发布。应用场景涵盖地理空间问答服务、地理编码及多语言地区的数字人文研究。RuBERT模型在坐标类问题上存在数值对齐缺陷，但后处理可完全修复。

Abstract: This paper addresses automatic geospatial question answering over multilingual toponymic data. An original bilingual dataset of toponyms of the Republic of Tatarstan is introduced, comprising 9,688 structured records with linguistic, etymological, administrative, and coordinate information (93.1% georeferenced). Based on this dataset, a question-answering corpus of approximately 39,000 question-context-answer triples is constructed with guaranteed answer localization. A hybrid retriever integrates dense semantic indexing (multilingual-e5-large) with geospatial filtering via KD-trees and haversine distance. On 500 test queries, the hybrid search achieves Recall@1=0.988, Recall@5=1.000, and MRR=0.994, significantly outperforming BM25 and purely spatial methods. Among tested reader architectures (RuBERT, XLM-RoBERTa-large, T5-RUS), XLM-RoBERTa-large attains the best quality: EM=0.992, F1=0.994. On raw outputs, RuBERT models fail on coordinate questions (F1=0) while XLM-RoBERTa-large reaches F1=0.984; however, simple post-processing eliminates numerical gaps and restores RuBERT accuracy to 100%. This discrepancy stems from tokenization differences and pre-training corpora composition. All resources (dataset, QA corpus, model weights, web demo) are openly published on Hugging Face. Results apply to geospatial QA services, geocoding, and digital humanities in multilingual regions.

</details>


### [28] [From Articles to Premises: Building PrimeFacts, an Extraction Methodology and Resource for Fact-Checking Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06006)
*Premtim Sahitaj,Jawan Kolanowski,Ariana Sahitaj,Veronika Solopova,Max Upravitelev,Daniel Röder,Iffat Maab,Junichi Yamagishi,Sebastian Möller,Vera Schmitt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出了PrimeFacts框架，从13,106篇PolitiFact事实核查文章中提取结构化证据，利用LLMs将文内锚点句子去语境化为独立前提句。实验证明该方法在证据检索和判决预测任务上分别获得显著性能提升，为自动化事实核查提供了大规模资源支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事实核查文章包含丰富的支持性证据和推理过程，但这些证据以非结构化方式呈现，难以被自动化验证系统所利用。如何有效提取和结构化这些证据是推动自动化事实核查的关键挑战。

Method: 该方法首先从PolitiFact文章中识别49,718个文内超链接作为证据锚点，然后利用大语言模型(LLMs)将这些锚点句子改写为独立、语境无关的前提句，并探索提取隐含证据。评估分别在跨文章证据检索和声明验证两个任务上进行。

Result: 去语境化证据显著提升检索性能，相对提升高达30%的Mean Reciprocal Rank；用于判决预测时，Macro-F1提升10-20个百分点。这些提升在不同的判决粒度(2类 vs 5类)和模型架构上都保持一致。定性分析表明去语境化前提忠实于原始来源。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了从真实事实核查文章中提取结构化证据的可行性和价值，为自动化事实核查系统提供了重要的资源支持。实验结果表明，去语境化的证据提取方法可显著提升检索和判决预测性能，且具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Fact-checking articles encode rich supporting evidence and reasoning, yet this evidence remains largely inaccessible to automated verification systems due to unstructured presentation. We introduce PrimeFacts, a methodology and resource for extracting fine-grained evidence from full fact-checking articles. We compile 13,106 PolitiFact articles with claims, verdicts, and all referenced sources, and we identify 49,718 in-article hyperlinks as natural anchors to pinpoint key evidence. Our framework leverages large language models (LLMs) to rewrite these anchor sentences into stand-alone, context-independent premises and investigates the extraction of additional implicit evidence. In evaluations on cross-article evidence retrieval and claim verification, the extracted premises substantially improve performance. Decontextualized evidence yields higher retrievability, achieving up to a 30 percent relative gain in Mean Reciprocal Rank over verbatim sentences, and using the evidence for verdict prediction raises Macro-F1 by 10-20 points over the baseline. These gains are consistent across different verdict granularities (2-class vs. 5-class) and model architectures. A qualitative analysis indicates that the decontextualized premises remain faithful to the original sources. Our work highlights the promise of reusing fact-checkers' evidence for automation and provides a large-scale resource of structured evidence from real-world fact-checks.

</details>


### [29] [PersonaKit (PK): A Plug-and-Play Platform for User Testing Diverse Roles in Full-Duplex Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06007)
*Hyunbae Jeon,Jinho D. Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PersonaKit (PK) 是一个开源、低延迟的网页平台，把"话轮接管策略"变成可 JSON 配置的人格参数：可定义 persona、以概率矩阵将打断意图映射到 Yield/Resume/Bridge/Override 四种动作、自动部署 A/B 问卷并导出结构化日志。在 8 个职业 persona、5 名被试、120 次对话的先导实验中，不同人际环象限（Interpersonal Circumplex）偏好的打断策略不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工口语对话系统正从"助手"扩展到多样人格（权威教官、不配合的商人、心不在焉的厨师等），而现有系统默认"always-yield"（用户一插话就立刻让出话轮），严重破坏非顺从型角色的一致性与沉浸感。真人评测此类人格化话轮策略需要搭建实时全双工测试环境，涉及 WebRTC 音频、VAD、动态 LLM prompt 注入与延迟追踪，工程成本极高，因此需要一个即插即用的原型与评测平台。

Method: 架构：浏览器端 WebRTC 采麦 + 客户端音量门限 VAD，打断时停止本地播放并按字节级记录被截断文本（cutoff text）与剩余文本（remaining text）；服务器端 Flask + Socket.IO，先 ASR 转写用户话语，再用零样本 LLM 将打断意图分类为 Competitive / Cooperative / Topic Change / Backchannel；Turn-Taking Manager 读取 interruption_config.json 中的策略矩阵与概率权重，采样出动作并以控制标记（如 [STRATEGY=RESUME]）注入系统 prompt，即"先决策、后生成"。配置全部以四个 JSON 文件表达：persona.json（场景、角色、开场 prompt）、interruption_config.json（策略矩阵）、session_config.json（问卷）、model_config.json（LLM/TTS 路由与密钥）。会话以 MAX_TURNS 或 [EXIT] 标签终止，导出 transcript、事件日志（逐轮意图/策略/截断与剩余文本）与问卷结果。实验：N=5 被试，8 个按人际环象限平衡的职业 persona（每象限 2 个），每个 persona 三种随机被试内条件（A always-yield 基线；B 概率化 JSON 权重；C autonomous 零样本由 LLM 自选），LLM 与音色固定，条件顺序随机，合计 120 次对话；每个 persona 后填 {-1,0,+1} 比较式 Likert（反应自然度、人格一致性、交互流畅度）、强制选择偏好与自由文本；barge-in 端到端延迟约 1–2 s。

Result: Q1（高支配低共情，如 Drill Sergeant、Tavern Keeper）：自然度从 0.20（Yield）升至 0.60（Probabilistic），60% 偏好票给 Autonomous；Q2 偏好 Probabilistic（50%）；Q3（低支配高共情，如 AI Assistant、Librarian）70% 偏好 always-yield；Q4 偏好 Yield（50%）但最高自然度出现在 Probabilistic（0.67）。人格式反馈支持策略差异（如"他打断我时无视我，像真实的新兵训练"），原始日志显示 Always-Yield 会抹除的一致性恢复行为（教官 persona 在 Competitive+RESUME 下说完剩余"…again!"）。平台同时支持展示（SIGDIAL 现场 Grumpy Tavern Keeper vs Standard AI Assistant 切换）与四类扩展用途：人格原型迭代、自定义问卷、模型/音色对照实验、数据采集（作为打断策略监督学习或 RLHF 奖励模型的种子集）。

Conclusion: PK 将话轮接管策略提升为一等公民的 JSON 可配置人格参数，并把从部署、自动问卷到数据导出、实验记录的全流程自动化，是研究"社会语言学行为—用户感知"关系的可扩展测试床。先导结果提示最优策略随 persona 角色而变：权威/低共情 persona 受益于非让话策略，低支配高共情 persona 更偏好让话。局限：N=5 仅描述性、无推断统计，样本量与跨人口学复现不足；意图分类依赖未与人工标注校验的零样本 prompt，噪声语音下的简短 backchannel 易误判；四动作词汇未涵盖音高重置、latching、注视等细粒度韵律线索（为可配置性牺牲声学保真度）。

Abstract: As spoken dialogue systems expand beyond traditional assistant roles to encompass diverse personas -- such as authoritative instructors, uncooperative merchants, or distracted workers -- they require distinct, human-like turn-taking behaviors to maintain psychological immersion. However, current full-duplex systems often default to a rigid, overly accommodating ``always-yield'' policy during overlapping speech, which severely undermines character consistency for non-submissive roles. Evaluating alternative, persona-specific turn-taking strategies through empirical user studies is challenging because building real-time full-duplex test environments requires substantial engineering overhead. To address this, we present PersonaKit (PK), an open-source, low-latency web platform for the rapid prototyping and evaluation of conversational agents. Using intuitive JSON configurations, researchers can define personas, specify probabilistic interruption-handling behaviors (e.g., yield, hold, bridge, or override), and automatically deploy comparative A/B surveys. Through an in-the-wild evaluation with 8 distinct personas, we demonstrate that PersonaKit provides an extensible, end-to-end framework for studying complex sociolinguistic behaviors in next-generation spoken agents.

</details>

Abstract: This study contributes to a growing line of research in comparing LLM-generated texts with human-authored text, in this case, English news text. We focus in particular on the evaluation of syntactic properties through formal grammar frameworks. Our analysis compares two generations of LLMs in the context of two human-authored English news datasets from two different years. Employing the Head-Driven Phrase Structure Grammar (HPSG) formalism, we investigate the distributions of syntactic structures and lexical types of AI-generated texts and contrast them with the corresponding distributions in the human-authored New York Times (NYT) articles. We use diversity metrics from ecology and information theory to quantify variation in grammatical constructions and lexical types. We show that English news text has changed little in the given time frame, while newer LLMs display reduced syntactic and, especially, lexical diversity compared to older, non-instruction-tuned models. These findings point to future work in studying effects of instruction tuning, which, while enhancing coherence and adherence to prompts, may narrow the expressive range of model output.

### [31] [Navigating by Old Maps: The Pitfalls of Static Mechanistic Localization in LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06076)
*Hang Chen,Jiaying Zhu,Hongyang Chen,Hongxu Liu,Xinyu Yang,Wenya Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文挑战了大语言模型后训练中"先定位后更新"范式的基础假设。通过追踪Transformer电路在监督微调过程中的结构演化，发现电路存在"自由演化"特性，静态机制因时间延迟而不适合指导未来参数更新。研究引入电路距离、稳定性、冲突三个新指标，并呼吁在机制定位中引入"预见性"概念，提出了预测性框架的研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前"先定位后更新"的范式基于一个未经验证的假设：当前静态参数推导出的机制能否可靠地指导未来动态参数更新。

Method: 通过系统追踪Transformer电路在监督微调（SFT）过程中的结构演化，引入三个新指标：电路距离（衡量神经迁移）、电路稳定性（衡量语义稳定性）、电路冲突（衡量跨任务干扰），从三个维度分析电路演化规律。

Result: 实验揭示了电路在参数更新过程中存在"自由演化"特性，导致从当前状态提取的静态机制必然遭受时间延迟问题，使其本质上不适合指导未来状态。

Conclusion: 静态机制提取方法存在时间延迟问题，无法有效指导未来状态更新；该研究揭示了现有方法"有效性假象"的本质，并呼吁在机制定位中引入"预见性"概念，提出了预测性框架的研究方向。

Abstract: The "Locate-then-Update" paradigm has become a predominant approach in the post-training of large language models (LLMs), identifying critical components via mechanistic interpretability for targeted parameter updates. However, this paradigm rests on a fundamental yet unverified assumption: can mechanisms derived from current static parameters reliably guide future dynamic parameter updates? To investigate this, we systematically track the structural evolution of Transformer circuits throughout the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) process, revealing the underlying dynamics of task mechanisms. We introduce three novel metrics-Circuit Distance, Circuit Stability, and Circuit Conflict-to analyze circuit evolution across three dimensions: neural migration, semantic stability, and cross-task interference. Our empirical results reveal that circuits inherently exhibit "Free Evolution" during parameter updates. Consequently, static mechanisms extracted from current states inevitably suffer from temporal latency, making them fundamentally inadequate for guiding future states. Moreover, by deconstructing the "illusion of effectiveness" in existing methods, this work underscores the necessity of "foresight" in mechanistic localization and proposes a predictive framework for future research.

### [32] [Milestone-Guided Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06078)
*Zixuan Wang,Yuchen Yan,Hongxing Li,Teng Pan,Dingming Li,Ruiqing Zhang,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BEACON proposes a milestone-guided policy learning framework to train language agents for long-horizon tasks by addressing credit misattribution and sample inefficiency through milestone-based trajectory partitioning, temporal reward shaping, and dual-scale advantage estimation, achieving 92.9% success rate on ALFWorld (vs 53.5% for GRPO) and 3.5x improvement in sample efficiency.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Training language agents for long-horizon agentic tasks with RL faces two fundamental challenges: (1) Credit misattribution - correct early actions are incorrectly penalized due to terminal failures, and (2) Sample inefficiency - scarce successful trajectories result in near-total loss of learning signal.

Method: BEACON (Milestone-Guided Policy Learning Framework) leverages the compositional structure of long-horizon tasks through three key mechanisms: (1) Trajectory partitioning at milestone boundaries, (2) Temporal reward shaping within segments to credit partial progress, and (3) Dual-scale advantage estimation to prevent distant failures from corrupting local action evaluation.

Result: On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld benchmarks, BEACON consistently outperforms GRPO and GiGPO. Specifically, on long-horizon ALFWorld tasks: 92.9% success rate (vs GRPO's 53.5%), and effective sample utilization improved from 23.7% to 82.0%.

Conclusion: Milestone-anchored credit assignment is established as an effective paradigm for training long-horizon language agents. BEACON effectively addresses both credit misattribution and sample inefficiency problems in long-horizon RL training.

Abstract: While long-horizon agentic tasks require language agents to perform dozens of sequential decisions, training such agents with reinforcement learning remains challenging. We identify two root causes: credit misattribution, where correct early actions are penalized due to terminal failures, and sample inefficiency, where scarce successful trajectories result in near-total loss of learning signal. We introduce a milestone-guided policy learning framework, BEACON, that leverages the compositional structure of long-horizon tasks to ensure precise credit assignment. BEACON partitions trajectories at milestone boundaries, applies temporal reward shaping within segments to credit partial progress, and estimates advantages at dual scales to prevent distant failures from corrupting the evaluation of local actions. On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, BEACON consistently outperforms GRPO and GiGPO. Notably, on long-horizon ALFWorld tasks, BEACON achieves 92.9% success rate, nearly doubling GRPO's 53.5%, while improving effective sample utilization from 23.7% to 82.0%. These results establish milestone-anchored credit assignment as an effective paradigm for training long-horizon language agents. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/BEACON.

</details>

*Shu Wu,Xiaotian Ye,Xinyu Mou,Dongsheng Liu,Xiaohan Wang,Mengqi Zhang*

TL;DR: 论文发现多模态知识编辑后模型存在"实体身份混淆"（EIC）问题：文本-only查询原实体时错误返回新实体信息。根本原因在于现有方法未能区分图像-实体绑定与实体-实体关系知识，导致模型将E-E关联作为捷径。通过将编辑约束在I-E处理阶段可有效缓解此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态知识编辑（MKE）旨在修正大视觉-语言模型部署后的内部知识，但编辑后模型的行为模式尚缺乏充分探索

Method: 构建EC-Bench诊断基准，直接探测图像-实体绑定在编辑前后的变化；探索将编辑约束在I-E处理阶段的缓解策略

Result: 发现现有方法未能区分I-E绑定与E-E（实体-实体）关系知识，导致模型将E-E关联作为捷径过度拟合；将编辑约束在I-E阶段可显著减少EIC

Conclusion: 约束编辑操作作用于模型的I-E（图像-实体）处理阶段，可显著减少EIC问题；为未来MKE研究提供了原则性需求和方法论指导

Abstract: Multimodal knowledge editing (MKE) aims to correct the internal knowledge of large vision-language models after deployment, yet the behavioral patterns of post-edit models remain underexplored. In this paper, we identify a systemic failure mode in edited models, termed Entity Identity Confusion (EIC): edited models exhibit an absurd behavior where text-only queries about the original entity's identity unexpectedly return information about the new entity. To rigorously investigate EIC, we construct EC-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly probes how image-entity bindings shift before and after editing. Our analysis reveals that EIC stems from existing methods failing to distinguish between Image-Entity (I-E) binding and Entity-Entity (E-E) relational knowledge in the model, causing models to overfit E-E associations as a shortcut: the image is still perceived as the original entity, with the new entity's name serving only as a spurious identity label. We further explore potential mitigation strategies, showing that constraining edits to the model's I-E processing stage encourages edits to act more faithfully on I-E binding, thereby substantially reducing EIC. Based on these findings, we discuss principled desiderata for faithful MKE and provide methodological guidance for future research.

</details>

*Chunyu Li,Jingyi Kang,Ding Chen,Mengyuan Zhang,Jiajun Shen,Bo Tang,Xuanhe Zhou,Feiyu Xiong,Zhiyu Li*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前"检索-重排序"两阶段范式中的通用重排序模型依赖语义相似度匹配，缺乏真正的推理能力，导致召回结果语义相关但无法有效回答问题。具体表现为：1) 相关性分数校准不当，难以阈值过滤；2) 时序约束、因果推理等复杂查询时排名退化；3) 无法利用对话上下文进行语义消歧。

Method: 基于Qwen3-Reranker构建，通过三阶段LLM知识蒸馏：1) 多教师成对比较生成校准的软标签；2) BCE点态蒸馏建立良好分布的分数；3) InfoNCE对比学习增强难例区分能力。训练数据融合通用语料与记忆专用多轮对话数据，覆盖时序约束、因果推理和指代消解场景。

Result: MemReranker-0.6B在记忆检索基准上大幅超越BGE-Reranker，并匹配开源4B/8B模型及GPT-4o-mini的关键指标。MemReranker-4B进一步达到0.737 MAP，多项指标与Gemini-3-Flash持平，推理延迟仅为大模型的10-20%。在金融、医疗垂直领域基准上保持良好泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该模型成功解决了记忆检索场景下的重排序难题，通过知识蒸馏将LLM的推理能力迁移至轻量级模型，在保持高性能的同时实现了高效的推理效率，具备良好的领域泛化能力。

Abstract: In agent memory systems, the reranking model serves as the critical bridge connecting user queries with long-term memory. Most systems adopt the "retrieve-then-rerank" two-stage paradigm, but generic reranking models rely on semantic similarity matching and lack genuine reasoning capabilities, leading to a problem where recalled results are semantically highly relevant yet do not contain the key information needed to answer the question. This deficiency manifests in memory scenarios as three specific problems. First, relevance scores are miscalibrated, making threshold-based filtering difficult. Second, ranking degrades when facing temporal constraints, causal reasoning, and other complex queries. Third, the model cannot leverage dialogue context for semantic disambiguation. This report introduces MemReranker, a reranking model family (0.6B/4B) built on Qwen3-Reranker through multi-stage LLM knowledge distillation. Multi-teacher pairwise comparisons generate calibrated soft labels, BCE pointwise distillation establishes well-distributed scores, and InfoNCE contrastive learning enhances hard-sample discrimination. Training data combines general corpora with memory-specific multi-turn dialogue data covering temporal constraints, causal reasoning, and coreference resolution. On the memory retrieval benchmark, MemReranker-0.6B substantially outperforms BGE-Reranker and matches open-source 4B/8B models as well as GPT-4o-mini on key metrics. MemReranker-4B further achieves 0.737 MAP, with several metrics on par with Gemini-3-Flash, while maintaining inference latency at only 10--20\% of large models. On finance and healthcare vertical-domain benchmarks, the models preserve generalization capabilities on par with mainstream large-parameter rerankers.

</details>

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出IRC-Bench基准用于评估回忆录转录文本中的隐式实体识别任务，针对实体识别线索分散于多个非连续子句的非局部性问题。基准包含25,136个样本，来自11个主题领域的1,994份转录文本。实验表明QLoRA微调的Llama 3.1 8B在开放世界设置下表现最佳，而微调DPR在封闭世界检索中领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Implicit entity references in reminiscence narratives rely on contextual cues rather than explicit names, requiring inference from dispersed narrative evidence—differing from standard NER, entity linking, or coreference resolution tasks which focus on local mentions.

Method: Constructed 25,136 samples from 12,337 Wiki-data-linked entities across 1,994 transcripts in 11 thematic domains. Each sample pairs Entity-Grounded Narratives (explicit entity mentions) with Entity-Elided Narratives (direct mentions removed). Evaluated 19 configurations across LLM generation, dense retrieval, RAG, and fine-tuning approaches.

Result: Open-world setting: QLoRA-adapted Llama 3.1 8B最佳 (38.94% EM; 51.59% Jaccard). Closed-world retrieval: fine-tuned DPR领先 (35.38% Hit@1; 71.49% Hit@10).

Abstract: When people recount personal memories, they often refer to people, places, and events indirectly, relying on contextual cues rather than explicit names. Such implicit references are central to reminiscence narratives: first-person accounts of lived experience used in therapeutic, archival, and social settings. They pose a difficult computational problem because the intended entity must be inferred from dispersed narrative evidence rather than from a local mention. We introduce IRC-Bench, the Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, for evaluating implicit entity recognition in reminiscence transcripts. The benchmark targets non-locality: entity-identifying cues are distributed across multiple, non-contiguous clauses, unlike named entity recognition, entity linking, or coreference resolution. IRC-Bench comprises 25,136 samples constructed from 12,337 Wiki-data-linked entities across 1,994 transcripts spanning 11 thematic domains. Each sample pairs an Entity-Grounded Narrative, in which the target entity is explicitly mentioned, with an Entity-Elided Narrative, in which direct mentions are removed. We evaluate 19 configurations across LLM generation, dense retrieval, RAG, and fine-tuning. QLoRA-adapted Llama 3.1 8B performs best in the open-world setting (38.94% exact match; 51.59% Jaccard), while fine-tuned DPR leads closed-world retrieval (35.38% Hit@1; 71.49% Hit@10). We release IRC-Bench with data, code, and evaluation tools.

</details>


### [36] [HNC: Leveraging Hard Negative Captions towards Models with Fine-Grained Visual-Linguistic Comprehension Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06157)
*Esra Dönmez,Pascal Tilli,Hsiu-Yu Yang,Thang Vu,Carina Silberer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Hard Negative Captions (HNC)，一个包含欺骗性困难负样本的自动生成数据集，用于改进图像-文本匹配(ITM)任务中的细粒度跨模态理解。实验表明，基于HNC训练的模型在零样本检测、噪声鲁棒性和下游微调初始化方面均表现出显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current Image-Text-Matching (ITM) methods suffer from weak associations in web-collected image-text pairs, which limits models' ability to achieve fine-grained understanding of cross-modal semantics.

Method: The paper proposes two key contributions: (1) Hard Negative Captions (HNC), an automatically generated dataset containing foiled hard negative captions for training; (2) A manually-created test set for benchmarking models on fine-grained cross-modal mismatch with varying complexity levels.

Result: Training on HNC significantly improves: (1) zero-shot capabilities in detecting mismatches on diagnostic tasks; (2) robustness under noisy visual input scenarios; (3) comparable or superior performance as initialization for fine-tuning compared to baseline models.

Conclusion: HNC provides a robust solution for improving fine-grained cross-modal comprehension, with models showing improved zero-shot capabilities and robust performance under noisy conditions. HNC serves as a strong initialization for downstream fine-tuning tasks.

Abstract: Image-Text-Matching (ITM) is one of the defacto methods of learning generalized representations from a large corpus in Vision and Language (VL). However, due to the weak association between the web-collected image-text pairs, models fail to show a fine-grained understanding of the combined semantics of these modalities. To address this issue we propose Hard Negative Captions (HNC): an automatically created dataset containing foiled hard negative captions for ITM training towards achieving fine-grained cross-modal comprehension in VL. Additionally, we provide a challenging manually-created test set for benchmarking models on a fine-grained cross-modal mismatch task with varying levels of compositional complexity. Our results show the effectiveness of training on HNC by improving the models' zero-shot capabilities in detecting mismatches on diagnostic tasks and performing robustly under noisy visual input scenarios. ### [37] [A$^2$TGPO: Agentic Turn-Group Policy Optimization with Adaptive Turn-level Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06200)
*Dingwei Chen,Zefang Zong,Zhipeng Ma,Leo Luo,Yang Li,Chengming Li,Peng Chen,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对agentic LLM强化学习中多轮交互的信用分配问题，提出A²TGPO方法，通过turn-group normalization、variance-rescaled discounted accumulation和adaptive turn-level clipping三个技术改进，解决了传统IG信号在归一化、累积和裁剪方面的系统性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有agentic LLM的强化学习方法面临过程信用分配难题：依赖外部过程奖励模型增加开销，树结构rollout限制轨迹多样性；而直接使用Information Gain作为内在信号存在归一化失真、优势量级漂移、固定裁剪不适配等问题。
