Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable success under the autoregressive paradigm, yet high-quality text generation need not be tied to a fixed left-to-right order. Existing alternatives still struggle to jointly achieve generation efficiency, scalable representation learning, and effective global semantic modeling. We propose Cola DLM, a hierarchical latent diffusion language model that frames text generation through hierarchical information decomposition. Cola DLM first learns a stable text-to-latent mapping with a Text VAE, then models a global semantic prior in continuous latent space with a block-causal DiT, and finally generates text through conditional decoding. From a unified Markov-path perspective, its diffusion process performs latent prior transport rather than token-level observation recovery, thereby separating global semantic organization from local textual realization. This design yields a more flexible non-autoregressive inductive bias, supports semantic compression and prior fitting in continuous space, and naturally extends to other continuous modalities. Through experiments spanning 4 research questions, 8 benchmarks, strictly matched ~2B-parameter autoregressive and LLaDA baselines, and scaling curves up to about 2000 EFLOPs, we identify an effective overall configuration of Cola DLM and verify its strong scaling behavior for text generation. Taken together, the results establish hierarchical continuous latent prior modeling as a principled alternative to strictly token-level language modeling, where generation quality and scaling behavior may better reflect model capability than likelihood, while also suggesting a concrete path toward unified modeling across discrete text and continuous modalities.

</details>


### [61] [Long Context Pre-Training with Lighthouse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06554)
*Bowen Peng,Subho Ghosh,Jeffrey Quesnelle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Lighthouse Attention通过一种训练阶段特有的对称选择式层次化注意力算法，解决长序列Transformer训练中注意力机制的二次方复杂度问题。该方法在预训练大部分阶段使用，训练末期可恢复为全注意力模型，实现更快的训练速度并达到更低的最终损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果Transformer在处理极长序列时，缩放点积注意力（SDPA）的时间复杂度和显存占用均为二次方，成为训练的主要瓶颈。

Method: 提出Lighthouse Attention，一种训练专用、对称的选择式层次化注意力算法：(1) 在SDPA外层封装子二次方的层次化预处理和后处理步骤，实现自适应压缩和解压；(2) 采用对称压缩策略，同时对Query、Key、Value进行池化操作，保持从左到右的因果性以提升并行度；(3) 两阶段训练方法——先用Lighthouse Attention进行大部分预训练，再用短时训练恢复全注意力模型。

Result: 小规模LLM预训练实验表明，与所有设置相同的全注意力训练相比，该方法在恢复阶段后实现了更快的总训练时间和更低的最终损失。

Conclusion: 该方法可作为长序列Transformer预训练的高效训练策略，通过恢复阶段确保模型可获得全注意力的表达能力。

Abstract: Training causal transformers at extreme sequence lengths is bottlenecked by the quadratic time and memory of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA). In this work, we propose Lighthouse Attention, a training-only symmetrical selection-based hierarchical attention algorithm that wraps around ordinary SDPA and can be easily removed towards the end of the training. Our hierarchical selection is also gradient-free, which exempts us from dealing with a complicated and potentially inefficient backward pass kernel. Our contribution is three-fold: (i) A subquadratic hierarchical pre- and post-processing step that does adaptive compression and decompression of the sequence. (ii) A symmetrical compression strategy that pools queries, keys and values at the same time, while preserving left-to-right causality, which greatly improves parallelism. (iii) A two stage training approach which we pre-train for the majority of the time with Lighthouse Attention and recover a full attention model at the end with a short training. We run preliminary small scale LLM pre-training experiments that show the effectiveness of our method compared to full attention training with all other settings matched, where we achieve a faster total training time and lower final loss after the recovery phase. Full code is available at: https://github.com/ighoshsubho/lighthouse-attention

</details>


### [62] [Automated Clinical Report Generation for Remote Cognitive Remediation: Comparing Knowledge-Engineered Templates and LLMs in Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06594)
*Yongxin Zhou,Fabien Ringeval,François Portet*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对远程认知康复治疗中的自动临床报告生成问题，对比了规则模板系统与GPT-4零样本生成两种方案，发现模板系统在临床可靠性上更优，而LLM在语言流畅性上占优，为低资源环境下的临床NLP系统设计提供了可复制的评估方法论和八条设计建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知康复治疗需求增长与言语治疗师资源有限之间的矛盾日益突出，远程康复系统产生了大量难以高效审阅的交互数据，现有的自动报告生成在低资源场景下缺乏参考标准，亟需可靠的自动化临床报告生成方案。

Method: 采用受控对比实验设计：规则模板系统编码言语治疗领域知识为显式决策规则和验证模板；GPT-4零样本系统使用相同专家验证的结构化变量输入。由8名言语治疗师和高年级学生使用九项标准问卷进行双系统输出评估。

Result: 规则模板系统在流畅性、连贯性和结果呈现方面得分更高；GPT-4生成内容更简洁。方向性差异在各评估维度一致，但经多重比较校正后均未达统计显著性，可能受限于专家评估的规模。

Conclusion: 两种方案存在临床可靠性与语言质量之间的权衡。建议包括：结合领域知识与灵活生成的混合架构、强化可解释性、建立领域特定评估标准等。本研究提供了低资源环境下临床NLP系统的可复制的评估方法论，为生成式AI在医疗领域的负责任应用提供了参考。

Abstract: The growing demand for cognitive remediation therapy, combined with limited speech therapist availability, has accelerated the adoption of remote rehabilitation tools. These systems generate large volumes of interaction data that are difficult for clinicians to review efficiently. This paper investigates automated clinical report generation for avatar-guided, home-based cognitive remediation sessions in a low-resource setting with no reference reports. We present and compare two approaches: (1) a rule-based template system encoding speech therapy domain knowledge as explicit decision rules and validated templates, ensuring clinical reliability and traceability; and (2) a zero-shot LLM-based approach (GPT-4) aimed at more fluent and concise output. Both systems use identical pre-extracted, expert-validated structured variables, enabling a controlled factual comparison. Outputs were evaluated by eight speech therapists and final-year students using a nine-criterion questionnaire. Results reveal a clear trade-off between clinical reliability and linguistic quality. The template-based system scored higher on fluidity, coherence, and results presentation, while GPT-4 produced more concise output. Directional differences are consistent across evaluation dimensions, though no comparison reached statistical significance after correction, reflecting the scale constraints of expert clinical evaluation. Based on evaluator feedback, we derive eight design recommendations for clinical reporting systems in remote rehabilitation settings. More broadly, this work contributes a replicable methodology combining expert elicitation, taxonomy-driven generation, and multi-dimensional human evaluation for clinical NLG in low-resource settings, and illustrates how controlled comparisons can inform the responsible adoption of generative AI in healthcare.

</details>


### [63] [UniSD: Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06597)
*Yiqiao Jin,Yiyang Wang,Lucheng Fu,Yijia Xiao,Yinyi Luo,Haoxin Liu,B. Aditya Prakash,Josiah Hester,Jindong Wang,Srijan Kumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UniSD是一个统一的自蒸馏框架，用于解决自回归LLM中自蒸馏面临的挑战（自由形式轨迹、任务依赖的正确性、不稳定的监督），通过集成多教师一致性、EMA教师稳定化、token级对比学习、特征匹配和 divergence clipping等多种机制。在6个基准、6个模型、3个模型族上的实验表明，UniSDfull相比基模型提升+5.4分，比最强基线提升+2.8分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归LLM的自蒸馏面临三大挑战：自生成轨迹是自由形式的、正确性取决于任务、看似合理的推理仍可能提供不稳定或不可靠的监督。现有方法仅考察孤立的设计选择，缺乏对各组件有效性、作用和相互作用的系统理解。

Method: 提出UniSD统一框架，系统研究自蒸馏。核心机制包括：(1) 多教师一致性提升监督可靠性；(2) EMA教师稳定化；(3) Token级对比学习；(4) 特征匹配；(5) Divergence clipping。进一步整合为UniSDfull管道。

Result: 跨6个基准、6个模型（来自3个模型族）的实验表明：UniSD揭示了自蒸馏何时优于静态模仿、哪些组件驱动收益、以及组件如何跨任务交互。UniSDfull取得最强整体性能：比基模型提升+5.4分，比最强基线提升+2.8分。

Conclusion: 自蒸馏是一种无需更强外部教师的实用且可控制的LLM适应方法。UniSD框架提供了系统理解自蒸馏各组件作用的途径。

Abstract: Self-distillation (SD) offers a promising path for adapting large language models (LLMs) without relying on stronger external teachers. However, SD in autoregressive LLMs remains challenging because self-generated trajectories are free-form, correctness is task-dependent, and plausible rationales can still provide unstable or unreliable supervision. Existing methods mainly examine isolated design choices, leaving their effectiveness, roles, and interactions unclear. In this paper, we propose UniSD, a unified framework to systematically study self-distillation. UniSD integrates complementary mechanisms that address supervision reliability, representation alignment, and training stability, including multi-teacher agreement, EMA teacher stabilization, token-level contrastive learning, feature matching, and divergence clipping. Across six benchmarks and six models from three model families, UniSD reveals when self-distillation improves over static imitation, which components drive the gains, and how these components interact across tasks. Guided by these insights, we construct UniSDfull, an integrated pipeline that combines complementary components and achieves the strongest overall performance, improving over the base model by +5.4 points and the strongest baseline by +2.8 points. Extensive evaluation highlights self-distillation as a practical and steerable approach for efficient LLM adaptation without stronger external teachers.

</details>


### [64] [Parser agreement and disagreement in L2 Korean UD: Implications for human-in-the-loop annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06625)
*Hakyung Sung,Gyu-Ho Shin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个简化的"人在回路"（HITL）形态句法标注流程：把两个经领域适配的依存分析器（Stanza、Trankit）之间的**一致性**当作标注正确性的代理，凡一致者自动保留，仅将**分歧词**送人工审查/裁决。结果显示两解析器在词级上一致率约82%，而在这些一致实例上两名人类标注者的一致率达93%（各特征均>90%），因此"解析器共识"可作为可扩展 L2 韩语 UD 标注的有效筛选机制；但31%的词仍需至少一处人工修正，8%需第三名标注者裁决，且分歧集中于论元角色、从句边界、修饰语附着与形态/切分等可预测的领域，说明并非所有分歧都能靠局部线索或再训练解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第二语言（L2）学习者语料上的形态句法标注是量化 L2 产出研究的关键，但存在三重瓶颈：(1) 通用 NLP 模型在非规范的学习者语言上表现较差，且长期缺乏学习者语料基准可供验证；(2) 领域适配（在已标注的 L2 树库上微调，如 L2 英语 UD Transformer 达到 POS/依存 >90 F1，而 L2 韩语仅形态素级 F1≈88%、LAS≈57%，且依存中心词准确率与 proficiency 负相关 r=-0.26）虽有效，却预设了"已有可靠 L2 标注"这一前提，形成鸡生蛋问题；(3) 现有八个 L2 UD 语料中绝大多数采用全人工标注（仅意大利语、瑞典语及本团队韩语项目采用半自动），人工标注资源密集、难以规模化、跨项目难以一致复现。因此需要一种可复现、可扩展的"自动预标注 + 定向人工核验"方案，并回答：解析器一致性能否充当人工一致性的代理，从而把人工精力精准投放到高风险区域。

Method: **框架（三步）**：(1) 自动标注——Stanza（BiLSTM/转换式联合标注管线）与 Trankit（基于 XLM-R 的多语转换器管线）分别在 UD-KSL（L2 韩语写作，含形态素切分、XPOS、依存标注）训练集上独立微调，考察 LEMMA、XPOS、HEAD、DEPREL 四个层（UPOS 在现行方案下由 XPOS 确定性派生，故排除）；测试集 F1：Stanza LEMMA 95.64/XPOS 89.72/UAS 85.53/LAS 80.36，Trankit 88.84/91.81/92.28/89.13。(2) 跨模型词级比对：输出相同者暂时接受，任何分歧触发人工复审（分析前先解决分词不一致以保证词级对齐）。(3) 人工裁决：两名受训标注者独立审阅被标记词，一致则定为 gold；不一致时由第三名标注者（作者之一）在参照两模型输出与两份独立标注后裁决。**评估设计**：为检验解析器一致性是否代理人类一致性，先对全部句子收集两名标注者的完全独立标注，再将审查范围收缩到分歧词，测量"解析器一致"与"人工一致"的重合度（预设阈值为一致子集内人类一致率 >90%）。**流水线噪声检验**：从 KoLLA 随机抽取 500 句（均未参与模型训练），分 5 轮、每轮 100 句按框架增量标注，裁决结果回灌训练数据、两模型各微调 10 epoch，每轮在 UD-KSL 测试集上评估性能走势。**语料**：2,208 句论说文，来自日语与英语母语的韩语学习者（为期一个月的写作），沿用团队既有的 L2 韩语形态句法标注方案（Sung et al. 2025）。

Result: **一致性结果**：解析器在词级整体一致率 82.58%（LEMMA 78.09、XPOS 84.83、HEAD 78.62、DEPREL 88.78）；在这些解析器一致实例上，人类标注者一致率 92.93%（LEMMA 96.97、DEPREL 92.55、XPOS 91.97、HEAD 90.22），四特征全部超过 90% 的预设阈值——支持"解析器共识≈可靠标注"的代理假设。**人工干预量**：对齐后 25,814 词中 31% 至少有一个特征需人工修正（LEMMA 4,485/17.37%、HEAD 3,798/14.71%、XPOS 2,263/8.77%、DEPREL 1,713/6.64%），近 70% 的词无需任何干预；其中 8%（2,019 词）两名标注者未收敛、需第三名标注者裁决（XPOS 5.66%、DEPREL 4.47%、LEMMA 4.36%、HEAD 2.25%）。**增量验证**：五轮"标注—回灌—微调"中两模型测试精度稳定在约 85% 以上，无可观察的下降，说明该半自动流水线未引入显著标注噪声。**分歧结构**：DEPREL 分歧聚为四类——语法关系判定 263（nsubj–obj、nsubj–obl、obj–obl，多由格助词脱落/欠定所致）、话语与结构 235（dislocated–nsubj、root–conj、conj–advcl，话题化左移位结构常被误判为规范主语）、从句边界 206（acl–advcl、advcl–ccomp、advcl–root，源于连接词尾 -go 的多义与话语语义线索缺失；另有 -ci 补足结构被误判为 advcl）、修饰语附着 152（amod–acl 的形容词性修饰语 vs 缩减关系从句；nmod–obl 的处所短语挂名词或挂谓语，线性临近无法定夺）。形态层面高频 XPOS 分歧为助词/格助词功能歧义（JKS/JKB/JKO/JKC/JX/JKG，以及结构格 vs 助动/话语助词）、词根识别与词汇分解（NNG vs XR、NNG vs NF、VV vs NV，其中 NF/NV/NA 标记不规范或异常形式，学习者特有的拼写错误常无词典支持）、以及分词差异（功能形态素的插入或省略，如额外 JX/EC）。

Conclusion: 解析器一致性可作为 L2 韩语 UD 标注中一条原则性的"分流/三分类"（triage）机制：一致项自动保留以大幅压缩人工核验规模，不一致项集中定向审查，从而兼顾效率与可靠性；二元一致性判据还可在未来嵌入集成式（ensemble）投票框架以获得更稳健的共识估计。核心洞见是形态句法分歧具有**多层次性**且分布可预测而非随机：一类属于可迭代再训练修复的建模不足（论元角色区分、-ci 补足结构的习得、-go 连接结构的上下文判定），另一类属于表征层面的深层歧义（从句边界与修饰语附着的上下文依赖性、L2 韩语词根归属与学习者特有形态变异在既有标注与词典资源中无据可依），仅靠局部形态句法线索无法消解，需更强的上下文建模与针对学习者形态的系统性处理策略。局限包括：语料仅限成人韩语学习者的论说文（受 proficiency、年龄、体裁、背景语言影响，外推性有限）；未系统考察学习者形态变异与拼写错误标注问题；工作流为简化版 HITL，未纳入动态置信度估计、主动学习与实时模型更新等组件。

Abstract: We propose a simplified human-in-the-loop workflow for second language (L2) Korean morphosyntactic annotation by leveraging agreement between two domain-adapted parsers. We first evaluate whether parser agreement can serve as a proxy for annotation correctness by comparing it with independent human judgments. The results show strong correspondence between parser and human judgments, supporting the feasibility of semi-automatic L2-Korean UD annotation. Further analysis demonstrates that parser disagreements cluster in linguistically predictable domains such as grammatical-relation distinctions and clause-boundary ambiguity. While many disagreement cases are tractable for iterative model refinement, others reflect deeper representational challenges inherent in parsing and tagging L2-Korean corpora.

</details>


### [65] [Cited but Not Verified: Parsing and Evaluating Source Attribution in LLM Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06635)
*Hailey Onweller,Elias Lumer,Austin Huber,Pia Ramchandani,Vamse Kumar Subbiah,Corey Feld*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出首个端到端的「来源归因评估框架」：用可复现的 Markdown AST 解析器从 LLM 深度研究报告中抽取行内引用-声明（claim-citation）对，再实际抓取被引网页内容，用「链接可用（Link Works）—内容相关（Relevant Content）—事实核查（Fact Check）」三维评分器（后两者为经人工校准的 rubric 式 LLM-as-a-judge）逐对评估。对 14 个闭源/开源模型、130 个研究查询的基准测试显示：链接有效率 >94%、主题相关率 >80%，但事实准确率仅 39%–77%；且工具调用从 2 增至 150 时事实准确率平均下降约 42%，而表面指标保持稳定——证明「引用看似可信」与「事实可靠」之间存在严重脱节，且检索越多反而引用越不准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 深度研究智能体（Perplexity、ChatGPT 联网搜索、Gemini 接地等）每天为数百万用户生成带引用的报告，但这些引用无法可靠核验：既有工作要么相信模型自引（易产生幻觉/误归因），要么使用 RAG 而不校验来源的可访问性、相关性与事实一致性；已有商业模型的引用幻觉率被报道为 11%–57%。现有评测（AttributionBench、CiteME、CiteEval、RefChecker、CiteAudit、CiteGuard 等）多停留在二元归因判定、引用匹配或范式比较，缺乏「引用抽取 + 多维质量评估」的端到端框架，也没有跨厂商在深度研究场景下的系统对比，更未研究检索深度与引用质量的关系。作者由此提出两个研究问题：前沿模型的引用在多大程度上事实准确，表层质量是否掩盖深层事实失败；增加搜索深度如何影响各维度引用质量。

Method: 三阶段流水线（Algorithm 1）。阶段0：具备联网搜索的深度研究智能体按固定系统提示（规定引用格式与最小搜索深度）生成含行内引用的 Markdown 报告。阶段1（确定性解析，无 LLM 推理）：规范化（统一换行/空白、剥离围栏代码块以防误匹配）→ 构建 AST → 遍历识别多种引用形态（编号式 [1]、脚注式 [^note]、内联 Markdown 链接 [text](url)、自动链接 <url>、区间 [1-3] 展开）→ 去重并归一化 URL 建注册表 → 句子级切分为独立声明 → 「向后归因」逻辑（段落尾部引用覆盖其前所有未加引用的句子）→ 生成 AttributionDocument(citations, attributions)。阶段2（评估执行器）：并发抓取每个被引 URL 的正文（支持 JS 渲染页面，截取前 5000 字符），再对每个声明-引用对独立评分——Link Works 用 HTTP 可访问性（404/403/超时/封锁判 0，无 LLM 推理）；Relevant Content 用 LLM-as-a-judge 判定主题一致性（0/1+自然语言解释）；Fact Check 用 LLM-as-a-judge 逐项核对事实、数字、日期与断言是否被来源支持（支持/一致=1，被反驳/缺失/不确定=0），并经 50–100 条人工复核校准。基准设置：14 个模型（OpenAI GPT-5.2/5.4/5 Mini/Codex；Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6、Opus 4.5/4.6、Haiku 4.5；Google Gemini 3.1 Pro/3 Flash；开源 OSS-120B、Llama 4 Maverick、Pixtral Large），130 条来自 DeepResearch Bench 与 BrowseComp 的查询，异步并发（10 代理/15 评估器）+5 次重试。消融：在 GPT-5.4 与 Claude Opus 4.6 上将最大工具调用数设为 2/10/30/50/70/100/150 七个档位以隔离搜索深度效应。

Result: 发现1（表层质量掩盖事实失败）：14 个模型中 12 个 Link Works >94%，所有前沿模型 Relevant Content >80%，但 Fact Check 仅 24%（OSS-120B）至 77%（Claude Opus 4.5），跨度 53 个百分点，是最具区分度的维度；即用户几乎总能打开一个主题相关的页面，却有近一半概率该来源并不支持所标注的具体事实。开源模型连任务本身都难完成：OSS-120B 40%、Llama 4 Maverick 30%、Pixtral Large 17% 成功率（前沿模型 83%–100%），且工具调用数远少（7–60 次 vs 73–211 次）。发现2（数量与准确性权衡）：OpenAI 成功率 100%、引用最多（GPT-5 Mini 共 1,272 条归因）但 Fact Check 仅 39%–59%；Anthropic 成功率 83%–97% 却事实准确率最佳（Opus 4.5 77%、Haiku 4.5 69%）；Gemini 居中（45%–49%）。作者推测为综合阶段的注意力稀释，且「选择性引用」优于「穷举引用」。发现3（信息过载）：两个模型 Fact Check 从 2 次调用到 150 次调用平均下降约 42%；GPT-5.4 从 79% 骤降至 17%（62%，且 2→10 次即跌 33 个百分点），Claude Opus 4.6 从 80% 降至 58%（22%），而 Link Works 与 Relevant Content 在所有深度均 >92% 且保持稳定，说明退化专属于事实综合而非来源选择。错误分析：Link Works 失败主要来自 HTTP 404、被封锁（付费墙/机器人检测）与超时，GPT-5.4 仅 1/2,159 失败，开源失败率显著更高（Llama 4 Maverick 19.2%、OSS-120B 16.1%），HTTP 429 限流影响 <0.3%。

Conclusion: 表层引用质量（链接可访问、主题相关）与事实可靠性之间存在系统性断裂：模型普遍能选出可访问且相关的来源，却难以忠实综合事实；且「更多检索≠更准确引用」，检索深度增加反而引发信息过载、显著损害事实归因。据此建议：（1）系统设计者应把引用质量监控集成进智能体流水线，检索策略应优先「深度理解来源」而非「广度覆盖来源」；（2）用户应警惕高链接有效率与高相关率制造的虚假信任感，在医疗、法律、金融等高风险领域尤其需要引用核验护栏；（3）未来工作包括多评委/规则混合的评估以缓解 LLM-as-a-judge 偏差、面向领域特定任务与私有知识库企业 RAG 的扩展、以及对引用持久性的纵向追踪研究；作者亦承认 Web 引用具有时间不稳定性、评测仅覆盖具备联网搜索能力的模型等局限。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) power deep research agents that synthesize information from hundreds of web sources into cited reports, yet these citations cannot be reliably verified. Current approaches either trust models to self-cite accurately, risking bias, or employ retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that does not validate source accessibility, relevance, or factual consistency. We introduce the first source attribution evaluation framework that uses a reproducible AST parser to extract and evaluate inline citations from LLM-generated Markdown reports at scale. Unlike methods that verify claims in isolation, our framework closes the loop by retrieving the actual cited content, enabling human or model evaluators to judge each citation against its source. Citations are evaluated along three dimensions. (1) Link Works verifies URL accessibility, (2) Relevant Content measures topical alignment, and (3) Fact Check validates factual accuracy against source content. We benchmark 14 closed-source and open-source LLMs across three evaluation dimensions using rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge evaluators calibrated through human review. Our results reveal that even the strongest frontier models maintain link validity above 94% and relevance above 80%, yet achieve only 39-77% factual accuracy, while fewer than half of open-source models successfully generate cited reports in a one-shot setting. Ablation studies on research depth show that Fact Check accuracy drops by approximately 42% on average across two frontier models as tool calls scale from 2 to 150, demonstrating that more retrieval does not produce more accurate citations. These findings reveal a critical disconnect between surface-level citation quality and factual reliability, and our framework provides the evaluation infrastructure to assess the disconnect.

</details>


### [66] [StraTA: Incentivizing Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Strategic Trajectory Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06642)
*Xiangyuan Xue,Yifan Zhou,Zidong Wang,Shengji Tang,Philip Torr,Wanli Ouyang,Lei Bai,Zhenfei Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: StraTA通过引入显式轨迹级策略和分层GRPO训练框架，有效解决了LLM智能体在长期决策任务中的探索和信用分配难题，在ALFWorld、WebShop、SciWorld三个基准上均达到最优性能，验证了层次化战略规划对提升智能体决策能力的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体优化方法主要采用纯粹反应式策略，导致在长时序决策任务中探索能力不足、信用分配困难，难以有效处理需要战略性规划的多步骤复杂任务。

Method: StraTA框架包含三个核心组件：1) 从初始任务状态采样紧凑策略；2) 分层GRPO风格的rollout设计，条件化后续动作于策略之上；3) 策略生成与动作执行的联合训练，辅以多样化策略rollout和关键自我判断机制增强判别能力。

Result: ALFWorld达到93.1%成功率，WebShop达到84.2%，SciWorld达到63.5%总分且超越前沿闭源模型。StraTA在样本效率和最终性能两个维度均持续超越强基线方法。

Conclusion: StraTA通过轨迹级策略抽象有效解决了LLM智能体在长期决策任务中的探索不足和信用分配困难问题，在多个基准测试上实现最优性能，超越前沿闭源模型，展示了将高层战略规划与低层动作执行相结合的潜力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents, but optimizing them for long-horizon decision making remains difficult because current methods are largely purely reactive, which weakens both exploration and credit assignment over extended trajectories. In this work, we present Strategic Trajectory Abstraction (StraTA), a simple framework that introduces an explicit trajectory-level strategy into agentic reinforcement learning (RL). StraTA samples a compact strategy from the initial task state, conditions subsequent actions on that strategy, and trains strategy generation and action execution jointly with a hierarchical GRPO-style rollout design, further enhanced by diverse strategy rollout and critical self-judgment. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld show that StraTA consistently improves both sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines. StraTA reaches success rates of 93.1% on ALFWorld and 84.2% on WebShop. On SciWorld, StraTA attains a 63.5% overall score, outperforming frontier closed-source models.

</details>


### [67] [Beyond Negative Rollouts: Positive-Only Policy Optimization with Implicit Negative Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06650)
*Mingwei Xu,Hao Fang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 Positive-Only Policy Optimization (POPO)：一种只利用在线"正确"rollout 进行梯度更新的 RLVR 框架，通过自归一化的有界重要性采样（自我竞争式权重）、孪生网络 + EMA 动量锚点、以及用表示空间余弦相似度替代 KL 散度，实现在数学推理任务上与 GRPO 相当甚至更优的性能（Qwen-Math-7B 在 AIME 2025 达 36.67%，超过 GRPO 的 30.00%），并从理论上证明了仅靠正向强化即可涌现"隐式负梯度"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）已成为提升 LLM 推理能力的主流范式，社区也迅速从 PPO 转向 GRPO——后者用组内正负 rollout 的相对优势估计简化了价值网络。但作者指出该范式存在两个根本问题：(1) 在稀疏二值奖励下，负 rollout 不存在失败严重程度的梯度区分（no gradation of failure severity）；(2) 数学推理中错误响应的组合空间极其庞大，惩罚少量采样的负样本几乎不可能覆盖有意义的失败模式。因此作者提出核心问题："策略能否仅从成功样本（正样本）中强化而改进？"该设想受三条观察支撑：错误空间组合巨大、在线策略蒸馏/自蒸馏已被证明有效、以及对比式自监督学习（BYOL、SimSiam）表明仅用正样本即可学到高质量表征。

Method: POPO 是一个"异步在线自蒸馏 + RLVR"框架，损失为：L = -E[Σ_{y∈S+(x)} w_θ(y|x)·log π_θ(y|x)] + α·L_sim + β·L_ent，期望仅在正样本集合 S+(x) 上取（相当于拒绝采样的硬优势），完全不用于负 rollout 提供梯度。四个关键组件：(1) 自归一化有界重要性采样权重 w_θ(y|x)=π_θ(y|x)/Z+(x)，Z+ 为正集概率和，形成"自我竞争"，使高置信正确解获得更大权重同时保持多样性；(2) 孪生策略网络 π_ξ 作为自适应锚点，以 EMA 更新 ξ←τξ+(1-τ)θ（τ=0.999），实现异步策略演化；(3) 表示空间对齐：用预测头 h_φ(f_θ(x,y)) 与 stop-grad(sg(f_ξ(x,y)+ε)) 的余弦相似度替代 KL 散度，配合高斯噪声、非对称预测头与停止梯度避免表示坍缩；(4) 熵正则鼓励探索。理论上给出两个结果：定理 3.1（隐式负梯度）证明 ∂L/∂z_{y'} = π_θ(y'|x)[1+β(log π_θ(y'|x)+H)]，当 π_θ(y'|x) > exp(-1/β - H) 时严格为正，且证明有界权重对负 logit 不敏感（∂w/∂z_{y'}=0），即归一化不会削弱隐式惩罚——负梯度来自正向 NLL 经 softmax 归一化产生的"概率税"与熵正则对高概率错误样本的额外抑制；引理 3.2 给出 EMA 有界参数间隙 ‖θ_t-ξ_t‖ ≤ τηG_max/(1-τ)，保证无 KL 情况下策略不漂移。

Result: 训练用 DeepScaleR-Preview-Dataset（约 4 万题，单一数据集以排除数据组成干扰），在 MATH-500、AMC23、AIME 2024/2025、OlympiadBench 上报告 Pass@8，覆盖 6 个基座（Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B、Llama-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-Math-7B），对比 Base/SFT/GRPO/Dr.GRPO/DAPO。POPO 在数学/蒸馏模型上全面占优：Qwen-Math-1.5B 均分 53.06（GRPO 50.22、Dr.GRPO 51.22、DAPO 50.36），AIME25 提升 17.59% vs MATH-500 的 1.66%；R1-Distill-1.5B 59.92（GRPO 57.03）；Qwen-Math-7B 63.12（GRPO 61.20），AIME 2025 达 36.67% 对 GRPO 30.00%。R1-Distill-7B 上 POPO 66.22 略优于 GRPO 65.60，但多数单项略低，作者归因于该蒸馏模型熵过低、on-policy 探索能力受限。通用模型上亦优于 GRPO：Llama-3.1-8B 29.84 vs 26.72，DeepSeek-Math-7B 50.15 vs 47.81。消融（Qwen-Math-1.5B）显示权重重分配最关键：去掉重分配改用均匀权重（且含负 rollout）时均分骤降至 23.00；去掉动量 EMA 降至 30.85；去掉表示空间对齐降至 31.74（训练不稳定）。扫描显示预测头 2 层、维度 4096、动量 0.999 为最优。

Conclusion: POPO 表明在稀疏二值奖励下，RLVR 可完全摆脱对负 rollout 的显式依赖，仅靠正向强化的概率重分配即可涌现有效的隐式负梯度，且配合孪生 EMA 锚定与表示空间相似度惩罚可获得比 GRPO 更好的策略优化稳定性，尤其在 AIME/Olympiad 等高难任务上优势更明显，印证了"错误空间组合巨大使有限负样本惩罚失效"的假设（AIME25 在模型发布后才公开，亦排除了数据泄漏）。局限：仅针对稀疏二值奖励设计（稠密奖励未验证）；仅在纯文本数学推理上验证，未扩展到代码生成、agentic RL、多模态与生成式建模；仅测试到 7B 规模，未扩展到 32B/70B。附带代码（GitHub: momo1443/self-distillation-rlvr-popo）与完整超参（lr 1e-7、group size 8、τ=0.999、α=0.1、β=0.01、σ=0.02、4×A100 80G）。注：所给 arXiv 全文标题为 "Improving Reasoning Ability via Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation under Positive Rollouts"，与列表标题略有出入。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), due to the deterministic verification, becomes a dominant paradigm for enhancing the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs). The community witnesses the rapid change from the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), in which GRPO reduces the complicated advantage estimation with simple estimation over grouped positive and negative rollouts. However, we note that negative rollouts may admit no gradation of failure severity, and the combinatorial vastness makes penalizing a few sampled negatives unlikely to cover a meaningful reward signal under sparse binary rewards. In this work, we propose Positive-Only Policy Optimization (POPO), a novel RLVR framework in which learning can occur exclusively via online positive rollouts. Specifically, POPO utilizes bounded importance sampling over the positive rollout set. Thus, no disjoint negative rollouts are used for the gradient guidance. We show that implicit negative gradients can emerge naturally through reinforcing the positive probability via rollouts redistribution. Next, POPO stabilizes the policy optimization through two mechanisms. First, it applies a siamese policy network with a momentum-based adaptation law for stabilized policy evolution. Second, we replace the KL-divergence with a bounded similarity penalty term in the siamese representation space. We conduct extensive experiments using publicly available, well-established text-LLM models, e.g., the Qwen family, across all-level mathematical benchmarks. Our experiment demonstrates that POPO achieves performance comparable to, or even superior to GRPO. Notably, we show that POPO can achieve 36.67% in AIME 2025 with Qwen-Math-7B, outperforming GRPO 30.00%. Our ablation and sweep studies further illustrate the necessity and robustness of POPO components.

</details>


### [68] [EMO: Pretraining Mixture of Experts for Emergent Modularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06663)
*Ryan Wang,Akshita Bhagia,Sewon Min*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EMO是一种模块化MoE架构，通过文档边界约束使同文档token共享专家池，无需人工定义即可实现模块化专家分组。实验表明其支持高效的选择性专家使用（25%专家仅损失1%性能），并展现出语义层面的专业化，为大模型的模块化、高效部署提供了新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统大语言模型采用单体架构，即使应用仅需特定能力（如代码、数学）也需加载完整模型。MoE虽能选择性激活专家，但实际限制专家子集用于特定领域会导致严重性能下降，限制了其在内存受限场景的实用性。

Method: EMO通过文档边界约束，让同一文档内的token共享专家池选择，而不同文档可使用不同池。这种自监督约束使相似领域的token在预训练中自然聚集到相同专家，实现无需人工先验的模块化。

Result: 在1T tokens上预训练的EMO（1B活跃/14B总量）作为完整模型达到标准MoE性能。在选择性专家使用测试中：保留25%专家仅下降1%，保留12.5%专家仅下降3%，而标准MoE在相同设置下崩溃。EMO的专家在语义层面（数学、代码等领域）专业化，而非标准MoE的低层句法专业化。

Conclusion: EMO展示了如何通过简单约束实现模块化的大模型部署，在保持性能的同时支持灵活的专业化使用，为内存受限环境下的稀疏模型应用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models are typically deployed as monolithic systems, requiring the full model even when applications need only a narrow subset of capabilities, e.g., code, math, or domain-specific knowledge. Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) seemingly offer a potential alternative by activating only a subset of experts per input, but in practice, restricting inference to a subset of experts for a given domain leads to severe performance degradation. This limits their practicality in memory-constrained settings, especially as models grow larger and sparser. We introduce EMO, an MoE designed for modularity-the independent use and composition of expert subsets-without requiring human-defined priors. Our key idea is to encourage tokens from similar domains to rely on similar experts. Since tokens within a document often share a domain, EMO restricts them to select experts from a shared pool, while allowing different documents to use different pools. This simple constraint enables coherent expert groupings to emerge during pretraining using document boundaries alone. We pretrain a 1B-active, 14B-total EMO on 1T tokens. As a full model, it matches standard MoE performance. Crucially, it enables selective expert use: retaining only 25% (12.5%) of experts incurs just a 1% (3%) absolute drop, whereas standard MoEs break under the same setting. We further find that expert subsets in EMO specialize at semantic levels (e.g., domains such as math or code), in contrast to the low-level syntactic specialization observed in standard MoEs. Altogether, our results demonstrate a path toward modular, memory-efficient deployment of large, sparse models and open new opportunities for composable architectures.

</details>

### [69] [Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05703)
*Huchen Yang,Xinghao Dong,Dan Negrut,Jin-Long Wu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于集成卡尔曼反演（EKI）的信息论主动学习框架，用于为 LLM 多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）选择最有信息量的通信结构优化训练任务：无需端到端梯度，仅靠前向 rollout 估计任务引起的图参数后验分布变化量（KL 信息增益），再结合嵌入式代表性筛选与代理模型+批量 Thompson 采样实现可扩展选择。实验显示在同等训练预算与同等总预算下均优于随机任务采样，并在良性/对抗（含恶意智能体）设置、多种任务格式与不同规模 MAS 上泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-MAS 的通信结构（谁与谁通信）通常被经验性地预设为全连接或启发式设计，冗余边浪费 token、不受限通信会传播幻觉与对抗内容，因此需针对目标任务分布优化通信图。已有图优化方法（如 AgentPrune）依赖随机采样的训练任务，但任务在难度与领域上差异巨大、对图参数更新的信息量不同，导致：(1) 下游准确率在不同独立运行间波动大（不稳定）；(2) 增加训练任务数并不单调提升准确率，峰值后反而下降；(3) 对训练集选择高度敏感。关键问题不是"用多少任务"，而是"用哪些任务"，因此需要主动学习式地识别最具信息量的任务。核心难点是三重黑盒嵌套：任务通过随机、不可微的 MAS rollout 评估，图优化在其上用 RL/策略梯度，任务效用又由参数分布变化定义，导致效用估计极其昂贵——基于采样的估计需大量 rollout，基于梯度/敏感度的估计方差大且需重复 rollout 控制方差。

Method: 把通信结构表示为空-时图 G=(V,E^S,E^T)（空间同轮内通信按拓扑序执行为 DAG，时间图为跨轮记忆传递），用可训练图 logits z={Z^S,Z^T} 参数化边的激活概率，rollout 前按 Bernoulli(sigmoid(logit)) 采样掩码 A；MAS 前向映射为 g=G(q;z,ω)，评价器 φ 给出性能分 l=φ(g,q,y)，图优化目标为最大化掩码分布下的期望性能分，用 REINFORCE 估计梯度。任务效用定义为信息增益 I(S)=D_KL(p(z|S)||p(z))。由于答案已知（已标注任务），无需对可能观测取期望，直接计算实现型信息增益。关键方法：(1) 用集成卡尔曼反演（EKI）无导数地近似贝叶斯更新——以 J 个粒子表示 z 的不确定性，前向得 l^(j)，用经验互协方差 C^zl 与 C^ll 做一步 EKI 更新 z_post^(j)=z^(j)+C^zl(C^ll+Γ)^{-1}(l*-l^(j))，再用高斯近似算 KL 得到 U(q)；附录给出 EKI 与 score-based 后验采样的等价性推导（局部线性高斯下 EKI 更新等价于用局部后验协方差预条件 likelihood score）。(2) 两阶段选择：先用文本嵌入（sentence-transformers，MMLU 附加学科标签）做贪心最远点采样，从 1000 任务池得 50 个代表性池；再用"嵌入→效用"代理模型（PLS 降维到 2-3 维 + Matérn-ν=2.5 的 GP 回归）配合批量 Thompson 采样，仅对 25（MMLU）/36（GSM8K）个任务做真实 EKI 评估，与全枚举 top-10 重合度 >80%，省下 50%/28% 的效用评估成本。(3) 批量扩展：多任务时把标量分替换为向量分 l^(j)∈R^m，并给出预测步缓存复用策略，把 J·Σ|S_b| 次前向降至 J·|∪S_b| 次。(4) 多目标扩展：用向量伪观测 [α1l1,...,αnl_n] 避免标量化抵消。超参：一步 EKI、集成大小 6、先验扰动 std 2.0、观测噪声 0.1、阻尼 0.7；单轮交互故 E^T=0，仅优化 36 维空间 logits；KL 用对角高斯近似（因 J=6 远小于 36 维，全协方差秩亏），方差下限 1e-8；MMLU 用正确选项对数概率 l*=0，GSM8K 用 0/1 正确性 l*=1。

Result: 1) 动机验证：MMLU（对抗）上随机训练随预算增加收益有限且不稳定，甚至在峰值后下降；随机训练即使开销超过主动学习总成本（0.92M tokens）仍劣于主动学习。2) 知识与推理：同训练预算下主动选择在 MMLU/GSM8K × 良性/对抗四种设置中一致提升均值、运行间稳定性与下尾（Q1、worst-25%）；对抗 MMLU 下 78.32% vs 随机 76.87%（worst-25% +4.25pp，bootstrap 95% CI [1.53,6.32] 排除 0），对抗 GSM8K 三项指标 CI 均排除 0。同总预算（随机 0.86/1.98M vs 主动 0.92/1.91M）下仍占优，表现出更高成本效率。3) 泛化：HumanEval（77.80→78.80%）、InterCode-SQL（Success@5 51.45→57.27，配对置换检验 p=0.037）、ALFWorld（Success@30 45.00→51.25）几乎全部指标占优；GPT-4.1-nano 与 GPT-5-nano 均有效；10/20 智能体规模下亦占优（选择成本随 N 近似二次增长，O(N²)–O(N³)）。4) 基线对比：EKI (78.32%) 与 Fisher coreset-det (78.59%) 优于 EGL (77.02%)、EMC (77.21%)、Fisher trace (76.25%)；EKI 内存 O(JN²) 优于稠密 Fisher 的 O(N⁴)，且无需梯度。5) 消融与敏感性：信息性选择贡献主要增益（77.12%），代表性选择额外提升并保障可扩展性；集成大小 6 与 20 参考排名 top-10 重合度约 0.75，一步 EKI 与三步 EKI 重合 8-9/10，选取稳健。诊断显示高信息增益任务兼具较大预测方差与更新方向的大幅改变（低余弦），表明单纯预测不确定性不足以刻画信息量。

Conclusion: 将"选哪些任务训练"显式化为通信结构优化之上的主动学习问题，是可行且必要的：训练任务的选择而非数量主导优化质量与稳定性。用 EKI 近似贝叶斯更新并以参数分布的 KL 变化度量信息增益，为黑盒、含噪的 LLM-MAS 提供了一个无梯度、计算可承受且可扩展的任务效用估计器，配合嵌入代表性筛选与代理模型 + Thompson 采样形成完整实用的流水线，在良性/对抗、多种任务格式与多种规模下均优于随机采样并具有更高成本效率。局限：EKI 仅在线性高斯下与 score-based 后验采样严格等价，对强非高斯、多峰后验及集合规模远小于参数维度的极端情形可靠性待刻画；依赖任务与参考答案均已给定，无标签/生成任务需改用期望信息增益（BALD）；当前为单轮、rollout 内固定图；嵌入与代理模型等组件仍有改进空间；其他图优化器（如非 REINFORCE）的实证验证留待未来。

Abstract: Optimizing the communication structure of large language model based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) has been shown to improve downstream performance and reduce token usage. Existing methods typically rely on randomly sampled training tasks. However, tasks may differ substantially in difficulty and domain, and thus they are not equally informative for updating communication structure, making optimization under limited training budgets often unstable and highly sensitive to the particular training set. To actively identify the most valuable tasks for communication-structure optimization, we propose an ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework. The proposed method estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the corresponding Bayesian update. The resulting estimator is especially suitable for black-box and noisy multi-agent systems. To enhance scalability, we construct a compact candidate pool through embedding-based representative selection and combine the informative selection with surrogate modeling and batch Thompson sampling. We validate our method in both benign settings and settings with agent attacks, demonstrating its effectiveness for communication-structure optimization under constrained computational budgets.

</details>


### [70] [Auto Research with Specialist Agents Develops Effective and Non-Trivial Training Recipes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05724)
*Jingjie Ning,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Hao Kang,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动化的"提交试验循环"系统，通过专门的AI智能体在无人干预的情况下自动提出假设、编写代码、执行实验、吸收反馈并迭代改进机器学习配方。系统在三个任务上验证了效果：Parameter Golf验证bpb降低0.81%、NanoChat-D12 CORE提升38.7%、CIFAR-10 Airbench96时间减少4.59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习研究长期以来依赖人类专家手动设计实验、调整配方（recipes），这一过程效率低下且难以规模化。现有AutoML方法多聚焦于单模型超参数优化或单次生成，缺乏持续学习与代码改进的能力。

Method: 构建了一种闭环自动研究系统，包含：1）专家智能体分区配方表面并跨试验共享谱系测量；2）每次提交试验携带假设、可执行代码修改、评估器所有权的结果和反馈；3）系统将失败（崩溃、超预算、大小失败、准确率门未达标）转化为程序级配方编辑而非一次性建议。共运行1197个头条试验和600个Parameter Golf对照试验，全程无人类选择提案、编辑配方、覆盖分数或修复失败试验。

Result: 三个头条运行中：（1）Parameter Golf验证bpb降低0.81%；（2）NanoChat-D12 CORE提升38.7%；（3）CIFAR-10 Airbench96 wallclock减少4.59%。对157个头条提交和程序重写进行了严格的架构域审计，包括NanoChat注意力内核路径变更等程序重写。

Conclusion: 该自动研究循环能够在无需人类干预的情况下自主编写代码、提交实验、吸收反馈、组合已知技术并改进公开起点配方。谱系反馈机制是将评估器结果（包括失败）有效转化为后续程序级编辑的关键。

Abstract: We study auto research as a closed empirical loop driven by external measurement. Each submitted trial carries a hypothesis, an executable code edit, an evaluator-owned outcome, and feedback that shapes the next proposal. The output is not a generated paper or a single model checkpoint, but an auditable trajectory of proposals, code diffs, experiments, scores, and failure labels. We instantiate this loop with specialist agents that partition recipe surfaces and share measured lineage across trials. The central empirical finding is that lineage feedback lets agents turn evaluator outcomes, including crashes, budget overruns, size failures, and accuracy-gate misses, into later program-level recipe edits rather than one-shot suggestions. Across 1,197 headline-run trials plus 600 Parameter Golf control trials after one-time setup and launch, humans did not choose proposals, edit recipes, override scores, or repair failed trials during the search. In the three headline runs, the same submitted-trial loop reduces Parameter Golf validation bpb by $0.81\%$, raises NanoChat-D12 CORE by $38.7\%$, and reduces CIFAR-10 Airbench96 wallclock by $4.59\%$, with each task measured by its own external evaluator and legality checks. The trace includes a strict architecture-domain audit of 157 headline-run submissions and program rewrites such as a NanoChat attention-kernel path change. Within this scope the loop autonomously writes code, submits experiments, absorbs feedback, applies and combines known techniques inside each environment, and improves public starting recipes.

Abstract: This correspondence presents a convex-optimization-based evaluation framework of satellite-swarm-based apertures maintained by magnetic-field interactions. Spaceborne distributed apertures are composed of multiple satellites and are attractive for scientific and commercial missions because their scalability enables high-gain, narrow-beam, and large-aperture capabilities beyond the launch-size limitations. A key challenge is that the long-term maintenance of such virtual structures requires consistent formation control amid unstable orbital dynamics, and magnetic interactions generated by satellite-mounted magnetorquers offer a desirable propellant-free position-control strategy. However, the nonlinearities of the electromagnetic force and torque model lead to a nonconvex power-consumption constraint, making system-level configuration analysis difficult. To address this issue, we develop a convex optimization-based framework to analyze the power consumption of large magnetically actuated satellite swarms. The resulting analysis shows that increasing the number of satellites can improve formation-keeping power efficiency. This indicates that magnetically actuated swarm architectures provide a power-efficient alternative to the conventional few-satellite electromagnetic formation-flight concept for constructing large-scale space systems.

### [73] [Improving the Efficiency of Language Agent Teams with Adaptive Task Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06320)
*Elizabeth Mieczkowski,Alexander Ku,Tiwalayo Eisape,Dilip Arumugam,John Matters,Katherine M. Collins,Ilia Sucholutsky,Thomas L. Griffiths*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: LATTE is a distributed systems-inspired framework for coordinating LLM teams using a shared evolving coordination graph, achieving better efficiency (tokens, time, communication) and fewer coordination failures than existing approaches while maintaining task accuracy.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing LLM team coordination occupies two extremes: highly structured methods with fixed roles and pipelines (inflexible), or fully unstructured teams (adaptable but inefficient with error propagation, conflicts, and resource waste). A balanced approach is needed.

Method: LATTE uses a shared, evolving coordination graph that encodes sub-task dependencies, agent assignments, and progress states. Agents collaboratively construct and maintain this graph, enabling dynamic work allocation, adaptive coordination, and emergent task discovery while preserving consistency under partial observability.

Result: Across diverse collaborative tasks and base models, LATTE reduces token usage, wall-clock time, communication overhead, and coordination failures (file conflicts, redundant outputs) while matching or exceeding accuracy compared to MetaGPT, decentralized teams, Leader-Worker hierarchies, and static decompositions.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in teams, yet existing coordination approaches often occupy two extremes. Highly structured methods rely on fixed roles, pipelines, or task decompositions assigned a priori. In contrast, fully unstructured teams enable adaptability and exploration but suffer from inefficiencies such as error propagation, inter-agent conflicts, and wasted resources (measured in time, tokens, or file operations). We introduce Language Agent Teams for Task Evolution (LATTE), a framework for coordinating LLM teams inspired by distributed systems, where processors must operate under partial observability and communication constraints. In LATTE, a team of agents collaboratively construct and maintain a shared, evolving coordination graph which encodes sub-task dependencies, individual agent assignment, and the current state of sub-task progress. This protocol maintains consistency while empowering agents to dynamically allocate work, adapt coordination, and discover new tasks. Across multiple collaborative tasks and a variety of base models, we demonstrate how LATTE reduces token usage, wall-clock time, communication, and coordination failures (e.g. file conflicts and redundant outputs) while matching or exceeding the accuracy of standard designs including MetaGPT, decentralized teams, top-down Leader-Worker hierarchies, and static decompositions.

</details>


### [74] [AgenticPrecoding: LLM-Empowered Multi-Agent System for Precoding Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06443)
*Zijiu Yang,Zixiang Zhang,Shunpu Tang,Qianqian Yang,Zhiguo Shi*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticPrecoding：一个由大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，把"自然语言通信需求 + 结构化场景参数"自动转写为可执行的预编码求解器。核心思路是将端到端预编码设计拆解为问题建模、求解器选择、提示词上采样、代码生成四个协同阶段，分别交由两个 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-8B 领域智能体（建模与选算法）与两个通用 LLM（GPT-5.2 做提示词、Claude/Gemini 3.1 Pro 做代码生成）承担，并加入基于执行反馈的迭代精修闭环。在 10 个代表性预编码场景（MU-MIMO 功率最小化、定包络、1-bit 混合、认知radio 保密/和速率/干扰温度、全双工 QoS、混合预编码鲁棒性等）、6 个 SNR 下与人工挑选的非学习基线对比，绝大多数设置取得最优性能并保持 100% 可行率，显著优于传统优化法与已有 LLM 单智能体方法（LLM-Optira、BeamAgent 等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预编码方法遵循"一个场景、一种建模、一个求解器"的固化范式（针对全双工、下行MIMO、认知radio、定包络、分布式天线、时空符号级、混合预编码等各自定制），难以适应 6G 中 NTN、ISAC 等高度异构且持续演化的场景；深度学习方法在部署条件偏离训练设定时性能退化，且无法显式刻画预编码问题的数学结构。已有 LLM 方案（LLM-Optira 的单一 CoT 智能体、BeamAgent、LLM-beamforming）要么实现可靠性差、频繁违反可行性约束，要么仍绑定场景专用优化器，通用预编码自动化仍未解决。此外，端到端推导包含异质的推理需求：问题建模与求解器选择需要无线领域知识（通信变量、约束、凸性、求解结构），而提示词组织与代码合成更依赖通用语言与编程能力，单一 LLM 难以同时胜任。

Method: 1) 统一广义系统模型：将预编码问题抽象为 min f(x;Θ) s.t. c_ℓ≤0, h_q=0，场景描述子 Θ={Θ_sys, Θ_ch, Θ_obj, Θ_con} 覆盖系统拓扑/收发架构/天线维度、信道与干扰链路、功率或和速率或干扰抑制等目标、功率预算/QoS/干扰温度/符号域/硬件等约束；最大化问题取负。2) 任务形式化：输入 I=(D,Θ)，输出求解器生成流水线 G:(D,Θ)↦(P,A,C,x*)。3) 四阶段多智能体架构：Problem Formulator Agent 输出结构化文本问题规格 P（设计变量、目标、可行域、场景约束）；Problem Solver Agent 依据目标类型、约束特征、凸性、变量耦合与硬件限制选择非学习型算法（凸化、SDR、SCA、交替优化、罚函数等）；Prompt Upsampler Agent 组织变量/目标/约束/算法步骤/数值设置/输入输出格式/可行性检查生成实现导向提示 Π；Code Generation Agent 产出可执行求解器代码 C。4) 领域适配：前两个智能体用 Qwen3-8B 经 LoRA SFT（rank 8、2 epochs）微调，训练数据来自 20 余篇预编码文献构造的指令-响应对（约 6500 条建模、800 条选算法）。5) 反馈驱动精修：执行评估器 E 产生编译/运行状态、约束可行性、目标值与数值告警 e^(t)，精修算子 R 更新 C^(t+1)，迭代至通过评估或触达终止条件。基线由人工独立选定（非 LLM 选择），排除学习型方法。

Result: 在 9 个代表性场景 × 6 个 SNR(0–25 dB) 的对比中，AgenticPrecoding 几乎在所有设置下取得最优：MU-MIMO 功率最小化（0.3144→0.0008 W，优于 ZF/SOCP/穷举 MRT），定包络 CI 归一化边距（1.8076→32.1447，优于坐标下降 30.4381），1-bit MISO 混合（3.4530→61.4033，优于 MRT 1-bit 54.6772），认知 radio 保密速率（1.8265→8.6522，优于 ZF 类零陷 8.0085），认知 radio 和速率（7.1113→42.2928，大幅领先 ZF 25.9629）、干扰温度约束和速率、全双工 QoS 和速率（5.7592→27.8034，优于 RZF/Plain SLNR）、全双工 QAM 功率最小化（0.2548→0.0673 W，优于 SINR-only）、混合预编码鲁棒性功率（0.0897→0.0002 W，优于有限交替 0.1576→0.0006）。多项传统基线出现轻微不可行/约束违反（如 P=40W 饱和），AgenticPrecoding 保持高度稳定；功率最小化案例中各 SNR 下功耗均最低，可行性矩阵显示其 100% 可行，而 RZF-GS 在 0 dB 因数值不稳定无法收敛。

Conclusion: AgenticPrecoding 证明"领域特化 LoRA 微调智能体 + 通用实现智能体 + 反馈驱动精修"的多智能体架构能够打通从高层通信需求到可执行预编码求解器的自动链路，弥合传统场景专用求解器在适配性与实现可靠性上的缺口，在异构场景与噪声受限/约束紧致的极端条件下仍取得最优性能与 100% 可行率。该工作验证了多智能体架构用于物理层设计的可行性，提供了面向 6G 自动化预编码优化的自适应框架。局限在于求解器空间限定为非学习型方法、依赖闭源通用 LLM、实验场景数有限，且部分场景（如全双工 QoS）优势幅度较小。

Abstract: Precoding is a key technique for interference management and performance improvement in multi-antenna wireless systems. However, existing precoding methods are typically developed for specific system models, objectives, and constraint sets, which limits their adaptability to the heterogeneous and evolving scenarios expected in future 6G networks. To address this limitation, we propose AgenticPrecoding, a universal multi-agent framework that automates end-to-end precoding derivation directly from user-level communication requirements. Specifically, AgenticPrecoding decomposes the derivation process into four coordinated stages: problem formulation, solver selection, prompt upsampling, and code generation, assigning each stage to a specialized agent tailored to its specific reasoning demands. We employ two LoRA-adapted reasoning agents to inject precoding-specific domain knowledge for problem formulation and solver selection, while two general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) handle prompt refinement and executable code generation. Furthermore, a feedback-driven refinement mechanism is incorporated to enhance code executability, constraint feasibility, and solution quality. Extensive experiments across 10 representative precoding scenarios demonstrate that AgenticPrecoding achieves superior cross-scenario adaptability compared to conventional optimization-based and LLM-based baselines.

</details>


### [75] [Coordination Matters: Evaluation of Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06557)
*Maria Ana Cardei,Matthew Landers,Afsaneh Doryab*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出协调感知评估视角，通过STAT测试平台补充回报指标来诊断过程级协调机制。研究发现相似回报可能掩盖不同的协调策略，为合作式多智能体强化学习评估提供新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合作式多智能体强化学习基准测试主要关注聚合结果指标（如回报率、成功率和完成时间），无法揭示智能体如何在智能体、任务和联合分配选择组合性扩展的设置中进行协调。

Method: 开发了STAT，一个受控的承诺约束型空间任务分配测试平台，系统性变化智能体数量、任务数量和环境规模，同时固定观察访问和任务规则；评估了六种具有代表性的基于值的多智能体强化学习方法，跨越不同集中化程度。

Result: 相似回报趋势可能反映不同的协调机制，包括冗余分配、分配多样性和任务完成效率的差异；在承诺约束型任务分配中，规模化性能不仅受名义动作空间大小影响，还受分配压力、稀疏决策机会和相互依赖智能体间的冗余选择影响。

Conclusion: 协调感知评估应作为基于回报的多智能体强化学习基准测试的必要补充，以揭示不同方法如何通过不同的协调机制实现相似性能。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) benchmarks commonly emphasize aggregate outcomes such as return, success rate, or completion time. While essential, these metrics often fail to reveal how agents coordinate, particularly in settings where agents, tasks, and joint assignment choices scale combinatorially. We propose a coordination-aware evaluation perspective that supplements return with process-level diagnostics. We instantiate this perspective using STAT, a controlled commitment-constrained spatial task-allocation testbed that systematically varies agents, tasks, and environment size while holding observation access and task rules fixed. We evaluate six representative value-based MARL methods across varying levels of centralization. Our results show that similar return trends can reflect distinct coordination mechanisms, including differences in redundant assignment, assignment diversity, and task-completion efficiency. We find that in commitment-constrained task allocation, performance under scale is shaped not only by nominal action-space size, but also by assignment pressure, sparse decision opportunities, and redundant choices among interdependent agents. Our findings motivate coordination-aware evaluation as a necessary complement to return-based benchmarking for cooperative MARL.

</details>

### [76] [From Cradle to Cloud: A Life Cycle Review of AI's Environmental Footprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05416)
*Katherine Lambert,Sasha Luccioni*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文是一篇结构化文献综述（61篇文献，2019–2025），提出并使用"AI八阶段生命周期"框架（硬件制造、基础设施建设、数据集创建与预处理、模型实验与研发、模型训练、后训练适配、部署与推理、退役与处置），系统梳理了AI环境影响研究在生命周期各阶段的覆盖度、报告指标（能耗、CO2e、水耗、多影响LCA、隐含硬件影响、算力代理、成本）与方法学选择。结论是：现有研究高度集中于训练与推理（分别31篇与36篇），后训练适配为0篇、数据集创建仅5篇、实验与研发8篇、退役8篇；报告以粗粒度代理估算的CO2e为主，水耗、材料制造、多影响LCA严重不足，导致跨研究不可比、无法聚合。论文据此提出生命周期感知、标准指标、直接测量工具、以及面向非技术受众的解读与政策披露机制等四项建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统规模与部署量快速增长，加剧了对其自然资源消耗（能源、水、矿产）、数据中心供电与冷却负担以及全供应链温室气体排放的担忧；但模型开发者普遍不披露这些影响，且"AI生命周期"一词在文献中定义混乱——有的仅覆盖训练与推理，有的纳入数据采集、基础设施与隐含排放，导致研究难以比较、审计与政策利用。此外，报告实践严重偏向碳排放（多基于粗放代理指标如GPU小时×TDP×电网碳强度×PUE），对水耗、材料制造与多影响LCA关注不足。因此需要一个以生命周期为组织视角、覆盖"从摇篮到云端"的全面文献图谱，定位空白阶段并提出可比较、可政策化的测量与报告规范。

Method: 结构化文献综述，三步法：(1) 定义分析性生命周期框架——综合LCA导向研究、ICT生命周期模型、ISO 14040/14044基础、OECD与ISO/IEC 5338:2023等来源，遵循"功能有序、影响相异、经验可测、粒度适中"四项划分准则，划分出八阶段（硬件制造、基础设施建设、数据集创建与预处理、模型实验与研发、模型训练、后训练适配、部署与推理、退役与处置），强调其为分析性分解而非严格顺序模型；(2) 2025年秋季在Semantic Scholar、arXiv、ACM DL、Google Scholar检索（AI术语与环境影响术语组合），初检82条，标题摘要筛选后全文复核，并做后向引文链与作者追踪，最终纳入61篇（2019–2025），含期刊26篇、会议14篇、arXiv预印本18篇、其他报告3篇；(3) 结构化电子表格编码：元数据、主题标签、多标签生命周期阶段标注（按实际测量/估计/方法讨论范围）、方法学（直接测量、硬件规格估算、理论建模、CodeCarbon/CarbonTracker/EIT等工具）、指标、硬件与模型类型、关键结论与局限。研究回答四个问题：研究程度、阶段覆盖分布、指标与测量方式、方法学差异。作者同时坦承局限：文献碎片化难以穷尽、纳入非同行评审来源导致质量异质、阶段归属需解释性判断、可能存在遗漏。

Result: 覆盖度：部署与推理36篇（59%）、模型训练31篇（50%）、基础设施建设25篇、硬件制造20篇、多影响/算力/隐含影响21篇、能耗36篇、碳排27篇、水耗仅10篇（<20%）、多影响LCA仅7篇、硬件隐含影响9篇、成本6篇；后训练适配0篇，数据集创建与预处理仅5篇（约8%），模型实验与研发8篇（13.1%），退役处置8篇（13.1%）。主要发现：①硬件制造的隐含排放与运营排放量级相当（NVIDIA HGX H100基板cradle-to-gate约1312 kg CO2e/单元），且在矿物耗竭、生态毒性、人类健康等维度上制造与稀土供应链常占主导；②基础设施多作为IT能耗的乘性开销系数出现，难以归属到AI；③数据阶段（爬取、存储、CLIP过滤、合成数据）几乎不被计量，LAION、DataComp等仅以数据规模/质量描述而无环境核算；④神经架构搜索等实验迭代可使排放比单次训练高出一个数量级以上，有分析甚至显示OpenAI算力的大头用于实验而非训练或推理，BUTTER-E数据集（6万余次实验）显示超线性能耗增长；⑤训练核算常遗漏失败/中止运行、预热调试与非加速器部件与冷却配电，系统性低估；⑥推理在规模化常驻服务中可能主导生命周期能耗（年服务排放超训练一个数量级），且对批量、并发、序列长度与软件栈高度敏感；⑦退役阶段直接碳占比通常仅数个百分点，但在矿物耗竭、有毒性与电子废弃物上不容忽视。方法学差异：从直接功率监测（NVML、RAPL）到软件估算器再到FLOPs/运行时/TDP解析近似，工具（CodeCarbon、CarbonTracker、Experiment Impact Tracker、MLCO2 Impact、BoaviztAPI）虽降低门槛但依赖硬件检测、系统边界与碳强度假设，不宜当作地面真值。此外计量单位与边界不一致（GPU小时是单卡还是整机集群、PUE 1.1–1.8或隐含1.0、全国平均碳强度代替区域值）严重削弱可比性。文献计量显示主题快速增长，2023–2025年数量激增，2025年明显转向更宽的生命周期覆盖。

Conclusion: 核心结论是：AI环境影响研究呈"运营阶段中心化"格局，训练与推理占主导，而上游（硬件、基础设施、数据）与下游（实验、后训练、退役）严重缺测，导致现有LCA只是局部、偏运营的视角而非真正的"从摇篮到grave"评估；同时报告在指标、范围与方法上高度异质，使跨研究比较与结果聚合几乎不可能，削弱了治理、审计与标准化披露的基础。论文提出四项改进建议：(1) 以八阶段框架提升生命周期完整性，显式声明所覆盖阶段；(2) 标准化指标与单位范围（至少报告kWh与CO2e，明确排放因子、PUE、碳强度、边界是设备级还是设施级，并纳入水耗/WUE等指标）；(3) 优先使用CodeCarbon、CarbonTracker等直接测量工具并公开原始测量数据与假设；同时承认代理指标只能做数量级比较；(4) 将实证结论翻译为非技术受众可理解的等价物（如美元、吨CO2e），以支撑监管与决策。政策层面建议：按模型、用法与基础设施细分的定期环境披露要求与激励机制（政府采购与资助挂钩）、将AI排放纳入碳定价与企业可持续报告等国际标准与生态标签/AI Energy Score等基准机制、以直接测量工具作为标准化监测与第三方审计的基础，以及研究者与监管者协作推动可执行政策。

Abstract: The rapid growth in the deployment and scale of modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems has intensified concerns regarding their environmental impacts, yet we still lack a comprehensive view of where and how these impacts arise across the AI life cycle. In order to shed more light on this question, we conduct a structured, comprehensive literature review of scientific papers and technical reports that examine different aspects of AI's environmental footprint. Using an eight-stage life cycle framework, spanning hardware manufacturing, infrastructure construction, data gathering and preprocessing, model experimentation, training, post-training adaptation, deployment, inference, and end-of-life, we systematically map which stages are covered, the metrics reported at each stage, and the methodological choices made. We then draw conclusions about the information we gathered, finding that although life cycle language is increasingly common in discussions of "green" or "sustainable" AI, its definition remains unclear -- while some studies focus solely on model training and inference, others encompass broader measurements such as data collection, infrastructure, and embodied emissions. We also find that reporting practices rely predominantly on CO2e estimates derived from coarse proxies, with limited attention dedicated to water usage, materials manufacturing, and multi-impact life cycle assessment, making it difficult to compare and aggregate true results. Building on these findings, we propose measurement and reporting approaches to support more comprehensive, comparable and policy-relevant assessments of AI's environmental impacts.

</details>


### [77] [LLMorphism: When humans come to see themselves as language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05419)
*Valerio Capraro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"LLMorphism"概念，指人类认知类似于大语言模型的偏倚信念。随着对话式LLM的普及，人们可能产生反向推断——若LLM能像人一样说话，人可能像LLM一样思考。这种偏差通过类比迁移和隐喻可及性两种机制传播。文章区分了LLMorphism与机械论、拟人论等概念，并探讨了其在工作、教育、医疗等领域的广泛影响，最终指出当前公共讨论遗漏了问题的另一半：不仅高估机器的心智，也可能低估人类的心智。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着对话式大语言模型的普及，人们可能产生"反向推论"——既然LLM能像人类一样说话，人类也可能像LLM一样思考。这种推断存在认知偏差，因为语言输出的相似性并不代表认知架构的相似性。

Method: 通过概念辨析、机制分析（类比迁移和隐喻可及性）和跨领域影响评估来展开论证，并将LLMorphism与相关概念（机械论、拟人论、计算主义等）进行区分。

Result: 该研究建立了LLMorphism的理论框架，阐明了其传播机制（类比迁移和隐喻可及性），并系统梳理了其在工作、教育、医疗、责任认定等领域的应用及其边界条件与抵抗形式。

Conclusion: 提出了双向思维归属问题：不仅要对机器赋予过多心智，还要警惕对人类赋予过少心智。呼吁学界和公众关注LLMorphism这一新兴偏见，可能对人类尊严、工作、教育等多个领域产生深远影响。

Abstract: LLMorphism is the biased belief that human cognition works like a large language model. I argue that the rise of conversational LLMs may make this bias increasingly psychologically available. When artificial systems produce human-like language, people may draw a reverse inference: if LLMs can speak like humans, perhaps humans think like LLMs. This inference is biased because similarity at the level of linguistic output does not imply similarity in cognitive architecture. Yet, LLMorphism may spread through two mechanisms: analogical transfer, whereby features of LLMs are projected onto humans, and metaphorical availability, whereby LLM vocabulary becomes a culturally salient vocabulary for describing thought. I distinguish LLMorphism from mechanomorphism, anthropomorphism, computationalism, dehumanization, objectification, and predictive-processing theories of mind. I outline its implications for work, education, responsibility, healthcare, communication, creativity, and human dignity, while also discussing boundary conditions and forms of resistance. I conclude that the public debate may be missing half of the problem: the issue is not only whether we are attributing too much mind to machines, but also whether we are beginning to attribute too little mind to humans.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI频繁产生错误和幻觉，传统观念视其为应用障碍，但研究者认为这些"缺陷"实际上可以被转化为教学契机，用于激发学生的分析、评估和反思等高阶思维过程。

Method: 采用混合方法研究设计，在数据库设计课程中实施AI整合教学大纲，通过结构化的AI交互活动让学生接触并分析AI生成的错误，对学生的元认知投入、学科严谨性以及自评AI素养和学科能力进行评估。

Result: 结构化的AI错误交互能够促进学生的元认知投入、增强学科严谨性，并与学生的AI素养和学科能力感知呈正相关。

Conclusion: 将AI的局限性重新定位为教学工具，而非需要规避的缺陷，证明了教育者可以通过有意设计AI与学生的互动来培养高阶思维能力。该研究为AI辅助教学的设计提供了实证依据，强调了错误分析在发展元认知和学科严谨性方面的价值。

Abstract: As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into higher education, its frequent errors and hallucinations, often seen as limitations, offer a unique pedagogical opportunity. By framing AI as a ``learning companion'' whose imperfect outputs prompt analysis, evaluation, and reflection, we argue that instructors can engage students in the fundamental processes of higher-order thinking. This paper presents a design-oriented study in which an AI-integrated syllabus in a \textit{database design} course deliberately leverages AI's limitations to foster critical thinking and higher-order cognitive skills aligned with Bloom's taxonomy of learning. Using a mixed-methods approach, we examine how structured interaction with AI-generated errors supports metacognitive engagement, reinforces disciplinary rigor, and relates to students' perceived AI literacy and subject-matter competency.

</details>


### [79] [Rigorous Interpretation Is a Form of Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05508)
*Isabelle Lee,Emmy Liu,Cathy Jiao,Brihi Joshi,Dani Yogatama,Fazl Barez,Michael Saxon*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: This paper argues that interpretability should evolve from a diagnostic tool to a core evaluation methodology for machine learning models, enabling deeper understanding of why models behave certain ways rather than just measuring what they produce.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current model evaluation relies on surface-level behavioral metrics (accuracies, win rates), treating explanation and evaluation as separate concerns. The paper argues that interpretability can serve not just as diagnostic tool but as a more principled evaluation framework.

Method: Conceptual exploration of three functional roles of interpretability in model evaluation, with argument for scientific standards as requirements.

Result: Identified three evaluative functions of interpretability: (1) root cause identification for fixing problems, (2) detection of subtly faulty mechanisms that invalidate outputs, (3) predictive understanding of model weaknesses to anticipate issues.

Conclusion: Interpretability methods must meet scientific standards (falsifiable, reproducible, predictive) to fulfill their evaluative potential as a principled form of model evaluation.

Abstract: Current machine learning models are evaluated through behavioral snapshots, with benchmark accuracies, win rates and outcome-based metrics. Model explanations and evaluations, however, are fundamentally intertwined: understanding why a model produces a behavior can be as important as measuring what it produces. If we trusted interpretability, we argue that it can serve not merely as diagnostics but as a richer and more principled form of model evaluation beyond surface-level performance metrics. We explore three ways interpretability can function evaluatively: (1) fixing problems by identifying the root causes of unwanted behavior, (2) detecting subtly faulty mechanisms that invalidate model outputs, and (3) predicting potential issues before they arise by fully understanding the model's weaknesses. To fulfill its evaluative potential, we argue that interpretability methods must generate claims that are falsifiable, reproducible, and predictive -- that is, interpretability must meet scientific standards.

</details>

Abstract: Current Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based tutoring systems (AI tutors) are primarily evaluated based on the pedagogical quality of their feedback messages. While important, pedagogy alone is insufficient because it ignores a critical question: what do students actually do with the feedback they receive? We argue that AI tutor evaluation should be extended with a behavioral dimension grounded in student interaction data, which complements pedagogical assessment. We propose an evaluation framework and apply it to 10,235 code submissions with corresponding AI tutor feedback from an introductory undergraduate programming course to measure whether students act on tutor feedback and whether those actions are applied correctly. Using this framework to compare two deployed AI tutors across different semesters in a large-scale introductory computer science course reveals substantial differences in student engagement patterns that are not captured by pedagogy-only evaluation. Moreover, these engagement-based behavioral signals are more strongly associated with student perception of helpful feedback than pedagogical quality alone, providing a more complete and actionable picture of AI tutor performance.

</details>


### [81] [Breaking In and Reaching Out: Networking for Women in Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06195)
*Shalini Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向 ACM womENcourage 2026 的**研讨会提案论文**（非完整实证研究）。作者 Shalini Chakraborty（拜罗伊特大学软件工程组）组织一场 1.5 小时的社区参与式研讨会，聚焦"计算机科学中的女性"在人际网络（networking）建立过程中遭遇的结构性与个体性障碍。研讨会以作者前作提出的"因素导向框架"（包含地理与位置、资金与资源、国籍与监管、会议时长、语言与沟通、性别与社会认同、个性与神经多样性、照护责任等八个维度）为讨论骨架，通过分享经验、反思与补充新因素，收集女性在学术与工业网络中的 lived experiences，最终目标是为软件工程与计算机科学界提出更包容、公平、可及的网络实践建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机有三层：① networking 对 CS 职业发展至关重要，直接影响合作机会、可见度（visibility）、导师关系与长期影响力；文献表明网络规模更大的研究者合作更多、发表更频繁、被引更高（Barabási 2002；Crane & Kaplan 1973）。但网络机会分布极不均衡——社会经济与地理差异决定了谁能负担国际会议差旅，签证限制与机构经费约束不成比例地限制中低收入国家研究者，语言与文化差异（英语主导的发表与交流体系）使非母语者在会议酒会、线上讨论等**非正式互动场景**中被边缘化，因为这类场景才是真正塑造合作与可见度的核心通道（Chakraborty 2026 的核心论点：networking 绝非单纯的个人技能问题）。② 现有研究多停留于识别"结构性障碍"的宏观层面，缺乏对女性群体跨背景、跨情境下"这些挑战如何被体验、协商与感知"的细致刻画。③ 尤其对早期职业研究者（ECR）而言，网络是决定学术路径的关键变量，而将讨论从软件工程单一学科扩展到更广的计算机科学领域，有可能浮现既有研究忽略的新因素。本文的定位并非要延续前一项实证研究，而是以其结论为动机，搭建一个开放、社区驱动的对话空间。

Method: 方法层面属定性-参与式研究设计（workshop-as-method），具体为：① **框架借用与扩展**：直接采用并扩展作者既有论文提出的 factor-based framework，八个维度为讨论议程骨架——Geography and Location、Funding and Other Resources、Nationality and Regulation、Timing and Duration of Conferences、Language and Communication、Gender and Social Identity、Personality and Neurodiversity、Caregiving Status and Personal Responsibilities。② **证据来源**：以 ICSE'26 会议上的问卷调查初步实证结果 + 后续在巴西软件工程社区通过在线社交媒体平台收集的定性与定量数据作为经验基础（用作动机与引言素材，不作为本论文的新数据）。③ **活动结构**：1.5 小时会议分三段——15 分钟引言（呈现动机、概述 ICSE-CHASE 论文要点、介绍框架与在研调查）；60 分钟引导式讨论（按因素分组，围绕"分享经历与挑战—反思该因素如何影响 networking 能力—指出框架缺口/补充新因素"三个提示展开）；15 分钟反思与自愿分享（明确声明无义务贡献研究产出）。④ **包容性与伦理设计**：全程不录音以保障安全支持的环境；不设技术演示要求，允许使用笔记本电脑；强调交叉性（intersectional）视角与跨认同的多元参与者，欢迎非女性参与者提供不同立场。⑤ **角色分工**：组织者担任主持人（facilitator）与框架讲解者，但刻意避免自上而下的报告式形式，构建"人人可发声"的协作场域。

Result: 论文本身**未报告独立的定量或定性实证结果**，其"产出"是会议设计与论证框架，可归纳为：① 明确了 networking 障碍的分析单位——不是个体技能缺陷，而是地理、资金、签证/监管、语言、身份、个性/神经多样性、照护责任等**多层次因素的耦合作用**，并将其操作化为可讨论的八个分析维度；② 提出了 networking 机会分配不均的机制性解释，指出非正式社交场景（走廊交谈、酒会、社区聚会）是决定可见度与合作关系的关键社会基础设施，却恰恰是资源劣势者最难进入的空间；③ 形成了一套可复用的参与式研究方法论：以"安全、不录音、无产出义务"的信任机制换取真实的经验叙述，这对研究敏感身份议题具有方法学示范意义；④ 明确了三个可检验的产出方向——(i) 理解女性 networking 的生活经验与挑战，(ii) 识别被忽略或新涌现的因素，(iii) 推动更包容的 SE networking 实践。相关先前的实证证据已指向：早期职业研究者、女性与全球南方学者在获取合作空间与资金网络上面临系统性的结构性壁垒（Bilecen & Van Mol 2017；Mokhachane et al. 2024；Curry & Lillis 2017；Gülel 2025）。

Conclusion: 结论与定位上，论文主张 networking 应被视为**社会-结构-个体交互的现象**而非个人能力问题，其不平等分布系统性地偏向拥有资源、流动性与既有学术环境的人，边缘化他人；女性在 CS 中的 networking 障碍尤其由交叉性身份、地理与经济约束、照护责任与语言/文化差异叠加而成。据此，研讨会试图把分散的个体经验汇聚为集体知识与共同体，并输出面向会议组织者、机构与社区的可操作启示：会议设计应考虑时长与时差安排（时区/时差、远程与混合参与）、可负担的差旅与资助机制、多语言支持以降低语言门槛、包容性的非正式社交形式（避免强制酒会式社交、线上等价通道）、以及照护友好型时间安排。作者也明确设定了边界：本文不是前作研究的延续，不产生新的数据集，产出是"促成讨论与共识的共享空间"；其价值需在研讨会实际实施后，通过参与者的经验反馈与后续归纳研究来验证。

Abstract: Networking is central to careers in computer science, where a globally distributed and diverse community increasingly collaborates across institutional and geographic boundaries, often in hybrid and remote settings. However, access to effective networking is shaped by structural and personal factors, including geography, funding, language, identity, personality, and caregiving responsibilities. Building on prior work, this workshop focuses on women in computing to examine lived experiences of networking and the barriers they encounter. Through a community-driven discussion grounded in a factor-based framework, the workshop aims to surface overlooked challenges and foster shared understanding. Ultimately, it seeks to inform more inclusive, equitable, and accessible networking practices within the computer science community.

</details>


### [82] [A Benchmark for Strategic Auditee Gaming Under Continuous Compliance Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06340)
*Florian A. D. Burnat,Brittany I. Davidson*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向"持续合规监控下受审方策略性博弈"的轻量级基准（benchmark）。核心内容：(1) 将连续审计形式化为 T 轮、领导者—跟随者承诺顺序的 Stackelberg 式博弈（但不给收益函数、不求均衡）；(2) 给出"覆盖—粒度权衡"设计引理（Design Lemma 4.1），证明任何仅依赖 Wald 噪声带的静态审计策略都存在一个"掩蔽区间（cover regime）"，其中覆盖率失效（在被审计轮次外漂移）与粒度失效（缩小样本量 n_t）两种逃逸方式不能同时被封堵；(3) 沿两条正交轴各提一个干预基线：样本量下限（Min-sample floor）封堵粒度失效，怀疑升级（Suspicion-escalation）封堵朴素 Drift 的覆盖失效，而二者皆无法同时封堵；(4) 审计感知策略 OffAuditDrift 利用承诺时序同时击败二者，但该零缺口性质依赖于"已实现审计日程被披露"，随机日程私有时立即失效；(5) 提出非可加的双暴露记账（覆盖面 W 与排除面 C），显示样本流失把可测危害从"监管可见面"转移到"监管不可见面"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟 AI 法案第 72 条（上市后持续监测）与 DSA 第 15/24/34/35/37/42 条（透明度报告、理由说明、系统性风险、年度独立审计、六个月发布周期）共同引入了一个此前被忽略的结构：审计关系是纵向的——受监管方在多轮中报告结果指标，审计方决定审查哪些轮次，而受审方可以从其预先承诺的映射中产生依赖时间与历史的输出。既有工作几乎都是一次性（one-shot）的：战略分类（Hardt et al. 2016；Dong et al. 2018）、performative prediction（Perdomo et al. 2020）、多资源审计博弈（Blocki et al. 2015）都只建模单轮分类器或单次审计资源分配；AI 审计生态与访问权研究（Raji et al. 2022；Casper et al. 2024）虽厘清了审计方需要什么，却假定受审方"诚实但好奇"；最接近的部署系统——用于公平性监控的多方安全计算协议（He et al. 2026）也明确假设诚实但好奇方。会计学中的连续审计文献（Heald 2018）虽长期承认策略性受审行为，却未转化为 AI 公平社区可共享、可执行的评测基元。经验证据方面，DSA 透明度数据库审计记录了跨平台内容审核报告的不一致（Trujillo et al. 2025），平台侧 API 限制又造成独立核验的"审计盲点"（Burnat & Davidson 2026b）。因此需要一个可在持续审计、跨多轮、审计方掌握调度节奏的条件下系统压力测试受审方行为的可执行基准。

Method: （1）过程规范：T 轮随机审计过程，领导者—跟随者承诺顺序——审计方先承诺完整策略映射，受审方在获披露信息后再承诺完整报告映射，映射在 rollout 期间固定（即便输出依赖历史），因此承诺阶段可视为对完整或 Contingent 计划的一次性 leader–follower 表示，而 T 轮 rollout 对漂移、检测延迟、累积暴露与历史条件化审计动作仍是必要的。隐含真值按裁剪漂移 m*_t=clip(m*_{t-1}+η_t,0,1)，η~N(0,σ²)，σ=0.02；审计方核验参考量 m_t 设为等于 m*_t（刻意简化的接受带，非双样本检验）。
（2）审计规则：噪声感知的 Wald 阈值，|m̂_t−m_t| > ε + z√(m̂_t(1−m̂_t)/n_t)，z=1.96，并给出族错误率控制的 Bonferroni 变体 z_Bonf=Φ⁻¹(1−α/(2K))，K 为承诺或实现的审计轮次数。
（3）日程的"形成（formation）"与"披露（disclosure）"两轴分离：One-shot/Periodic/Scheduled-random/Min-sample-floor 披露已实现日程（R1），R2 为公开随机策略但私有实现抽样，R3（私有/更丰富历史条件调度）不在评测网格内。
（4）受审方策略库（诊断套件）：Delay(k=2)、Drift(δ=0.05)、Cherry-pick(J=5, σ_pick=0.04，从 J 个候选定义中取最大)、Attrition(τ=0.40, δ_cover=0.05，m_t<τ 时把 n_t 从 1000 降到 100 并附加漂移)、OffAuditDrift(已实现审计集上诚实、其余轮次漂移 δ)，外加 HonestAuditee 与 HonestNoisyAuditee（后者为二项采样噪声）对照。
（5）审计方策略库：One-shot(t*=5)、Periodic(k=3, phase 2, 审计轮 {2,5,8,11})、Scheduled-random(K=4, seed 42)、Min-sample floor(n_floor=500，附加 n_t<n_floor 即标记)、Suspicion-escalation(基线 {4,8}，观察到超阈间隙后审计其后每轮)。前两者有监管类比，后两者是基准提出的诊断性干预而非现行法律要求。
（6）设计引理 4.1：限定"静态时间覆盖策略 + Wald 规则"这一类别，定义掩蔽区间 Δ=(ε+z√(p(1−p)/n_max), ε+z√(p(1−p)/n_min]；给出两例构造性逃逸——Case 1 覆盖失效（未审计轮次漂移，τ_d=T 且 W≥δ·n_max）与 Case 2 粒度失效（全审计但 n_t=n_min，阈值变宽到 δ 之下，G=δ 且永不被标记），证明"提高审计频率能削弱 Case 1 但不能施加独立的证据量约束"。
（7）度量：G（审计轮次上的平均报告-真值差）、τ_d（首次触发检测的审计轮次，τ_d=T 表示未检出）、覆盖面暴露 W=Σ_{t∉A} n_t|m̂−m|（报告已覆盖人群内的加权误述）、排除面暴露 C=Σ_t (N−n_t)|m̂−m|（报告未覆盖人群上的加权误述）；二者不可加、非福利估计。
（8）实现与实验：纯 Python 包 audit_gaming_benchmark（env/strategies/policies/metrics/run 五模块），YAML 配置、确定性种子、JSON 输出、23 项 pytest 回归测试；30 个种子、两种配置（默认 m0=0.5，Attrition 配置 m0=0.30）；参数区分"制度锚点 / 规模启发 / 机制激活压力测试点"，明确不拟合平台轨迹。

Result: 五条主结论。（1）Drift 可被检出但未审计暴露仍在：检测延迟随节奏变化，Scheduled-random 平均 1.3 轮、Periodic 2.0 轮、One-shot 5.0 轮（解析期望 (T+1)/(K+1)−1=1.6），未审计轮次仍累积 W=400–550 人轮。（2）Bonferroni 校正以延迟换误报控制：Cherry-pick 在 Periodic 下未校正 τ_d=2.7、校正后 4.2（+1.5 轮）；诚实噪声标定显示每轮假阳率 0.044–0.054，4 次审计策略的族错误率由未校正 0.165–0.195 降至 ≤0.065。（3）Attrition 改变的是"测得的表面"而非总危害：n_t 由 1000 降至 100 使阈值由 ≈0.031 放宽到 ≈0.098，同一 +0.05 漂移被吞没；Periodiс 下 Drift 为 W=400、C=0，而 Attrition 为 W=39、C=534，说明加权暴露从报告覆盖面向排除面迁移，符合引理 Case 2。（4）两种干预作用于不同轴：Min-sample floor 在首次 Periodic 审计即检出 Attrition（τ_d=2.0），但对真实的小规模人群产生结构性二元误报（Fig.3a TPR/FPR 共用同一阈值变量）；Suspicion-escalation 对 Drift 检出于 4.0 轮且把 W 降至 200，对 Attrition 虽把实现审计集扩到 K=8、正式检测仍失败（因 0.05 间隙仍在 n_t=100 的加宽带内）。（5）OffAuditDrift 暴露"日程公开"这一条件：在已实现日程披露时其审计轮次缺口为零、所有头条策略均不检出、W=400–550；R2 私有抽样诊断中两个日程盲探针在全部种子被检出（τ_d=1.3 与 2.1，独立猜测日程时 W 降至 257），说明零缺口保证依赖日程披露。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献是"过程规范 + 双暴露记账 + 一条设计引理 + 可复现制品"式的基准，而非均衡求解或实证行为模型。作者明确限定：基准不设收益函数、不计算最优响应、不假定任一策略理性最优；结论只支持关于"指定探针与指定策略"的设计层陈述，不能推断受监管企业实际使用 Delay/Attrition/定义套利/日程利用的普遍程度；参数仅借 DSA 摘要统计提供语境，不构成平台级验证；W 与 C 是分立的责任面账本，不是社会福利（因此 W+C 不是充分危害统计量），且事后补救效应、声誉后果、审计方参考噪声、秘密/序贯策略均未建模；DSA/AI 法案只提供制度动机，不规定该策略类或接受规则，Min-sample floor 与 Suspicion-escalation 是基准提出的诊断性干预而非法律要求。展望方向包括多维指标与含噪审计参考、平台派生轨迹、显式成本与处罚、贝叶斯/序贯策略，以及联合条件化 (n_t 轨迹, 间隙历史) 的历史条件化前沿。

Abstract: Continuous post-deployment compliance audits, mandated by emerging regulations such as the EU AI Act and Digital Services Act, create a class of strategic gaming distinct from the one-shot input/output gaming studied in prior work. Regulated systems can delay outcome reporting, drift their reports within plausible noise envelopes, exploit longitudinal sample attrition, and cherry-pick among ambiguous metric definitions. We formalize continuous auditing as a $T$-round Stackelberg game between an auditor that commits to a temporal policy and an adaptive auditee, and identify a structural feature of any noise-aware static-auditor design: a cover regime in which coverage gaps and granularity gaps cannot be closed simultaneously. We make this formal as Observation 1 and show that two minimal extension policies, each derived from the observation, close the regime along orthogonal axes: a sample-size-aware static rule (Periodic-with-floor) closes the granularity-failure case, while a history-conditioned suspicion-escalation policy closes the coverage-failure case for the naive Drift strategy -- and neither closes both, exactly as the observation predicts; an audit-aware OffAuditDrift strategy that exploits Stackelberg commitment defeats both. To support empirical study we contribute a non-additive harm decomposition (welfare loss $W$, coverage loss $C$) that exposes how attrition shifts harm from the regulator-accountable surface to a regulator-invisible one; an initial library of five auditee strategies (Delay, Drift, Cherry-pick, Attrition, OffAuditDrift) and five auditor policies, calibrated to summary statistics from published audits of the DSA Transparency Database; and a reproducible simulator with a small, extensible Python interface.

</details>


### [83] [From Review to Design: Ethical Multimodal Driver Monitoring Systems for Risk Mitigation, Incident Response, and Accountability in Automated Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06439)
*Bilal Khana,Waseem Shariff,Rory Coyne,Muhammad Ali Farooq,Peter Corcoran*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶车辆中的驾驶员监控系统（DMS），审查现有监管框架（GDPR、EU AI Act、IEEE标准）的适用性，识别其在车内多模态感知场景中的监管空白，并提出针对DMS的模块化伦理设计框架，涵盖用户可配置同意机制、公平感知模型开发、透明性与可解释性工具，以及驾驶员情感健康保障措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着车辆自动化程度提升，DMS成为确保人类监督与安全的关键，但其部署引入了复杂的伦理与法律挑战，包括隐私、知情同意、数据所有权和算法公平性等。现有的通用监管框架（GDPR、EU AI Act、IEEE标准）缺乏针对车内感知技术特殊风险的专门规范。

Method: 采用“审查-设计”视角：①批判性审查现有监管工具与伦理框架；②基于审查结果提出模块化伦理设计框架；③制定风险分析与失效缓解策略，强调主动事件响应与问责机制。

Result: 提出针对DMS的模块化伦理设计框架，包含：用户可配置同意机制、公平感知模型开发、透明性与可解释性工具、驾驶员情感健康保障；并形成面向DMS场景的风险分析与失效缓解策略。

Conclusion: 本文为开发透明、可信赖、以人为中心的下一代自动驾驶车辆驾驶员监控系统提供了设计指导与监管建议，填补了现有框架在车内AI感知领域的技术-伦理交叉空白。

Abstract: As vehicles transition toward higher levels of automation, Driver Monitoring Systems (DMS) have become essential for ensuring human oversight, safety, and regulatory compliance in a vehicle. These systems rely on multimodal sensing and AI-driven inference to assess driver attention, cognitive state, and readiness to take control. While technologically promising, their deployment introduces a complex set of ethical and legal challenges - ranging from privacy and consent to data ownership and algorithmic fairness. While overarching frameworks such as the GDPR, EU AI Act, and IEEE standards offer important guidance, they lack the specificity required for addressing the unique risks posed by in-cabin sensing technologies.
  This paper adopts a review-to-design perspective, critically examining existing regulatory instruments and ethical frameworks -- such as the GDPR, the EU AI Act, and IEEE guidelines -- and identifying gaps in their applicability to the distinctive risks posed by multimodal, AI-enabled in-cabin monitoring. Building on this review, we propose a modular ethical design framework tailored specifically to Driver Monitoring Systems. The framework translates high-level principles into actionable design and deployment guidance, including user-configurable consent mechanisms, fairness-aware model development, transparency and explainability tools, and safeguards for driver emotional well-being.
  Finally, the paper outlines a risk analysis and failure mitigation strategy, emphasizing proactive incident response and accountability mechanisms tailored to the DMS context. Together, these contributions aim to inform the development of transparent, trustworthy, and human-centered driver monitoring systems for next-generation autonomous vehicles.

</details>

### [84] [Understanding Annotator Safety Policy with Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05329)
*Alex Oesterling,Donghao Ren,Yannick Assogba,Dominik Moritz,Sunnie S. Y. Kim,Leon Gatys,Fred Hohman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出注解策略模型（APMs），通过学习标注行为来推断标注者内部的安全策略，无需额外标注成本即可区分标注分歧的来源（操作失误、政策模糊性、价值多元主义），从而支持更具针对性、透明性和包容性的安全政策设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Annotation disagreement in safety policy is pervasive but its root causes (operational failures, policy ambiguity, value pluralism) are difficult to distinguish. Existing approaches of directly asking annotators for reasoning are costly and unreliable for both human and LLM annotators.

Method: Introduced Annotator Policy Models (APMs)—interpretable models that learn annotators' internal safety policies from labeling behavior alone, without requiring additional annotation effort or direct querying of annotator reasoning.

Result: Validated APMs achieve >80% accuracy in modeling annotator safety policy, faithfully predict responses to counterfactual edits, and recover known policy differences in controlled settings. Demonstrated applications include surfacing policy ambiguity and uncovering systematic differences in safety priorities across demographic groups.

Conclusion: APMs enable more targeted, transparent, and inclusive safety policy design by distinguishing between operational failures, policy ambiguity, and value pluralism as sources of annotation disagreement.

Abstract: Safety policies define what constitutes safe and unsafe AI outputs, guiding data annotation and model development. However, annotation disagreement is pervasive and can stem from multiple sources such as operational failures (annotators misunderstand or misexecute the task), policy ambiguity (policy wording leaves room for interpretation), or value pluralism (different annotators hold different perspectives on safety). Distinguishing these sources matters. For example, operational failures call for quality control, ambiguity calls for policy clarification, and pluralism calls for deliberation about incorporating diverse perspectives. Yet understanding why annotators disagree is difficult. Directly asking annotators for their reasoning is costly, substantially increasing annotation burden, and can be unreliable for both human and LLM annotators as self-reported reasoning often fails to reflect actual decision processes.
  We introduce Annotator Policy Models (APMs), interpretable models that learn annotators' internal safety policies from labeling behavior alone, making annotator reasoning visible and comparable without additional annotation effort. We validate that APMs accurately model annotator safety policy (>80% accuracy), faithfully predict responses to counterfactual edits, and recover known policy differences in controlled settings. Applying APMs to LLM and human annotations, we demonstrate two core applications: (1) surfacing policy ambiguity by revealing how annotators interpret safety instructions differently, and (2) surfacing value pluralism by uncovering systematic differences in safety priorities across demographic groups. Together, these capabilities support more targeted, transparent, and inclusive safety policy design.

</details>


### [85] [ZAYA1-8B Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05365)
*Robert Washbourne,Rishi Iyer,Tomas Figliolia,Henry Zheng,Ryan Lorig-Roach,Sungyeon Yang,Pritish Yuvraj,Quentin Anthony,Yury Tokpanov,Xiao Yang,Ganesh Nanduru,Stephen Ebert,Praneeth Medepalli,Skyler Szot,Srivatsan Rajagopal,Alex Ong,Bhavana Mehta,Beren Millidge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ZAYA1-8B是一个700M活跃参数、8B总参数的MoE推理模型，通过四级RL级联训练和创新的Markovian RSA测试时计算方法，在多个推理基准测试中取得优异成绩，将AIME'25提升至91.9%，几乎追平当前顶级大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在保持活跃参数低于1B的前提下，开发一个能够匹配或超越大型推理模型（如DeepSeek-R1-0528）性能的高效推理模型，同时探索测试时计算扩展的高效方法。

Method: 基于MoE++架构构建ZAYA1-8B模型，采用全AMD计算平台进行预训练、中训练和SFT；在后训练阶段使用四级RL级联（推理热身、RLVE-Gym课程、数学/代码RL、行为RL）；引入Markovian RSA方法在测试时递归聚合并行推理轨迹，仅携带4K-token尾部长度。

Result: ZAYA1-8B在AIME'25上达到91.9%，HMMT'25上达到89.6%，在多项数学和代码基准测试中匹配或超越DeepSeek-R1-0528，显著缩小了与Gemini-2.5 Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-5-High等更大模型的差距。

Conclusion: ZAYA1-8B通过高效的MoE架构和创新的Markovian RSA测试时计算方法，在仅700M活跃参数下实现了与参数量大得多的推理模型相当甚至更好的性能，证明了小规模模型通过优化训练策略和推理方法可以达到接近顶级大模型的推理能力。

Abstract: We present ZAYA1-8B, a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 700M active and 8B total parameters, built on Zyphra's MoE++ architecture. ZAYA1-8B's core pretraining, midtraining, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) were performed on a full-stack AMD compute, networking, and software platform. With under 1B active parameters, ZAYA1-8B matches or exceeds DeepSeek-R1-0528 on several challenging mathematics and coding benchmarks, and remains competitive with substantially larger open-weight reasoning models. ZAYA1-8B was trained from scratch for reasoning, with reasoning data included from pretraining onward using an answer-preserving trimming scheme. Post-training uses a four-stage RL cascade: reasoning warmup on math and puzzles; a 400-task RLVE-Gym curriculum; math and code RL with test-time compute traces and synthetic code environments built from competitive-programming references; and behavioral RL for chat and instruction following. We also introduce Markovian RSA, a test-time compute method that recursively aggregates parallel reasoning traces while carrying forward only bounded-length reasoning tails between rounds. In TTC evaluation, Markovian RSA raises ZAYA1-8B to 91.9\% on AIME'25 and 89.6\% on HMMT'25 while carrying forward only a 4K-token tail, narrowing the gap to much larger reasoning models including Gemini-2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2, and GPT-5-High.

</details>


### [86] [Partial Evidence Bench: Benchmarking Authorization-Limited Evidence in Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05379)
*Krti Tallam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Partial Evidence Bench，一个用于测量智能体在部分证据场景下产生不安全完整答案这一失败模式的确定性基准。该基准包含3个场景家族、72个任务和4个评估维度，验证了显式失败-报告机制相比静默过滤的安全性优势，为企业环境中的AI系统完整性评估提供了可重复的测试框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业智能体日益在受限检索系统和策略约束环境中运行。在这些设置中，访问控制可以正确执行，但系统仍可能产生看似完整的答案，而关键证据实际上位于调用者授权边界之外。这种"部分证据"场景构成了一个关键但未被充分识别的失败模式——系统表面上合规但实际产生误导性输出。

Method: 该研究提出Partial Evidence Bench，采用确定性基准测试方法论。包含3个场景家族（尽职调查、合规审计、安全事件响应），共72个任务。核心组件包括：ACL分区语料库（强制权限边界）、Oracle完整答案、Oracle授权视图答案、Oracle完整性判断以及结构化gap报告Oracle。评估维度涵盖四个方面：答案正确性、完整性意识、gap报告质量和unsafe completeness行为。

Result: 实验表明：1) 静默过滤（silent filtering）在所有场景家族中表现出灾难性的不安全行为；2) 显式失败-报告机制能够消除unsafe completeness，同时不会将任务退化为trivial弃权。真实模型初步测试揭示了模型依赖和场景敏感的差异——某些系统过度声称完整性，另一些则保守地低估完整性，或以企业可用形式报告不完整性。

Conclusion: 该基准测试为治理关键型智能体故障提供了可测量的评估框架，无需人工评判或易受污染的静态语料库。初步实验表明，显式失败-报告机制能够消除不安全的完整性，同时不将任务退化为trivial弃权。未来研究可扩展场景家族规模、探索更细粒度的ACL分区策略，并深入分析模型在企业场景下的安全性-可用性权衡。

Abstract: Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside scoped retrieval systems, delegated workflows, and policy-constrained evidence environments. In these settings, access control can be enforced correctly while the system still produces an answer that appears complete even though material evidence lies outside the caller's authorization boundary. This paper introduces Partial Evidence Bench, a deterministic benchmark for measuring that failure mode. The benchmark ships three scenario families -- due diligence, compliance audit, and security incident response -- with 72 tasks total, ACL-partitioned corpora, oracle complete answers, oracle authorized-view answers, oracle completeness judgments, and structured gap-report oracles. It evaluates systems along four surfaces: answer correctness, completeness awareness, gap-report quality, and unsafe completeness behavior. Checked-in baselines show that silent filtering is catastrophically unsafe across all shipped families, while explicit fail-and-report behavior eliminates unsafe completeness without collapsing the task into trivial abstention. Preliminary real-model runs show model-dependent and scenario-sensitive differences in whether systems overclaim completeness, conservatively underclaim, or report incompleteness in an enterprise-usable form. The benchmark's broader contribution is to make a governance-critical agent failure measurable without human judges or contamination-prone static corpora.

</details>


### [87] [BALAR : A Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05386)
*Aymen Echarghaoui,Dongxia Wu,Emily B. Fox*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BALAR，一种基于贝叶斯推理的主动问答框架，通过维护信念状态并最大化互信息来选择最优问题，在侦探推理、思维谜题和临床诊断三个不同领域均取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数系统在对话中采用被动响应机制，缺乏对缺失信息的系统性推理机制，也无法主动判断应向用户询问什么问题以推进任务解决。

Method: BALAR采用贝叶斯推理机制维护对潜在状态的信念，通过最大化预期互信息来选择澄清性问题，并能动态扩展状态表示。算法采用外环架构，无需对LLM进行微调。

Result: BALAR在AR-Bench-DC上提升14.6%准确率，在AR-Bench-SP上提升38.5%，在iCraft-MD上提升30.5%，三项基准测试均显著超越所有基线方法。

Conclusion: BALAR作为一个无需微调的任务无关框架，在三个不同领域的基准测试中均显著超越基线模型，证明了主动推理和多轮交互策略的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate in interactive settings where solving a task requires multiple rounds of information exchange with a user. However, most current systems treat dialogue reactively and lack a principled mechanism to reason about what information is missing and which question should be asked next. We propose BALAR (Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning), a task-agnostic outer-loop algorithm that requires no fine-tuning and enables structured multi-turn interaction between an LLM agent and a user. BALAR maintains a structured belief over latent states, selects clarifying questions by maximizing expected mutual information, and dynamically expands its state representation when the current one proves insufficient. We evaluate BALAR on three diverse benchmarks: AR-Bench-DC (detective cases), AR-Bench-SP (thinking puzzles), and iCraft-MD (clinical diagnosis). BALAR significantly outperforms all baselines across all three benchmarks, with $14.6\%$ higher accuracy on AR-Bench-DC, $38.5\%$ on AR-Bench-SP, and $30.5\%$ on iCraft-MD.

</details>


### [88] [Intelligent CCTV for Urban Design: AI-Based Analysis of Soft Infrastructure at Intersections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05402)
*Vinit Katariya,Seungjin Kim,Curtis Craig,Nichole Morris,Hamed Tabkhi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了一套基于AI计算机视觉的CCTV分析框架，利用明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯市9个路口既有监控摄像头的视频数据，量化"柔性"干预措施（临时行人安全岛、临时路缘外扩/bollard、临时中心线）安装前后车辆速度与驾驶行为的变化。非信号交叉口平均速度最多下降18.75%、85分位速度最多下降16.56%，直行车流占比最多下降12.2%；信号交叉口除一处外，平均与85分位速度最多分别下降20.0%与17.19%。结果表明软性基础设施具有交通缓和效果，且AI视频分析可作为快速、低成本、可扩展的交通政策评估手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市交叉口安全治理长期依赖事后反应：硬性改造（混凝土安全岛、隔离设施）成本高、审批与实施周期长（数月），而传统评估手段（测速枪、专用速度传感器、人工观测）同样耗时数周至数月，无法在干预实施后及时获得可靠的驾驶行为证据。与此同时，既有大量CCTV摄像头长期处于被动记录状态，未被转化为主动的数据驱动安全管理工具。既有研究对"快速建设"（quick-build）柔性干预的量化评估主要依赖长期事故数据或有限观察，难以捕捉实施后即刻的行为变化。此外，已有文献指出速度降低并不必然带来停车让行行为的改善，说明仅看速度不足以刻画完整安全效应。因此需要一种低成本、可规模化、可在干预前后立即获取高分辨率行为证据的评估方法。

Method: 研究采用前后对照（before–after）设计，在明尼阿波利斯市9个路口（3个非信号交叉口：Lyndale/34th、Lyndale/33rd、Longfellow/38th；6个信号交叉口：Nicollet/26th、Bloomington/24th、Pillsbury/31st、Cedar/38th、Hennepin/12th、Maple/Hennepin）收集安装前一周基线视频与安装后第1周、第2周视频，每日7:00–18:30、帧率10–25 fps；其中Loc 1/8/9为永久性硬基线参照，其余为柔性处理。
