We propose SPARK (Self-Play with Asymmetric Reward from Knowledge Graphs), a framework that automatically constructs a unified knowledge graph (KG) from multi-document scientific literature and uses it as the structural basis for self-play. KG paths over multimodal nodes serve as a source for generating relational reasoning questions, and structured facts stored in the KG provide a basis for verifiable reward computation. A single small vision-language model (sVLM) alternates between Proposer and Solver roles under information asymmetry against a fixed KG, a design that we believe can be naturally extended toward online adaptation in future work. We evaluate SPARK on public benchmarks and a self-constructed cross-document multi-hop QA dataset. Results show that SPARK consistently outperforms flat-corpus-based self-play baselines, and the performance gap widens as hop count increases, suggesting that KG-structure grounding contributes to relational multi-hop reasoning beyond what unstructured corpus grounding can provide.

</details>


### [115] [Text-Graph Synergy: A Bidirectional Verification and Completion Framework for RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05643)
*Jiarui Zhong,Hong Cai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TGS-RAG提出了一种文本-图谱协同增强的统一框架，通过双向增强机制解决RAG系统中的"信息孤岛"问题。该框架包含两个通道：Graph-to-Text通道使用全局投票策略重新排序和精炼文本证据；Text-to-Graph通道通过记忆孤岛实体桥接算法从搜索历史中复活被剪枝的有效推理路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于文本的RAG容易检索到逻辑不相关的伪证据，而基于图的RAG受搜索时剪枝限制，可能丢弃有效的推理路径。现有混合方法主要采用简单的证据拼接或单向增强，无法解决非结构化文本与结构化图之间非对称推理流导致的"信息孤岛"问题。

Method: TGS-RAG引入双向增强机制：(1) Graph-to-Text通道：从已访问图节点采用全局投票策略重新排序和精炼文本证据，过滤语义噪声；(2) Text-to-Graph通道：利用基于记忆的孤岛实体桥接算法(Memory-based Orphan Entity Bridging)，使用文本线索从搜索历史中主动复活被剪枝但有效的推理路径，且无需额外数据库开销。

Result: 在多个多跳推理基准测试上的实验结果表明，TGS-RAG显著优于现有最优基线方法，在检索精度和计算效率之间取得了更优的平衡。

Conclusion: TGS-RAG通过双向协同增强机制有效解决了文本与图谱融合中的信息孤岛问题，为RAG系统在多跳推理任务中的性能提升提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a core paradigm for enhancing factual grounding and multi-hop reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional text-based RAG often retrieves logically irrelevant pseudo-evidence, while graph-based RAG is frequently hindered by search-time pruning, which may discard potentially valid reasoning paths. Existing hybrid approaches primarily adopt simple evidence concatenation or unidirectional enhancement, which fails to address the fundamental "Information Island" problem caused by asymmetric reasoning flows between unstructured text and structured graphs. We propose \textbf{TGS-RAG}, a unified framework for \textbf{T}ext-\textbf{G}raph \textbf{S}ynergistic enhancement. TGS-RAG introduces a bidirectional mechanism: (i) a \textbf{Graph-to-Text} channel that employs a Global Voting strategy from visited graph nodes to re-rank and refine textual evidence, filtering out semantic noise; and (ii) a \textbf{Text-to-Graph} channel that utilizes the \textbf{Memory-based Orphan Entity Bridging} algorithm. This algorithm utilizes textual cues to proactively resurrect valid but previously pruned reasoning paths from the search history without additional database overhead. Experimental results on multiple multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that TGS-RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a superior balance between retrieval precision and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [116] [Addressing Labelled Data Scarcity: Taxonomy-Agnostic Annotation of PII Values in HTTP Traffic using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06305)
*Thomas Cory,Axel Küpper*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索大语言模型（LLM）在HTTP流量中检测和标注PII的可行性，提出多阶段LLM管道和合成流量生成器，实现与分类法无关的隐私审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的PII检测器依赖稀缺的人工标注数据，且与固定标签分类法紧耦合，难以适应不同领域和 evolving 的PII定义，限制了其可迁移性。

Method: 提出多阶段LLM管道：确定性预处理→标签级分类→实例级值标注→输出验证；同时提出基于LLM的合成HTTP流量生成器，无需使用真实敏感用户数据即可生成带标注的训练/测试数据。评估涵盖三个不同领域和粒度级别的PII分类法。

Result: 管道能准确检测PII类型并提取对应值，尤其对具体PII分类法表现良好。合成流量生成器可有效创建带验证标注的数据。

Conclusion: LLM可作为灵活、分类法无关的流量标注基础，并能在 evolving 隐私分类法下生成标注数据，具有显著的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Automated privacy audits of web and mobile applications often analyse outbound HTTP traffic to detect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) leakage. However, existing learning-based detectors typically depend on scarce, manually labelled traffic and are tightly coupled to fixed label taxonomies, limiting transferability across domains and evolving definitions of PII. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can support taxonomy-agnostic annotation of explicitly transmitted PII values in HTTP message bodies when the taxonomy is provided at runtime. We introduce a multi-stage LLM-based pipeline that combines deterministic pre-processing with label-level classification, targeted instance-level value annotation, and output validation. To enable controlled evaluation and exemplar-based prompting without relying on sensitive real-user captures, we further propose an LLM-based generator for synthetic HTTP traffic with manually validated, taxonomy-derived PII annotations. We evaluate the approach across three taxonomies spanning different PII domains and granularity levels. Results show that the pipeline accurately detects PII types and extracts corresponding values for concrete PII taxonomies. Overall, our findings position LLMs as a promising foundation for flexible, taxonomy-agnostic traffic annotation and for creating labelled data under evolving privacy taxonomies.

</details>


### [117] [BitCal-TTS: Bit-Calibrated Test-Time Scaling for Quantized Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05561)
*Sai Babu Patarlapalli,Surya Teja Avvaru*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BitCal-TTS 是一个无需微调的推理期“侧车控制器”：在 4-bit NF4 量化、硬性 token 预算 B 的贪心解码场景下，用 token 熵、推理链稳定性、末层隐状态稳定性等廉价在线信号，叠加“位宽条件化的置信度缩放”（s(b)=0.85@b≤4）与“位宽条件化的答案标记确认尾窗”（Δ(b)=32@b≤4），抑制量化导致的过早停止（premature stop）。在 GSM8K 小规模分片（N=50/54/35，Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B-Instruct，B=512）上，7B 相对非位感知自适应基线点估计 +3.7（83.3% vs 79.6%）、14B +2.8（85.7% vs 82.9%），过早停止率由 14.8%→11.1%、17.1%→11.4%，同时相对固定预算仍节省 32.1%/40.8% token；但差异落在 Wilson 95% CI 重叠区间内，McNemar 检验不显著，作者自陈为“提示性而非结论性”结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化（尤其是 bitsandbytes 的 4-bit NF4）虽让大推理模型在消费级 GPU 上可部署，但会改变 logits 与隐状态的几何分布，使得用于自适应测试时计算分配的“在线停机线索”（token 熵、推理轨迹稳定性）相对全精度失准。在固定新生成 token 上限 B 的服务场景中，量化常导致“过早停止”：模型输出一条看似合理的最终答案行（GSM8K 的 #### 分隔符）而底层推理其实错误，或控制器在轨迹尚未稳定时就终止。后果有双重性——最终准确率下降，同时自适应节省的算力被浪费在虚假完成上。作者由此提出三个问题：Q1) 4-bit 量化如何影响自适应停机信号的可靠性；Q2) 不训练基座模型的前提下，精度感知的置信度调整与答案后确认窗能否找回部分损失精度；Q3) 这些效应在 3B/7B/14B 规模上的扩展规律。

Method: 形式化预算约束下的分步推理循环，动作集合 {continue, stop, escalate}，对比三种策略：fixed（用满 B 或遇 EOS）、adaptive（同一套停机机制但校准器误用 b_eff=16，即过度乐观）、BitCal-TTS（用真实 b=4）。核心三件套：(i) 在线代理信号——末位 logits 的 Shannon 熵 H_t（nats，归一化 H_max=10）；推理轨迹稳定性 τ_tr（相邻文本块去空白后完全相同且长度≥8 字符的比例，不足两对时置 1）；末层隐状态稳定性 τ_hid（L2 归一化隐向量余弦相似度均值，不足两个向量时置 1）。(ii) 位宽条件化置信度：c_raw = w_e(1-u_t)+w_tr·τ_tr+w_hid·τ_hid（默认权重 0.40/0.35/0.25），再乘 s(b)=0.85 (b≤4)、1.00 (4<b≤8)、1.05 (b>8) 并裁剪到 [0,1]，使低精度下的停止判定更保守；可选温度 γ 调整锐度。(iii) 位宽感知的“后标记确认尾窗”：首次出现 #### 后不立即允许终止，强制 continue 直至 T_t−T* ≥ Δ(b)（b≤4 时 32 token，4<b≤8 时 16，b>8 时 0；adaptive 用 b_eff=16 故 Δ=0，可立即停）。停机策略（Eq.6，按序匹配）：T_t<m 则 continue；剩余预算 r_t<m_buf 则 stop；H_t≥θ_E 则 escalate；H_t≤θ_H 且 c_t≥θ_c 则 stop；否则 continue。默认 k=16 token/块，m=128，m_buf=32，θ_H=2.0、θ_c=0.75、θ_E=4.0，γ=1。实现上不改动基座权重，借助 Hugging Face forward hook 抓取 logits 与末层 hidden states，作为“侧车”挂在标准 4-bit 推理之外；每步额外开销为 O(|V|) 熵计算与 O(d) 余弦跟踪，不产生额外模型调用。

Result: GSM8K（gsm8k/main test 集前 N 项，确定性分片）、贪心解码、单一 NVIDIA T4 (16GB) Colab 环境、bitsandbytes NF4 权重 + BF16 计算。B=512 主结果：7B fixed 90.7% [80.1,96.0] / 466 tok，adaptive 79.6% [67.1,88.2] / 286 tok，BitCal-TTS 83.3% [71.3,91.0] / 316 tok（+3.7 分，过早停止 14.8%→11.1%，相对 fixed 省 32.1%）；14B fixed 88.6% / 455 tok，adaptive 82.9% / 239 tok，BitCal-TTS 85.7% / 269 tok（+2.8 分，过早停止 17.1%→11.4%，省 40.8%）。3B 出现显著退化：fixed 60.0%，adaptive 22.0%，BitCal-TTS 20.0%，两者过早停止率均 63%；日志分析归因于解长度常超 200 token 而停机下限 m=128 过早放行，以及 τ_tr 在流利的中途重复计算上即触发 τ_tr=1 使 c_t 越过 θ_c=0.75（0.75/0.85≈0.88 易被超过），作者视其为超出控制器工作包络而非控制器本身失效，建议 m≈E[L]、提高 θ_c 或改用学习式校准器。预算扫描：7B 在 B∈{256,512,1024} 下 BitCal-TTS 精度分别为 44.4/83.3/83.0，adaptive 为 42.6/79.6/79.3，fixed 为 44.4/90.7/90.6（B=1024 时用不到 fixed 一半 token，约收回 adaptive–fixed 差距的 1/3）；14B 在 B=1024 为 fixed 91.2 / adaptive 82.4 / BitCal 85.3，省 token 69.0%。统计层面：分片 N∈{35,50,54}，单个准确率的 Wilson 95% CI 约 ±10 分，大于所报任何方法间差异；14B 的 +2.8 分仅相当于多对 1 题，配对 McNemar 检验不会拒绝零假设；作者明确称结果为方向性一致（跨规模、跨预算、跨准确率与过早停止两类指标）但幅度待全量测试集确认。组件级消融（s(b) 开/关 × Δ(b) 开/关，再 τ_hid 开/关）尚未完成，作者将其列为待办。

Conclusion: BitCal-TTS 证明：在量化 + 硬 token 预算这一部署常态中，停机策略不能沿用全精度假设；用位宽条件化的置信度缩放与“答案标记后确认尾窗”这一轻量、无需训练的运行时修正，可在几乎不损失自适应节省收益的前提下（相对 fixed 仍省 32%–41% token）降低有害过早停止并提升 GSM8K 精确匹配点估计，作用机制为二者互补（保守置信度抑制不稳定轨迹上的熵阈值停止；32-token 尾窗阻止首次 #### 被当作完成的铁证）。同时该工作以“负面/边界结果”的方式记录了 3B–4bit 的失败区间，强调 BitCal-TTS 是控制器而非能力扩容，基座在目标精度下推理能力不足时收益递减。局限与未来工作：统计功效不足（需在完整 1319 题测试集上重跑并做配对检验）；缺乏组件级消融；证据集中于 GSM8K 这类带显式终止标记的任务，对无结构化终止符的任务需另设确认准则；s(b)、Δ(b) 为手工常数，可替换为学习式位宽条件化校准器或小型过程验证器/停机头；未报告真实墙钟延迟与能耗（以 token 数作代理）；可扩展至 MATH、代码推理并与 R1/o1 类推理后训练模型结合。伦理定位为仅影响冻结模型的运行时长度，不改变权重或安全对齐，风险等同底层 LLM。

Abstract: Post-training quantization makes large reasoning models practical under tight memory and latency budgets, but it can distort the online signals that drive adaptive test-time compute allocation. Under a fixed cap on the number of newly generated tokens, miscalibrated confidence can lead to harmful early halting: the model may surface a plausible final line while the underlying reasoning is still wrong, or the controller may stop before the trace has stabilized. We study this interaction for greedy 4-bit inference and propose BitCal-TTS, a lightweight runtime controller that combines (i) inexpensive online proxies for token-level uncertainty and reasoning-trace stability, (ii) a bit-conditioned confidence rescaling that is conservative at low nominal precision, and (iii) a bit-aware post-marker confirmation horizon designed for GSM8K-style structured outputs. The method requires no fine-tuning of the base model and integrates with standard Hugging Face 4-bit inference using forward hooks for logits and last-layer hidden states.
  On small evaluation shards of GSM8K with Qwen2.5 Instruct models, BitCal-TTS improves exact-match accuracy over a non-bit-aware adaptive baseline at the 7B and 14B scales while preserving substantial token savings relative to fixed-budget decoding. At a token cap of B=512, on the evaluation shards we report (N=54 for 7B and N=35 for 14B; not the full GSM8K test set), accuracy gains are +3.7 points (7B) and +2.8 points (14B), with the premature-stop rate falling from 14.8% to 11.1% on 7B and from 17.1% to 11.4% on 14B. We report Wilson 95% confidence intervals throughout and explicitly discuss the limited statistical power of the partial-shard comparisons. We release code and figure-generation scripts to support full reproduction.

</details>


### [118] [Nonsense Helps: Prompt Space Perturbation Broadens Reasoning Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05566)
*Langlin Huang,Chengsong Huang,Jinyuan Li,Donghong Cai,Yuyi Yang,Jiaxin Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LoPE框架，通过在提示前添加Lorem Ipsum（伪拉丁占位符文本）序列来解决GRPO强化学习中的"零优势问题"。该方法在1.7B、7B、4B模型上均显著优于原始提示重采样，为LLM强化学习的探索扩展提供了新思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂推理任务中，GRPO算法经常遇到"零优势问题"——当某个问题的所有采样rollout都失败时，相对优势坍缩为零，导致模型失去有效训练信号。这不仅浪费训练数据和计算资源，而且简单的增加采样预算受限于静态采样策略，难以突破推理探索的瓶颈。

Method: LoPE的核心方法是在提示前添加由Lorem Ipsum词汇随机组装的序列。研究者假设，与任务无关的提示空间扰动可以充分转移模型输出分布，从而为难题解锁正交的推理路径。实验还验证了其他低困惑度的拉丁语随机序列同样有效。

Result: 在1.7B、4B和7B三种规模的模型上，LoPE均显著优于使用原始提示的重采样方法。消融分析表明，低困惑度的拉丁语随机序列作为扰动同样有效。

Conclusion: LoPE为扩展LLM强化学习探索提供了一个简单而有效的基线方法，证明任务无关的提示扰动能够有效打破探索瓶颈。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, in complex tasks, GRPO frequently suffers from the ``zero-advantage problem'': when all sampled rollouts for a query fail, the relative advantage collapses to zero. Consequently, the model loses effective training signals for these questions, wasting the training data and computational budget. While simply increasing the sampling budget for these questions is a common remedy, the static sampling policy inherently constrains reasoning exploration, limiting the success rate. In this paper, we propose Lorem Perturbation for Exploration (LoPE), a simple yet effective training framework to break this exploration bottleneck. We posit that task-irrelevant prompt-space perturbations can shift the model's output distribution enough to unlock orthogonal reasoning pathways for hard questions. Specifically, LoPE prepends sequences stochastically assembled from Lorem Ipsum vocabulary (a pseudo-Latin placeholder text) to the prompts before resampling. Experiments across 1.7B, 4B, and 7B models demonstrate that LoPE significantly outperforms resampling with the original prompts. Further analysis reveals that other Latin-based random sequences with low perplexity are also effective perturbations. Our results establish LoPE as a strong baseline for broadening exploration in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [119] [Locality-aware Private Class Identification for Domain Adaptation with Extreme Label Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05567)
*Chuan-Xian Ren,Cheng-Jun Guo,Hong Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对域适应中标签空间包含关系下的私有类识别难题，提出基于局部运输评分函数的局部感知方法，ReOT通过分离聚类结构和类内可靠传输有效解决极端标签偏移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法假设私有类的偏移足够大可视为离群点，但单一共享类内的方差可能大于私有类与其他共享类间的差异，导致该假设不成立，私有类显著增加跨域分类难度。

Method: 提出基于局部运输和最优传输度量性质的局部感知私有类识别方法（评分函数）；ReOT最小化分类风险，学习已识别共享类与私有类之间的分离聚类结构，避免共享-私有样本对错配，确保重要知识在类内可靠传输以减轻类条件偏差。

Result: 提出了一种基于评分函数的局部感知私有类识别方法，在理论上证明了其区分共享类与私有类样本的能力。

Conclusion: ReOT在大规模基准数据集上验证了有效性，理论上提供了极端标签偏移场景下目标风险的泛化上界，可通过ReOT最小化。

Abstract: Domain adaptation aims to transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain with different distributions. In real-world scenarios, the label spaces of the two domains often have an inclusion relationship, where some classes exist only in one domain but not the other. These non-overlapping classes are referred to as private classes. Identifying private class samples and mitigating their adverse effects is critical in the literature. Existing methods rely on the assumption that shifts in private classes are large enough to be considered outliers. However, the variance within a single shared class can be significantly larger than the difference between a private class and another shared class, challenging this assumption. Consequently, private classes substantially increase the difficulty of cross-domain classification. To address these issues, based on local transportation and metric properties of optimal transport (OT), a locality-aware private class identification approach is proposed in the form of a score function on transport mass. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is theoretically proven, highlighting the score function's strong ability to distinguish between shared and private class samples. Building on this, we introduce a reliable OT-based method (ReOT) for domain adaptation under severe label shift. ReOT minimizes classification risk while learning the separated cluster structure between the identified shared classes and private classes, effectively avoiding mismatch between shared-private sample pairs, thus ensuring that important knowledge is reliably transported intra-class to mitigate class-conditional discrepancy. Furthermore, a generalization upper bound of the target risk is provided for extreme label shift scenarios, which can be minimized by ReOT. Extensive experiments on benchmarks validate the effectiveness of ReOT.

</details>


### [120] [AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05580)
*Yishuo Yuan,Jiayi Sheng,Sirui Zeng,Jiaqi Wang,Jiaheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaCrafter是一个全栈式多智能体量化交易框架，通过Miner（因子挖掘）、Screener（市场状态评估）和Trader（风险约束执行）三个专业化智能体协同工作，实现从因子发现到交易执行的闭环自适应流程，解决现有方法在静态或孤立假设下优化各组件的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量化策略框架存在两个关键缺陷：因子挖掘将alpha发现视为一次性搜索过程，假设因子效力在各市场状态下持续有效；执行系统采用角色扮演式智能体架构，引入行为噪声而非系统性理性。因此，缺乏一个统一的自适应因子-执行流水线框架。

Method: AlphaCrafter采用三智能体架构：1) Miner智能体通过LLM引导搜索持续扩展因子池；2) Screener智能体评估市场状态构建状态条件化因子集成；3) Trader智能体在显式风险约束下将因子集成转化为量化策略。三智能体形成横截面交易系统的闭环。

Result: 在CSI 300和S&P 500上的广泛实验表明，AlphaCrafter在风险调整收益上持续优于最先进的基线方法，同时展现最低的跨试验方差，证实了集成自适应因子-执行设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 集成且自适应的因子-执行设计能够产生稳健的交易性能，多智能体协作框架可有效应对金融市场的非平稳性挑战。

Abstract: Financial markets are inherently non-stationary, driven by complex interactions among macroeconomic regimes, microstructural frictions, and behavioral dynamics. Building quantitative strategies that remain profitable demands the continuous coupling of factor discovery, regime-adaptive selection, and risk-constrained execution. Prevailing approaches, however, optimize these components under static or isolated assumptions. Factor mining frameworks typically treat alpha discovery as a one-time search process, implicitly assuming that factor efficacy persists across market regimes. Execution-oriented systems often adopt role-playing agent architectures that simulate anthropomorphic trading committees, introducing behavioral noise rather than systematic rationality. Consequently, a fully automated, rationality-driven framework unifying a coherent quantitative pipeline remains absent. We introduce AlphaCrafter, a full-stack multi-agent framework that closes this gap through a continuously adaptive factor-to-execution pipeline, designed to track and respond to evolving market conditions without manual intervention. AlphaCrafter operates via three specialized agents: a Miner that continuously expands the factor pool via LLM-guided search, a Screener that assesses prevailing market conditions to construct regime-conditioned factor ensembles, and a Trader that translates these ensembles into quantitative strategies under explicit risk constraints. Together, these three agents form a closed-loop cross-sectional trading system that adapts holistically to evolving market dynamics. Extensive experiments on CSI 300 and S&P 500 demonstrate that AlphaCrafter consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in risk-adjusted returns while exhibiting the lowest cross-trial variance, confirming that integrated and adaptive factor-to-execution design yields robust trading performance.

</details>


### [121] [Belief Memory: Agent Memory Under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05583)
*Junfeng Liao,Qizhou Wang,Jianing Zhu,Bo Du,Rui Yan,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BeliefMem 提出将 LLM 智能体的记忆范式从存储单一确定性结论转变为保留多个候选结论及其概率，通过 Noisy-OR 规则更新概率，从而在部分可观测环境中保留不确定性，避免自我强化错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体记忆方法将每次观察存储为单一确定性结论（如从临时错误推断"API~X失败"），但这类观察本质上是部分且可能模糊的。确定性方法会引入自我强化错误：智能体基于存储的结论行动，从不重新审视替代方案，并随时间强化该结论。

Method: BeliefMem 将候选结论存储为独立的记忆条目，每个条目携带概率值。当新观察到来时，通过 Noisy-OR 规则更新概率。检索时，所有候选结论及其概率一同浮现，使替代方案对智能体可见。

Result: 在 LoCoMo 和 ALFWorld 基准测试中，即使数据有限，BeliefMem 仍实现最佳平均性能，显著优于知名基线方法。

Conclusion: 概率记忆方法产生了实质性收益，探索了部分可观测环境中智能体记忆的新方向，使智能体能够对有充分证据的知识保持高置信度行动，同时保留在新证据到来时更新置信度的能力。

Abstract: LLM agents that operate over long context depend on external memory to accumulate knowledge over time. However, existing methods typically store each observation as a single deterministic conclusion (e.g., inferring "API~X failed" from temporary errors), even though such observations are inherently partial and potentially ambiguous. By committing to one conclusion and discarding uncertainty, these methods introduce self-reinforcing error: the agent acts on the stored conclusion, never revisits alternatives, and reinforces the conclusion over time. To address this issue, we propose BeliefMem, which shifts the memory paradigm from committing to a single conclusion per observation to retaining multiple candidate conclusions with their probabilities. Concretely, BeliefMem stores the candidate conclusions as separate memory entries, each carrying a probability that is updated via Noisy-OR rules as new observations arrive. At retrieval, all candidates surface together with their probabilities, keeping alternatives visible to the agent. Since each conclusion in memory retains its probability, BeliefMem preserves the uncertainty that the deterministic paradigm discards, enabling the agent to act with high confidence on well-evidenced knowledge while retaining the capacity to update its confidence when new evidence arrives. Empirical evaluations on LoCoMo and ALFWorld benchmarks show that, even with limited data, BeliefMem achieves the best average performance, remarkably outperforming well-known baselines. More broadly, such probabilistic memory produces substantial gains and explores a new direction for agent memory in partially observable environments.

</details>


### [122] [Causal Probing for Internal Visual Representations in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05593)
*Zehao Deng,Tianjie Ju,Zheng Wu,Liangbo He,Jun Lan,Huijia Zhu,Weiqiang Wang,Zhuosheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出基于激活干预的因果框架，揭示多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)对不同视觉概念的编码机制存在显著差异：实体概念呈现局部的记忆化特征，而抽象概念则全局分布。发现模型深度对编码抽象复杂概念至关重要，但实体定位对模型规模保持不变。还发现感知与生成之间存在补偿机制，以及MLLMs在视觉推理中将几何关系仅视为静态特征，无法触发程序化执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在多种任务中取得显著成功，但其内部如何编码和定位不同视觉概念的机制尚不清楚。现有研究缺乏对视觉表征内部运作的系统性理解。

Method: 提出基于激活干预(activation steering)的因果框架，通过对四类视觉概念进行系统性干预，主动探测和操控内部视觉表征。

Result: 1. 实体概念呈现局部化的记忆特征，抽象概念则全局分布；2. 模型深度对编码分布式复杂抽象概念不可或缺，但实体定位对规模保持不变；3. 反向干预发现阻止显式输出会引发潜在激活激增，揭示感知与生成间的补偿机制；4. 视觉推理存在断连——MLLMs虽能识别几何关系，但仅将其视为静态视觉特征，无法触发抽象问题求解所需的程序执行。

Conclusion: 该研究通过因果干预框架揭示了MLLMs编码视觉概念的内在机制差异，发现模型深度与抽象概念编码的必然关联，以及感知与推理之间的功能断连，为理解多模态模型的认知架构提供了重要见解。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable success of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across diverse tasks, the internal mechanisms governing how they encode and ground distinct visual concepts remain poorly understood. To bridge this gap, we propose a causal framework based on activation steering to actively probe and manipulate internal visual representations. Through systematic intervention across four visual concept categories, our results reveal a divergence in concept encoding: entities exhibit distinct localized memorization, whereas abstract concepts are globally distributed across the network. Critically, this divergence uncovers a mechanistic driver of scaling laws: increasing model depth is indispensable for encoding distributed and complex abstract concepts, whereas entity localization remains remarkably invariant to scale. Furthermore, reverse steering uncovers that blocking explicit output triggers a surge in latent activations, exposing a compensatory mechanism between perception and generation. Finally, extending our analysis to visual reasoning, we expose a disconnect between perception and reasoning although MLLMs successfully recognize geometric relations, they treat them merely as static visual features, failing to trigger the procedural execution necessary for abstract problem-solving.

</details>


### [123] [Prober.ai: Gated Inquiry-Based Feedback via LLM-Constrained Personas for Argumentative Writing Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05598)
*Ran Bi,Shiyao Wei,Yuanyiyi Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Prober.ai 是一个面向论证性写作（argumentative writing）教学的 Web 原型系统：它不替学生写作，而是通过人格化系统提示（Reviewer #2 逻辑严苛的同行评审、Confused Reader 新手读者）加 OpenAI Responses API 的 Structured Outputs 严格 JSON schema 约束 LLM，只输出基于 Toulmin 论证框架的针对性追问；并用 "Write–Challenge–Defend–Improve" 循环与"反思门（reflection gate）"把具体修改建议锁在学生书面自辩之后，先评判推理实质性，不合格则返回教练式提示（coaching）而非答案。系统已完成功能验证并全量埋点，但尚无受控实验数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 进入写作教学后产生了"教育悖论"：学生把批判性思考外包给 AI，产出表面流畅但论证结构空洞的文本。Kosmyna 等（2025）的 EEG 研究显示，使用 ChatGPT 写作用户的 alpha 带 dDTF 连接显著降低（认知债务），且即使被要求仅作"思考伙伴"仍然如此。现有工具各有缺口：Grammarly/QuillBot 只停留在语法与措辞层面，不触及论证结构；通用 AI 助手（ChatGPT、Gemini）倾向于给出直接答案并保持迎合性（"Sounds great!"），从不提供尖锐的挑战性反馈。Ba 等（2025）的元分析显示 facilitated（提问式）反馈比 directive（改写式）反馈更有利于长期学习；Latifi 等（2021）证明 peer feedforward（提问而非评价）比传统反馈更能提升论证质量与学习深度。据此，系统的核心主张是：AI 应当做"认知催化剂"而非"认知替代品"，且"教学摩擦（pedagogical friction）"是特性而非缺陷——刻意提高获取帮助前的认知努力阈值，迫使学生先完成反思、自我解释与论证辩护这些产生持久学习增益的元认知过程。

Method: 设计原则四条：认知努力保全、纯提问式交互、必要认知脚手架、双视角反馈。系统采用前后端分离架构，后端 Node.js + Express（单文件约 700 行），前端原生 HTML/CSS/JS + Quill 富文本编辑器，部署于 Vercel serverless；应用本身由 Codex（GPT-5.6 Terra 模型）作为编码智能体在 OpenAI Build Week 期间与人工协作开发（产品定位与"以反思门为核心"的决策保留在人类手中）。\n（1）人格约束输出：Reviewer #2 产出恰好 4 个问题（claim/reasoning/counterargument/scope_or_implication），对应 Toulmin 六要素（claim、data、warrant、backing、qualifier、rebuttal）；Confused Reader 产出 2 个问题（clarification、co_construction），针对"知识诅咒"、术语未定义与解释跳跃。\n（2）三层约束机制：负面系统提示（不得改写、不得使用 unclear/weak/insufficient 等评价词、避免是非问、避免诱导性答案、避免大段复述）；内部推理协议（论证切分→问题检测→认知状态分类→触发优先级排序，取前 2–3 项以控制认知负荷，reasoning.effort=medium）；Structured Outputs 以 strict:true 的命名 JSON schema 在解码期强制约束字段类型（excerpt 字段可为 null），彻底消除"仅靠提示诱导 schema"导致的解析失败类。返回的 excerpt 由服务端校验必须是原文精确子串，否则静默丢弃，避免幻觉引文驱动前端高亮。\n（3）反思门（两层）：第一层为确定性启发式 assessReflectionQuality，检查填充词/非答案、最小长度 18 词、推理标记（because/therefore/this shows/however 等）、与具体问题的内容词重叠度，输出 0–4 的 reflectionScore 与 reasonCodes（too_short、missing_reasoning_marker、not_specific_to_question、low_effort）；不达标则不调用模型、直接返回针对性教练提示，两次教练后允许"真诚但吃力"的学生（≥10 词）进入更脚手架化的提示，以实现 productive struggle。第二层为模型侧，unlock schema 强制 status ∈ {coaching, unlocked}，模型仍可拒绝释放建议。\n（4）API：POST /challenge（essay 上限 20,000 字符，超限 413；persona；study 元数据；reasoning.effort=medium；输出 1200 token 上限）与 POST /unlock（先确定性评估，再切换到"友好的写作导师"人格——与对抗性提问人格隔离以防人格污染；建议 <130 词、tip <25 词；reasoning.effort=low；700 token 上限）。\n（5）教学指南 pedagogy_guide.md（128 行，含问题模块分类与诊断触发词表）作为内部上下文注入，禁止向学生引用。\n（6）研究埋点：Study Setup 模式采集受试者/会话/条件/提示标识与同意标志，写入 6 个 JSONL 日志（sessions、events、drafts、challenges、unlocks、reflection-coaching），并记录 {question, defense, score, reasonCodes, revision} 元组；每次调用附带由研究/会话上下文哈希得到的 privacy-preserving safety_identifier，store:false，45 秒超时与自动重试。\n（7）Demo 模式提供预置样例（K-12 无人驾驶汽车议论文）与离线反思门复现；前端支持卡片/标签视图切换、悬停 excerpt 高亮（quill.formatText）、会话导出打印就绪 HTML。

Result: 原型在多体裁、多个质量层次的样例文上迭代验证，得到四点观察：（1）schema 合规性——由于 Structured Outputs 在解码期约束，所有 /challenge 与 /unlock 调用均返回合法完整类型化对象，解析失败与回退恢复这一类问题被"构造性消除"而非事后缓解；（2）问题质量——Reviewer #2 稳定命中真实的论证缺陷，能区分 claim/reasoning/counterargument/scope 四个层级并产生范畴上互异的问题；（3）人格差异——同一篇作文上 Confused Reader 与 Reviewer #2 给出质性不同的问题（后者挑战逻辑结构，前者定位术语、概念与解释缺口），验证人格约束确实改变模型分析焦点；（4）门控有效性——填充式与单词式辩护被教练而非被直接回答，含真实推理且切题的辩护解锁建议，且因第一层为确定性判定，该行为无需模型调用即可复现与测试。延迟方面：/challenge 用 medium effort、/unlock 用 low effort，低努力辩护完全由确定性层即时返回、零模型往返。此外系统已针对 K–12 ELA 写作与 AP/GRE 等考试类论证写作两类目标用户完成场景适配验证。作者同时明确列出 8 项局限：无受控实证评估（关于认知参与与学习效果的论断仍属理论性）、问题质量存在跨调用波动且缺乏 rubric 后置过滤、单题单轮交互不支持开放式多轮对话、体裁特异（仅适配论证/说服文）、无跨会话学习者建模与适应性脚手架、excerpt 精确子串匹配对空白与标点差异敏感、serverless 本地磁盘日志不可持久、部署端点无鉴权与速率/费用上限。需注意文内不一致：摘要写作 Gemini 3 Flash Preview 与 NY EdTech Hackathon（2026 年 3 月），而正文为 GPT-5.6 + OpenAI Build Week，二者明显属不同版本稿。

Conclusion: Prober.ai 论证并初步验证了：通过人格化系统提示 + 显式负面约束 + 解码期 schema 约束 + 双层反思门，可以把通用 LLM 改造成只提问、不代写的论证反馈引擎，且在建议释放前强制产生可证量的认知努力（写辩护、说理链接、切题性）。其核心架构洞见——"教学摩擦是特性而非缺陷"——直接挑战了 AI 辅助教育中一味优化"降低认知努力"的主流设计哲学，主张刻意抬高获取帮助的门槛以激活反思、自我解释与论证辩护等元认知过程。作者定位于"认知催化剂"而非"认知替代品"，原型已证明技术可行性并完成课堂级研究埋点（DBR 设计研究 + IRB 受控实验已在规划中，拟测量论证作文质量量表、认知参与（出声思维、潜在生理指标）与 gated/ungated 条件下的修订行为模式），并计划扩展多轮辩护对话、SSE 流式响应、学生画像与教师看板、更多领域人格、持久化日志与鉴权/限流。结论落点清醒：教育学效度仍需受控课堂实证检验，这是从原型走向生产的关键下一步。

Abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in educational settings has paradoxically undermined the cognitive processes they purport to support. Students increasingly outsource critical thinking to AI assistants that generate polished text on demand, resulting in measurable cognitive debt and diminished argumentative reasoning skills. We present Prober.ai, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM (Gemini 3 Flash Preview) through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses. A two-phase interaction architecture -- Challenge and Unlock -- implements a pedagogical friction mechanism whereby revision suggestions are gated behind mandatory student reflection. The system's design is grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory, research on peer feedforward questioning mechanisms, and evidence on AI-supported feedback in writing instruction. A functional prototype was developed in 36 hours during the NY EdTech Hackathon (March 2026), where it was awarded second place. We describe the system architecture, the prompt engineering methodology for constraining LLM output to pedagogically aligned JSON schemas, and discuss implications for scalable, cognition-preserving AI integration in writing education.

</details>


### [124] [Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05668)
*Gongli Xi,Ye Tian,Mengyu Yang,Huahui Yi,Liang Lin,Xiaoshuai Hao,Kun Wang,Wendong Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文通过信息论-几何统一框架揭示LVLMs中Attention与FFN的功能解耦，发现Attention主要负责重配置而FFN驱动语义创新。更关键的是，移除或替换注意力权重后模型性能不降反升，揭示当前注意力机制存在严重冗余，建议重新审视"注意力优先"的设计范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏统一理论基础，统计归因方法无法系统揭示LVLMs内部模块的功能角色，无法为架构优化提供清晰指导。

Method: 提出基于信息论和几何学的统一框架，从几何和熵的角度量化残差更新的特性，区分Attention和FFN在功能解耦中的作用。

Result: 实验表明，用预定义值（如高斯噪声）替代学习到的注意力权重，在多数数据集上获得相当或更优的性能。

Conclusion: SOTA LVLMs存在严重的注意力机制错配与冗余问题，模型实际上"迷失在注意力中"而非有效利用视觉上下文。论文建议重新审视并优化当前注意力机制的设计。

Abstract: Despite the rapid evolution of training paradigms, the decoder backbone of large vision--language models (LVLMs) remains fundamentally rooted in the residual-connection Transformer architecture. Therefore, deciphering the distinct roles of internal modules is critical for understanding model mechanics and guiding architectural optimization. While prior statistical approaches have provided valuable attribution-based insights, they often lack a unified theoretical basis. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified framework grounded in information theory and geometry to quantify the geometric and entropic nature of residual updates. Applying this unified framework reveals a fundamental functional decoupling: Attention acts as a subspace-preserving operator focused on reconfiguration, whereas FFNs serve as subspace-expanding operators driving semantic innovation. Strikingly, further experiments demonstrate that replacing learned attention weights with predefined values (e.g., Gaussian noise) yields comparable or even superior performance across a majority of datasets relative to vanilla models. These results expose severe misallocation and redundancy in current mechanisms, suggesting that state-of-the-art LVLMs effectively ``get lost in attention'' rather than efficiently leveraging visual context.

</details>


### [125] [Chain of Risk: Safety Failures in Large Reasoning Models and Mitigation via Adaptive Multi-Principle Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05678)
*Xiaomin Li,Jianheng Hou,Zheyuan Deng,Zhiwei Zhang,Taoran Li,Binghang Lu,Bing Hu,Yunhan Zhao,Yuexing Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"阶段化诊断 + 自适应多原则激活引导（adaptive multi-principle steering）"的两段式方案：在统一的 20 条安全原则、1–5 级严重度评分体系下，同时为 15 个大型推理模型（LRM）的思维链推理轨迹与最终答案打分，证明最终答案安全不足以代理完整生成轨迹的安全；并用按原则分解、按提示自适应的白盒测试时激活引导，在三个开放推理模型上同时降低推理链与最终答案的不安全计数，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 平均降低 40.8% 且保留 97.7% 的宏平均通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRM）普遍对外暴露类思维链的中间推理以实现透明性、可验证性与刻意求解，这带来了新的安全面：模型可能先在推理中重建有害细节、比较危险方案，最后只给出"看起来安全"的拒绝答案（leak），此时最终答案层面的评测会完全漏掉已暴露的风险；反之表面无害的推理也可能导向不安全答案（escape）。现有 LLM 安全对齐与红队评测绝大多数只看最终回答是否拒答/有害，缺乏对推理阶段本身的独立评估与干预。因此本文核心问题为：最终答案安全是否是完整"推理—回答"轨迹的充分安全代理？若不是，缓解方法应当作用在风险最早出现的位置，而不是只编辑最终答案。

Method: 诊断部分：构建统一提示基准——7 个分布内公开来源（WildChat、PKU-SafeRLHF、JailbreakV、HarmBench、BeaverTails、StrongREJECT、JailbreakBench）经字段归一化、非英文/长度过滤、MinHash-LSH 近重复去除后约 43K，按来源分层切分为 41K 诊断/质心构建池 + 2K HeldOut2K；另用 AdvBench、SaladBench、SimpleSafetyTests、WildJailbreak 构成完全隔离的 OOD2K。评测 15 个模型（10 个开放权重 + 5 个 API：Qwen3 系列、DeepSeek-R1 及 Distill、GLM-Z1-9B、MiMo-7B-RL-Zero、DeepMath-Zero-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、Kimi-K2.5、Gemini-Pro-3.1/Flash-3、Claude-Sonnet-4.5/Haiku-4.5），每模型 41K 提示，每个提示同时生成推理轨迹 r 与最终答案 y。采用 20 原则（物理伤害、心理伤害、隐私、网络安全、错误信息、偏见歧视、法律合规、儿童安全、经济伤害、环境、药物滥用、性剥削、知识产权、医疗错误信息、政治操纵、社会工程、极端主义、AI 安全、研究伦理双用、文化敏感性）× 1–5 严重度评分，由 Claude-4.5-Haiku 与 Gemini-Flash-3 两个 LLM 裁判在单次 API 调用中一次给出 20 个分数，按原则取均值；以最大原则分 M^t≥4 判定某阶段"不安全"，据 (I_cot, I_ans) 定义 unsafe / leak / escape 三类失效，并用平均严重度 H^t 与差值 ΔH=H_cot−H_ans 刻画阶段偏离；判官管线在 80 样本×20 原则（1600 条）上与 3 名人类标注者对齐验证（judge-human Pearson 0.799/0.820，高于 human-human）。干预部分：自适应多原则引导——对每个可引导模型，在最后一个解码层（ℓ*=27 或 35）的残差流上，对提示前 8 个 token 做均值池化得到 h_ℓ(x)；用"基线判为某原则≥4 分"的样本集合 U_k 与"依据判官解释重新生成且该原则得 1 分"的配对安全集合 S_k，分别计算安全/不安全质心 μ_k^safe、μ_k^unsafe，构造归一化方向 v_k=(μ^safe−μ^unsafe)/‖·‖；推理时按最近质心门控 g_k(x)=‖h−μ^safe‖−‖h−μ^unsafe‖>δ（δ=0）只激活"更靠近不安全质心"的原则方向，h̃=h+α·Σ1[g_k>δ]·v_k，单次 prefill 注入、α=2.0（相对范数标度）、贪心解码、max_new_tokens=2048、seed=42、H100-80GB bf16。消融覆盖 α∈{0…2.5}、干预层∈{7,14,21,27}、自适应门控 vs 全开启 20 方向、前缀窗口连续注入 vs 单次 prefill。

Result: 诊断：15 个模型全部满足推理链平均严重度高于最终答案（ΔH 均为正），最大差距为 Gemini-Pro-3.1(0.0278)、GPT-OSS-20B(0.0219)、DeepMath-Zero-7B(0.0208)、Kimi-K2.5(0.0178)，绝对幅度小但方向完全一致，且样本级 ΔH 分布存在持续正尾，说明并非少数离群点所致。阶段失效呈稀疏高危形态：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 的 leak 1.57%/escape 1.69%、DeepMath-Zero-7B leak 3.05%、GPT-OSS-20B/Kimi-K2.5 等 API 模型 leak 极低（0.02–0.49%）但仍存在，证明仅看最终答案会同时漏掉两类离对角失效。原则层面风险高度结构化（非均匀）：错误信息（P05）总风险最高，法律合规（P07）阶段分歧与 leak 信号最明显，偏见歧视（P06）跨模型持续偏高，物理伤害（P01）与心理伤害（P02）分别是 unsafe/leak 与 CoT 侧抬升的主因。定性案例分别对应 unsafe（推理与答案同构有害、无阶段纠正）、leak（推理已枚举操作性有害因素后拒绝）、escape（游戏/虚构框架使推理显benign，答案却转为可操作有害内容）三种机制。干预：三个可引导模型在 HeldOut2K 与 OOD2K 上不安全计数在推理链与最终答案两个阶段均一致下降，整体降幅 HeldOut2K 为 10.8%/41.9%/30.5%（1.5B/7B/MiMo），OOD2K 为 18.3%/39.8%/48.0%；推理侧最强降幅达 77.2%（HeldOut2K, MiMo）与 62.7%（OOD2K, MiMo），最终响应在 OOD2K 最多降 48.1%，表明收益并非仅来自"改变拒答风格"。安全—能力权衡：DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 最佳，平均不安全计数降低 40.8% 且保留 97.7% 宏平均准确率（BBH 94.4→90.4、GSM8K 73.4→77.0、MMLU 55.5→50.6，−1.8 点）；1.5B 保住 GSM8K 但 BBH 掉 15.2 点；MiMo 安全收益大但能力损失最重（−8.6 点，GSM8K −13.3）。消融：α 呈明显非单调，2.0 为甜点，2.5 收益回落；末层干预优于早期层（layer 7 甚至略降安全）；把自适应门控换成 always-on 20 方向会把降幅从 0.45/0.40 压缩到 0.05/0.25，说明门控是必要条件而非效率启发式；前缀窗口连续注入虽在 7B 上数值好看，但会产生退化/重复文本（judge 可能因无操作性内容误判为安全），故弃用。判官-人一致性在 Pearson、Cohen's κ、1–5 完全一致三项指标上均不低于人-人一致性（推理 κ=0.708、回答 κ=0.741），支持以双裁判均值作为安全度量代理。

Conclusion: LRM 的安全评估与控制必须覆盖"暴露的推理—回答"全轨迹，而不能只看最终答案：leak 说明拒绝并不等于轨迹已安全，escape 说明无害推理也不保证安全答案，两侧偏差随模型与原则而变，因此单一"输出级"基准会系统性低估风险。安全具有原则结构（错误信息、法律合规、歧视、物理与心理伤害为核心），相应地缓解也应按原则分解并只在被激活的原则上施加：自适应多原则引导以每原则一条 unsafe→safe 方向 + 最近质心门控，在几乎零推理开销的条件下显著压低推理链与最终答案的不安全计数，且在强模型上以极小的通用能力代价取得最优安全—效用前沿，验证了"评估分解结构即干预分解结构"的诊断—控制闭环可行性。局限与展望：外露推理未必忠实反映内部计算，故结论限定于可见推理制品；引导需白盒/半白盒访问，对闭源 API 不适用（可探索原则条件化提示、验证器引导解码、外部安全监控、策略感知后处理）；门控目前仅最近质心、仅单层，未来可做 token 级门控、不确定性感知原则选择、多层干预与联合优化控制器；评测需扩展到多语言、多模态、工具使用与 agentic 场景（推理轨迹可能被传给工具、写入记忆或被下游系统消费），并注意安全分析本身可能被对手用于识别模型弱点，故本文只发布聚合失效模式与经脱敏的定性片段。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) increasingly expose chain-of-thought-like reasoning for transparency, verification, and deliberate problem solving. This creates a safety blind spot: harmful or policy-violating content may appear in reasoning traces even when final answers appear safe. We test whether final-answer safety is a sufficient proxy for the full reasoning-answer trajectory by scoring both stages under a unified twenty-principle safety rubric. Using prompts from seven public harmfulness and jailbreak sources, plus four out-of-distribution (OOD) sources, we evaluate 15 open-weight and API-based LRMs across 41K prompts per model. Reasoning traces consistently reveal additional safety risks beyond final answers, especially in high-severity stage-wise failures: leak cases, where unsafe reasoning precedes a safe-looking answer, and escape cases, where benign-looking reasoning precedes an unsafe final response. Principle-level analysis shows that risk concentrates in misinformation, legal compliance, discrimination, physical harm, and psychological harm. We further propose adaptive multi-principle steering, a white-box test-time mitigation that learns one unsafe-to-safe activation direction per safety principle and activates only directions whose current hidden state is closer to the unsafe than safe centroid. On three steerable open reasoning models, adaptive steering reduces unsafe counts in both reasoning traces and final answers on held-out and OOD benchmarks. DeepSeek-R1-Qwen-7B achieves a 40.8% average unsafe-count reduction while retaining 97.7% macro-averaged accuracy on BBH, GSM8K, and MMLU. These results suggest that LRM safety should be evaluated and mitigated over the full exposed reasoning-answer trajectory, not only at the final-answer stage.

</details>


### [126] [Attractor Geometry of Transformer Memory: From Conflict Arbitration to Confident Hallucination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05686)
*Qiyao Liang,Risto Miikkulainen,Ila Fiete*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了大型语言模型中冲突与幻觉两类失败模式的统一几何解释：记忆事实形成隐藏状态空间中的吸引子盆，冲突对应盆间竞争（工作记忆干扰正确盆收敛），幻觉对应盆缺失（无记忆盆约束时状态自由漂移）。输出头无法区分这两种情况导致高置信度错误输出。几何边缘测量比输出熵更有效区分两类错误，且隐藏状态的认知状态编码随规模增加被输出头系统性擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前输出-based监控机制存在根本缺陷：冲突（参数记忆与工作记忆不一致）和幻觉（查询事实从未被学习）都会产生高置信度输出，使输出空间的事后检测在设计上失效。

Method: 采用受控合成任务（实体标识符映射到唯一代码），通过LoRA适配器精确安装参数记忆，可通过定向适配器放置隔离各组件角色。在预训练模型上使用自然语言事实查询进行验证。核心测量指标为几何边缘——隐藏状态到最近记忆吸引盆的距离。

Result: 几何边缘比输出熵更清晰地区分正确回忆与幻觉，可实现零错误拒绝，而熵基检测需拒绝大量正确输出。自然语言事实查询证实吸引子几何是结构性特征而非微调产物。幻觉率遵循缩放律 C = exp(-c/Δ̄)，随模型规模增大而增加，尽管整体错误率下降。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态几何结构可靠编码认知状态，但冻结的输出头系统性地擦除了这一信息，且这种擦除随模型规模增大而加剧。这意味着输出层的预测机制与不确定性编码之间存在根本性矛盾，需要重新设计输出头来恢复模型的自我监控能力。

Abstract: Language models draw on two knowledge sources: facts baked into weights (parametric memory, PM) and information in context (working memory, WM). We study two mechanistically distinct failure modes--conflict, when PM and WM disagree and interfere; and hallucination, when the queried fact was never learned. Both produce confident output regardless, making output-based monitoring blind by design. We show both failures share a unified geometric account. In the hidden-state space of autoregressive generation, learned facts form attractor basins. Conflict is basin competition: WM disrupts convergence to the correct basin without raising output entropy. Hallucination is basin absence: the hidden state drifts freely when no memorized basin exists. The frozen LM head, designed for next-token prediction, cannot distinguish these cases and fires confidently either way. We verify this account in a controlled synthetic task--entity identifiers mapped to unique codes with PM installed via LoRA adapters--where ground truth is exact and component roles can be causally isolated through targeted adapter placement. Geometric margin--the hidden state's distance to the nearest memorized basin--reads this geometry directly and separates correct recall from hallucination far more cleanly than output entropy, with zero false refusals where entropy-based detection cannot avoid rejecting the vast majority of correct outputs. The separation holds on natural-language factual queries from the pretrained model with no adaptation, confirming attractor geometry is structural rather than a fine-tuning artifact. The fraction of confident hallucinations follows a scaling law $C = \exp(-c/\barΔ)$, growing with scale even as overall error rates fall. Hidden states reliably encode epistemic state; the frozen output head systematically erases it--and this erasure worsens with scale.

</details>


### [127] [DataDignity: Training Data Attribution for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05687)
*Xiaomin Li,Andrzej Banburski-Fahey,Jaron Lanier*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出精确溯源任务，通过FakeWiki基准和监督对比学习方法ScoringModel，实现从词汇/主题相似性中分离真实答案支持，在多模型多条件下显著优于传统检索基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型输出审计不仅需要判断正确性，还需要识别哪个源文档最可能支持响应中的知识。这要求将"精确溯源"（pinpoint provenance）与表面相似性区分开来。

Method: 构建了包含3537篇虚构维基百科文章的FakeWiki基准，采用QA探测、源保持改写、溯源生成变体和硬反文档等数据策略；提出了SteerFuse（无需训练的激活空间融合方法）和ScoringModel（使用InfoNCE损失的监督对比学习模型，结合batch内负例、检索挖掘负例和反文档负例）。

Result: ScoringModel将Recall@10从最强基线的35.0提升至52.2，在9个开源指令微调模型和5种查询条件下赢得41/45个实验单元；在越狱变换查询上平均提升15.7点。SteerFuse无需监督训练即可获得次优表现。

Conclusion: 稳健的训练数据归因需要在评估设置中将真实的答案支持与主题或词汇相似性分开。ScoringModel在41/45个模型×条件下获胜，证明了受监督的方法在精确溯源方面的有效性。

Abstract: Auditing language-model outputs often requires more than judging correctness: an auditor may need to identify which source document most likely supports the knowledge expressed in a response. We study this as pinpoint provenance: given a prompt, a target-model response, and a candidate corpus, rank the documents that best support the response. We introduce FakeWiki, a controlled benchmark of 3,537 fabricated Wikipedia-style articles designed to preserve ground-truth provenance while weakening lexical shortcuts. FakeWiki includes QA probes, source-preserving paraphrases, retro-generated variants, hard anti-documents that remain topically similar while removing answer-critical facts, and five query conditions: clean prompting plus four jailbreak-inspired transformations. We evaluate seven retrieval baselines, a training-free activation-steering retrieval-fusion method, SteerFuse, and a supervised contrastive provenance ranker, ScoringModel. ScoringModel maps response and document features into a shared space and is trained with InfoNCE using in-batch, retrieval-mined, and anti-document negatives. Across nine open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs and five query conditions, ScoringModel improves mean Recall@10 from 35.0 for the strongest retrieval baseline to 52.2, without inference-time fusion, and wins 41/45 model-by-condition cells. SteerFuse is usually second-best despite requiring no supervised training, showing that activation-space evidence can efficiently complement text retrieval. On jailbreak-inspired transformed queries, ScoringModel improves Recall@10 by 15.7 points on average over the best baseline. Overall, our work shows that robust training data attribution requires evaluation settings that separate true answer support from topical or lexical resemblance.

</details>


### [128] [GCCM: Enhancing Generative Graph Prediction via Contrastive Consistency Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05689)
*Shaozhen Ma,Wei Huang,Hanchen Wang,Dong Wen,Wenjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型在图预测中推理成本高的问题，提出通过一致性训练减少去噪步骤，但发现现有方法容易陷入捷径解——模型通过忽略噪声目标直接退化为确定性预测器。为此，论文提出GCCM方法，引入负样本对比学习和输入特征扰动来防止捷径解，使其在图预测任务上取得一致性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于扩散的图预测方法存在两个核心问题：(1) 推理阶段需要昂贵的迭代去噪过程，计算成本高；(2) 一致性训练方法虽然可以减少推理步数并稳定采样，但容易陷入"捷径解"——模型通过忽略噪声目标使其权重趋近于零，从而退化为纯确定性预测器，失去生成式建模的优势。

Method: 论文提出GCCM（Graph Contrastive Consistency Model）方法，包含两个关键组件：(1) **负样本对比一致性目标**：在传统成对匹配的基础上引入负样本对，增加了分离约束，使捷径解无法再轻易满足优化目标；(2) **输入特征扰动**：对输入的节点/边特征进行扰动，打破相同输入的固定条件化，使得捷径解在噪声层级上无法产生一致预测，从而降低其吸引力。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，GCCM能够有效缓解捷径解问题，相比确定性预测器在图预测任务上实现了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过引入负样本对比学习和输入特征扰动，GCCM成功防止了一致性训练中的捷径解问题，为扩散模型在图预测领域的实际应用提供了更高效、更稳定的解决方案。

Abstract: Conditional generative models, particularly diffusion-based methods, have recently been applied to graph prediction by modeling the target as a conditional distribution given the input graph, yielding competitive results compared to deterministic predictor. However, existing diffusion-based prediction methods typically require expensive iterative denoising at inference and often suffer from unstable sampling, which motivates recent efforts to reduce inference denoising steps and enable stable sampling via techniques such as consistency training. Despite this progress, we find that existing consistency training methods for graph prediction could potentially fall into a shortcut solution: the model may attempt to satisfy the self-consistency constraint by ignoring the noisy target (i.e., assigning it negligible weight), ultimately collapsing into a purely deterministic predictor. To mitigate such shortcut solution, we propose GCCM, a graph contrastive consistency model that goes beyond isolated pairwise matching between the same target at different noise levels by introducing negative pairs into a contrastive consistency objective. This adds an additional separation requirement, making the shortcut solution no longer trivially sufficient to satisfy the proposed objective. Moreover, we apply feature perturbation to the input node/edge features to break identical conditioning on the input graph, so that the shortcut no longer yields the same predictions across noise levels and becomes less attractive. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that GCCM mitigates the shortcut solution and yields consistent performance improvements in graph prediction compared to deterministic predictors.

</details>


### [129] [Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05693)
*Yanlong Zhao,Xiaoyuan Cheng,Huihang Liu,Baihua He,Xinyu Zhang,Harrison Bo Hua Zhu,Wenlong Chen,Li Zeng,Zhuo Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SARQC，通过在标准PTQ目标中加入显式正则化项来约束量化权重与原始权重的偏差，从而改善LLM量化后的泛化性能。该方法可同时增强基于尺度搜索和基于Gram的量化校准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing PTQ calibration objectives based only on empirical reconstruction error on limited or unrepresentative calibration data may cause quantized weights to diverge from original weights, leading to generalization risk and potential degradation of downstream performance.

Method: SARQC augments the standard PTQ objective with a saliency-aware regularization term that encourages quantized weights to remain close to original weights during calibration. This approach unifies both scale search and Gram-based methods under a single framework.

Result: Extensive experiments on both dense and Mixture-of-Experts LLMs demonstrate consistent improvements in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy without additional computational overhead during inference.

Conclusion: SARQC provides a unified framework that integrates seamlessly with existing PTQ pipelines, showing consistent improvements across dense and MoE LLMs in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy without adding inference computational overhead.

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is an effective approach for deploying large language models (LLMs) under memory and latency constraints. Most existing PTQ methods determine quantization parameters by minimizing a layer-wise reconstruction error on a predetermined calibration dataset, usually optimized via either scale search or Gram-based methods. However, from the perspective of generalization risk, existing calibration objectives of PTQ based only on empirical reconstruction error on limited or unrepresentative calibration data could move the quantized weights away from the original weights. This may cause the generalization risk to diverge, potentially degrading downstream performance. To address this issue, we propose \emph{Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration} (SARQC) a unified framework that augments the standard PTQ objective with a saliency-aware regularization term. This term encourages quantized weights to stay close to the original weights during calibration, leading to improved generalization during inference. SARQC integrates seamlessly into existing PTQ pipelines, enhancing both scale search and Gram-based methods under a unified formulation. Extensive experiments on dense and Mixture-of-Experts LLMs demonstrate consistent improvements in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, without additional computational overhead during inference.

</details>


### [130] [Inference-Time Budget Control for LLM Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05701)
*Zhengru Fang,Senkang Forest Hu,Zhonghao Chang,Yu Guo,Yihang Tao,Hongyao Liu,Mengzhe Ruan,Jun Huang,Yuguang Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究LLM搜索智能体在工具调用次数和token生成量的双重硬预算约束下的推理时预算控制问题，在多跳问答场景中提出两阶段方法：搜索阶段通过信息价值（VOI）评分分配预算，答案阶段通过选择性重写优化答案格式错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM搜索智能体在推理时依赖工具，但其轨迹受工具调用次数和生成token数的双重硬预算限制。在双重预算约束下，获得更好答案不仅需要更强模型，还需要对搜索动作的预算分配和答案提交时机进行显式控制。

Method: 提出两阶段推理时间预算控制方法：1) 搜索阶段，使用任务级信息价值（VOI）评分控制器，为每个可行动作（检索、分解、答案承诺）分配评分，据此分配预算；2) 搜索后，使用选择性证据锚定的 finalizer，将轨迹答案与精炼候选答案比较，仅在残差为低风险答案格式错误时重写。

Result: 实验覆盖四个多跳QA基准、三种LLM主干和四种预算水平，在相同硬双重预算协议下相较于四个审计基线取得正向 aggregate 收益。

Conclusion: 在四个多跳QA基准测试、三种LLM主干模型和四种预算水平下，该方法在相同硬双重预算协议下相较于四个审计基线均取得正向 aggregate 收益。消融实验表明搜索阶段预算控制（尤其是预算依赖惩罚）是主要性能增益来源，而答案阶段控制主要在检索路径已足够时发挥作用。

Abstract: LLM search agents increasingly rely on tools at inference time, but their trajectories are often constrained by hard limits on both tool calls and generated tokens. Under such dual budgets, better answers require not only stronger models, but also explicit control over which search action should receive the next budget unit and when the accumulated evidence is sufficient to commit a final answer. We study this problem in multi-hop question answering (QA) and formulate it as two-stage inference-time budget control. At search time, our controller assigns each feasible action a task-level Value-of-Information (VOI) score, defined as an operational estimate of marginal task value per unit budget under the current search state and remaining dual budget, and uses this score to choose among retrieval, decomposition, and answer commitment. After search, a selective evidence-grounded finalizer compares the trajectory answer with a refined candidate and rewrites only when the residual error appears to be a low-risk answer-form error. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, three LLM backbones, and four budget levels, the method yields positive aggregate gains over four audited baselines under the same hard dual-budget protocol. Ablations show that search-time budget control, especially budget-dependent penalty, provides the main performance gain, while answer-time control helps mainly when the retrieval path is already adequate. These results suggest that inference-time budget control for LLM search agents should govern both how budget is spent during search and how the final answer is committed.

</details>


### [131] [Knowledge-Graph Paths as Intermediate Supervision for Self-Evolving Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05702)
*Huyu Wu,Jun Liu,Xiaochi Wei,Yan Gao,Yi Wu,Yao Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对Search Self-Play (SSP)框架的两个瓶颈进行改进：一是通过知识图谱子图引导问题构建，避免生成无效问题；二是提出路点覆盖奖励(WCR)机制，为部分正确的解题轨迹提供分级奖励。实验在7个QA基准和9种模型配置上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Search Self-Play (SSP)框架存在两个关键瓶颈：(1) Proposer仅从孤立答案实体构建问题，缺乏关系上下文，导致早期训练产生大量无效或不可验证的问题；(2) Solver仅获得二元结果奖励，丢弃了部分正确轨迹中的有用信号。

Method: 提出两个解决方案：(1) 利用LLM引导的知识图谱子图进行问题构建，为Proposer提供关系上下文；(2) 观察到多跳问题的构建路径与解题路径存在实体重叠，设计Waypoint Coverage Reward (WCR)机制，根据Solver轨迹对构建路径上实体的覆盖程度给予分级部分奖励。

Result: 在7个QA基准和9种模型配置上，本方法在所有配置中均优于标准SSP，尤其在多跳QA任务上提升显著。

Conclusion: 知识图谱路径可作为轻量级中间监督信号，为问题构建提供关系指导并为奖励塑造提供过程反馈，且无需额外的人工标注或手动标注的过程步骤。

Abstract: Self-evolving search agents reduce reliance on human-written training questions by generating and solving their own search tasks. We build on Search Self-Play (SSP), a representative Proposer and Solver framework in which questions are generated and answered via multi-step search and reasoning. In practice, however, SSP faces two bottlenecks: the Proposer constructs questions from isolated answer entities without relational context, yielding many invalid or unverifiable questions in early self-play training, while the Solver receives only a binary outcome reward that discards useful signal from partially on-track search trajectories. We address both bottlenecks by reusing knowledge-graph paths as construction-derived intermediate supervision for both question construction and reward shaping. First, we ground question construction in LLM-guided knowledge-graph subgraphs, providing relational context for the Proposer. Second, we observe that constructing and solving a multi-hop question can involve overlapping intermediate entities: the factual bridges used to formulate the question may provide approximate waypoints for answering it. Exploiting this overlap, we introduce Waypoint Coverage Reward (WCR), which grants graded partial credit to incorrect Solver trajectories according to their coverage of entities on the construction path, while preserving full reward for correct answers. Across seven QA benchmarks and nine model configurations, our approach improves the average score over standard SSP in all configurations, including notable gains on multi-hop QA tasks. These results suggest that knowledge-graph paths can be reused as lightweight intermediate supervision, providing both relational guidance and process feedback without additional task-specific human annotations or manually labeled process steps.

</details>


### [132] [Resolving the bias-precision paradox with stochastic causal representation learning for personalized medicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05706)
*Peisong Zhang,Manqiang Peng,Yuxuan Wu,Pawit Phadungsaksawasdi,Wesley Yeung,Ye Zhang,Trang Nguyen,Qiang Zhang,Nan Liu,Meng Wang,Kee Yuan Ngiam,Yih-Chung Tham,Ching-Yu Cheng,Tianfan Fu,Qingyu Chen,Rosemary Ke,Chang Li,Wenzhuo Yang,Zhenghao Lu,Chunyou Lai,Yu Zhang,Sheng Zhong,Hao Deng,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究针对纵向观察性数据中个性化治疗效果估计的问题，提出采样最大均值差异(sMMD)方法，通过子集级别匹配替代全局对抗平衡策略，解决偏差-精度悖论。在两个大型ICU队列中验证，该方法可减少高达11.5%的预测误差，并将临床医生准确率提升14.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果表征学习方法存在根本性局限：减少混杂偏倚往往抑制临床相关的异质性，导致患者特异性预测质量下降，形成"偏差-精度悖论"。临床决策支持需要同时满足因果推断的准确性和对个体差异的敏感度。

Method: 提出采样最大均值差异(sMMD)方法，采用随机对齐策略，在子集层面进行匹配而非全局对抗平衡。并构建反事实结果预测框架，结合归因解释实现可解释性。模型在分布偏移条件下评估性能，通过两个大型ICU队列(n=27,783)进行验证。

Result: 相比现有方法，sMMD在分布偏移下提升预测精度，误差减少达11.5%；高风险任务召回率显著提高；机制分析表明sMMD选择性保留临床关键变量。人类-AI评估中，该方法优于受训临床医生和大语言模型，临床医生准确率提升14.7%同时缩短决策时间。

Conclusion: sMMD通过子集级匹配有效解决偏差-精度悖论，实现了可解释的实时临床决策支持。该框架在保持因果推断准确性的同时保留了个体异质性信息，为ICU等高风险环境中的精准医疗提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Estimating individualized treatment effects from longitudinal observational data is central to data-driven medicine, yet existing methods face a fundamental limitation: reducing confounding bias often suppresses clinically informative heterogeneity, degrading patient-specific predictions. Here, we identify this tension as a bias-precision paradox in causal representation learning and introduce sampling-based maximum mean discrepancy (sMMD), a stochastic alignment strategy that replaces global adversarial balancing with subset-level matching. We instantiate this approach in a framework for counterfactual outcome prediction with attribution-grounded interpretability. Across two large-scale ICU cohorts (n = 27,783), our framework improves accuracy under distribution shift, reducing error by up to 11.5% and substantially increasing recall in high-risk tasks. Mechanistic analyses show that sMMD selectively preserves clinically decisive variables. In human-AI evaluation, our method outperforms clinicians-in-training and large language models, and improves clinician accuracy by 14.7% while reducing decision time, enabling interpretable, real-time clinical decision support.

</details>


### [133] [Conceal, Reconstruct, Jailbreak: Exploiting the Reconstruction-Concealment Tradeoff in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05709)
*Md Farhamdur Reza,Richeng Jin,Tianfu Wu,Huaiyu Dai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了针对多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)的意图混淆越狱攻击，核心发现是此类攻击受限于"重建-隐藏权衡"：转换后的输入需隐藏恶意意图以绕过安全过滤器，同时需保留足够信息供目标模型重建原始请求。研究发现现有变换方法难以平衡此权衡，而字符移除变体可获得更好平衡。提出 concealment-aware variant construction 方法，通过贪心选择低有害关键词对齐度和互相多样性的变体，并配合五种模态感知提示策略和关键词相关干扰图像进行攻击。实验表明攻击策略优于基线，揭示了模型自身重建能力可被利用来恢复隐藏恶意意图这一未被充分探索的漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)面临新型越狱攻击威胁：攻击者将有害查询转换为隐蔽的多模态输入以绕过安全机制。现有攻击方法的内在机制和局限性尚不清晰，需要理论分析和系统性改进。

Method: 1) 提出"重建-隐藏权衡"概念框架，分析三种代表性黑盒方法；2) 发现字符移除变体可更好平衡该权衡；3) 提出concealment-aware variant construction方法，贪心选择低有害关键词对齐度且互相多样性的变体；4) 设计五种模态感知提示策略；5) 引入关键词相关干扰图像作为辅助视觉上下文。

Result: 实验在闭源和开源MLLMs上进行，验证了所提策略优于强基线方法，揭示了模型自身重建能力可被滥用来恢复隐藏恶意意图这一新漏洞。

Conclusion: MLLMs存在未被充分探索的安全漏洞：模型的重建能力可被攻击者利用来绕过安全机制。字符移除变体和关键词相关干扰图像是有效的攻击手段，提示需要设计更鲁棒的防御机制来应对此类多模态越狱攻击。

Abstract: Intent-obfuscation-based jailbreak attacks on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) transform a harmful query into a concealed multimodal input to bypass safety mechanisms. We show that such attacks are governed by a \emph{reconstruction--concealment tradeoff}: the transformed input must hide harmful intent from safety filters while remaining recoverable enough for the victim model to reconstruct the original request. Through a reconstruction analysis of three representative black-box methods, we find that existing transformations struggle to balance this tradeoff, limiting their effectiveness. In contrast, we show that character-removed variants achieve a better balance. Building on this, we propose \emph{concealment-aware variant construction}, which greedily selects character-removed variants that are low in harmful-keyword alignment and mutually diverse, and instantiates them through five modality-aware prompting strategies. We further introduce \emph{keyword-related distractor images} that depict the harmful keyword in diverse contexts, providing more effective auxiliary visual context than generic distractor images. Experiments across closed-source and open-source MLLMs show the proposed strategies outperform strong baselines, revealing an underexplored vulnerability: a model's own reconstruction ability can be exploited to recover hidden harmful intent and produce unsafe responses.

</details>


### [134] [Decodable but Not Corrected by Fixed Residual-Stream Linear Steering: Evidence from Medical LLM Failure Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05715)
*Ming Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM隐藏状态中可线性解码的失败信号是否能用于纠正推理失败。通过医学QA中的"过度思考"(Overthinking, OT)现象——模型在重采样时答对但在扩展思维链中失败——发现失败信号可被线性解码（71.6%准确率），但固定线性 steering 方法无法利用这些信号进行纠正（Delta≈0）。通过三类证据表明这是由于表征纠缠：OT方向与任务关键计算重叠85-88%；非定向共享方向 steering 损害准确率(-12.1pp)；LEACE概念擦除损害准确率(-3.6pp)。然而，同一探针可实现选择性放弃（AUROC=0.610），超过所有五个不确定性基准，表明可解码的失败结构支持后生成可靠性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题是：LLM隐藏状态中是否存在可利用的失败信号？如果存在，为何线性 steering 无法利用这些信号进行纠正？

Method: 1) 定义OT行为 regime（Jaccard≥0.81，94%注释者一致性）作为研究对象；2) 训练线性分类器探针解码失败信号；3) 测试29种固定线性 steering 配置（n=1,273）；4) 通过三个收敛证据链分析表征纠缠：方向重叠度、非定向 steering 效果、概念擦除实验；5) 探索探针在选择性放弃中的应用。

Result: 1) OT失败信号可被线性解码（71.6%平衡准确率，p<10^-16）；2) 固定线性 steering 无法纠正（Delta≈0），跨架构（Qwen2.5-7B）和跨领域（MMLU-STEM）一致；3) OT方向与任务关键计算重叠85-88%（特异性比≤0.152）；4) 非定向 steering 损害准确率(-12.1pp)；5) LEACE擦除损害准确率(-3.6pp, p=0.01)，而10次随机擦除产生+0.3pp增益；6) 探针-steering相关性在实例级别为r=-0.002 (p=0.97)；7) 同一探针实现选择性放弃（held-out AUROC=0.610），超过所有五个不确定性基准(p=0.009)。

Conclusion: 失败信号的线性可解码性无法转化为可纠正性的原因在于表征纠缠——失败方向与任务执行方向高度重叠，无法在不损害正确推理的情况下独立操纵。尽管如此，可解码的失败结构仍可用于后生成可靠性估计，为"选择性放弃"策略提供有效信号。

Abstract: Can linearly decodable failure signals in LLM hidden states be leveraged to correct those failures? We investigate this classification-correction gap via Overthinking (OT)--a stable behavioral regime (Jaccard >= 0.81, 94% inter-annotator agreement) in medical QA where models answer correctly under resampling yet fail in extended chain-of-thought. OT is linearly decodable at 71.6% balanced accuracy (p < 10^{-16}). Yet five families of fixed linear steering (29 configurations, n=1,273) all yield Delta ~= 0, with identical null results cross-architecture (Qwen2.5-7B) and cross-domain (MMLU-STEM). Three convergent lines of evidence suggest representational entanglement: the OT direction has 85-88% overlap with task-critical computation (specificity ratio <= 0.152); non-targeted shared-direction steering damages accuracy (-12.1pp); and LEACE concept erasure damages accuracy (-3.6pp, p=0.01), while 10 random erasures produce Delta=+0.3pp. The per-instance probe-steering correlation is r=-0.002 (p=0.97). Positively, the same probe enables selective abstention (held-out AUROC=0.610, exceeding all five uncertainty baselines, p=0.009): decodable failure structure supports post-generation reliability estimation even when the fixed linear steering family cannot exploit it for correction.

</details>


### [135] [More Is Not Always Better: Cross-Component Interference in LLM Agent Scaffolding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05716)
*Ming Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以全因子实验（5个脚手架组件×32种组合×2个基准×3个模型族5个尺度）系统检验LLM智能体中"组件越多越好"的默认假设，发现"跨组件干扰"（CCI）：最优真子集在全部6个模型×基准组合中都达到或超过全组件的All-In系统（HotpotQA上单工具比All-In高32%，F1 0.233 vs 0.177，p=0.023；GSM8K上三组件子集高79%，0.43 vs 0.24，p=0.010）；最优组件数依任务而定（k*=1–4）、随能力上升而衰减（8B 32% → 70B 19% → Claude Haiku ≈0%），并证明该现象在Qwen2.5、模板改写与长度匹配对照下稳健，结论是应按任务做交互感知的子集选择而非堆满组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM智能体框架（LangChain、ReAct、Reflexion、Voyager等）鼓励开发者自由叠加规划、工具、记忆、思维链、自我反思、检索等脚手架组件，隐含"组件越多性能越好"的假设；此前研究（Kapoor et al. 2024等）至多做逐一消融，未做全因子设计，无法揭示组件组合间的高阶交互。本文将这种"负边际收益"现象操作性地定义为跨组件干扰（CCI），并系统刻画其存在性、任务/规模依赖性与结构来源。

Method: （1）全因子设计：对{P, T, M, SR, R}五个标准组件的全部32个子集做评测，HotpotQA（token级F1）与GSM8K（精确匹配），模型含Llama-3.1-8B/70B（4-bit NF4）、Qwen2.5-3B/7B、Claude Haiku 4.5（Bedrock），共118种受控配置、32,000+次评测，每配置最多4步推理、温度0.1、top-p 0.9、每步256 token；主设置10个随机种子（16,000次）。（2）统计分析：配对t检验、Wilcoxon符号秩、Holm–Bonferroni/ Benjamini–Hochberg校正、Cohen's dz、贝叶斯JZS Cauchy先验（BF10）、bootstrap与BCa CI、任务级cluster bootstrap。（3）结构分析：主效应回归 vs 16参数两两交互模型（±1 spin编码），比较R²/adjusted R²/LOOCV/BIC/AIC；精确Shapley值（32个联盟无需近似）；325个(S,T,i)三元组的次模性检验与边际比率γ分布；Harsanyi三体红利INT₃；组件顺序实验（5种顺序×5配置）；长度匹配padding对照、三种模板改写；错误分析。（4）概念层面将CCI与多任务学习的梯度冲突对比，提出"上下文窗口拥挤"与"推理期组件亲和度"类比。

Result: 1) CCI 确证：在Llama-8B/HotpotQA，单独工具T在10种子下F1=0.233±0.039，All-In仅0.177±0.049（配对t检验p=0.023，Wilcoxon p=0.014，d_z=0.87，BF10=3.2，差异95% HDI [+0.010,+0.102]）；从T出发的6次扩张全部退化，5/6在未校正p<0.05下显著（4/6通过Holm校正），效应量0.87–1.44。2) 任务依赖：GSM8K上k*=3（T+SR+R=0.430），比All-In（0.240）高79%（McNemar p=0.010）。3) 规模依赖：70B上T+R=0.441优于All-In 0.372（差距19%，单种子p=0.13）；Claude Haiku上K=1..5全部聚在0.395–0.398（<1%差距），呈饱和。跨族复现：Qwen 3B 40%、Qwen 7B 8%。4) 结构：主效应模型R²=0.916、adj-R²=0.899、LOOCV=0.872，显著优于两两模型（ΔBIC=25.3，LOOCV降至0.748），表明CCI在聚合层面近似可加；Shapley值显示T占绝对价值的70%（φ=+0.177，z=9.1），P显著为负（-0.029）、M方向为负（-0.016），P+M构成22%的"CCI税"，GSM8K上R转正（+0.065）。5) 非次模：325个三元组中183个（56.3%）违反次模性，中位比率γ=0.52（bootstrap CI [0.23,0.71]）；top-20违反中90%为符号翻转（如SR加到{T}为-0.068、加到{P,R,T}为+0.094），T在95%的top违反情境中出现；在GSM8K贪心从T终止于K=1（0.220），错过最优T+SR+R（0.430），故贪心不可靠。三体红利INT₃(T,SR,R)=+0.175（BCa CI [+0.004,+0.352]，p=0.027）被标为探索性，GSM8K上近零。6) 稳健性：真实组件比长度匹配padding高6–9倍；3种模板改写下T>All-In（+3%/+20%/+13%），但配置级排序模板敏感（Spearman ρ=0.14–0.49）；Claude Haiku中Memory仍唯一有害（P+T+SR→P+T+M+SR：-5%）。7) 错误分析：19个"T成功而All-In失败"任务中，68%属组件特异性干扰、21%阈值崩溃、11%脆弱T-only成功；有害组件身份随任务变化（13/19任务存在"可加一个但不能加另一个"的情形）。附录报告负面结果：隐藏状态线性探针预测K近随机、输出熵与性能不相关、数据流图理论预测相关性近零、性能-K更符合平滑衰减而非分段阈值。

Conclusion: 在各测试设定中，"最优真子集匹配或超过全组件All-In"始终成立（8B经统计验证，其余为方向性一致）；最优组件数依任务而定（HotpotQA k*=1、GSM8K k*=3）并随模型能力提升而衰减（32%→19%→≈0%），但CCI在所有能力级别上未被消除。结构上CCI主要由可加的主效应解释（6参数模型优于16参数两两模型），Shapley归因显示Tool Use主导、Planning与Memory为负贡献，56.3%的次模性违反（以符号翻转为主）使贪心组件选择在实证上不可靠。因此实践建议是：在部署前按任务与模型对脚手架子集做穷举或交互感知评估（如基于主效应+Shapley），并以简单充分脚手架替代"最大化装备"默认值；未来工作需在编码/具身/多步智能体基准上验证三种干扰类型（带宽竞争、信号稀释、容量消解）假说，并发展推理期"组件亲和度"度量及联合提示优化。作者亦承认局限：仅8B HotpotQA有多种子验证、70B量化、仅两基准、4步预算、仅提示层脚手架、工具协议与Tool Use组件耦合（无T配置缺少Finish[answer]协议，影响T的Shapley归因）、缺乏确认的因果机制。

Abstract: LLM agent systems are built by stacking scaffolding components (planning, tools, memory, self-reflection, retrieval) assuming more is better. We study cross-component interference (CCI): degradation when components interact destructively. We run a full factorial experiment over all 2^5=32 subsets of five components on HotpotQA and GSM8K with Llama-3.1-8B/70B (96 conditions, up to 10 seeds). The All-In system is consistently suboptimal: on HotpotQA, a single-tool agent surpasses All-In by 32% (F1 0.233 vs 0.177, p=0.023); on GSM8K, a 3-component subset beats All-In by 79% (0.43 vs 0.24, p=0.010). Optimal component count is task-dependent (k*=1-4) and scale-sensitive: at 70B, combinations that hurt at 8B provide gains, though All-In still trails the best subset. We fit a main-effects regression (R^2=0.916, adj-R^2=0.899, LOOCV=0.872), compute exact Shapley values, and find 183/325 submodularity violations (56.3%), showing greedy selection is unreliable. A three-body synergy among Tool Use, Self-Reflection, and Retrieval (INT_3=+0.175, 95% CI [+0.003,+0.351]) is reported as exploratory. CCI replicates across model families (Qwen2.5) and is robust to prompt paraphrasing. Our findings suggest maximally-equipped agent defaults should be replaced by task-specific subset selection via interaction-aware analysis.

</details>


### [136] [Detecting Time Series Anomalies Like an Expert: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Specialized Analyzers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05725)
*Hyeongwon Kang,Jeongseob Kim,Jinwoo Park,Pilsung Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE多智能体框架，用于单变量时间序列的结构化异常诊断。该框架通过四类专业分析器分工协作，结合合成上下文示例，在三个基准数据集上达到最佳平均性能，显著提升了异常检测的可靠性和诊断实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测方法通常依赖单一通用模型直接推断异常索引或间隔，这在复杂异常模式场景下存在可控性、可解释性和可靠性方面的局限。

Method: 提出SAGE（Specialized Analyzer Group for Expert-like Detection）多智能体框架，将异常分析分解为四个专业分析器（点异常、结构异常、季节异常、模式异常）。每个分析器使用家族特定的数值工具和诊断可视化生成证据；基于证据的检测器将证据整合为带置信度评分、间隔和候选类型的异常记录；监督器将这些结构化记录转换为面向分析师的诊断报告。该框架从正常参考训练片段构建合成上下文示例，无需使用真实异常片段或异常类型标签作为上下文示例。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，SAGE在强基线模型（ML/DL和基于语言模型的基线）中取得最佳平均性能。消融实验和人类评估表明该框架提升了检测可靠性和诊断输出的实用价值。

Conclusion: SAGE框架显著提升了时间序列异常检测的可靠性和诊断输出的实用价值。消融实验和人类评估验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Recent studies have explored large language models for time-series anomaly detection, yet existing approaches often rely on a single general-purpose model to directly infer anomaly indices or intervals, limiting controllability, interpretability, and reliability for complex anomaly patterns. We propose SAGE (Specialized Analyzer Group for Expert-like Detection), a multi-agent framework for structured anomaly diagnosis in univariate time series. It decomposes anomaly analysis into four specialized Analyzers for point, structural, seasonal, and pattern anomalies. Each Analyzer applies family-specific numerical tools and diagnostic visualizations to generate evidence, while an evidence-grounded Detector consolidates the evidence into confidence-scored anomaly records with intervals and candidate types. A Supervisor then converts these structured records into analyst-facing diagnostic reports. SAGE further constructs synthetic in-context examples from normal-reference training segments, without using real anomalous segments or anomaly-type labels as in-context examples. Across three benchmarks, SAGE achieves the best average performance among strong ML/DL and language-model-based baselines. Ablation studies and human evaluation further show that the proposed framework improves detection reliability and the practical usefulness of diagnostic outputs.

</details>


### [137] [SkillRet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Skill Retrieval in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05726)
*Hongcheol Cho,Ryangkyung Kang,Youngeun Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillRet基准，用于评测LLM智能体中的技能检索性能，包含大规模真实技能库和丰富评测数据；实验表明任务特定微调可显著提升检索效果，为大规模智能体系统检索研究奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体技能库的不断扩张，在严格上下文和延迟约束下，如何为用户请求选择正确技能已成为关键系统挑战；然而技能检索研究不足，缺乏基准测试和现实规模技能库上的检索行为理解。

Method: 构建了包含17,810个公共智能体技能的大规模基准，采用结构化语义标签和两级分类体系（6大类、18子类），提供63,259个训练样本和4,997个评估查询，训练与评估采用不相交技能池设计；对多种检索器进行了系统评测，并针对SkillRet进行任务特定微调。

Result: 技能检索问题仍远未解决：现成模型在真实大规模技能库上表现困难，先前技能检索模型仍有很大改进空间；任务特定微调显著提升性能，NDCG@10分别比最强先前检索器和最强现成检索器提升13.1和16.9个百分点；改进源于微调模型更好地聚焦于冗长嘈杂查询中的微小技能相关信号。

Conclusion: SkillRet为大规模智能体系统中的检索研究提供了坚实的基准和未来研究基础，有望推动该领域的持续进步。

Abstract: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed with large libraries of reusable skills, selecting the right skill for a user request has become a critical systems challenge. In small libraries, users may invoke skills explicitly by name, but this assumption breaks down as skill ecosystems grow under tight context and latency budgets. Despite its practical importance, skill retrieval remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and little understanding of retrieval behavior on realistic skill libraries. To address this gap, we introduce SkillRet, a large-scale benchmark for skill retrieval in LLM agents. SkillRet contains 17,810 public agent skills, organized with structured semantic tags and a two-level taxonomy spanning 6 major categories and 18 sub-categories. It provides 63,259 training samples and 4,997 evaluation queries with disjoint skill pools, enabling both benchmarking and retrieval-oriented training. Across a diverse set of retrievers, we find that skill retrieval remains far from solved: off-the-shelf models struggle on realistic large-scale skill libraries, and prior skill-retrieval models still leave substantial headroom. Task-specific fine-tuning on SkillRet substantially improves performance, improving NDCG@10 by +13.1 points over the strongest prior retriever and by +16.9 points over the strongest off-the-shelf retriever. Our analysis further suggests that these gains arise because fine-tuned models better focus on the small skill-relevant signals within long and noisy queries. These results establish SkillRet as a strong benchmark and foundation for future research on retrieval in large-scale agent systems.

</details>


### [138] [Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Grading Using Optimized Deep Learning and LLM-Driven Intelligent AI on Computationally Limited Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05731)
*Dayam Nadeem,Neha,Safdar Mustafa,Adnan Alvi,Mohd Hussain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种端侧部署的膝骨关节炎（KOA）自动分级诊断方案：以 ResNet-18 为骨干网络，通过迁移学习在公开数据集上对膝关节X线影像进行 Kellgren-Lawrence（KL）五级分类，测试准确率达 94.48%；随后将模型转换为轻量级 TensorFlow Lite 格式，使其可在无网络连接的资源受限设备（如手机）上离线运行；并引入 Gemini-2.0-flash 大语言模型作为辅助解释层，生成潜在症状、风险因素与预防建议等结构化解读，但该 LLM 不参与分类决策。整体论证了"端侧 + 可解释"的 AI 辅助膝关节筛查决策支持工具的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 膝骨关节炎（KOA）是全球范围内的常见慢性肌肉骨骼疾病，会显著限制关节活动、引发慢性疼痛并降低生活质量。传统临床诊断与严重程度评估（如 Kellgren-Lawrence 分级）高度依赖医师主观阅片，存在主观性与观察者间/内一致性差的缺陷，导致评估结果不稳定且可能延误诊断。因此需要一种客观、精确、及时且易于获取的自动化影像分级方法。移动端/边缘侧设备在医疗资源有限地区与筛查场景中的普及，也对模型轻量化、离线可用性提出了需求；同时，纯深度学习模型的"黑箱"输出缺乏临床可解释性，需要额外的解释层以提升医生与患者的信任与可用性。

Method: 1）数据与模型：以公开的膝关节X线影像数据库为训练基础，构建基于 ResNet-18 的卷积神经网络分类器。采用迁移学习（预训练权重微调）路线，先将膝关节影像划分为五个 Kellgren-Lawrence 等级类别；2）训练与优化：在训练过程中进一步优化网络（超参数/结构微调），获得稳定收敛的判别性能，并记录测试准确率 94.48%；3）边缘部署：将优化后的模型转换为轻量化的 TensorFlow Lite 格式，使其可在资源受限设备上以完全离线（无需持续互联网连接）的方式推理；4）解释层：接入辅助性大语言模型 Gemini-2.0-flash，根据分类结果生成结构化的解释性发现，包括潜在症状、风险因素及预防措施建议等，该 LLM 仅作为人机交互与解释接口，明确不参与也不影响分类过程。

Result: ResNet-18 迁移学习模型在训练中实现了 94.48% 的测试准确率，并表现出稳定的收敛曲线，验证了迁移学习在 KL 分级任务上的有效性。模型经优化后转换为 TensorFlow Lite 轻量格式，可在资源受限设备上离线推理，具备可部署性。附加的 LLM 模块能够围绕分级结果输出潜在症状、风险因素、预防建议等结构化文本解读，同时保持与分类管线的解耦。作者据此表明该系统具备"端侧运行 + 可解释"的 AI 辅助膝关节筛查决策支持能力，有助于提升诊断可及性（尤其在网络条件受限或医疗资源不足的场景）。

Conclusion: 本文验证了将 ResNet-18 深度卷积神经网络与 TensorFlow Lite 边缘推理平台结合、用于膝骨关节炎 Kellgren-Lawrence 自动严重程度分级的可行性，测试准确率达 94.48%，并实现了无需网络连接的端侧部署。在此基础上引入 LLM 作为非侵入式解释与交互接口，进一步增强了系统的临床可解释性与用户友好性。论文证明了构建低成本、可移植、可解释的 AI 辅助膝关节早期筛查决策支持工具的可行性。不过摘要中未报告灵敏度/特异度、各 KL 类别别的混淆矩阵、外部数据集上的泛化验证、与其他基线模型的对照比较及临床可用性评估，实际临床应用仍需多中心验证与更严格的性能与安全性评价。

Abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is among the musculoskeletal disorders that considerably restrict joint mobility, cause severe chronic pain and impact negatively on quality life. It is one of the persistent health issues worldwide. Generally, subjectivity and inter-observer variability undermine conventional practices and evaluation process that are adopted to address such health issues. Hence precise and timely diagnosis would be one of the effective ways for the assessment of its severity. This paper proposes an automated diagnostic approach for severity grading of KOA by blending a deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) with a device-based inference platform powered by TensorFlow Lite. It proposes a model based on the ResNet-18 convolutional neural network. The designed model is trained on publicly available database. Through a transfer learning approach obtained knee images are first classified into five Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grades. Further the developed model is optimised. During the training of the model test accuracy of 94.48% with stable convergence has been achieved. Subsequently the optimised model transformed into a lightweight TensorFlow Lite format, facilitating seamless deployment on resource-constrained devices. The designed model is capable enough to operate in the environment having no continuous internet connectivity. Also, an auxiliary Large Language Model (Gemini-2.0-flash) is applied to generate structured interpretive findings like potential symptoms, risk factors, and preventive majors etc. The LLM component functions as interface without influencing the classification process. The proposed model articulates the feasibility of an on-device, interpretable decision-support tools for early diagnosis and improve accessibility to Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted knee screening tool.

</details>


### [139] [SDFlow: Similarity-Driven Flow Matching for Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05736)
*Wei Li,Shibo Feng,Pengcheng Wu,Min Wu,Peilin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SDFlow，一种基于流匹配的非自回归时间序列生成框架，完全在冻结的VQ潜空间中运行，通过低秩流形分解和变分流匹配机制克服了自回归模型的曝光偏差问题，在长序列生成任务上实现了质量与速度的双重提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于自回归token建模的VQ方法存在曝光偏差问题——推理时预测误差会跨步累积，导致长序列生成质量严重下降。这是自回归范式的根本性局限。

Method: SDFlow基于流匹配框架，通过三大核心设计解决技术挑战：(1) 用全局传输映射替代步进式token预测以消除曝光偏差；(2) 采用低秩流形分解和锚点先验解决VQ token空间高维问题；(3) 在变分流匹配框架内引入离散码本索引的类别后验，将离散监督融入连续传输动力学。

Result: SDFlow在Discriminative Score和Context-FID（特别是长序列生成）上均达到最优，推理速度相比自回归基线显著加快，实现了高保真度与高计算效率的统一。

Conclusion: SDFlow通过非自回归方式在VQ潜空间中实现高效时间序列生成，在保真度和计算效率上都优于自回归基线模型，尤其在长序列生成任务上表现突出。

Abstract: Vector quantization (VQ) with autoregressive (AR) token modeling is a widely adopted and highly competitive paradigm for time-series generation. However, such models are fundamentally limited by exposure bias: during inference, errors can accumulate across sequential predictions, leading to pronounced quality degradation in long-horizon generation. To address this, we propose SDFlow ($\textbf{S}$imilarity-$\textbf{D}$riven $\textbf{Flow}$ Matching), a non-autoregressive framework that operates entirely in the frozen VQ latent space and enables parallel sequence generation via flow matching. We tackle three key challenges in making this transition: (1) eliminating exposure bias by replacing step-wise token prediction with a global transport map; (2) mitigating the high-dimensionality of VQ token spaces via a low-rank manifold decomposition with a learned anchor prior over the latent manifold; and (3) incorporating discrete supervision into continuous transport dynamics by introducing a categorical posterior over codebook indices within a variational flow-matching formulation. Extensive experiments show that SDFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Discriminative Score and substantially reducing Context-FID, particularly for challenging long-sequence generation. Moreover, SDFlow provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines, offering both high fidelity and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SDFlow-D6F3/

</details>


### [140] [ReFlect: An Effective Harness System for Complex Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05737)
*Fan Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReFlect是一个推理harness系统，通过在模型外部构建独立的错误检测与恢复逻辑，有效解决了长周期多阶段任务中错误累积问题，在多种规模模型上实现显著性能提升，且提升幅度与模型基线能力呈可预测的负相关关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理范式（链式思考、ReAct、事后自批评）在长周期多阶段任务中因两个假设失效而导致错误累积，且无法有效检测和恢复自身失败。具体而言，prompt级自批评产生公式化模板（在90/100个审计块中未发现问题），且所测LLM至少在76%的情况下错误接受错误答案。

Method: ReFlect采用"harness"架构，将错误检测与恢复逻辑作为确定性包装器独立于语言模型外部运行，而非依赖模型自身的即时自反思。系统在推理时动态监控推理状态，识别错误并触发恢复机制，实现模型无关、免训练的推理增强。

Result: ReFlect在6个模型（从gpt-4o-mini到Claude Sonnet 4.5）上实现41%-56%的任务成功率，相比Direct CoT提升7-29个百分点；SWE-bench补丁结构质量从0%提升至82%-87%。关键发现：harness收益与模型Direct CoT基线成功率呈负相关（斜率-1.69，r=-0.76），即基线每下降1个百分点，harness收益机械性恢复1.69个百分点。

Conclusion: ReFlect通过将错误检测与恢复逻辑作为确定性包装器独立于模型运行，成功实现了推理失败的自主检测与恢复。该系统无需训练、模型无关、完全在推理时运行，在多种规模模型上均取得显著提升，且提升幅度与模型基线性能呈负相关，为长周期多阶段任务的推理可靠性提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Current reasoning paradigms for LLMs include chain-of-thought, ReAct, and post-hoc self-critique. These paradigms rely on two assumptions that fail on long-horizon, multi-stage tasks. As a result, errors accumulate silently across reasoning steps, leaving an open question: can a reasoning system effectively detect and recover from its own failures? We present ReFlect, a \emph{harness} system for LLM reasoning that creates standalone error detection and recovery logic as a deterministic wrapper around the model. Controlled experiments across 6 reasoning domains show that prompt-level self-critique produces formulaic templates that flag no issues in 90 of 100 audited reflection blocks, and the investigated LLMs wrongly accept a wrong answer in at least 76\% of cases. Our ReFlect harness achieves task success rates ranging from 41\% on gpt-4o-mini to 56\% on Claude Sonnet 4.5 across six models spanning small and frontier scale, with per-model gains over Direct CoT ranging from +7 pp on Qwen2.5-72B to +29 pp on Claude Sonnet 4.5, and additionally raises SWE-bench patch-structural quality from 0\% (Direct CoT) to between 82\% (Qwen2.5-72B) and 87\% (GPT-4o). Notably, the harness gain is inversely proportional to the model's Direct CoT task success rate (the fitted slope is -1.69 with r=-0.76): each pp lost in baseline success rate is mechanically recovered by 1.69 pp of harness gain. We spot that adding structured reasoning state and operators yields only 15.0--18.7\% pair-mean on Llama-3.3-70B and Qwen2.5-72B because models at this scale cannot reliably populate the state its operators require. ReFlect is model-agnostic, training-free, and operates entirely at inference time.

</details>


### [141] [HyperLens: Quantifying Cognitive Effort in LLMs with Fine-grained Confidence Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05741)
*Chengda Lu,Xiaoyu Fan,Wei Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HyperLens，一种用于追踪大语言模型(LLM)推理过程中置信度轨迹的高分辨率探测工具，通过发现Transformer深层具有放大层间置信度微小变化的内在放大机制，量化推理过程中的认知努力，并揭示标准监督微调(SFT)可能降低认知努力从而损害领域内性能的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM推理动态分析工具分辨率有限，难以深入理解模型在推理过程中的内部工作机制，特别是无法精细地追踪和分析推理时的置信度变化轨迹。

Method: 识别出Transformer架构中深层层间置信度的固有放大机制，在此基础上设计HyperLens高分辨率探测工具，用于追踪置信度轨迹并量化推理过程中的认知努力。

Result: 在多个LLM和数据集上的实验表明，HyperLens能够揭示复杂任务与简单任务在置信度轨迹上的系统性差异，并将其抽象为可量化的认知努力指标。

Conclusion: 复杂任务一致性地需要更高的认知努力，这是LLM推理的一个基本原则。同时发现标准监督微调可能导致认知努力降低，进而损害领域内任务的性能。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, their inference dynamics remain poorly understood because of the limited resolution of existing analysis tools. In this work, we identify an intrinsic magnification mechanism in transformer architectures: deeper layers inherently magnify the small changes of layer-wise confidence, providing a fine-grained confidence trajectory. Building on this insight, we introduce HyperLens, a high-resolution probe designed to trace confidence trajectories and quantify the cognitive effort during inference. Across LLMs and datasets, HyperLens reveals a consistent divergence in confidence trajectories that separates complex from simple tasks. We abstract this pattern into a quantitative cognitive effort metric. Our analysis reveals a fundamental principle: complex tasks consistently require higher cognitive effort. Finally, we provide a mechanistic diagnosis of a common side effect of standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT): it can reduce cognitive effort and consequently degrade performance on in-domain tasks.

</details>


### [142] [Best Arm Identification in Generalized Linear Bandits via Hybrid Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05745)
*Qirun Zeng,Xuchuang Wang,Jiayi Shen,Xutong Liu,Fang Kong,Jinhang Zuo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究广义线性 bandit 中固定置信度下最佳臂识别问题，采用混合反馈模型（单臂绝对奖励反馈与臂对相对比较反馈），提出基于似然比的置信序列和自适应 Track-and-Stop 算法，实现样本效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
