TL;DR: 本文提出一种纯黑盒的“轨迹置信度”评分：将思维链(CoT)按滑动窗口嵌入为轨迹，用一参数 softmax 度量其对外部答案锚点的收敛程度，无需 logits、隐状态或有监督校准器；进一步把黑盒置信度分解为 Coverage(可达性先验)、Geometry(轨迹内承诺度)、Verbalization(自评)三个通道。融合 C+G+V 在 K=4 时于 6/6 个闭集设置上 Pareto 优于 SC@8(中位 AUC 0.78 vs 0.71, ΔAUC=+0.075),并节省约 51% API 成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT 推理常通过纯文本 API 部署,无法获得 logits、隐状态或检索支持,置信度只能从生成文本估计。主流黑盒基线 self-consistency(SC)需要 K 次采样、成本随 K 线性增长,完全忽略推理轨迹自身的几何结构,且给出的是 k/K 这样的离散票数比,在小 K 时分辨率低、无法对平票排序。本文动机在于:在纯文本、轨迹级、外锚定(而非自指)这一此前少被探索的组合下,能否从单条 CoT 的嵌入轨迹中读出连续、logit 形状的正确性概率;并且识别出“轨迹几何”这一信号的结构性上限(轨迹从未提出正确假设时任何轨迹内评分都无法恢复),从而推动把黑盒置信度视为多通道融合问题而非单一标量。

Method: 1) 轨迹构建:每条 CoT 用滑窗(W=30 词、步长 S=15)嵌入为轨迹 T=(z0,…,zM),z0 为问题嵌入;答案锚点 y_j 为外部提供的选项文本嵌入(固定、与生成器无关)。2) 几何分数:取倒数第二个滑窗 z_{M-1} 到各锚点的余弦距离 D_j,对 K 条轨迹平均;pick 为 argmin_j D_j。3) 一参数 softmax:Geo(q)=exp(β̂_all·D_ŷ)/Σexp(β̂_all·D_j'),β̂_all 由训练折 MLE 拟合(强负值表示“越靠近某锚点越可能正确”),再经 null 标准化 top-2 margin 给出 Fermi–Dirac 二元读出 σ(β̂_bin·D̃−α);文中给出统一后验推导及 Eq.5 的可证伪一致性检验(6/6 通过)。4) 辅助特征:Str 字符串共识、Sem 答案嵌入平均余弦、Vol 轨迹相邻窗波动、Ens 跨模型多数答案一致;复合置信度为 (Geo,Str,Sem,Vol,Ens) 上的平衡类权重逻辑回归。5) 三通道设置:引入 proposer(生成假设池)与 judge(判定金标等价),Coverage 由池可达率、判官标签熵等构成;Geometry 换用 proposer 假设锚点;Verbalization 为同一生成器对自己 CoT 的 0–100 自评;每通道各自 5 折逻辑回归得通道分数,再二次 5 折逻辑融合(嵌套避免泄漏)。6) 协议:全部学习参数按分层 5 折在训练折重拟合并冻结应用于留出折,报告选择性预测 AUC;另设窗口位置扫描、锚点设计消融、跨 embedder(E5-large-v2)复现、判官家族替换、fixed-pick 对照、词汇遮蔽控制与成本核算。

Result: 几何通道:在盲测 MCQ 协议下,MedQA/GPQA 四组 (benchmark,model) 的 β̂_all 全部强负且显著(z=−5.48 至 −25.39),Geo 单特征 AUC 0.71–0.82,Composite 0.701–0.826,移除 Geo 掉 0.12–0.25 AUC;单通道 G 在 9/10 组合超过预算匹配的 SC,MedQA/Gemini 上 DeBERTa-MNLI 语义熵仅 0.590 对几何复合 0.821。窗口扫描:β̂ 随窗口位置非平坦,6/6 组合在倒数第二窗(−2/−3)最深负;GPQA 终端窗反号(+22.1 Gemini、+23.7 Claude),按错误分层更达 +66.7/+70.1,而 MedQA/MMLU-Pro 终端窗保持强负,说明终端翻转源于字面答案复述的条件性机制;作者预先固定的倒数第二窗默认因此在 6/6 上位于或接近谷底。锚点设计是关键:condensed-answer 与 reasoning-tail 锚点退化至近随机(0.319–0.479),数据集选项锚点达 0.710/0.750。三通道:18 个 benchmark×reasoner×proposer 设置中,C 与 G 提供独立信号 18/18 与 16/18(LRT,p≤0.002),V 仅 6/18;融合在 17/18 超过最佳单通道(中位 0.78,最高 0.92)。头部结果:C+G+V@K=4 在 6/6 闭集设置上 Pareto 优于 SC@8(中位 ΔAUC=+0.075,均值 +0.077,Stouffer z=5.67,p=7.1e−9,4/6 逐组合 CI 排除零);fixed-pick 对照在 SC 自身答案上仍 +0.060(94% 答案一致),说明增益来自校准而非换答案;E5-large-v2 替换 embedder 后融合仍 6/6 优于 SC@8(z=3.14),但 Geo-only 效应减弱(中位 +0.027)。判官家族替换(GPT-5-mini→Claude Sonnet 4.6):κ=0.82,G-only AUC 变化 |Δ|≤0.013,C-only 跨判官变化 ≤±0.02。成本:K=4 三通道相对 SC@10 每题从 $0.2839 降至 $0.1379(节省 42.6–54.4%),嵌入成本可忽略(≈3e−5)。结构上限:所有嵌入/投票类分数在“正确但未提出金标”(桶 iii)与“提出金标但未选中”(桶 ii)的分离上呈反相关(AUC 0.06–0.44),仅 Verbalization 不倒挂(0.45–0.62),支持“需要第二通道”的论证。

Conclusion: 纯文本黑盒 CoT 置信度是结构化的三通道信号:Coverage(正确假设是否可达)、Geometry(轨迹在可达集内的承诺强度)、Verbalization(可获得元认知访问时的自评)。轨迹几何的置信信号在倒数第二个推理窗口达到峰值,构成“答案承诺先于字面表述”的黑盒证据;倒数第二窗默认使协议在三个基准上不变(终端反号仅在 GPQA 出现)。实践结论是:应无条件使用 C 与 G,并以设置级校准与正交性检验为条件门控 V;置信度来自融合而非单一标量,成本为 K 次额外 rollout 加一次嵌入,无需 logits/权重/隐状态。局限:C 受 LLM 判官中介(已用字符串匹配抽查与判官替换界定其影响,但缺多判官/人工裁定/检索接地研究);V 仅在 6/18 设置提供残余信号;仅在三个英文基准与三个前沿推理器上验证;轨迹内分数无法恢复从未被提出的假设这一结构性上限始终存在。

Abstract: Reliable confidence estimation enables safe deployment of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning through text-only APIs. Yet the dominant black-box baseline, self-consistency over K samples, is linearly expensive and ignores the geometry of the trace. We propose a black-box trajectory-confidence score: we embed a CoT as a sliding-window trajectory and measure its convergence to external answer anchors with a one-parameter softmax. The method needs no logits, hidden states, or supervised calibrators. Across six (benchmark, reasoner) settings on MedQA-USMLE, GPQA Diamond, and MMLU-Pro with Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.6, fusing this score with coverage and verbalized-confidence channels at K=4 yields Pareto improvements over self-consistency at K=8 in 6/6 settings (median AUC 0.78 vs 0.71, deltaAUC=+0.075). A fixed-pick control (+0.060) and E5 cross-embedder replication rule out answer switching and single-vendor artifacts. Geometry peaks in the penultimate window across benchmarks and reasoners, and inverts at the terminal window on GPQA Diamond. Three unscaffolded regimes separate black-box confidence into a judge-mediated Coverage prior (C), within-trace Geometry (G), and a conditional Verbalization channel (V). Across 18 benchmark x reasoner x proposer settings, C and G provide independent signal in 18/18 and 16/18, while V contributes residual signal in 6/18. Swapping the judge from GPT-5-mini to Claude Sonnet 4.6 leaves G-only AUC unchanged (|delta|<=0.013) and shifts C-only AUC by at most +/-0.02 (kappa=0.82). Fusion beats the best single channel in 17/18 settings (median AUC 0.78, max 0.92).

</details>


### [202] [A Regime Theory of Controller Class Selection for LLM Action Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06339)
*Zhaoyang Jiang,Zhizhong Fu,Yunsoo Kim,Jiacong Mi,Zicheng Li,Xuanqi Peng,Honghan Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套"控制器类别选择"的制度(regime)理论：把"直接作答/检索证据/转交强模型/弃答"决策的控制器按表达能力嵌套为四层格 Π0(固定动作)⊂Π1(分区路由)⊂Π2(样本级学习控制器)⊂Π3(先验门控控制器)，并证明在有限样本下"更强的逐样本表达力"并非单调更优——不同基准因统计制度不同而偏好不同层级。三个可由数据估计的瓶颈（残余质量、Π2 可行样本量阈值、分区几何）被转化为类别选择规则：残余界（Thm1）、Bernstein 紧的 Π2 符号判定阈值 n≥2α(1−α)log(2/δ)/(qβ²) 且有匹配的信息论下界（Thm2/Prop1）、分区增益下界（Thm3），并给出嵌套交叉验证的留出选择界（Thm4）。在 SMS-Spam、HallusionBench、A-OKVQA、FOLIO 上预测类别与经验赢家完全一致，TextVQA-OCR 上 Π3 以 10.8 个联合种子标准差领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署中的 LLM/VLM 必须在每个输入上决定"直接答、检索、转交更强模型还是弃答"，但现有各子文献（拒绝选项、learning-to-defer、级联路由、选择性生成）都预先固定了一种控制器结构并只在族内优化，从未问过"数据到底支持哪一档表达力"。作者要反驳的隐含前提是单调性：更强的逐样本规则总是更好。已有工作表明：基于置信度的级联仅在逐样本置信度是充分统计量时才是 Bayes 最优（Jitkrittum et al., 2023），且仅凭同源实例信息检测幻觉存在不可能性下界（Kalai & Vempala 2024; Karbasi et al. 2025）——即实例级信息在某个依赖分布的有限尺度上被耗尽。因此真正的问题是：给定数据 (D, n)，哪一个控制器类别在统计上是正当的？

Method: 【形式化】输入 x~D，动作集 A={direct, retrieve, defer, abstain}，每个动作有正确性 c∈{0,1}、语义风险 h∈[0,1]、操作成本 k≥0，组合损失 ℓ=w_c(1−c)+w_h h+w_k k∈[0,L_max]。定义四个严格嵌套的控制器类（Def1）：Π0 固定动作；Π1 分区路由（K 个簇、簇内最优动作）；Π2=Π1+样本级学习控制器（逐样本特征→有界复杂度假设族）；Π3=Π2+先验门控（确定性规则 ρ 用回退控制器 r 不可见的外部通道，门内用 ρ、门外用 r）。注意集合嵌套保证总体最优风险单调下降，但估计复杂度反向上升，故须比较 E_S[R(π̂_m(S))]。

【三个瓶颈与定理】
(1) 残余界 Thm1：任意控制器的期望改进 ≤ P(R)·sup_{x∈R,a}(ℓ(x,a*)−ℓ(x,a))，其中 R 是存在更优动作的输入集合；一行条件期望即证。
(2) Thm2（Bernstein 紧的可行性阈值）：在"局部尾部裕度约定" μ_w(q)−α_min ≥ β 下，n ≥ n_min(α,β,q,δ)=2α(1−α)log(2/δ)/(qβ²) 以概率 ≥1−δ 保证经验损失差与总体损失差同号；n 明显低于该阈值时符号不可认证（称"方差受限"区）。证明用 Bernstein 不等式作用于 bottom-q 精度估计器。Prop1（Bretagnolle–Huber/Le Cam）给出匹配下界 n ≥ c·α(1−α)log(1/δ)/(qβ²)，故阈值在阶上最优。
(3) Thm3（分布依赖的分区下界）：Δ_partition = Σ_g p_g γ_g ≥ max_g p_g γ_g；并给出 κ 折 CV 下分区估计器达到"簇损失不劣于全局基线"所需的样本量 n ≥ (κ/(κ−1))·max{8log(2/δ)/p_g, (16σ²+(8/3)L_max γ_g)log(4|A|/δ)/(p_g γ_g²)}，其复杂度依赖簇质量 p_g 与判别间隙 γ_g 而不依赖实例级裕度 β——这正是 Π1 能在 Π2 方差受限处取胜的原因。
Cor1（制度分解）：(i) 残余积小则无自适应类可改进；(ii) β>0 但 n<n_min 时 Π2 符号未认证，而只要某分区 C_Π1(G)>0，Π1 可严格改进；(iii) n≥n_min 时由上限 C_Π1 与 C_Π2=q*β(L_w−L_r) 的比较决定总体赢家，实证赢家还取决于有限容量族对上限的实现程度。Thm4（Hoeffding+对类别并合界）给出嵌套 CV 内折选择的期望风险 ≤ min_m R̄_κ(m) + 4L_max√(log(2|M|)/n_in)，重拟合再加 2ε_stab。

【实验】统一 fit/predict 接口的控制器池（Π0: always_direct + fair_fixed_train；Π1: KMeans K∈{4,5,6,8}，消融 CART depth 3/4；Π2: HistGradientBoosting md∈{3,4}、校准逻辑回归 C=0.3），严格嵌套 5 折×5 种子 CV（家族选择仅在外层训练集上做内层 CV，再在外层训练集重拟合，外层测试一次性评估）。损失权重 (1,1,0.05)，语义风险由 InternVL2.5-8B 评判（不同模型族），控制器特征块 41/39/12 维（置信度边际、动作间一致性、K=10 采样熵、盲图/自验证探针等）。外部基线：Mozannar–Sontag 与 Narasimhan 的成本敏感 learning-to-defer 适配。三个受控合成实验：跨阈值 bottom-q 精度扫描、Π1/Π2 相变、Π3 正交通道扫描。

Result: 【四个核心基准（严格嵌套 5×5 CV，loss↓）】SMS-Spam(n=1114)：P(R)=0.009、β≤0、max_g p_g γ_g=0，残余受限，Π0=0.0590 严格胜出（Π1 塌缩为 direct，Π2 差 +0.0002）。HallusionBench(n=920)：α=0.722、β=0.469、n_min=23，C_Π2=0.15>C_Π1=0.10，Π2(HGBC-md3, 0.8970) 以约 3 个种子 sd 胜 Π1(KM-8, 0.9093)，内层 CV 在 20/25 外折选 Π2；KM-4 的 Σp_gγ_g=0.047 与经验降幅 0.048±0.005 一致，Thm3 紧。A-OKVQA(n=1145)：α=0.874、β=0.246、n_min=45，C_Π2=0.094>C_Π1=0.039，Π2(Selective-0.3, 0.3805) 胜 Π1(0.3902)，但内层 CV 呈 10:15 的 Π1:Π2 分裂，属 Cor1(iii) 的"上限相当"边界（CART 消融 0.3742 反而略低于 Π2）。FOLIO(n=203)：α=0.687、β=0.053、n_min=1898（约 9.4 倍差距），Π1(KM-6, 0.7195) 胜出，而最好的 Π2(0.7546) 比 Π0(0.7520) 差 +0.0027，正是"符号未认证"的预测行为；两个 L2D 基线（0.7478/0.7705）同样落后 Π1 约 2.7/2.3 联合种子 sd。预测类别与经验赢家 4/4 吻合。

【Π3 可部署见证】TextVQA-OCR 验证集 n=5000：OCR 令牌是无标签预测时先验，Π3(OCR 门控+回退) 达 0.8212±0.0021，优于 Π0(always_ocr) 0.8463、Π1(CART-d4) 0.8445、Π2(logistic) 0.8595；相对最佳低层领先 0.0233，合 10.8 个联合种子 sd。Π2 反而差于固定 OCR 属信息设计问题（n=5000 远高于阈值），合成实验（先验 z⊥X）证实增加样本无法弥补通道缺失。

【稳健性】损失权重 7 种扰动：A-OKVQA(7/7) 与 FOLIO(7/7) 稳定，HallusionBench 5/7 保留 Π2、2/7 翻为 Π1（差 <0.005），印证其边界性质；自动选类在 HallusionBench/A-OKVQA 接近逐类最优（−0.183 / −0.028），但 FOLIO 仅 −0.003，因 4/25 外折误选未被认证的 Π2，说明需要 Cor1(ii) 的类别约束。合成实验：跨阈值扫描中经验符号正确率在 n/n_min∈[0.43,0.69] 处达到 0.95，FOLIO 的 n/n_min=0.107 稳健落在未饱和区。

Conclusion: 核心主张是"类别选择，而非族内调优，才是损失的主要来源"：把三个彼此不同的瓶颈（残余质量、样本量、分区几何）各自映射到可从留出探针计算的诊断量，即可决定该用哪一档控制器；残余受限→Π0，方差受限→Π1，Bernstein 可行且实例上限更高→Π2，存在无标签预测时先验通道→Π3。作者强调边界条件：诊断量依赖所选动作集、损失矩阵、特征块与评判模型（故可重算），Bernstein 分析源自选择性子问题并被当作类级可行性代理，当两个上限相近时实测赢家由有限容量族的实现程度中介（A-OKVQA 的 Π1/Π2 平局即此故）；Π3 要求真正的无标签先验通道，A-OKVQA 的 rationale 门控虽达到 0.3554 但属答案派生、不可部署，只能作为动机；语义风险仅由单一 InternVL2.5-8B 评判者给出，换评判者会移动制度标签。实践含义：可靠部署的关键是把控制器复杂度匹配到数据能支撑的尺度，而非一味追求更强的逐样本规则。

Abstract: Deployed language and vision-language models must decide, on each input, whether to answer directly, retrieve evidence, defer to a stronger model, or abstain. Contrary to the common monotonicity intuition, greater per-input expressivity is not uniformly beneficial in finite samples: under identical strict cross-validation, different benchmarks prefer different controller classes. This reflects a finite-sample limitation of instance-level uncertainty signals, which can be exhausted at a distribution-dependent scale. We organize controllers into a nested lattice of four classes: fixed actions, partition routers, instance-level controllers, and prior-gated controllers, ordered by complexity. We prove a regime theory that turns three data-estimable bottlenecks into a class choice: how much improvement is possible beyond the best fixed action, whether there are enough samples for instance-level controllers to make reliable decisions, and how much improvement a coarse partition router can recover when instance-level signal is unreliable. The resulting Bernstein-tight threshold has a matching information-theoretic lower bound, and strict nested cross-validation provably selects a near-best class. Across SMS-Spam, HallusionBench, A-OKVQA, and FOLIO, the predicted class matches the empirical winner; the prior-gated controller wins on TextVQA when OCR tokens supply a label-free prediction-time prior. Code is available at https://github.com/Anonymous-Awesome-Submissions/Regime-Theory.

</details>


### [203] [Mind the Gap? A Distributional Comparison of Real and Synthetic Priors for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06343)
*Alex O. Davies,Telmo de Menezes e Silva Filho,Nirav Ajmeri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以 T4（网络抓取）、TabFM（Kaggle 策展）与 TabICL（合成先验）三类表格基础模型预训练语料为对象，用表级/列级/相关性级聚合特征、判别器 AUC 与 k-NN 覆盖率度量其分布关系：合成先验仅占据真实表格空间的狭窄区域（判别器 AUC≈0.999，真实表被覆盖比例仅 8.8%–16%），86k+ 组超参数网格搜索与贝叶斯/遗传优化均无法弥合该差距，而策展与网络抓取语料在分布上高度可互换（AUC 0.91，双向覆盖 0.83–0.97）；在 TALENT 基准上，表到先验的邻近度与 TabICL 相对性能无统计显著相关，说明“覆盖真实数据分布”并非 TabICL 泛化能力的主要驱动力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）的预训练语料主要有三类来源：基准库策展的表格（如 TabFM）、大规模网络抓取表格（如 T4/Tabula-8B）、以及从参数化生成先验采样的合成表格（如 TabPFN、TabICL）。预训练数据的质量与多样性被认为是 TFM 性能的关键，但这些语料之间在分布上如何关联、以及分布差异是否真的传导到下游性能，此前研究甚少。论文因此提出四个递进问题：RQ1 合成先验是否覆盖真实表格；RQ2 策展数据集是否覆盖网络抓取表格；RQ3 先验能否通过超参数优化以覆盖真实表格；RQ4 与先验的邻近度是否影响下游性能。

Method: （1）构建统一的表级/列级/列间相关性级聚合特征空间，并做特征集消融：Full（d=70，含列数）、Scalars（d=9）、Histograms（d=60）、Col. Hists（d=50）、Corr. Hists（d=50）；列的唯一值比 κ=‖C_j‖/|R|，κ<0.2 视为类别列。作者强调 RQ1–3 无需学习式嵌入（避免模型自举），仅在下游分析中使用 TabICL 内部表示。（2）判别器：以 XGBoost 在真实/合成表特征上训练二分类器，bootstrap（200 次）报告 AUC（0.5=不可区分，1.0=完全可分），作为先验“真实性”代理。（3）覆盖度：借鉴生成模型文献（Sajjadi、Kynkäänniemi、Naeem 等）的 k-NN 覆盖度量，特征归一化至 [0,1]，阈值 δ_0.95 取合成集内 k=5 平均 k-NN 距离的 95 分位；定义未覆盖比例 f_unc、Recall（P 被 Q 覆盖比例）与 Precision（Q 被 P 覆盖比例），并明确数值仅在相同特征/距离度量下可比，应视为上下界。（4）语料：T4（网络抓取，源自 TabLib/GitHub/CommonCrawl）、TabFM 的 384 个 Kaggle 策展数据集、TabICL 合成先验（唯一同时开源默认参数与生成代码的规范先验）。（5）先验优化：贝叶斯与遗传优化（以 AUC 为目标）、以 G=6 离散网格（条件参数裁剪，86k+ 组，6 节点×2 NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip 并行，<23 小时）、以及联合 AUC+覆盖损失的贝叶斯优化；先验超参 θ 控制 SCM 类型、树模型族、类别平衡、类别列生成概率，列数分布直接取自真实数据分布以缩小搜索空间。（6）下游分析：在 TALENT 基准表上计算每个表到先验的 Recall/Precision 与 k-NN 距离，并检验其与 TabICL 相对性能（相对基准均值/最大 AUC）的相关性，含 TabICL 列/行/拼接内部表示作为特征。

Result: 合成 vs 真实：ICL vs T4 判别器 AUC 0.9997±0.0001，Recall 仅 0.088（Precision 0.988）；ICL vs FM AUC 0.9972，Recall 0.160（Precision 0.978）；列级与相关性级特征 AUC 仍在 0.97–0.99，Recall 持续低于 50%。特征重要性显示直方图特征（尤其列数与分布偏度）最具判别力，中间分位区间合成列的取值系统性偏低、方差小。策展 vs 抓取：T4 vs FM AUC 0.9133±0.0237，双向覆盖高（Recall 0.975、Precision 0.830；其余特征集 Precision 0.88–0.90），单个特征贡献均不超过 6%，区分难度显著更高；说明两者在分布层面近乎可互换，但单表仍留有来源“指纹”（策展过滤与抓取噪声的痕迹）。优化：网格搜索最低 AUC 仍 >0.95，绝大多数配置与未优化先验无显著差异；top-5 配置在 1000 样本下 AUC 重回 0.9985–0.9989、Recall 0.063–0.125；贝叶斯优化 AUC≈0.995–0.997、Recall 0.194–0.218，均无实质改善。性能相关性：在 Full、Col. Hists、Corr. Hists 及 TabICL 内部表示（列/行/拼接）下，覆盖率与 k-NN 距离和 TabICL 相对 AUC 的相关系数均未达 p≤0.05 显著性（例如 Full 特征 Recall r=0.171、Precision r=0.084），即邻近先验与性能无清晰关系。

Conclusion: 合成先验（TabICL）仅覆盖真实表格空间的一个狭窄区域，且这一分布错配无法通过大规模超参数优化消除；策展与网络抓取语料在特征空间上分布上大体可互换，这解释了为何仅数百个策展数据集即可获得有竞争力的预训练效果；更有趣的是，合成数据与真实数据的分布差距在本文的多套特征（含 TabICL 自身内部表示）下并未在统计上转化为可检测的性能差异，说明“先验覆盖真实数据分布”并非 TabICL 泛化能力的主要驱动因素，其泛化更可能源于先验中任务结构的多样性（如 SCM 生成的判别任务形态）而非特征分布的精确匹配。作者指出结论受限于所用特征集的简洁性与仅一个开源先验，并建议社区开放先验参数与数据级代码以便扩展该分析，同时提醒 Recall/Precision 数值应作为上下界而非绝对分布刻画来解读。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models are pre-trained on one of three classes of corpus: curated datasets drawn from benchmark repositories, tables harvested at scale from the web, or synthetic tables sampled from a parametric generative prior. Despite the centrality of pre-training data to model performance, little is known about how these corpora relate to one another in distribution, and the impact this has on downstream performance. In this work we take three canonical, archetypal datasets used to train tabular foundation models; the T4 dataset represents web-scraped corpora, the TabFM dataset curated tables from Kaggle, and the TabICL dataset as the only well-used synthetic prior with publicly available parameters. We characterise each corpus using aggregate features over whole tables, columns and correlations, and compare them using discriminator AUCs and k-NN coverage metrics. We find that the TabICL synthetic prior occupies a narrow region of the space of real tables, that this mismatch cannot be closed by optimising prior hyper-parameters across more than 86 thousand configurations, and that curated and web-scraped corpora are broadly interchangeable on a distributional level in feature space. Surprisingly, the distributional gap between synthetic pre-training data and real tables has a clearly detectable effect on performance under neither feature-based proximity measures or TabICL's own internal representations, suggesting that coverage of the real-data distribution is not the primary driver of TabICL's generalisation.

</details>


### [204] [More Than Can Be Said: A Benchmark and Framework for Pre-Question Scientific Ideation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06345)
*Jie Yu,Song Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出InciteResearch框架，旨在将研究者隐性的研究摩擦显性化、可检查化。核心创新在于：五维画像提取隐性需求、苏格拉底式追问链分布式执行、假设违背与必要性验证机制。配合首个跨科学模式的隐性与显性研究辅助基准TF-Bench验证效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI研究智能体假设用户已具备清晰可操作的研究问题，无法处理人类研究中常见的状态——"隐性摩擦"（即问题形成前的不对齐感）。这种研究起点与当前系统的假设存在根本性矛盾。

Method: (1) 五维研究者画像提取：从模糊甚至领域无关的输入中锚定特定摩擦点，构建结构化状态表征；(2) 隐含假设违背机制：最大化可行性-新颖性乘积，强制执行7阶段因果推导追溯；(3) 方法必要性验证：检查所提方法是否为重构洞见的必要推论；(4) TF-Bench基准：区分领域相关与领域无关的灵感，覆盖四种科学模式。

Result: 在TF-Bench上显著超越基于提示的基线：新颖性从3.671提升至4.250，影响力从3.806提升至4.397。将生成的研究提案从"重组式创新"转变为"架构式洞察"。

Conclusion: AI研究智能体应从"自动化执行工具"升级为"思维延伸伙伴"，通过将隐性摩擦显性化、假设违背机制化、方法必要性验证系统化，推动研究提案从"重组式创新"转向"架构式洞察"。

核心贡献：(1) 提出多智能体协作框架InciteResearch，模拟苏格拉底式追问链；(2) 构建首个跨四种科学模式的隐性与显性研究辅助基准TF-Bench；(3) 验证了可行性-新颖性乘积最大化的有效性（新颖性↑15.7%，影响力↑15.5%）。

Abstract: AI research agents have shown strong potential in automating literature search and manuscript refinement, yet most assume a clear and actionable initial input, operating only after a research question has been made explicit. In contrast, human research often begins with tacit friction, a sense of misalignment before a question can be formed. We introduce InciteResearch, a multi-agent framework designed to make a researcher's implicit understanding explicit, inspectable, and actionable. InciteResearch decomposes the logical chain of Socratic questioning and distributes it across the entire pipeline that: (1) Elicits a structured five-dimensional researcher profile state anchored by specific friction points from vague, even domain-unrelated inputs; (2) Violates hidden assumptions by maximizing the feasibility-novelty product with enforcing a 7-stage causal derivation trace; and (3) check whether the proposed method is a Necessary consequence of the reframed insight. We further introduce TF-Bench, the first benchmark for tacit-to-explicit research assistance that distinguishes domain-related from domain-unrelated inspirations across four scientific modes. On TF-Bench, InciteResearch achieves leapfrogging gains over a prompt-based baseline (novelty/impact from 3.671/3.806 to 4.250/4.397), shifting generated proposals from recombination to architectural insight. Our work demonstrates that AI can serve as an extension of thinking itself, rather than merely automating downstream execution.

</details>


### [205] [Prediction and Empowerment: A Theory of Agency through Bridge Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06346)
*Richard Csaky*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文在确定性物理世界中研究部分可观测条件下的智能体问题，将感知和 actuation 建模为 agent 与环境之间的"桥接接口"，证明预测、压缩和 empowerment 之间存在分离，并探讨这对现代 AI 智能体设计和人机对齐的启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文旨在解决部分可观测环境下智能体理论的基础问题：在看似随机的确定性世界中（随机性源于初始条件、固定定律和外部噪声的不确定性），如何形式化理解预测、状态识别和控制能力之间的关系，并为人机对齐提供理论框架。

Method: 构建了一个统一的形式化框架：1) 将感知和 actuation 建模为 split between agent 控制参数和环境控制通道状态的桥接接口；2) 通过潜在微观状态上的先验和多对一的观测粗粒化，诱导出确定性 POMDP；3) 在此框架下进行理论证明；4) 进一步将框架特化为保信息量的比特串模型。

Result: 主要理论结果包括：1) 完美预测可通过识别目标相关的隐藏商空间或通过覆写控制使未来 action-determined 实现；2) 高 empowerment 本身不足以保证预测；3) 在可精炼接口和足够记忆下，动作条件的观测压缩过程可减少关于潜在商的后验不确定度；4) 比特串特化中，预测通过识别需要内部容量至少等于相关潜在熵，覆写控制需要终末端动作容量。

Conclusion: 对于现代 AI 智能体，设计原则应区分：隐藏状态识别、接口精炼、任务相关可控性和纯覆写/干扰控制。人机对齐部分是一个接口设计问题，涉及人类意图、智能体内部状态、外部工具和世界通道状态之间的桥接。论文以工作草稿形式发表，欢迎反馈。

Abstract: We study agency under partial observability in deterministic physical or simulated worlds, where apparent randomness arises from uncertainty over initial conditions, fixed law bits, and unrolled exogenous noise. We model sensing and actuation as bridge interfaces split between agent-controlled parameters and environment-controlled channel state, inducing a deterministic POMDP through a prior over latent microstates and many-to-one observation coarsening. Within this framework, we prove a separation between prediction, compression, and empowerment. Perfect prediction can be achieved either by identifying the hidden quotient relevant to the target family or by overwrite control that makes the future target action-determined; high empowerment alone is insufficient. Under refinable interfaces and sufficient memory, action-conditioned observation-compression progress reduces posterior uncertainty about the latent quotient, and when refinement requires steering world-side channel conditions, this creates target-conditioned interface empowerment. A bit-string specialization with a conserved information budget makes the resulting tradeoff explicit: prediction by identification requires internal capacity at least the relevant latent entropy, whereas overwrite control requires terminal action capacity over the controlled quotient. For modern AI agents, the results suggest a design principle rather than a theorem of inevitability: objectives should distinguish hidden-state identification, interface refinement, task-relevant controllability, and mere overwrite or distractor control. Human--AI alignment is partly an interface-design problem, where the relevant bridge is between human intent, agent internal state, external tools, and world-side channel conditions. This is a working draft: feedback and criticism is most welcome.

</details>


### [206] [Debiased Multimodal Personality Understanding through Dual Causal Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06371)
*Yangfu Zhu,Zitong Han,Nianwen Ning,Yuting Wei,Yuandong Wang,Hang Feng,Zhenzhou Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Multimodalpersonalityunderstandingplaysacriticalroleinhuman centered artificial intelligence. Previous work mainly focus on learn-ing rich multimodal representations for video personality under standing. However, they often suffer from potential harm caused by subject bias (e.g., observable age and unobservable mental states), as subjects originate from diverse demographic backgrounds. Learn ing such spurious associations between multimodal features and traits may lead to unfair personality understanding. In this work, weconstruct aStructural Causal Model (SCM)toanalyze theimpact of these biases from a causal perspective, and propose a novel Dual Causal Adjustment Network (DCAN) to mitigate the interference of subject attributes on personality understanding. Specifically, we design a Back-door Adjustment Causal Learning (BACL) module to block spurious correlations from observable demographic factors via a prototype-based confounder dictionary, and subsequently ap ply a Front-door Adjustment Causal Learning (FACL) module to ad dress latent and unobservable biases throughalearnedmediatordic tionary intervention, thereby achieving causal disentanglement of representations for deconfounded reasoning. Importantly, we con struct a Demographic-annotated Multimodal Student Personality (DMSP) dataset to support the analysis and discussion of fairness related factors. Extensive experiments on the benchmark dataset CFI-V2 and our DMSPdataset demonstrate that DCAN consistently improves prediction accuracy, reaching 92.11% and 92.90%, respec tively. Meanwhile, the improvementsinthefairnessmetricsofequal opportunity and demographic parity are 6.57% and 7.97% on CFI-V2, and 15.38% and 20.06% on the DMSP dataset. Our code and DMSP dataset are available at https://github.com/Sabrina-han/DCAN

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

### [207] [Rethinking Vacuity for OOD Detection in Evidential Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06382)
*Claire McNamara*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究揭示了Evidential Deep Learning中基于空隙(Uncertainty Mass)的OOD检测指标对类别数K的敏感性：当ID和OOD的K值不同时，即使模型预测完全不变，AUROC/AUPR也可能被人为夸大（最高达0.68），这是一个重要的评估伪影，在因果语言模型的MCQA任务中同样存在此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空隙(Uncertainty Mass)作为EDL中OOD检测的指标，其计算依赖于类别数K，但当ID和OOD的K值不同时，该指标可能产生人为夸大的检测性能，需要揭示这一评估 artifacts。

Method: 实验对比分析不同K值下AUROC/AUPR指标的变化；区分标准EDL和IB-EDL两种方法。

Result: 当K值差异仅为1时，AUROC最多相差0.318-0.360，AUPR最多相差0.613-0.683，证明基于空隙的指标对K值变化极度敏感，存在评估假象。

Conclusion: 建议在EDL中采用非基于空隙的指标或确保ID和OOD的K值相等；需要更清晰定义MCQA场景下的ID和OOD。

Abstract: Vacuity, or Uncertainty Mass (UM), is commonly used as a metric to evaluate Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL). It generally involves dividing the number of classes ($K$) by the total strength of belief ($S$) of the model's predictions, where $S$ is derived from summing the Dirichlet parameters. As such, UM is sensitive to the cardinality of $K$. In particular, it is unlikely in practice that there is a linear relationship between $K$ and $S$ as $K$ and $S$ increase due to the nature of EDL (suppressing incorrectly assigned evidence). As a result, when comparing In Distribution (ID) and OOD results, it is important that $K_{\mathrm{ID}}$ and $K_{\mathrm{OOD}}$ are equal; something that is not always ensured in practice. We provide an empirical demonstration of how results for AUROC and AUPR can substantially differ when class cardinality between ID and OOD differs by 1, with AUROC differing by as much as 0.318 and AUPR by 0.613 for standard EDL, and AUROC by 0.360 and AUPR by 0.683 for IB-EDL. More concretely, our findings isolate an evaluation artefact: when K differs between ID and OOD, AUROC/AUPR can be artificially inflated without any change in model predictions. We further discuss the evaluation of EDL over causal language models using Multiple-Choice Question-Answer (MCQA) datasets and argue for clearer definitions of ID and OOD in this context. Our primary contribution is an empirical and theoretical demonstration that vacuity-based OOD detection in EDL-fine-tuned LLMs is highly sensitive to uncontrolled differences in evaluated class cardinality.

</details>


### [208] [Automated alignment is harder than you think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06390)
*Aleksandr Bowkis,Marie Davidsen Buhl,Jacob Pfau,Geoffrey Irving*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: A leading proposal for aligning artificial superintelligence (ASI) is to use AI agents to automate an increasing fraction of alignment research as capabilities improve. We argue that, even when research agents are not scheming to deliberately sabotage alignment work, this plan could produce compelling but catastrophically misleading safety assessments resulting in the unintentional deployment of misaligned AI. This could happen because alignment research involves many hard-to-supervise fuzzy tasks (tasks without clear evaluation criteria, for which human judgement is systematically flawed). Consequently, research outputs will contain systematic, undetected errors, and even correct outputs could be incorrectly aggregated into overconfident safety assessments. This problem is likely to be worse for automated alignment research than for human-generated alignment research for several reasons: 1) optimisation pressure means agent-generated mistakes are concentrated among those that human reviewers are least likely to catch; 2) agents are likely to produce errors that do not resemble human mistakes; 3) AI-generated alignment solutions may involve arguments humans cannot evaluate; and 4) shared weights, data and training processes may make AI outputs more correlated than human equivalents. Therefore, agents must be trained to reliably perform hard-to-supervise fuzzy tasks. Generalisation and scalable oversight are the leading candidates for achieving this but both face novel challenges in the context of automated alignment.

### [209] [Knowledge Graphs, the Missing Link in Agentic AI-based Formal Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06434)
*Vaisakh Naduvodi Viswambharan,Keerthan Kopparam Radhakrishna,Deepak Narayan Gadde,Aman Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled workflows that generate SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) from natural-language specifications, with the potential to accelerate Formal Verification (FV). However, high-quality assertion synthesis remains challenging because specifications are often ambiguous or incomplete and critical micro-architectural details reside in the Register Transfer Level (RTL). Many existing approaches treat the specification and RTL as loosely structured text, which weakens specification-to-RTL grounding and leads to semantic mismatches and frequent syntax failures during formal parsing and elaboration. This work addresses these limitations with a verification-centric Knowledge Graph (KG) constructed from structured Intermediate Representations (IRs) extracted from the specification, RTL, and formal-tool feedback, including syntax diagnostics, Counterexamples (CEXs), and coverage reports. The KG links requirements, design hierarchy, signals, assumptions, and properties to provide traceable, design-grounded context for generation. A multi-agent workflow queries and updates this KG to generate SVAs and to drive three refinement loops: syntax repair guided by tool diagnostics, CEX-guided correction using trace links, and coverage-directed property augmentation. Evaluation across seven benchmark designs indicates that KG-based context retrieval improves specification-to-RTL grounding and consistently produces compilable SVAs with low syntax-repair overhead. The approach achieves formal coverage ranging from 78.5% to 99.4%, though convergence exhibits design dependence with complex temporal and arithmetic reasoning remaining challenging for current LLM capabilities.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled workflows that generate SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) from natural-language specifications, with the potential to accelerate Formal Verification (FV). However, high-quality assertion synthesis remains challenging because specifications are often ambiguous or incomplete and critical micro-architectural details reside in the Register Transfer Level (RTL). Many existing approaches treat the specification and RTL as loosely structured text, which weakens specification-to-RTL grounding and leads to semantic mismatches and frequent syntax failures during formal parsing and elaboration. This work addresses these limitations with a verification-centric Knowledge Graph (KG) constructed from structured Intermediate Representations (IRs) extracted from the specification, RTL, and formal-tool feedback, including syntax diagnostics, Counterexamples (CEXs), and coverage reports. ### [210] [SCRuB: Social Concept Reasoning under Rubric-Based Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06444)
*Jamelle Watson-Daniels,Himaghna Bhattacharjee,Skyler Wang,Brandon Handoko,Antonio Li,Anaelia Ovalle,Mahesh Pasupuleti,Candace Ross,Vidya Sarma,Arjun Subramonian,Karen Ullrich,Will van der Vaart,Yijing Xin,Maximilian Nickel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出了SCRuB框架用于评估LLM的社会概念推理能力，通过4711个评估提示和博士级专家标注数据，发现前沿模型在五维度批判性思维评估中全面超越人类专家，并首次证明社会概念推理的单回合考试式评估已达到饱和上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理能力研究多聚焦数学或技术任务，而较少关注社会概念推理能力——即对塑造社会规范、文化和制度的抽象概念的理解与推理。这一能力对于现代模型作为社会智能体运行至关重要，但目前缺乏系统性的评估方法。

Method: 研究团队开发了SCRuB框架，包含三个阶段：①从权威资源构建提示；②由专家和模型生成响应；③通过五维度批判性思维评分 rubric 进行比较评估。团队引入Panel of Disciplinary Perspectives集成方法，并经独立专家评审验证其泛化能力，最终形成SCRuBEval（4711个评估提示）、SCRuBAnnotations（300个专家撰写响应和150个专家比较判断，共45名博士级学者参与）。

Result: 前沿模型在全部五个rubric维度上持续优于人类专家。在1170次成对比较中，专家评审在80.8%的判断中将模型响应排在首位，74.4%的情况下整体偏好模型响应。

Conclusion: 该研究首次通过专家基准证明了社会概念推理的评估饱和现象，表明在单回合考试式评估中，模型与人类专家均已达到能力上限，为后续关于社会概念推理的研究提供了评估框架和数据资源。

Abstract: While many studies of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning capabilities emphasize mathematical or technical tasks, few address reasoning about social concepts: the abstract ideas shaping social norms, culture, and institutions. This understudied capability is essential for modern models acting as social agents, yet no systematic evaluation methodology targets it. We introduce SCRuB (Social Concept Reasoning under Rubric-Based Evaluation), a framework designed for this setting of task indeterminacy. Our goal is to measure the degree to which a model reasons about social concepts with the depth and critical rigor of a human expert. SCRuB proceeds in three phases: prompt construction from established sources, response generation by experts and models, and comparative evaluation using a five-dimensional critical thinking rubric. To enable generalization of the pipeline, we introduce a Panel of Disciplinary Perspectives ensemble validated against independent expert judges. We release SCRuBEval (n=4,711 evaluation prompts) and SCRuBAnnotations (300 expert-authored responses and 150 expert comparative judgments from 45 PhD-level scholars). Our results show that frontier models consistently outperform human experts across all five rubric dimensions. Across 1,170 pairwise comparisons, expert judges ranked a model response first in 80.8% of judgments and preferred model responses overall 74.4% of the time. Ultimately, this study provides the first expert-grounded demonstration of evaluation saturation for social concept reasoning: the single-turn exam-style format has reached its ceiling for models and humans alike.

</details>


### [211] [PrefixGuard: From LLM-Agent Traces to Online Failure-Warning Monitors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06455)
*Xinmiao Huang,Jinwei Hu,Rajarshi Roy,Changshun Wu,Yi Dong,Xiaowei Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PrefixGuard是一个轨迹到监控器的框架，通过离线StepView归纳和监督式监控训练，在异构轨迹上实现轻量级前缀风险监控。在四个基准上AUPRC达0.533-0.900，比原始文本对照平均提升+0.137，优于LLM评判器。提供可观测性上限和DFA提取诊断，证明强排序能力不等于部署实用性，为前缀预警的实际干预转化提供诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体现在执行长时间、工具使用类任务，但最终结果检查来得太晚无法干预。需要在线预警机制，但面临挑战：(1) 手编事件模式脆弱且难以适应异构轨迹；(2) 部署时使用LLM评判成本高昂；(3) 异构轨迹上需要轻量级前缀监控。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：(1) 离线StepView归纳步骤，从原始轨迹样本中诱导确定性类型化步骤适配器；(2) 监督式监控训练，从终端结果中学习事件抽象和前缀风险评分器。监控器通过观察前缀学习事件抽象，通过终端反馈学习风险评分，实现轻量级在线警告而无需部署时LLM判断。

Result: 四个基准测试中，最强PrefixGuard监控器分别达到0.900/0.710/0.533/0.557 AUPRC。使用各表征最强后端时，平均比原始文本对照提升+0.137 AUPRC。LLM评判器在同一前缀预警协议下表现显著较弱。推导出基于分数的AUPRC可观测性上限，区分监控错误与缺乏证据的失败。有限状态审计中，DFA提取在WebArena（29状态）和τ²-Bench（20状态）紧凑，但在SkillsBench（151状态）和TerminalBench（187状态）膨胀。

Conclusion: PrefixGuard定位为实用的监控合成方案，提供明确诊断能力以判断前缀预警是否可转化为可操作干预。DFA提取在简单任务上紧凑（WebArena 29状态、τ²-Bench 20状态），但在复杂任务上膨胀（SkillsBench 151状态、TerminalBench 187状态）。关键发现：强排序能力不等于部署实用性——WebArena虽然排名表现好但无法支持低误报预警，而τ²-Bench和TerminalBench保留更多可操作的早期预警。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents now execute long, tool-using tasks where final outcome checks can arrive too late for intervention. Online warning requires lightweight prefix monitors over heterogeneous traces, but hand-authored event schemas are brittle and deployment-time LLM judging is costly. We introduce PrefixGuard, a trace-to-monitor framework with an offline StepView induction step followed by supervised monitor training. StepView induces deterministic typed-step adapters from raw trace samples, and the monitor learns an event abstraction and prefix-risk scorer from terminal outcomes. Across WebArena, $τ^2$-Bench, SkillsBench, and TerminalBench, the strongest PrefixGuard monitors reach 0.900/0.710/0.533/0.557 AUPRC. Using the strongest backend within each representation, they improve over raw-text controls by an average of +0.137 AUPRC. LLM judges remain substantially weaker under the same prefix-warning protocol. We also derive an observability ceiling on score-based area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) that separates monitor error from failures lacking evidence in the observed prefix. For finite-state audit, post-hoc deterministic finite automaton (DFA) extraction remains compact on WebArena and $τ^2$-Bench (29 and 20 states) but expands to 151 and 187 states on SkillsBench and TerminalBench. Finally, first-alert diagnostics show that strong ranking does not imply deployment utility: WebArena ranks well yet fails to support low-false-alarm alerts, whereas $τ^2$-Bench and TerminalBench retain more actionable early alerts. Together, these results position PrefixGuard as a practical monitor-synthesis recipe with explicit diagnostics for when prefix warnings translate into actionable interventions.

</details>


### [212] [Beyond Task Success: Measuring Workflow Fidelity in LLM-Based Agentic Payment Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06457)
*Donghao Huang,Joon Kiat Chua,Zhaoxia Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ASR（Agentic Success Rate）指标，用于评估LLM多智能体系统的轨迹级执行保真度。该指标将性能分解为Transition Recall和Transition Precision，可发现TSR和HF1无法检测到的工作流偏差（如确认检查点的跳过）。在18个LLM和90,000个任务实例上的实验表明，该诊断驱动的优化可带来高达+93.8百分点的TSR提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指标（TSR和HF1）仅关注最终结果或无序路由决策，无法捕捉智能体执行序列中的关键偏差。在受监管的支付领域，这种缺陷可能导致合规问题，但现有评估体系无法有效识别。

Method: 提出ASR指标，对比观察到的与预期的智能体执行序列，在转换级别进行匹配。该指标进一步分解为Transition Recall（召回率）和Transition Precision（精确率）。实验覆盖18个LLM和90,000个支付任务实例。

Result: ASR揭示了10/18模型系统性跳过支付结账时的确认检查点（TSR和HF1均无法检测），8个模型完美执行检查点。GPT-4.1存在隐藏工作流捷径但TSR/HF1完美，GPT-5.2实现完美ASR。基于ASR诊断的提示优化和确定性路由守卫可显著提升性能。

Conclusion: 轨迹级评估在受监管领域至关重要。ASR能够发现传统指标遗漏的关键执行偏差，诊断驱动的优化策略可带来实质性性能提升（高达+93.8个百分点TSR）。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for payment workflows, yet prevailing metrics, Task Success Rate (TSR) and Agent Handoff F1-Score (HF1), capture only final outcomes or unordered routing decisions. We introduce the Agentic Success Rate (ASR), a trajectory-fidelity metric that compares observed and expected agent execution sequences at the transition level, decomposing performance into Transition Recall and Transition Precision. Applied to the Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Payments (HMASP) across 18 LLMs and 90,000 task instances, ASR reveals that 10 of 18 models systematically skip a confirmation checkpoint during payment checkout, a deviation invisible to both TSR and HF1, while 8 models enforce the checkpoint perfectly. Notably, GPT-4.1 exhibits hidden workflow shortcuts despite achieving perfect TSR and HF1, while GPT-5.2 achieves perfect ASR. Prompt refinements and deterministic routing guards guided by ASR diagnostics yield substantial TSR improvements, with gains up to +93.8 percentage points for previously struggling models, demonstrating that trajectory-level evaluation is essential in regulated domains.

</details>


### [213] [Probabilistic Dating of Historical Manuscripts via Evidential Deep Regression on Visual Script Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06475)
*Ranjith Chodavarapu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: We introduce a probabilistic approach for dating historical manuscript pages from visual features alone. Instead of aggregating centuries into classes as is standard in the previous literature, we pose dating as an evidential deep regression problem over a continuous year axis, allowing our neural network to output a full predictive distribution with decomposed aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass. Our architecture combines an EfficientNet-B2 backbone with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG) output head trained with a joint negative-log-likelihood and evidence-regularization objective. On the DIVA-HisDB benchmark (150 pages, 3 medieval codices, 151,936 patches), our model scores a test MAE of 5.4 years, well below the 50-year century-label supervision granularity, with 93\% of patches within 5 years and 97\% within 10 years. Our approach achieves \textbf{PICP=92.6\%}, the best calibration among all compared methods, in a single forward pass, outperforming MC Dropout (PICP=88.2\%, 50 passes) and Deep Ensembles (PICP=79.7\%, 5 models) at $5\times$ lower inference cost. Uncertainty decomposition shows aleatoric uncertainty is a strong predictor of dating error (Spearman $ρ=0.729$), and a selective prediction about the most certain 20\% of patches can provide \textbf{0.5 years MAE}. We show that predicted uncertainty increases as image degradation worsens, spatial decomposition maps explain which script regions cause aleatoric uncertainty, and page-level aggregation reduces MAE to 4.5 years with $ρ=0.905$ between uncertainty and page-level error.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

### [214] [ReasonSTL: Bridging Natural Language and Signal Temporal Logic via Tool-Augmented Process-Rewarded Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06483)
*Bowen Ye,Zhijian Li,Junyue Huang,Junkai Ma,Xiang Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReasonSTL是一个工具增强框架，使用本地开源语言模型将自然语言翻译为信号时序逻辑(STL)，通过显式推理、确定性工具调用和结构化公式构建解决隐私和成本问题，并在4B参数模型上实现最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STL是用于指定时空需求的形式化语言，但用户通常使用自然语言表达需求。现有方案存在问题：手动规范需要时序逻辑专业知识且无法扩展；商业LLM API存在高Token成本和隐私泄露风险，不适合工业部署。

Method: ReasonSTL采用工具增强框架，将翻译过程分解为三个阶段：显式推理、确定性工具调用、结构化公式构建。引入过程奖励训练(process-rewarded training)监督工具使用轨迹和最终公式质量。同时提出STL-Bench基准测试，支持双语、具备计算感知能力，并基于真实世界信号。

Result: 4B参数模型经过ReasonSTL训练后，在自动指标和人类评估中均达到最优性能。

Conclusion: ReasonSTL为形式化规范编写提供了透明、低成本、隐私保护的替代方案，可有效替代商业LLM API进行自然语言到STL的翻译。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) is an expressive formal language for specifying spatio-temporal requirements over real-valued, real-time signals. It has been widely used for the verification and synthesis of autonomous systems and cyber-physical systems. In practice, however, users often express their requirements in natural language rather than in structured STL formulas, making natural-language-to-STL translation a critical yet challenging task. Manual specification requires temporal-logic expertise and cannot scale, while prompting commercial LLM APIs incurs substantial token costs and may expose sensitive system requirements to third-party services, raising privacy concerns for industrial deployment. To address these challenges, we present \textsc{ReasonSTL}, a tool-augmented framework that adapts local open-source language models for natural-language-to-STL generation. \textsc{ReasonSTL} decomposes the translation process into explicit reasoning, deterministic tool calls, and structured formula construction. We further introduce process-rewarded training to supervise both tool-use trajectories and final formulas, together with \textsc{STL-Bench}, a bilingual, computation-aware benchmark grounded in real-world signals. Experiments show that a 4B model trained with \textsc{ReasonSTL} achieves state-of-the-art performance in both automatic metrics and human evaluations, demonstrating that \textsc{ReasonSTL} provides a transparent, low-cost, and privacy-preserving alternative for formal specification drafting.

</details>


### [215] [From Token Lists to Graph Motifs: Weisfeiler-Lehman Analysis of Sparse Autoencoder Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06494)
*Ruben Fernandez-Boullon,Pablo Magariños-Docampo,Javier Perez-Robles*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Sparse autoencoders分析新方法：用token共现图表示每个SAE特征，通过WL-style图核计算相似性进行聚类，揭示了decoder权重和token频率方法无法捕捉的结构关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing SAE feature analysis relies exclusively on top-activating token lists or decoder weight vectors, leaving the higher-order co-occurrence structure shared across features largely unexamined.

Method: Model each SAE feature as a token co-occurrence graph (nodes=tokens near strong activations, edges=context co-occurrence), then use a custom WL-style frequency-binned graph kernel to compute similarity for clustering.

Result: Graph-based clustering recovers motif families (punctuation patterns, language/script clusters, code templates) not captured by decoder cosine similarity. While token-histogram baseline has higher purity, the graph view provides complementary structural insights. Results are stable across hyperparameters and random seeds.

Conclusion: Graph-structured representation provides complementary insights to existing SAE analysis methods, revealing structural relationships between features that token-frequency and decoder-weight views alone cannot capture. This graph-based approach surfaces higher-order co-occurrence patterns useful for mechanistic interpretability research.

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become central to mechanistic interpretability, decomposing transformer activations into monosemantic features. Yet existing analyses characterise features almost exclusively through top-activating token lists or decoder weight vectors, leaving the higher-order co-occurrence structure shared across features largely unexamined. We introduce a graph-structured representation in which each SAE feature is modelled as a token co-occurrence graph: nodes are the tokens most frequent near strong activations, and edges connect pairs that co-occur within local context windows. A custom WL-style, frequency-binned graph kernel then provides a similarity measure over this structural space. Applied as a proof of concept to features from a large SAE trained on GPT-2 Small and probed with a synthetic mixed-domain corpus, our clustering recovers heuristic motif families (punctuation-heavy patterns, language and script clusters, and code-like templates) that are not recovered by clustering on decoder cosine similarity. A token-histogram baseline achieves higher overall purity, so the contribution of the graph view is complementary rather than dominant: it surfaces structural relationships that token-frequency and decoder-weight views alone do not capture. Cluster assignments are stable across graph-construction hyperparameters and random seeds.

</details>


### [216] [Process Matters more than Output for Distinguishing Humans from Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06524)
*Milena Rmus,Mathew D. Hardy,Thomas L. Griffiths,Mayank Agrawal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Reliable human-machine discrimination is becoming increasingly important as large language models and autonomous agents are deployed in online settings. Existing approaches evaluate whether a system can produce behavior or responses indistinguishable from those of a human, following the emphasis on outputs as a criterion for intelligence proposed by Alan Turing. Cognitive science offers an alternative perspective: evaluating the process by which behavior is produced. To test whether cognitive processes can reliably distinguish humans from machines, we introduce CogCAPTCHA30, a battery of 30 cognitive tasks designed to elicit diagnostic process-level features even when task performance is matched. Across the battery, process-level features provide stronger discriminative signal than performance metrics alone, reliably distinguishing humans from agents even under output matching (mean process-feature classifier AUC = 0.88). To evaluate agentic process differences, we compare off-the-shelf frontier agents (Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro), Centaur (a language model fine-tuned on 10.7M human decisions), and two task-specific fine-tuning approaches applied to Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: action-level supervised fine-tuning (A-SFT) and process-level fine-tuning (P-SFT), which directly optimizes process features. Broad fine-tuning on human decisions improves human-like task processes relative to off-the-shelf agents, while task-specific process-level supervision further improves behavioral mimicry. However, this advantage diminishes under cross-task transfer when supervised process targets do not naturally generalize across tasks. Explicit process-level supervision can improve human behavioral mimicry, but only if appropriate task-specific process representations are available, highlighting process specification as a bottleneck for achieving human-like cognitive processes in machines.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.
