### [235] [DisastRAG: A Multi-Source Disaster Information Integration and Access System Based on Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05210)
*Bo Li,Zhitong Chen,Kai Yin,Junwei Ma,Yiming Xiao,Ali Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: DisastRAG 是一个面向灾害场景的信息集成与访问系统，将大语言模型与"文档检索 + 结构化数据库查询 + 网络回退"三条访问路径结合，并集成查询理解、策略路由、响应生成与上下文记忆。实验显示检索增强相比无检索基线可带来 12–23 个百分点的多选提升、开放问答关键点覆盖率最高提升 10.5 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害管理需要快速获取分散在三类信息源中的信息：结构化业务记录（数据库表格）、非结构化机构文档（报告、预案、手册）和动态外部来源（网页）。但现有灾害信息系统与 RAG 框架大多围绕单一访问路径（仅文档检索）构建，难以应对异构、强时效、依赖上下文的查询需求，例如"某地当前受灾人口分布"需查结构化记录，"最新预警通报"需外部网页。因此需要一个能根据查询类型自动路由到合适访问路径的统一系统。

Method: 多路径（multi-path）架构，包含：(1) 在精选灾害语料库上的文档检索（RAG）；(2) 对关系型灾害记录的结构化访问；(3) 语料库外的外部网页回退。整体流程涵盖查询理解、策略路由（决定走哪条路径及检索策略）、响应生成，以及统一系统内的上下文记忆机制。文档检索部分用四个开源 LLM、多种检索配置（候选池大小、纯向量检索 vs 混合检索、重排序深度等）在多项选择与开放式灾害信息任务上评测，并对结构化访问与网页回退做案例研究。

Result: 检索增强一致优于无检索基线：多项选择任务提升 12–23 个百分点，开放式任务关键点覆盖率最高提升 10.5 个百分点。分析发现：更大的候选池对较弱模型帮助更大；更强的模型对检索噪声更敏感。混合检索在开放式覆盖率上表现最佳，而纯向量检索与较浅的重排序更倾向于有利于封闭式事实型选择题。案例研究表明结构化访问与网页回退使框架能力超出"纯文档 RAG"的限制。

Conclusion: DisastRAG 证明了将大语言模型与结构化、非结构化、情境化灾害信息的检索式访问相结合是可行的，其核心价值在于多路径架构与策略路由机制：检索策略应与模型能力相匹配（弱模型需更大候选池以补偿召回，强模型需更严格的重排序与噪声抑制），不同任务类型（事实型 vs 覆盖型）需差异化检索策略（向量/浅层重排 vs 混合检索）。该系统通过结构化查询与网页回退弥补了静态语料的时效性与覆盖度局限，为灾害信息管理系统提供了一个统一、自适应的访问范式。

Abstract: Effective disaster management requires rapid access to information distributed across structured operational records, unstructured institutional documents, and dynamic external sources. However, most existing disaster information systems and retrieval-augmented generation frameworks remain organized around a single access pathway, limiting their ability to support heterogeneous, time-sensitive, and context-dependent information needs. This study presents DisastRAG, a disaster-aware information integration and access system that combines large language models with retrieval-augmented access to structured, unstructured, and contextual disaster information. The framework is built around a multi-path architecture that supports document retrieval over a curated hazard corpus, structured access over relational disaster records, and external web fallback for out-of-corpus requests, while also incorporating query understanding, strategy routing, response generation, and contextual memory within a unified system. We evaluated the document retrieval performance using four open-source large language models across multiple retrieval configurations on multiple-choice and open-ended disaster information tasks. Retrieval augmentation consistently improves performance over no-retrieval baselines, yielding multiple-choice gains of 12-23 percentage points and open-ended keypoint coverage gains of up to 10.5 percentage points. Results show that larger candidate pools are most helpful for weaker models, while stronger models are more sensitive to retrieval noise. Hybrid retrieval performs best for open-ended coverage, whereas vector retrieval and shallower reranking more often favor closed-form factual selection. Case studies further show that structured access and web fallback extend the framework beyond document-only RAG.

</details>


### [236] [Dynamic Graph with Similarity-Aware Attention Graph Neural Network for Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05238)
*Aadarsh Senapati,Neha Kujur,Vivek Yelleti*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 DG-SA-GNN：在训练过程中周期性重建四张用户相似度图（Cosine、Jaccard、Discount PCC、IP·IJ），由四个并行 UserGNN 分别编码，再经 Graph Transformer 跨视图融合与 CrossAttention 做用户-物品对齐，并采用 mini-batch BPR + 70% 硬负采样训练。在 MovieLens100K 上取得 Recall@20=0.1622（NDCG@20=0.0654），Recall 略优于 LightGCN（0.1580/0.0663），但 NDCG 略低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GNN 推荐方法（如 LightGCN）仅在静态的用户-物品二部图上做邻域聚合，缺少显式的用户-用户关系建模；且相似度图一旦构建便在全训练期固定，随嵌入表示空间演化，固定拓扑会与学到的表示失配，传播过期/噪声的相似信号并限制模型上限。同时，全图训练与均匀随机负采样带来可扩展性差、负样本过易的问题。论文由此提出三个研究问题：动态重建多相似度图是否优于静态图；四种相似度函数在动态图设定下各自贡献如何；mini-batch 硬负采样对收敛速度与最终精度的影响。

Method: 1) 动态图构建模块：对交互矩阵 R 分别用 Cosine（评分向量角度对齐）、Jaccard（评分集合重叠）、Discount PCC（Pearson 相关系数按共评数 n/(n+2) 折扣、负值截断为 0）、IP·IJ（Discount PCC × Jaccard 混合）计算用户对相似度，各取 top-K=30 近邻建边，权重经温度 0.2（缩放因子 5）的 softmax 锐化；邻接矩阵做对称归一化 D^{-1/2}AD^{-1/2}。重建调度为 epoch 0、1–9 每 3 epoch、10 之后每 5 epoch（{0,3,6,9,10,15,20}），并用 multiprocessing 4 进程并行计算四种相似度，使开销约等于单图成本（朴素复杂度 O(4|U|^2)）。2) 四个并行 UserGNN：各 2 层图卷积，逐层用带自环的加权聚合 h_new=αh_u+Σ w_uv h_v，再做残差 h←h+ReLU(Wh_new) 与 L2 归一化。3) Graph Transformer：四组 |U|×d 嵌入堆叠为 4×|U|×d 序列，2 层多头自注意力（4 头，FFN=2d，dropout 0.1）后对视图维均值池化得统一用户嵌入 U。4) CrossAttention：物品嵌入先经 I'=L2Norm(I+R^T U) 注入用户上下文；每用户取与自身嵌入内积得分 top-50 物品，以用户嵌入为 query、top-50 物品为 key/value 做多头注意力，再 u*_u=L2Norm(u_u+W_c z_u) 精炼用户表示。5) 训练：mini-batch（1024 用户）+ BPR 损失 + L2（λ=1e-4），负样本 70% 从 top-200 非交互高分物品中采、30% 均匀采（候选池每 T 步刷新），Adam lr=0.001，梯度裁剪 max-norm 5，训练 20 epoch。超参 d=128，K=30，CrossAttention 4 头。基线为 3 层、d=64 的 LightGCN（同一 BPR 目标），评测用 Recall@20 与 NDCG@20，leave-one-out 划分。

Result: Table III：DG-SA-GNN (Discount PCC) Recall@20=0.1622、NDCG@20=0.0654；LightGCN 0.1580/0.0663；IP·IJ 0.1580/0.0618；Jaccard 0.1516/0.0597；Cosine 0.1347/0.0553。结论：Recall@20 上 Discount PCC 变体优于 LightGCN（约 +2.7% 相对），但 NDCG@20 仍略低于 LightGCN（0.0654 vs 0.0663），说明排序精度未超越基线；作者归因于 LightGCN 直接在用户-物品二部图上传播可捕获全局物品共现信号，而 DG-SA-GNN 仅依赖用户侧相似度图。Cosine 明显最弱，Jaccard 次之，表明仅有评分幅度或仅有集合重叠都不足以刻画显式评分数据中的相似性，共评数可靠性折扣是关键因素。数据集规模小（943 用户/1682 物品/稀疏度 93.7%），结果绝对值提升有限，缺乏统计显著性检验与更多数据集/基线对比。

Conclusion: DG-SA-GNN 验证了「动态重建多相似度图 + 注意力融合 + 硬负采样」组合在显式反馈推荐上的可行性，Recall 略优于 LightGCN，说明显式评分数据上基于相关系数（并按共评数折扣）的用户相似度最有价值。主要局限是相似度计算的二次复杂度 O(|U|^2×|I|)，仅靠 4 进程并行难以支撑 Yelp2018 等大规模场景，需借助 FAISS/LSH 等近似近邻；此外未联合建模用户相似度图与用户-物品二部图导致排序精度受限。后续工作方向：FAISS 近似图构建、二部图与相似图联合建模、可学习的自适应相似度函数选择、以及扩展到显式建模交互动态的时序推荐。

Abstract: Recommender systems are essential components of modern online platforms which presents personalized content in various domain. The traditional collaborative filtering methods depends on static user-item interaction graphs and a limited subset of similarity measures which fail to capture the changing nature of preferences of an individual. Recent graph neural network (GNN) based approaches focus on user-item bipartite graphs which do not use explicit user-user relational modelling and dynamic graph evolution during training. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Dynamic Graph SimilarityAware Attention Graph Neural Network (DG-SA-GNN) framework that integrates dynamic user similarity graph construction with multi-similarity propagation and attention-based aggregation. The proposed architecture constructs four parallel user similarity graphs using Cosine, Jaccard, Discounted Pearson Correlation Coefficient (Discount PCC), and IPIJ similarity functions, each processed by a dedicated UserGNN module. A Graph Transformer fuses the four graph views, and a CrossAttention module refines user embeddings through interaction with item embeddings. Crucially, the graphs are reconstructed at scheduled epochs during training, enabling the model to adapt to the learned embedding space constituting the dynamic graph component. Mini-batch training with hard negative sampling improves scalability and convergence. Experiments on the MovieLens100K benchmark demonstrate that DG-SA-GNN achieves a Recall@20 of 0.162 and NDCG@20 of 0.065 which is better than the LightGCN baseline in recall. The results validate that dynamic multi-similarity graph construction coupled with attention-based fusion which produce recommendation performance

</details>


### [237] [Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05242)
*Zhuofeng Li,Haoxiang Zhang,Cong Wei,Pan Lu,Ping Nie,Yi Lu,Yuyang Bai,Shangbin Feng,Hangxiao Zhu,Ming Zhong,Yuyu Zhang,Jianwen Xie,Yejin Choi,James Zou,Jiawei Han,Wenhu Chen,Jimmy Lin,Dongfu Jiang,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出直接语料库交互（DCI）范式，让语言智能体直接使用终端工具搜索原始语料，绕过传统检索接口的限制，在多个基准上超越主流检索方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检索系统的固定相似度接口（单一top-k检索步骤）成为智能体搜索的瓶颈：难以实现精确词汇约束、稀疏线索合取、本地上下文检查和多步假设精化，且早期过滤的证据无法被下游推理恢复。

Method: 提出直接语料库交互（DCI），让智能体使用通用终端工具（如grep、文件读取、shell命令、轻量级脚本）直接搜索原始语料库，无需任何嵌入模型、向量索引或检索API。

Result: 该简单方案在多个BRIGHT和BEIR数据集上显著优于强基线（稀疏、密集和重排序方法），在BrowseComp-Plus和多跳QA上获得强准确率，无需依赖任何传统语义检索器。

Conclusion: DCI表明，随着语言智能体的增强，检索质量不仅取决于推理能力，还取决于模型与语料库交互的界面解析能力，为智能体搜索开辟了更广阔的界面设计空间。

Abstract: Modern retrieval systems, whether lexical or semantic, expose a corpus through a fixed similarity interface that compresses access into a single top-k retrieval step before reasoning. This abstraction is efficient, but for agentic search, it becomes a bottleneck: exact lexical constraints, sparse clue conjunctions, local context checks, and multi-step hypothesis refinement are difficult to implement by calling a conventional off-the-shelf retriever, and evidence filtered out early cannot be recovered by stronger downstream reasoning. Agentic tasks further exacerbate this limitation because they require agents to orchestrate multiple steps, including discovering intermediate entities, combining weak clues, and revising the plan after observing partial evidence. To tackle the limitation, we study direct corpus interaction (DCI), where an agent searches the raw corpus directly with general-purpose terminal tools (e.g., grep, file reads, shell commands, lightweight scripts), without any embedding model, vector index, or retrieval API. This approach requires no offline indexing and adapts naturally to evolving local corpora. Across IR benchmarks and end-to-end agentic search tasks, this simple setup substantially outperforms strong sparse, dense, and reranking baselines on several BRIGHT and BEIR datasets, and attains strong accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus and multi-hop QA without relying on any conventional semantic retriever. Our results indicate that as language agents become stronger, retrieval quality depends not only on reasoning ability but also on the resolution of the interface through which the model interacts with the corpus, with which DCI opens a broader interface-design space for agentic search.

</details>


### [238] [Towards Dependable Retrieval-Augmented Generation Using Factual Confidence Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05244)
*Florian Geissler,Francesco Carella,Laura Fieback,Jakob Spiegelberg*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个与架构无关的两阶段 RAG 事实性置信度预测框架：先用保形预测（conformal prediction）对检索分数做校准与阈值化，只保留"有统计保证来自正确源文档"的 chunk；再用基于注意力 lookback ratio 的逻辑回归分类器判断生成答案与所给上下文是否一致（幻觉检测）。该方法可为"认证型 RAG"提供分阶段的可信度度量，但保形预测的统计保证依赖样本可交换性假设，在有限检索深度下并不普遍成立，需用 m1/m2 诊断指标预先评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 已成为工业界给大语言模型注入领域知识的标准做法，但其缺乏事实性保证：相似度检索返回的上下文可能是无关信息，反而误导生成器产生幻觉。在安全攸关的 agentic AI 场景中，RAG 作为子程序被调用，其可靠性直接决定最终结果，因此需要一种与具体实现无关、可应用于任意 RAG 实例的"认证协议"，为检索质量与生成事实性分别提供可量化的置信度。已有工作多依赖启发式附加模块、闭卷/开卷幻觉检测或人工自验证，缺乏统计意义上的保证，也未区分检索环节与生成环节各自的失效来源。

Method: 第一阶段（检索置信度）：将检索器视为单类分类器 f̂，检索分数 s 为其归一化输出。在校准集上用 RougeL 相似度 h(c,r) 与文档归属 d(c)=d(r) 构造 chunk 级布尔真值标签 Y_cal；先用非正确 chunk 相似度的 β-分位数得到 s_thres（NQ 取 β=0.99，Ragbench 取 β=0）；再用调整置信率 δ=⌈(n+1)(1-α)/n⌉ 计算正确 chunk 分数的 δ-分位数 q̂，推理时以 s≥1-q̂ 判定 chunk 可信，在样本可交换性下给出 1-α ≤ P(y=true | s≥1-q̂) ≤ 1-α+1/(n+1) 的保证。定义两个诊断指标：m1 = 是否至少存在一个可信 chunk（k>0），m2 = k/K。第二阶段（生成置信度）：提取 LLM 生成过程中对上下文的注意力张量 α^{l,h}_{t,p}，对各语义块（preamble、chunk c_i、问题、已生成输出）求时间步平均注意力 A^{l,h}_t(x)，构造 chunk-wise lookback ratio：LR^{l,h}(c_i) = K·A(c_i)/(A(context)+A(output))，再对生成步求时间平均并拼接为固定长度 L×H×K 的特征向量 v（不足的 chunk 位置补零），用单层逻辑回归分类器输出事实性分数 p∈[0,1]，以 GPT3.5 作为 LLM judge 给出的答案一致性 γ_ac 作为训练标签（⌊p⌉=γ_ac 判为正确），用 AUROC 评估。实验设置：NQ 与 Ragbench 12 个子数据集，每集最多 10K 样本对半分为校准/测试；Llama-3-8B-Instruct 生成，text-ada-embedding-002 嵌入、chunk 512、BM25（Llama-index）检索并可选 stsb-roberta-base 交叉编码器重排；K=10、α=0.1；分类器 3:2 划分训练/验证，并按规模将数据集聚为 4 组做组内/跨组交叉验证，比较 chunk-wise LR (CW) 与含 preamble/问题的全上下文 LR (FC)。

Result: （1）共形化检索本身即可提升答案质量，最高约 +6%（如 RB-expertqa），但重排序会因错误 chunk 被挤出 top-K 而显得过于乐观。（2）除 RB-tatqa、RB-finqa 等金融类数据集外，多数数据集的平均 m1（81%–98%）接近 1-α=0.9 的理论预期；finqa/tatqa 上 BM25 几乎无法给出有意义的分数（m1≈m2），表明正确 chunk 缺失会破坏校准集与测试集的可交换性，构成 CP 实践中的关键陷阱。（3）chunk 过滤效果与 m1 强相关：m1 高时过滤提升答案一致性（如 RB-expertqa +6%），m1 低时反而下降约 10%（如 finqa、tatqa、emanual），说明 m1/m2 可作为"检索器—数据集—检索深度"组合适用性的判据。（4）幻觉检测：组内测试 AUROC 最高达 77%（CW LR）/82%（FC LR），跨组下降最多 16%；FC 优于 CW 最多 12%，但分析表明 FC 的优势来自系统提示与问题上的注意力，即分类器学到的是与事实性无关的领域先验（如"金融类问题更容易出错"），因此可能产生误导，作者主张在可靠 RAG 中仍应采用排除非检索注意力的 CW LR，以获得更扎实的接地性。

Conclusion: 本文给出了一套分阶段度量 RAG 事实置信度的完整工作流：检索阶段用保形预测提供 chunk 来源的统计保证，并用可信 chunk 集合基数（m1/m2）作为诊断指标来挑选检索器—数据集—深度组合，因为可交换性在有限 top-K 下并非先验成立，且检索性能差还会反过来劣化生成质量；生成阶段用基于 chunk-wise lookback ratio 的分类器在不引入提示词/问题等非检索注意力的前提下实现较高比例的幻觉检测。作者认为这为面向安全攸关系统的"认证型 RAG"（certified RAG）提供了可行路径，后续可系统研究系统提示与问题域对模型注意力及幻觉检测的具体影响。

Abstract: Incorporating specific knowledge into large language models via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widespread technique that fuels many of today's industry AI applications. A fundamental problem is to assess if the context retrieved by some similarity search provides indeed supporting facts, or instead misguides the generator with irrelevant information. It is critical to associate meaningful confidence measures about the factuality of the retrieval process with the generated answers. We present a new, two-staged approach to predict fact faithfulness of the output of retrieval-augmented generations. First, we employ conformal prediction to select only those retrieved chunks who have a high chance to come from the correct source. This approach in itself can improve answer quality by up to 6% in some of the studied datasets, however, the associated statistical guarantees do not hold generally, since the assumption of sample exchangeability depends on the retriever setup. We present diagnostic metrics to assess whether a setup is suitable. Second, we quantify confidence in the consistency of a generated final answer with a given retrieved context, using an attention-based factuality classifier. This approach can detect inconsistent answers with a chance of up to 77%. Our work helps to establish a novel type of certified RAG systems for a broad range of natural language industry applications.

</details>


### [239] [TriAlignGR: Triangular Multitask Alignment with Multimodal Deep Interest Mining for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05249)
*Yangchen Zeng,Hao Peng,Rongfeng Guo,Zhenyu Yu,Zhiyuan Hu,Jinze Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TriAlignGR 是一个面向生成式推荐（GR）的统一多任务多模态框架，针对现有 Semantic ID 流水线中「SID 内容退化（SCD）」与「SID 语义不透明（SSO）」两大问题，通过三阶段流水线实现：CMSA 用 VLM 生成图像描述 + gme-Qwen2-VL 多模态嵌入把视觉语义直接编码进 SID；MDIM 用 LLM CoT 挖掘潜在用户兴趣标签丰富 SID 语义后再做 RQ-VAE 离散化；TMT 用统一的单一自回归损失联合训练 8 个生成任务（含 VisDesc→SID、VisDesc→Title 两个新视觉语义任务），补全 SID-文本-图像三角对齐。在 Beauty/Sports/Instruments 三个 Amazon 数据集上相对最强基线 SIDReasoner 取得 HR@5 最高 +13.6%、NDCG@5 最高 +15.5% 的相对提升，碰撞率由 5.1% 降至 3.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）依赖将物品表示为离散 token 序列（Semantic ID, SID）以适配 LLM 的自回归生成，但现有 SID 构造流程存在两个尚未被充分研究的基础缺陷：(1) SID 内容退化（SID Content Degradation, SCD）——级联编码与残差量化会丢弃关键的多模态语义与兴趣层级语义；(2) SID 语义不透明（SID Semantic Opacity, SSO）——模型只是机械地自回归生成 SID 序列，并未真正理解其含义，导致幻觉与泛化差。已有工作（如 RQ-VAE、RQ-KMeans、端到端可微量化、SIDReasoner 的六个纯文本多任务）最多只做文本-SID 对齐，视觉语义与潜在用户兴趣完全未被利用；且传统多任务架构（MMoE、PLE）需要任务专属塔与复杂损失加权，缺乏优雅的 GR 多任务方案。

Method: 问题形式化：给定用户交互历史 S_u = [i_1,...,i_T]，预测下一物品；每物品含标题 t_i、描述 d_i 与图像 v_i。流程分三阶段。

Stage 1 多模态语义预处理：
- CMSA（Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment）双通路：(a) Qwen2.5-VL 以 Prompt_align 将图像转为文本描述 v_i^text，与标题/描述拼接为统一多模态文本 t̃_i = Concat(t_i, d_i, v_i^text)；(b) 用多模态嵌入模型 gme-Qwen2-VL 联合编码「富化文本 + 兴趣 + 原图」得 e_i^final = f_mm-emb(Concat(t̃_i, z_i), v_i)，使 SID 天然携带多模态语义（外观、配色、美学风格）而非纯文本。文本截断 512 token，MDIM 兴趣标签置于描述之前。
- MDIM（Multimodal Deep Interest Mining）：以结构化 CoT 提示驱动 LLM（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）从 t̃_i 中做表层属性分析→上下文意图推断→可解释兴趣标签综合，抽取 2–4 个兴趣标签（如从降噪耳机得到「专注导向的工作风格」），克服浅层文本属性无法揭示潜在购买动机的缺陷。
- 量化：采用标准 RQ-VAE（3 层，码本 4096/2048/1024，嵌入维度 1024），逐层残差最小化分配码字，得到 SID s_i = (s_i^(1),...,s_i^(H))；每个 SID token 作为独立原子 token 加入 LLM 词表。

Stage 2 三角多任务微调（TMT）：8 个任务统一为对话式文本生成，共享单一自回归交叉熵损失（无任务专属头、无损失加权，每 batch 均匀采样一个任务）：类别 I 双向翻译 T1 Title→SID、T2 SID→Title（语义锚定）；类别 II 序列推荐 T3 SID→SID、T4 Title→SID、T5 SID→Title、T6 Title→Title（笛卡尔积，跨空间桥接）；类别 III 视觉语义对齐（新增）T7 VisDesc→SID、T8 VisDesc→Title——因 SID 本身由多模态嵌入构造，图像信息已蒸馏进 SID token，故称"视觉语义"任务，完成 SID-Text-Image 三角闭合。

Stage 3 推理：基于 SID 或标题序列自回归生成下一物品的 SID（beam size 20）。

全部 VLM 描述、兴趣标签、多模态嵌入与 SID 目标离线缓存，保证训练稳定与可复现。

Result: 主结果（3 个 Amazon 数据集，3 次随机种子平均，标准差 <0.003）：TriAlignGR 在所有指标上全面超越传统序列模型（SASRec、BERT4Rec、S³-Rec 等）、生成/LLM 基线（TIGER、LC-Rec、HSTU、MiniOneRec、BIGRec、D³、S-DPO、LETTER、ETEGRec）与 SIDReasoner，相对提升 12.2%–15.5%；Beauty HR@5 = 0.0708（+13.6%）、NDCG@5 = 0.0453（+13.0%），Sports HR@5 = 0.0468（+13.6%），Instruments NDCG@5 = 0.0411（+15.5%）。对 MiniOneRec（同 backbone/协议/tokenizer）HR@5 提升 15.7%–17.6%。

消融（Beauty/Sports/Instruments HR@5 降幅）：w/o MDIM −10.3%/−9.2%/−9.6%（最大贡献）；w/o 翻译任务 T1,T2 ≈ −9.4%/−7.7%/−7.9%；w/o CMSA −7.6%/−6.8%/−6.6%；w/o 视觉语义任务 T7,T8 −6.6%/−5.8%/−5.6%；单任务变体降幅最大 −19.2%/−17.1%/−17.4%。组件排序跨数据集稳定：MDIM > 翻译 > CMSA > 视觉语义。

SID 构造与任务设计解耦（表4）：(a) 原始 SID + 6 文本任务 → (b) CMSA+MDIM SID + 6 任务（+8.0%/+7.0%/+7.7% HR@5）→ (c) 完整 8 任务（再 +7.1%/+6.1%/+5.9%），两因素贡献相当。任务组合分析（Beauty）：任务数从 1 增至 8 单调提升（0.0572→0.0708），T1 单项加入贡献最大（+5.1%），第 7、8 个任务分别再带来 +2.6% 与 +4.4%。

SID 诊断（Beauty）：碰撞率 5.1%→3.1%，唯一 SID 比例 94.9%→96.9%，码本利用率 71.8%→78.4%，前缀熵 5.42→5.78。SCD/SSO 验证：类别探针（2 层 MLP）准确率 62.1%→78.3%（+16.2%）；SID→标题重建 BLEU-4 0.412→0.623（+50.7%）；属性召回 45.3%→64.7%（+19.4%）；RQ-VAE 重建余弦相似度在 H=3 时 0.758→0.903（+19.1%），且各量化深度一致更优（CMSA 平均 +5.5%，MDIM 再 +3.7%）。对照实验：关键词扩展、LLM 摘要/改写、朴素标题拼接等均不及完整模型（HR@5 低 6.0%–9.9%），说明增益来自语义特异性而非更长输入。t-SNE 显示 TriAlignGR 语义布局聚类更清晰、类别分离更好。

Conclusion: 论文正式提出并验证了 SID 内容退化（SCD）与 SID 语义不透明（SSO）两个诊断，指出「量化前做多模态语义富化 + 量化后做三角对齐」是一条有原则的路径：MDIM（LLM 兴趣挖掘）、CMSA（VLM 跨模态对齐 + 直接编码图像的多模态嵌入）、TMT（统一自回归损失下的八任务三角微调）三者协同，在三个 Amazon 基准上一致优于 SOTA，消融与对照实验证实各组件均必要，且增益源于语义特异性。实验同时表明视觉-文本-标题三角形对齐可产生更具判别性、语义更扎实的离散物品表示（更低碰撞率、更高码本利用率、更好重建保真度），为可解释、高效的生成式推荐系统提供了可行方向。

Abstract: We introduce TriAlignGR, a unified multitask-multimodal framework for generative recommendation that establishes two-stage multimodal semantic propagation: (i) encoding visual semantics directly into SIDs via multimodal embeddings, and (ii) enabling the model to decode these semantics through visual description tasks. Existing Semantic ID (SID) pipelines suffer from two fundamental but underexplored problems: \textbf{SID Content Degradation (SCD)}, where cascaded encoding and residual quantization discard critical multimodal and interest-level semantics; and \textbf{SID Semantic Opacity (SSO)}, where models autoregressively generate SID sequences without truly comprehending their underlying meaning, leading to hallucination and poor generalization. Prior work addresses at most text-SID alignment, leaving visual semantics and latent user interests entirely unexploited. TriAlignGR resolves both problems through three tightly integrated components: (1)~\textbf{Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment (CMSA)} integrates visual content into SID construction through both VLM-generated textual descriptions and a multimodal embedding model that directly encodes image features alongside text, ensuring that SIDs inherently carry multimodal semantics; (2)~\textbf{Multimodal Deep Interest Mining (MDIM)} leverages LLM Chain-of-Thought reasoning to extract latent user intents (\eg ``productivity-focused lifestyle'' from noise-canceling headphones) beyond surface attributes, enriching SID semantics before discretization; and (3)~\textbf{Triangular Multitask (TMT)} jointly trains on eight complementary generation tasks under a single autoregressive loss -- including two novel visual-semantic tasks (VisDesc$\to$SID, VisDesc$\to$Title) that map VLM-generated image descriptions to SIDs and titles, completing the SID-Text-Image triangle -- without requiring task-specific towers or complex loss weighting.

</details>


### [240] [Decision-aware User Simulation Agent for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05250)
*Yuan-Chi Li,Li-Chi Chen,Sung-Yi Wu,Yu-Che Tsai,Shou-De Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Hesitator——一个理论驱动（theory-grounded）的用户模拟框架，用于评估对话推荐系统（CRS）。其核心是可插拔的「决策模块（Decision Module）」：由「选择模块（Selection Module）」模拟人类从启发式到补偿式的两阶段商品评估（EBA 过滤 + WADD 效用），由「犹豫模块（Hesitation Module）」用四维选择过载向量与 Chernev et al. (2015) 元分析回归系数校准出接受概率，并经「响应模块（Response Module）」生成自然语言回复。实验表明该模块能纠正现有 LLM 模拟器在过载下成功率不降反升的失真行为，并复现倒 U 型信息过载等心理学经济学规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话推荐系统（CRS）的自动化评估越来越依赖 LLM 用户模拟器，但其关键要求是能建模人类决策过程。现有框架（PersonaLens、UserSimCRS、RecUserSim 等）虽能刻画 persona 与多样人群，却普遍未显式建模认知决策过程：LLM 继承了底座模型过强的信息处理能力，能从容消化大量非结构化信息，因而几乎不表现出真实消费者常见的犹豫与决策推迟（choice overload 下的 deferral），导致模拟出的购买/接受概率过高，进而系统性高估 CRS 效果，掩盖了「意图—行为落差」（intention–behavior friction）这一真实转化率的关键摩擦。因此需要显式引入认知约束的决策建模。

Method: 框架结构：全局状态 G=(P,S)，persona 含开放度 φO、挑剔度 φK、偏好不确定性 φU；scenario 含需求 σN、预算 σB、时间压力 σT；对话历史 H 逐轮累积。决策模块为条件式串行流水线。①选择模块：当 |I|>θ 时用 Elimination by Aspects 做非补偿性硬约束过滤得到候选集 C，当 |C|≤θ(θ=3) 时用 Weighted Additive 计算效用 u_i=w^T a_i（权重 w 由历史评论抽取），取 s_u=max u_i 与 s_i=argmax u_i，与挑剔度相关阈值 τ(φK)=γ+αφK(0.6+0.1φK) 比较，低于阈值直接拒绝。②犹豫模块三阶段：状态感知——LLM 对五个叶变量（v_{s,d} 优势性、v_{s,a} 可比性、v_{t,a} 属性数、v_{t,f} 格式复杂度，以及组合因子）输出 1–3 级强度，v_u 与 v_{t,p} 由 persona/scenario 常量确定；元分析校准——用 Chernev et al. (2015) 覆盖 99 个实验观测的回归系数 β（v_a=0.41, v_s=0.55, v_t=0.37, v_u=0.32）与各因子的效应量范围 δ，经插值函数 f_interp 得 d_total=βᵀf_interp(v,δ)，并将原本被吸收到截距的 assortment 效应重参数化为显式项；概率映射——用反正弦比例变换 P_accept=sin²(arcsin√P_base − d_total/2)，P_base=0.5，d_total 截断于 [−π/2, π/2]，采样 ε≤P_accept 才购买，否则 defer 并给出理由。③响应模块：Action Selection（LLM 选 accept/追问/澄清/defer）+ Response Synthesis 生成话语。实验：Amazon Reviews 2023 的 Electronics 与 Video Games 两域，每配置 N=40 会话、最多 T=20 轮；销售代理用 CSI 框架 + gpt-oss-20b，Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B + HNSW 向量检索（top-K=50），Basic 与 Persuasive 两种模式；基线为 PersonaLens、UserSimCRS、RecUserSim；指标为成功率 SR、五维成对主观对话质量（Gemini 3 Flash 评审）、幻觉率 H̄_R。

Result: 1）失真行为被纠正：无决策模块时各基线在 Low→Severe 过载下成功率持平甚至上升（Electronics：PersonaLens 60.0→70.0，UserSimCRS 35.0→55.0；Video Games：PersonaLens 达 75.0，UserSimCRS 保持 70.0）；加入 +DM 后一致下降（Electronics：RecUserSim+DM 67.5→22.5，PersonaLens+DM 90.0→35.0，UserSimCRS+DM 65.0→50.0；Video Games：RecUserSim+DM 70.0→12.5，PersonaLens+DM 77.5→22.5），Wilcoxon 符号秩检验显著（*p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001）。2）复现心理学经济学规律：总信息量呈倒 U 型（Jacoby et al. 1974），偏好不确定性越低峰后下降越平缓（专家更抗过载）；属性信息增加先升后趋平（Fasolo et al. 2007）；大 assortments 在高不确定性下降低成功率（决策冲突/选择过载，Tversky & Shafir 1992）。3）主观质量：Hesitator 在整体质量、自然度、清晰度、适应性、相关性、真实感上均优于三个基线。4）幻觉率不升反略降（PersonaLens 0.1290→0.1088，UserSimCRS 0.2548→0.2268，RecUserSim 0.0584→0.0624；Hesitator 0.0969 仍高于 RecUserSim，后者含专门的响应精修阶段）。5）消融：以普通打分 prompt 替换选择模块后，属性数增加带来的正向效应不再稳定出现，偏离人类行为，说明结构化效用计算是必要条件。6）鲁棒性：在 Persuasive 模式与不同 LLM 底座下趋势一致。

Conclusion: Hesitator 通过显式建模认知约束下的选择过载与决策推迟，为 CRS 评估提供了更可信的用户模拟基准：它同时复现效用驱动的选择与过载驱动的推迟，并在过载条件下持续修正现有模拟器的失真行为而保持对话质量与可信度。局限包括：仅在 Amazon Reviews 2023 两个商品域上验证；犹豫机制依赖消费心理学元分析参数，缺少领域自适应的行为数据校准；persona 在整场会话中视为静态，未建模对话中的偏好漂移；选择模块仅适用于属性驱动型购物，审美/情感/探索型场景需替代策略。作者亦指出可替换为其他选择策略与动态偏好建模作为未来工作。

Abstract: Conversational recommender systems (CRS) increasingly rely on user simulators for automated evaluation of sales agents. A key requirement for such simulators is the ability to model human decision-making. However, most existing simulation frameworks do not explicitly model the internal decision process, and LLM-based simulators often exhibit unrealistically strong information-processing capabilities, rarely exhibit the hesitation or decision deferral commonly observed in real consumer behavior, resulting in overly high acceptance probabilities. To address this limitation, we propose Hesitator, a theory-grounded user simulation framework that explicitly models human decision-making under choice overload. The framework introduces a modular Decision Module that separates utility-based item selection from overload-aware commitment decisions. Experiments across multiple user simulation frameworks, domains, sales modes, and LLM backbones show that integrating our module consistently mitigates unrealistic behaviors under increasing overload conditions. Furthermore, Hesitator reproduces established behavioral patterns from psychological economics, demonstrating its ability to model human decision behavior.

</details>


### [241] [EnterpriseRAG-Bench: A RAG Benchmark for Company Internal Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05253)
*Yuhong Sun,Joachim Rahmfeld,Chris Weaver,Roshan Desai,Wenxi Huang,Mark H. Butler*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文发布了EnterpriseRAG-Bench，一个用于评估企业级检索增强生成系统的基准数据集，包含约50万份跨9种企业数据源的文档和500道测试不同检索与推理能力的问题，并提供了可定制的生成框架和开源代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG数据集和基准主要针对网页或公开来源，缺乏能够真实反映企业内部知识特点的数据集。与此同时，初创公司、企业和研究人员正越来越多地开发针对私有数据进行操作的AI Agent，因此迫切需要一个反映真实企业场景的RAG评估基准。

Method: 研究者构建了一个包含约50万份文档的企业语料库，涵盖9种企业数据源类型（Slack、Gmail、Linear、Google Drive、HubSpot、Fireflies、GitHub、Jira、Confluence），并设计了500道问题，涵盖10种不同类别的检索和推理能力测试。语料库具有跨文档一致性（基于共享项目、人员和计划），并添加了真实噪声（错放文档、近重复、冲突信息）。同时提供了可定制的生成框架。

Result: 发布了EnterpriseRAG-Bench数据集，包含约50万份企业文档、500道问题和评估工具。

Conclusion: 该数据集、代码、评估工具和排行榜均已开源，为研究人员和从业者提供了评估企业级RAG系统的标准化基准。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the standard approach for grounding large language models in information that was not available during training. While existing datasets and benchmarks focus on web or other public sources, there is still no widely adopted dataset that realistically reflects the nature of company-internal knowledge. Meanwhile, startups, enterprises, and researchers are increasingly developing AI Agents designed to operate over exactly this kind of proprietary data. To close this gap, we release a synthetic enterprise corpus, its generation framework, and a leaderboard.
  We present EnterpriseRAG-Bench, a dataset consisting of approximately 500,000 documents spanning nine enterprise source types (Slack, Gmail, Linear, Google Drive, HubSpot, Fireflies, GitHub, Jira, and Confluence) and 500 questions across ten categories that test distinct retrieval and reasoning capabilities. The corpus is generated with cross-document coherence (grounded in shared projects, people, and initiatives) and augmented with realistic noise such as misfiled documents, near-duplicates, and conflicting information. The question set ranges from simple single-document lookups to multi-document reasoning, constrained retrieval, conflict resolution, and recognizing when information is absent. The generation framework lets teams generate variants tailored to their own industry, scale, and source mix. The dataset, code, evaluation harness, and leaderboard are available at https://github.com/onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench.

</details>


### [242] [Career-Aware Resume Tailoring via Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Provenance Tracking: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05257)
*Kumar Abhinav*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了Resume Tailor系统，通过维护长期职业数据库并使用多源检索增强生成（RAG）来改进简历定制。该系统在9个职位描述上的试点评估表明，当候选人在同一职业类别有相关经历时，职业数据库可使ATS匹配分数平均提升7.8分；但当缺乏领域重叠时，分数反而下降8.0分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI辅助简历定制系统仅基于单份简历，无法有效利用候选人的完整职业历史，且难以区分用户原始内容与AI生成内容，导致信息遗漏和幻觉问题。

Method: 系统采用12节点LangGraph管道架构，实现：1）混合语义-词法置信度评分；2）溯源感知的回退生成机制；3）反幻觉防护栏；4）条件审查循环。通过多源RAG从历史简历和结构化职业档案中检索并组装职位相关内容。

Result: 试点评估显示：同一职业类别的6个JD中，启用职业库使ATS分数平均提升7.8分；缺乏领域专业知识覆盖的2个JD中分数下降8.0分；部分重叠角色提升2分。

Conclusion: 纵向检索在存在相关经历时可有效改善简历定制效果，但当领域重叠较弱时需要置信度门控检索机制。系统架构中的反幻觉防护栏和溯源机制对于区分生成内容与原始内容至关重要。

Abstract: AI-assisted resume tailoring systems commonly operate on a single uploaded resume, which limits their ability to recover relevant experience omitted from the current draft and makes it difficult for users to distinguish grounded edits from model-generated suggestions. This paper presents Resume Tailor, an agentic resume-tailoring system that maintains a longitudinal career vault in a vector database and uses multi-source retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to assemble job-specific resume content from historical resumes and structured career records. The system is implemented as a 12-node LangGraph pipeline with typed state management, hybrid semantic-lexical confidence scoring, provenance-aware fallback generation, anti-hallucination guardrails, and a conditional review loop. We report a pilot evaluation on nine job descriptions (JDs) across software engineering, data analytics, and business analysis roles using a single candidate's career history. For six JDs where the candidate held at least one prior role in the same occupational category, enabling the career vault improved Applicant Tracking System (ATS)-style fit scores by an average of 7.8 points. For two JDs requiring domain-specific expertise absent from the vault, scores decreased by an average of 8.0 points. One partially overlapping role showed a modest gain of 2 points. These results suggest that longitudinal retrieval can improve resume tailoring when relevant prior experience exists, while also highlighting the need for confidence-gated retrieval when domain overlap is weak.

</details>


### [243] [Effective Knowledge Transfer for Multi-Task Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05730)
*Guohao Cai,Jun Yuan,Zhenhua Dong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文针对推荐系统中CVR建模面临的转化数据稀疏问题，提出EKTM多任务知识迁移方法，通过路由器-发射器架构实现跨任务知识共享与迁移。在基准数据集和商业平台线上实验中均验证了该方法的有效性，并成功完成工业级部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转化率（CVR）是衡量平台有效性的关键指标，但用户转化行为数据稀疏有限，严重制约了排序模型的训练效果。同时推荐系统中存在多个相关的CVR任务，暗示跨任务知识迁移的潜在价值。

Method: 提出基于路由-传输的知识迁移框架：路由器模块（Router Module）整合并分发跨任务知识；发射器模块（Transmitter Module）将知识从路由器转换到各CVR任务；同时设计增强模块确保迁移知识真正服务于原任务学习。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上验证， EKTM 优于现有最先进的基线方法。线上A/B测试在大规模商业平台实现eCPM提升3.93%，算法已全量部署于平台两个主要流量场景。

Conclusion: EKTM算法已在商业平台完成部署，在两个主要流量场景中应用，线上A/B测试实现eCPM提升3.93%，证明了其在工业级大规模场景中的有效性。

Abstract: The conversion rate (CVR) is a crucial metric for evaluating the effectiveness of platforms, as it quantifies the alignment of content with audience preferences. However, the limited nature of customers' conversion actions presents a significant challenge for training ranking models effectively. In this paper, we propose an Effective Knowledge Transfer method for Multi-task Recommendation Models (EKTM). This method enables the ranking model to learn from diverse user behaviors, thereby enhancing performance through the transfer of knowledge across distinct yet related tasks. Each specific CVR task can directly benefit from the insights provided by other tasks. To achieve this, we first introduce a router module that integrates and disseminates knowledge across tasks. Subsequently, each CVR task is equipped with a transmitter module that facilitates the transformation of knowledge from the router. Additionally, we propose an enhanced module to ensure that the transferred knowledge benefit the original task learning. Extensive experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches. Online A/B testing on a commercial platform has validated the effectiveness of the EKTM algorithm in large-scale industrial settings, resulting in a 3.93% uplift in effective Cost Per Mille (eCPM). The algorithm has since been fully deployed across two of the platform's main-traffic scenarios.

</details>


### [244] [Beyond Long Tail POIs: Transition-Centered Generalization for Human Mobility Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05771)
*Dingyang Lyu,Zhengjia Xu,Jey Han Lau,Jianzhong Qi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: This paper identifies a new problem in human mobility prediction called transition-level long-tail generalization, where source-destination transitions are sparse or missing in training data. The proposed RECAP framework addresses this by reconstructing long-tail transitions using multi-hop transitivity and revisit evidence, combined with warm-transition holdout training. Evaluation demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements, especially on tail transitions.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Previous work focused on long-tail POIs (POIs with few visit records), but the authors found that many predictions fail even for popular POIs. The underlying cause is transition-level sparsity: the source-destination transition appears rarely or never in the training set. This reveals that the core bottleneck is transition-level long-tail generalization, not just POI-level long-tail.

Method: 1) Reconstruct long-tail transitions from two signals: (a) multi-hop transitivity in global transition graph, (b) revisit evidence from user's historical trajectory; 2) Use warm-transition holdout training to discourage memorization of frequent transitions and encourage generalization from transferable signals.

Result: Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that RECAP consistently improves prediction accuracy, with clear gains on tail transitions.

Conclusion: RECAP provides a novel solution for transition-level long-tail generalization by reconstructing long-tail transitions from multi-hop transitivity and revisit evidence, with warm-transition holdout training to prevent memorization. This approach can improve prediction accuracy on multiple real-world datasets, particularly on tail transitions.

Abstract: Human mobility prediction forecasts a user's next Point of Interest (POI) from historical trajectories, supporting applications from recommendation to urban planning. Recent studies have recognized the problem with long-tail POIs in human mobility prediction, which are POIs with few visit records, making new visits to such POIs difficult to predict. Our analysis shows that many predictions fail even for visits to popular POIs. The underlying cause is often transition-level sparsity: the corresponding source-destination transition appears rarely, or never appears, in the training set. We therefore argue that a core bottleneck in human mobility prediction lies in transition-level long-tail generalization. We formulate this problem as compositional generalization and propose a tRansition rEconstruction framework for Compositional generAlization in next-POI prediction (RECAP). RECAP reconstructs long-tail transitions from two generalizable signals: multi-hop transitivity in the global transition graph and revisit evidence from a user's historical trajectory. It further uses warm-transition holdout training to discourage memorization of frequent transitions and encourage generalization from transferable signals. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that RECAP consistently improves prediction accuracy, with clear gains on tail transitions.

</details>


### [245] [Unified Value Alignment for Generative Recommendation in Industrial Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05803)
*Xinxun Zhang,Yuling Xiong,Jiale Zhou,Zhengkai Guo,Zhennan Pang,Junbang Huo,Jingwen Wang,Xuyang Sun,Enming Zhang,Jiaguang Jin,Changping Wang,Yi Li,Jun Zhang,Xiao Yan,Jiawei Jiang,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出UniVA框架，将生成式推荐(GR)应用于工业广告场景，通过价值对齐解决传统GR语义中心化的局限。核心贡献包括：价值感知SID分词器、融合排序的解码器、以及价值引导的个性化束搜索，在微信视频号广告平台实现离线Hit Rate@100提升37.04%，在线GMV提升1.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐(GR)在工业广告中面临挑战：需同时优化用户兴趣和商业价值，但现有GR管道仍以语义为中心，难以在分词、解码和在线服务各环节对齐价值信号。

Method: 提出三阶段方案：1) Commercial SID分词器将价值相关属性注入SID构建；2) Generation-as-Ranking SID解码器结合监督学习与eCPM感知强化学习联合优化；3) 价值引导的个性化束搜索复用排序logits作为在线价值导向，并使用个性化前缀树约束解码路径。

Result: 离线实验：Hit Rate@100提升37.04%；在线A/B测试：GMV提升1.5%。

Conclusion: UniVA成功将生成式推荐扩展至工业广告场景，通过统一的价值对齐框架在用户兴趣与商业价值间取得平衡，验证了GR在广告推荐中的应用可行性。

Abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) reformulates recommendation as a next-token generation problem and has shown promise in industrial applications. However, extending GR to industrial advertising is non-trivial because the system must optimize not only user interest but also commercial value. Existing GR pipelines remain largely semantics-centric, making it difficult to align value signals across tokenization, decoding, and online serving. To address this issue, we propose UniVA, a Unified Value Alignment framework for advertising recommendation. We first introduce a Commercial SID tokenizer that injects value-related attributes into SID construction, yielding value-discriminative item representations. We then develop a Generation-as-Ranking SID Decoder jointly optimized by supervised learning and eCPM-aware reinforcement learning, which fuses value scores into next-item SID generation to perform generation and ranking in one decoding process. Finally, we design a value-guided personalized beam search that reuses generation-as-ranking logits as online value guidance and applies a personalized trie tree to constrain decoding to request-valid SID paths. Experiments on the Tencent WeChat Channels advertising platform show that UniVA achieves a 37.04\% improvement in offline Hit Rate@100 over the baseline and a 1.5\% GMV lift in online A/B tests.

</details>


### [246] [Bridging Passive and Active: Enhancing Conversation Starter Recommendation via Active Expression Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05855)
*Yiqing Wu,Haoming Li,Guanyu Jiang,Jiahao Liang,Yongchun Zhu,Jingwu Chen,Feng Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出PA-Bridge框架，利用用户主动输入的"自由意志"查询打破传统会话推荐系统的"回音壁"困境。通过对抗式分布对齐器解决主动查询与被动推荐间的分布偏移问题，并借助语义离散器实现大规模popularity debiasing。在线实验表明该方法显著提升了功能渗透率和用户活跃度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统会话推荐系统依赖"曝光-点击"闭环反馈机制，在数据稀疏场景下陷入"回音壁"困境，导致推荐结果偏向流行但通用的话题，无法捕捉开放世界中动态多变的会话搜索意图。系统需要突破这一反馈循环来提升推荐多样性。

Method: 提出PA-Bridge框架，包含两个核心模块：(1)对抗式分布对齐器(Adversarial Distribution Aligner)，用于弥合被动推荐 starters 与主动用户表达之间的分布差异；(2)语义离散器(Semantic Discretizer)，将开放文本转换为可处理的语义单元，从而实现大规模工业流式训练中的 popularity debiasing 算法部署。

Result: 在线A/B测试显示，PA-Bridge显著提升功能渗透率0.54%，同时增加用户活跃天数，验证了该方法在工业级应用中的有效性。

Conclusion: PA-Bridge通过对抗式分布对齐和语义离散化技术，成功打破了传统曝光-点击反馈循环的"回音壁"效应，显著提升了工业场景下的功能渗透率和用户活跃天数。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-driven conversational search is shifting information retrieval from reactive keyword matching to proactive, open-ended dialogues. In this context, Conversation Starters are widely deployed to provide personalized query recommendations that help users initiate dialogues. Conventionally, recommending these starters relies on a closed "exposure-click" loop. Yet, this feedback loop mechanism traps the system in an echo chamber where, compounded by data sparsity, it fails to capture the dynamic nature of conversational search intents shaped by the open world. As a result, the system skews towards popular but generic suggestions.In this work, we uncover an untapped paradigm shift to shatter this harmful feedback loop: harnessing user "free will" through active user expressions. Unlike traditional recommendations, conversational search empowers users to bypass menus entirely through manually typed queries. The open-world intents in active queries hold the key to breaking this loop. However, incorporating them is non-trivial: (1) there exists an inherent distribution shift between active queries and formulated starters. (2) Furthermore, the "non-ID-able" nature of open text renders traditional item-based popularity statistics ineffective for large-scale industrial streaming training. To this end, we propose Passive-Active Bridge (PA-Bridge), a novel framework that employs an adversarial distribution aligner to bridge the distributional gap between passively recommended starters and active expressions. Moreover, we introduce a semantic discretizer to enable the deployment of popularity debiasing algorithms. Online A/B tests on our platform, demonstrate that PA-Bridge significantly boosts the Feature Penetration Rate by 0.54% and User Active Days

</details>


### [247] [A Case-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for E-Commerce Search Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05991)
*Global E-Commerce Search Relevance Team*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种案例驱动的多智能体框架，通过标注智能体、优化智能体和用户智能体的协同，自动化电商搜索相关性优化全流程，并结合工程化训练策略和记忆机制，在实际生产环境中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商搜索的相关性优化是一个涉及用户、产品经理、标注员、算法工程师、评估员等多角色的人机闭环系统。论文提出系统级问题：能否用自主智能体替代这些人类角色，从而实现从"坏案例识别"到"解决"的全自动流水线。

Method: 提出了案例驱动的多智能体框架，包含标注智能体（多轮标注）、优化智能体（自主分析与解决）和用户智能体（对话识别）；并构建了统一检索-排序模型、指令跟随模型、全局记忆库、深度搜索智能体及人机协作聊天机器人等关键组件。

Result: 大量人类评估表明，该框架能有效完成相关性任务，提高标注准确率，实现更及时、更具泛化能力的坏案例解决。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了多智能体自动化框架在工业级搜索相关性优化中的可行性和有效性，为电商搜索系统的持续迭代提供了一种可扩展的工程范式。

Abstract: Relevance is a foundation of user experience in e-commerce search. We view relevance optimization as a closed-loop ecosystem involving multiple human roles: users who provide feedback, product managers who define standards, annotators who label data, algorithm engineers who optimize models, and evaluators who assess performance. Because improving relevance in practice means systematically resolving user-perceived bad cases, we ask a system-level question: can this ecosystem be reimagined by replacing its human roles with autonomous agents? To answer this question, we propose a case-driven multi-agent framework that automates the pipeline from bad-case identification to resolution. The framework instantiates an Annotator Agent for multi-turn annotation, an Optimizer Agent for autonomous bad-case analysis and resolution, and a User Agent that identifies bad cases through conversational interaction, together forming an autonomous and continually evolving system. To make the framework practical in production, we further adopt a harness-engineering paradigm and build a unified retrieval-and-ranking relevance model for efficient training, an instruction-following relevance model for real-time case resolution, Global Memory to reduce information asymmetry across agents, a Deep Search Agent to target underestimation failures, and an agent-based chatbot for human--agent collaboration. Extensive human evaluation shows that the framework performs relevance-related tasks effectively, improves annotation accuracy, and enables more timely and generalizable bad-case resolution, indicating a practical paradigm for industrial search relevance optimization.

</details>


### [248] [OBLIQ-Bench: Exposing Overlooked Bottlenecks in Modern Retrievers with Latent and Implicit Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06235)
*Diane Tchuindjo,Devavrat Shah,Omar Khattab*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出了一种新型检索评估范式OBLIQ-Bench，专门针对"斜向查询"——即需要识别文档中潜在模式的查询。该基准揭示了当前检索系统与验证能力之间的关键差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索基准测试已日趋饱和，但高效的语义搜索远未得到解决。研究者发现了一类称为"斜向（oblique）"的查询，这类查询寻求的是能够实例化潜在模式的文档，而非基于显式关键词匹配的传统检索任务。

Method: 研究团队识别了斜向查询的三种产生机制，并构建了OBLIQ-Bench——一个包含五个斜向搜索问题的基准套件，涵盖真实长尾语料库。通过对比推理LLM的验证能力与检索系统的召回能力，揭示了检索与验证之间的不对称性。

Result: OBLIQ-Bench暴露了检索与验证之间一个被忽视的不对称性：推理LLM在相关文档被检索出来后能够可靠地识别其潜在相关性，但即便采用复杂的检索管道，在首轮检索时仍无法将大部分相关文档召回。

Conclusion: OBLIQ-Bench揭示了当前检索系统的一个关键缺陷：即使配备复杂推理能力的大语言模型能够可靠地识别潜在相关内容，但现有检索管道在首轮检索时就无法有效地将大部分相关文档召回。这一发现强调了需要开发能够高效捕获隐式模式和潜在信号的检索架构，以解决斜向查询问题。

Abstract: Retrieval benchmarks are increasingly saturating, but we argue that efficient search is far from a solved problem. We identify a class of queries we call oblique, which seek documents that instantiate a latent pattern, like finding all tweets that express an implicit stance, chat logs that demonstrate a particular failure mode, or transcripts that match an abstract scenario. We study three mechanisms through which obliqueness may arise and introduce OBLIQ-Bench, a suite of five oblique search problems over real long-tail corpora. OBLIQ-Bench exposes an overlooked asymmetry between retrieval and verification, where reasoning LLMs reliably recognize latent relevance whenever relevant documents are surfaced, but even sophisticated retrieval pipelines fail to surface most relevant documents in the first place. We hope that OBLIQ-Bench will drive research into retrieval architectures that efficiently capture latent patterns and implicit signals in large corpora.

</details>


### [249] [Expressiveness Limits of Autoregressive Semantic ID Generation in Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06331)
*Yupeng Hou,Haven Kim,Clark Mingxuan Ju,Eduardo Escoto,Neil Shah,Julian McAuley*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式推荐模型(GRA)解码树结构导致的物品概率耦合问题，提出Latte方法，通过在语义ID前注入潜在标记将单一解码树扩展为多个条件树，增加物品间的多路径变距，从而提升推荐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐模型的自回归解码过程形成了解码树结构，导致树中距离相近的物品获得相似概率，难以根据用户偏好区分它们，且理论证明这种结构相关性使GR模型无法表示协同过滤可捕获的简单模式。

Method: 提出Latte方法：在每个语义ID前注入潜在标记，将解码空间从单一树结构重塑为多个潜在标记条件树，创建物品间不同距离的多种路径。

Result: 在NDCG@10上实现平均3.45%的相对改进。

Conclusion: 提出Latte方法，通过注入潜在标记将单一解码树重塑为多个潜在标记条件树，从而缓解树结构诱导的概率耦合问题，在NDCG@10上实现3.45%的相对提升。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) models generate items by autoregressively producing a sequence of discrete tokens that jointly index the target item. However, this autoregressive generation process also induces a structured decoding space whose impact on model expressiveness remains underexplored. Specifically, token-by-token generation can be viewed as traversing a decoding tree induced by semantic ID tokens, where leaf nodes correspond to candidate items. We observe that the item probabilities produced by GR models are strongly correlated with this tree structure: items that are close in the tree tend to receive similar probabilities for any given user, making it difficult to distinguish among them based on user-specific preferences. We further show theoretically that such structural correlations prevent GR models from representing even simple patterns that can be well captured by conventional collaborative filtering models. To mitigate this issue, we propose Latte, a simple modification that injects a latent token before each semantic ID, reshaping the decoding space from a single tree into multiple latent-token-conditioned trees. This design creates multiple paths with varying tree distances between items, relaxing tree-induced probability coupling and yielding an average of 3.45% relative improvement on NDCG@10. Our code is available at https://github.com/hyp1231/Latte.

</details>


### [250] [Light-FMP: Lightweight Feature and Model Pruning for Enhanced Deep Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06441)
*Nghia Bui,Yue Ning,Lijing Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Light-FMP框架，通过预训练-剪枝-继续训练三阶段流程，利用硬Concrete分布识别重要特征并实施模型与特征剪枝，实现推荐系统在效率与精度上的双重优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度推荐系统（DRS）在处理高维输入特征时面临计算效率与模型精度之间的权衡困境。现有方法要么追求精度而忽视训练效率，要么牺牲精度以换取效率，导致难以在两项指标上同时取得优异表现。

Method: Light-FMP框架包含三个关键阶段：预训练、剪枝和继续训练。采用硬Concrete分布和掩码层，在小规模数据子集上进行预训练以识别重要特征。随后对模型和特征进行剪枝，并使用领域适配参数在剩余数据集上继续训练。

Result: 实验结果表明，Light-FMP在真实世界推荐系统基准数据集上，在效率和精度两方面均优于现有方法，同时保持了良好的可扩展性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Light-FMP通过特征与模型剪枝的协同设计，成功实现了推荐系统在效率与精度之间的平衡，展示了在真实世界推荐系统基准数据集上的有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Deep recommender systems (DRS) often face challenges in balancing computational efficiency and model accuracy, especially when handling high-dimensional input features. Existing methods either focus on improving accuracy while neglecting training efficiency or prioritize efficiency at the cost of suboptimal accuracy across tasks. We propose Light-FMP: Lightweight Feature and Model Pruning for Enhanced DRS, a lightweight framework that addresses the challenges through three key phases: \textit{pretraining}, \textit{pruning}, and \textit{continued training}. Using a hard concrete distribution, a masking layer is efficiently pretrained on a small data subset to identify important features. The model and features are then pruned, and training continues on the remaining dataset with domain-adapted parameters. Experiments on benchmark datasets from real-world recommender systems demonstrate that Light-FMP outperforms existing methods in both efficiency and accuracy while maintaining scalability and robustness.

</details>


### [251] [Superintelligent Retrieval Agent: The Next Frontier of Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06647)
*Zeyu Yang,Qi Ma,Jason Chen,Anshumali Shrivastava*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SIRA introduces "superintelligent retrieval" defined as compressing multi-round exploratory search into a single corpus-discriminative action. By leveraging LLM cognition on both corpus (offline vocabulary enrichment) and query (evidence vocabulary prediction) sides, combined with lightweight document-frequency filtering, SIRA achieves superior retrieval performance with a single weighted BM25 call—outperforming expensive multi-round approaches while remaining interpretable, training-free, and efficient.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current retrieval-augmented agents treat retrieval as a black box, requiring multi-round exploratory queries similar to how newcomers search unfamiliar databases rather than experts with strong priors. This results in unnecessary retrieval rounds, increased latency, and poor recall.

Method: SIRA employs a dual-sided enrichment strategy: (1) Corpus-side: LLM enriches documents offline with missing search vocabulary; (2) Query-side: LLM predicts evidence vocabulary omitted by the query. Document-frequency statistics filter proposed terms (removing absent, overly common, or low-margin terms). Final step: single weighted BM25 call combining original query with validated expansion terms.

Result: SIRA achieves significantly superior performance across 10 BEIR benchmarks and downstream question-answering tasks, outperforming dense retrievers and state-of-the-art multi-round agentic baselines.

Conclusion: SIRA remains interpretable, training-free, and efficient, demonstrating that a single well-formed lexical query guided by LLM cognition and lightweight corpus statistics can outperform substantially more expensive multi-round search approaches.

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented agents are increasingly the interface to large organizational knowledge bases, yet most still treat retrieval as a black box: they issue exploratory queries, inspect returned snippets, and iteratively reformulate until useful evidence emerges. This approach resembles how a newcomer searches an unfamiliar database rather than how an expert navigates it with strong priors about terminology and likely evidence, and results in unnecessary retrieval rounds, increased latency, and poor recall.
  We introduce \textit{SuperIntelligent Retrieval Agent} (SIRA), which defines \emph{superintelligence} in retrieval as the ability to compress multi-round exploratory search into a single corpus-discriminative retrieval action. SIRA does not merely ask what terms are relevant to the query; it asks which terms are likely to separate the desired evidence from corpus-level confusers. On the corpus side, an LLM enriches each document offline with missing search vocabulary; on the query side, it predicts evidence vocabulary omitted by the query; and document-frequency statistics as a tool call to filter proposed terms that are absent, overly common, or unlikely to create retrieval margin. The final retrieval step is a single weighted BM25 call combining the original query with the validated expansion.
  Across ten BEIR benchmarks and downstream question-answering tasks, SIRA achieves the significantly superior performance outperforming dense retrievers and state-of-the-art multi-round agentic baselines, demonstrating that one well-formed lexical query, guided by LLM cognition and lightweight corpus statistics, can exceed substantially more expensive multi-round search while remaining interpretable, training-free, and efficient.

</details>


<div id='cs.DB'></div>

# cs.DB [[Back]](#toc)

### [252] [Anatomy of a Query: W5H Dimensions and FAR Patterns for Text-to-SQL Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05525)
*Vicki Stover Hertzberg,Eduardo Valverde,Joyce C. Ho*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: QUEST框架通过两个独立驱动的组件评估NLIDB系统：FAR结构不变量（Filter-Aggregate-Return）和W5H语义维度框架（Who/What/Where/When/Why/How）。在120,464条跨5个文本转SQL数据集的验证中，FAR一致性普遍成立，但W5H维度分布差异显著，医疗领域查询高度集中于时间和人物维度，因果和机制推理几乎为零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自然语言数据库接口日益流行，但其理论评估和设计基础仍不成熟。现有系统缺乏系统性的语义理解评估框架，无法识别不同领域查询的语义维度分布差异，也未能明确界定真正机器推理的边界。

Method: 研究提出两个框架组件：(1) FAR结构不变量——任何格式良好的查询都归结为Filter、Aggregate、Return三种操作的组合；(2) W5H维度框架——所有过滤条件映射到Who、What、Where、When、Why、How六个语义维度。通过对五个文本转SQL数据集（共120,464条）进行跨领域验证。

Result: FAR一致性在所有领域和模式类型中普遍成立；W5H维度分布在不同领域间差异显著。医疗查询高度集中于时间维度（80.4%）和人物维度（73.0%），远超通用领域基准；因果（WHY）和机制（HOW）推理几乎为零，看似HOW的例外实为定量聚合而非真正的程序性推理。

Conclusion: 研究确立了文本转SQL系统实现真正机器推理所需跨越的前沿边界。当前系统在处理因果推理和机制性推理方面存在根本性不足，这是迈向结构化数据真正机器推理的必克难题。

Abstract: Natural language interfaces to databases have gained popularity, yet the theoretical foundations for evaluating and designing these systems remain underdeveloped. We present QUEST (Query Understanding Evaluation through Semantic Translation), a framework resting on two independently motivated components: the FAR structural invariant, which holds that every well-formed query reduces to Filter, Aggregate, and Return operations; and the W5H dimensional framework, which holds that all filtering criteria map to six semantic dimensions (Who, What, Where, When, Why, and How). Validated across five text-to-SQL datasets (n = 120,464), FAR conformance is universal across all domains and schema types, while W5H dimensional profiles vary substantially. Healthcare queries are strongly concentrated in temporal (WHEN: 80.4%) and person-centric (WHO: 73.0%) dimensions far exceeding general-domain benchmarks, and causal (WHY) and mechanistic (HOW) reasoning are near-zero everywhere, with apparent HOW exceptions reflecting quantitative aggregation rather than genuine procedural reasoning. These results identify a frontier that must be crossed for genuine machine reasoning over structured data.

</details>


### [253] [An Extensible and Verifiable Language for Query Rewrite Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05536)
*Sicheng Pan,Shuxian Wang,Wesley Zheng,Zirong Zeng,Vijay Sharma,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: Rulescript是一种与引擎无关的领域特定语言(DSL)，用于开发查询重写规则。它通过关系代数风格的核心语言和规则匹配-转换阶段的显式分解，将规则定义与执行基础设施分离。规则通过模式匹配查询计划来表达，自动进行形式化验证以确保正确性，并且可扩展以支持自定义运算符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统的重写规则通常手动实现，与特定执行引擎紧耦合，缺乏形式化正确性保证，导致开发新引擎需要重新实现规则，产生巨大工程成本，且每次新实现都可能引入新bug。

Method: Rulescript通过关系代数启发的核心语言和匹配-转换阶段的显式分解来表达重写规则；用户通过核心算子模式匹配查询计划并构建语义等价的转换计划；通过实现轻量级适配器将核心/自定义算子映射到目标引擎。

Result: 成功重实现了Apache Calcite的33条重写规则，扩展了多个自定义算子，自动部署到CockroachDB和Apache Data Fusion两个不同后端的引擎，验证了"一次编写，到处部署"的范式。

Conclusion: Rulescript实现了查询计划重写的"一次编写，到处部署"范式，向新数据引擎部署先前编写的规则只需最少工作量。

Abstract: Logical query plan rewriting transforms a relational database query into an equivalent but more efficient form and is crucial to the performance of database-backed applications. In existing systems, rewrite rules are typically implemented manually, tightly coupled to specific execution engines, and often lack formal correctness guarantees. Consequently, developing a new engine requires reimplementing both legacy and new rules, incurring significant engineering cost, limiting portability, and every new implementation is an opportunity for introducing new bugs.
  We introduce Rulescript, an engine-agnostic domain-specific language (DSL) for developing query rewrite rules. Rulescript separates rule definition from execution infrastructure via a relational algebra-inspired core language and an explicit decomposition of rules into matching and transformation phases. Developers express rewrites by pattern-matching query plans using Rulescript's core operators and constructing semantically equivalent transformed plans, with all rewrites automatically verified formally to ensure correctness. Rulescript is extensible: users can define custom operators in terms of the core language to capture engine-specific semantics. To integrate with an existing system, developers need only implement a lightweight adapter that maps Rulescript's core and custom operators to the operators implemented in the target engine.
  We evaluate Rulescript by reimplementing 33 rewrite rules from Apache Calcite and extending the language with several custom operators. To demonstrate portability, we automatically deploy these rules to CockroachDB and Apache Data Fusion, two engines with substantially different backends. Our results show that Rulescript enables "write once, deploy everywhere" paradigm for query plan rewriting, with minimal effort required to deploy previously written rules on a new data engine.

</details>


### [254] [Low-Latency Out-of-Core ANN Search in High-Dimensional Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05787)
*Ziwen Song,Bin Wang,Xiaochun Yang,Junhua Zhang*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SkipDisk是一种磁盘-内存混合的近似最近邻搜索方法，通过专属pivot优化下界、三级数据剪枝和异步I/O策略，在大幅降低内存占用的同时实现与内存方法HNSW相当或更优的搜索延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内存优化 ANN 方法内存占用高，磁盘方法存在高磁盘访问延迟问题；且现有基于下界的过滤方法下界过于宽松，无法有效减少磁盘访问

Method: 设计了专属pivot改进三角形不等式下界、三级数据剪枝策略保留内存中的关键信息、以及基于邻居节点内存存储的异步I/O策略

Result: 在仅需HNSW约10%内存占用时实现85μs延迟（对比HNSW基准），在约20%内存占用时实现63μs延迟，显著优于现有磁盘ANN方法

Conclusion: SkipDisk实现了内存占用仅为HNSW的10%时延迟降至其85%，内存约20%时延迟降至其63%的性能，兼顾了内存效率与搜索性能。

Abstract: In-memory graph-based approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search has superior search performance but incurs significant memory footprint. Disk-based methods reduce memory usage but suffer from high disk access latency. A common challenge is how to achieve low-latency search while significantly reducing memory footprint. In this paper, we propose SkipDisk, a disk-memory hybrid ANN search that significantly reduces memory footprint while achieving search latency comparable to or lower than in-memory method HNSW. By analyzing existing disk-based methods, we observed that disk access remains the primary bottleneck, and existing lower bound based filtering methods are two loose to effectively reduce disk access. Therefore, we design SkipDisk to achieve tight lower bound with low memory footprint to reduce the search latency. First, we design a dedicated pivot for each point to improve the lower bound of the triangle inequality for effective filtering. We further design an estimation-based approach based on this lower bound. Second, to reduce the memory footprint, we employ a three-level data pruning strategy to preserve informative data in memory. Third, to further reduce search latency, we design an asynchronous I/O strategy based on the decoupling of in-memory search and disk access by storing neighbor nodes in memory. Experiments show that our method achieves a latency of 85 of HNSW's latency with approximately 10 memory footprint, and a latency to 63 of HNSW's with a slightly higher memory footprint of around 20.

</details>
