Motivation: The core token-mixing mechanism in Transformers remains attention, and despite various improvements to positional encoding, attention, and feed-forward networks, the fundamental approach has not fundamentally changed. The authors seek a stronger mathematical foundation by interpreting attention as Nadaraya-Watson regression and proposing a KRR-based alternative.

Method: Proposes Cubit, a KRR-based architecture that replaces classical attention with the closed-form solution of KRR, combining kernel similarity-based value aggregation with kernel matrix inverse normalization. Also introduces Limited-Range Rescale (LRR) to improve training stability by rescaling value layers within a controlled range.

Result: Experiments validate that Cubit exhibits stronger long-sequence modeling capability, and the performance gain over Transformers increases as training sequence length grows.

Conclusion: Cubit provides a stronger mathematical foundation than vanilla Transformers by replacing Nadaraya-Watson regression with Kernel Ridge Regression, and demonstrates improved long-sequence modeling capability that increases with sequence length.

Abstract: Since its introduction in 2017, the Transformer has become one of the most widely adopted architectures in modern deep learning. Despite extensive efforts to improve positional encoding, attention mechanisms, and feed-forward networks, the core token-mixing mechanism in Transformers remains attention. In this work, we show that the attention module in Transformers can be interpreted as performing Nadaraya-Watson regression, where it computes similarities between tokens and aggregates the corresponding values accordingly. Motivated by this perspective, we propose Cubit, a potential next-generation architecture that leverages Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR), while the vanilla Transformer relies on Nadaraya-Watson regression. Specifically, Cubit modifies the classical attention computation by incorporating the closed-form solution of KRR, combining value aggregation through kernel similarities with normalization via the inverse of the kernel matrix. To improve the training stability, we further propose the Limited-Range Rescale (LRR), which rescales the value layer within a controlled range. We argue that Cubit, as a KRR-based architecture, provides a stronger mathematical foundation than the vanilla Transformer, whose attention mechanism corresponds to Nadaraya-Watson regression. We validate this claim through comprehensive experiments. The experimental results suggest that Cubit may exhibit stronger long-sequence modeling capability. In particular, its performance gain over the Transformer appears to increase as the training sequence length grows.

</details>


### [385] [PairAlign: A Framework for Sequence Tokenization via Self-Alignment with Applications to Audio Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06582)
*Adhiraj Banerjee,Vipul Arora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PairAlign是一种通过序列级自对齐实现紧凑音频标记化的框架。该方法将标记化视为条件序列生成任务，使用编码器-解码器架构学习标记身份、顺序、长度和结束位置，通过双视图对比训练减少多对一坍缩，在TIMIT检索任务上实现55%的token数量减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频标记器依赖量化、聚类或codec重建，采用局部分配策略，导致序列一致性、紧凑性、长度控制、终止判断和编辑相似性等关键指标未被直接优化。这是语音处理中比较、记忆、检索和推理等操作的核心瓶颈。

Method: PairAlign将标记化视为条件序列生成任务：编码器将语音映射为连续条件表示，自回归解码器从BOS开始生成token序列，学习标记身份、顺序、长度和EOS位置。核心训练策略包括：(1)给定两个内容保持的视图，序列被训练为另一视图表示的似然目标；(2)使用VQ风格标记化作为起点，通过EMA教师目标、交叉配对教师强制、前缀损坏、似然对比和长度控制进行精炼。

Result: 在3秒语音任务中，PairAlign学习到紧凑、非退化的序列，具有广泛的词汇使用量和强跨视图一致性。在TIMIT检索任务中，在保持编辑距离搜索能力的同时，存档token数量减少55%。连续扫描探针显示其局部重叠低于密集几何标记器，但具有更强的长度控制和100ms偏移下的有界编辑轨迹。

Conclusion: PairAlign是一种序列-符号预测学习器，类似于JEPA风格的目标函数，从另一视图预测抽象目标作为学习的长度可变符号序列而非连续潜变量。该方法为音频标记化提供了一种新的序列级优化范式，在紧凑性和编辑距离保持之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Many operations on sensory data -- comparison, memory, retrieval, and reasoning -- are naturally expressed over discrete symbolic structures. In language this interface is given by tokens; in audio, it must be learned. Existing audio tokenizers rely on quantization, clustering, or codec reconstruction, assigning tokens locally, so sequence consistency, compactness, length control, termination, and edit similarity are rarely optimized directly.
  We introduce PairAlign, a framework for compact audio tokenization through sequence-level self-alignment. PairAlign treats tokenization as conditional sequence generation: an encoder maps speech to a continuous condition, and an autoregressive decoder generates tokens from BOS, learning token identity, order, length, and EOS placement. Given two content-preserving views, each view's sequence is trained to be likely under the other's representation, while unrelated examples provide competing sequences. This gives a scalable surrogate for edit-distance preservation while discouraging many-to-one collapse.
  PairAlign starts from VQ-style tokenization and refines it with EMA-teacher targets, cross-paired teacher forcing, prefix corruption, likelihood contrast, and length control.
  On 3-second speech, PairAlign learns compact, non-degenerate sequences with broad vocabulary usage and strong cross-view consistency. On TIMIT retrieval, it preserves edit-distance search while reducing archive token count by 55%. A continuous-sweep probe shows lower local overlap than a dense geometric tokenizer, but stronger length control and bounded edit trajectories under 100 ms shifts. PairAlign is a sequence-symbolic predictive learner: like JEPA-style objectives, it predicts an abstract target from another view as a learned variable-length symbolic sequence, not a continuous latent.

</details>


### [386] [Matrix-Decoupled Concentration for Autoregressive Sequences: Dimension-Free Guarantees for Sparse Long-Context Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06017)
*Pei-Sen Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出矩阵解耦集中不等式（MDC）：把序列的依赖结构编码为因果互作用矩阵 H，其方差代理不再被压缩成标量，而是由因果预解矩阵 Γ=(I−H)^{-1} 与目标敏感度向量 c 的精确矩阵-向量乘积 ‖Γc‖²₂ 决定。对仅依赖终端 token 的稀疏奖励（c 只有 c_N 非零），该代理与序列长度 N 无关，得到与 N 无关的 O(1) 界，从而为长上下文推理的稳定性提供理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归 LLM 的序列级评估（ORM 奖励模型、DPO 等）涉及高度依赖的 token 生成，缺乏紧的集中界。现有框架存在两大结构性缺陷：(i)「标量坍塌」——经典不等式（Marton 运输成本、Paulin 谱方法、Kontorovich–Ramanan 鞅图方法）把依赖结构与目标敏感度解耦，通过 ‖Γ‖∞²‖c‖∞² 之类的次乘性范数松弛把稀疏终端奖励的方差代理人为放大到 O(N)；(ii)「因果结构失配」——空间耦合法（Chazottes 等、Chatterjee 的 Stein 方法）虽能达到 O(N) 紧界，却依赖全局 Gibbs 测度的边界条件（即对整个图结构的同时条件化），违反自回归解码的非预期性/因果时间箭头，无法适用。因此需要一个既保留敏感度稀疏结构、又严格因果的集中界框架。

Method: 设路径空间 A^N，由转移核族 {p_i} 诱导联合分布；以条件 2.1（广义 Lipschitz 向量 c）刻画目标函数 f 的逐坐标敏感度。用全变差距离定义严格上三角的因果互作用矩阵 H：H_{i,j} 为在固定中间轨迹下扰动第 i 步状态所引起 p_j 的最大 TV 距离；因 H 幂零，预解矩阵 Γ=(I−H)^{-1}=Σ_{r=0}^{N−1}H^r 项非负。定理 3.1：P(|f(X)−E f|≥t) ≤ 2exp(−2t²/‖Γc‖²₂)。证明路径为：Doob 鞅分解 → 向量化路径耦合（TV 最优耦合）→ 差异概率递推 v_j ≤ Σ_m H_{m,j} v_m，即 (I−Hᵀ)v ≤ e_k → 左乘 Γᵀ 得 v ≤ Γᵀe_k → 条件振幅 δ_k(x) ≤ cᵀv ≤ (Γc)_k → 逐条件 Hoeffding 引理 + Markov 不等式得 Chernoff 界。推论 3.2 给出谱衰减系数 κ=‖Γ‖₂^{-2} 及由 H_{i,j}≤φ_{j−i} 推得 κ≥(1−S)²；H=0 时精确退化为经典 McDiarmid 不等式。应用层面：马尔可夫链（Dobrushin 系数 α）下 H 截断为次对角，得到 (1−α)^{-2} 最优运输常数；亚临界有向因果树（αD<1）下 Γ_{i,j}≤α^{d(i,j)}，得到 O(N) 界；LLM 场景在条件 5.1（‖H‖₁≤α）下对稀疏终端目标 c=(0,…,0,c_N) 得到 ‖Γc‖²₂ ≤ c_N²(1−α)^{-2}，与 N 无关。

Result: MDC 实现了：(1) 对同质收缩马尔可夫链精确复现 Marton 的最优 (1−α)^{-2} 常数，且避免 L2 化带来的 √α 损失与鞅图方法在 α≥1/2 时的发散；(2) 对亚临界有向因果树借 d-分离给出 O(N) 阶最优界（‖Γ1‖²₂ ≤ N/(1−αD)²），优于需一维线性滤网方法的 O(N²) 退化；(3) 对稀疏终端奖励给出与 N 无关的 O(1) 方差代理 2exp(−2t²(1−α)²/c_N²)，数值实验（滑动窗口 W=5, α=0.8）显示经典松弛为 O(N) 发散而 MDC 保持 O(1)。

Conclusion: MDC 框架通过精确保留依赖结构与敏感度结构的矩阵-向量乘积，避免了标量坍塌，在严格因果滤网下同时获得最优常数、树结构的阶最优界以及长上下文稀疏奖励的维数无关保证，为自回归 LLM 长上下文推理的稳定性提供严格数学依据。局限与未来方向：当前依赖最坏情形的绝对跨度（Hoeffding 型），可拓展到 Freedman/Bernstein 型可预测二次型变差；H 的定义取的是对所有历史的 quenched L∞ 上确界，可放宽为 annealed L¹ 平均以适应非一致混合序列；可研究非三角依赖图（MRF/Glauber 动力学）下预解矩阵界是否仍成立。

Abstract: Sequence-level evaluations in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly dependent token generation. Establishing tight concentration bounds for these processes remains a challenge due to two fundamental bottlenecks in existing frameworks: (i) classical inequalities typically separate dependency structures from target sensitivities, leading to a scalar collapse that inflates the variance proxy to a suboptimal $\mathcal{O}(N)$ for sparse terminal rewards; (ii) conversely, while certain spatial methods achieve tighter bounds, they lack the strictly causal filtration required by sequential generation, rendering them inapplicable to the autoregressive setting. To resolve both bottlenecks, we establish a sharp McDiarmid-type inequality for dependent sequences, governed strictly by the exact matrix-vector multiplication of the causal dependency resolvent and the target sensitivity vector. This Matrix-Decoupled Concentration (MDC) framework natively recovers optimal constants for Markov chains and exploits directed $d$-separation to yield order-optimal bounds for causal trees. Crucially, by exactly preserving the coordinate-wise sparsity of rewards within a strictly causal framework, MDC mathematically prevents scalar collapse, guaranteeing a dimension-free $\mathcal{O}(1)$ variance proxy and providing a rigorous mathematical justification for the stability of long-context reasoning.

</details>


### [387] [Multi-agent decision making: A Blackwell's informativeness approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06028)
*Zheng Zhang,Cuong C. Nguyen,Kevin Wells,Gustavo Carneiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用Blackwell信息论框架分析多智能体LLM决策问题，证明了投票和辩论机制的信息量不超过所有智能体的私有信息池，并提出基于后验乘积估计的实用方法，在6个QA基准上超越现有辩论和投票方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体LLM决策研究缺乏正式的理论保证，现有的投票和辩论等聚合方法多为经验性设计，无法保证决策的信息丰富度(informativeness)。需要从信息论角度建立原则性分析框架。

Method: 1) 将多智能体LLM决策问题抽象为Blackwell信息结构；2) 形式化证明投票和辩论产生的信息结构在Blackwell序意义下不超过所有智能体的联合私有信息；3) 提出贝叶斯联合后验最大化作为理论上界；4) 设计基于后验乘积估计器的近似实现方法。

Result: 在6个问答基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有的多智能体辩论和投票方法，验证了理论分析的正确性和近似方法的实用性。

Conclusion: Blackwell信息论框架为多智能体LLM决策提供了严格的理论分析工具；联合后验最大化是优于投票和辩论的最优决策规则；后验乘积估计是可行的近似实现方案。

Abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has motivated research on decision-making in multi-agent systems, where multiple agents collaborate to achieve shared objectives. Existing aggregation approaches, such as voting and debate, are largely ad-hoc and lack formal guarantees regarding the informativeness of the resulting decisions. In this paper, we provide a principled approach to analyse decisions made in the multi-LLM setting using Blackwell's informativeness framework. Within the Blackwell information-structure abstraction, we show that voting and debate induce information structures that are no more informative than the pooled private information of all agents. This result identifies Bayesian pooled posterior maximisation as an information-theoretic upper-bound decision rule under the Blackwell ordering. Motivated by this theoretical analysis, we introduce a practical method for LLM-based question-answering (QA) tasks that estimates each agent's posterior and approximates the pooled posterior using a product-of-posteriors estimator. Extensive experiments on six QA benchmarks demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art multi-LLM debate and voting methods.

</details>


### [388] [When and Why SignSGD Outperforms SGD: A Theoretical Study Based on $\ell_1$-norm Lower Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06615)
*Hongyi Tao,Dingzhi Yu,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文在新的问题几何框架（l1范数稳定点、l∞-光滑性、可分离噪声）下首次严格证明了SignSGD在稀疏噪声条件下的维度优势（复杂度降低d倍），并将该理论推广至Muon矩阵优化器，通过GPT-2预训练实验验证了理论预测的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sign-based算法（SignSGD、Muon）在训练大模型中表现优异，但理论上缺乏对标SGD优势的清晰理解；标准条件下SGD对l2范数稳定点已是最小最优，限制了sign方法的理论收益空间。

Method: 在l1范数稳定点、l∞-光滑性和可分离噪声模型的新几何框架下，推导SignSGD的匹配上下界，并将框架推广至矩阵域分析Muon优化器。

Result: 在稀疏噪声下，SignSGD相比SGD复杂度降低d倍（d为维度）；Muon在矩阵域保持相同的维度缩放最优性；124M GPT-2预训练实验验证了理论预测的收敛速度优势。

Conclusion: SignSGD在稀疏噪声条件下确实具有维度优势（复杂度降低d倍），且该理论优势在124M参数GPT-2预训练中得到验证；Muon在矩阵域也保持此最优维度缩放特性。

Abstract: Sign-based optimization algorithms, such as SignSGD and Muon, have garnered significant attention for their remarkable performance in training large foundation models. Despite this empirical success, we still lack a theoretical understanding of when and why these sign-based methods outperform vanilla SGD. The core obstacle is that under standard smoothness and finite variance conditions, SGD is known to be minimax optimal for finding stationary points measured by $\ell_2$-norms, thereby fundamentally precluding any complexity gains for sign-based methods in standard settings. To overcome this barrier, we analyze sign-based optimizers leveraging $\ell_1$-norm stationarity, $\ell_\infty$-smoothness, and a separable noise model, which can better capture the coordinate-wise nature of signed updates. Under this distinct problem geometry, we derive matched upper and lower bounds for SignSGD and explicitly characterize the problem class in which SignSGD provably dominates SGD. Specifically, we compare the \emph{upper bound of SignSGD} with the \emph{lower bound of SGD}, illustrating that SignSGD effectively reduces the complexity by a factor of $d$ under \emph{sparse noise}, where $d$ is the problem dimension. Furthermore, we elevate this framework to the matrix domain, providing an equivalent optimal lower bound for the Muon optimizer, proving that extending the sign operator to matrices preserves this optimal scaling with dimensionality. Finally, we bridge our theoretical bounds to practice, demonstrating that the theoretical superiority of SignSGD accurately predicts its faster convergence during the pretraining of a 124M parameter GPT-2 model.

</details>


### [389] [Does Synthetic Data Help? Empirical Evidence from Deep Learning Time Series Forecasters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06032)
*Hugo Cazaux,Eyjólfur Ingi Ásgeirsson,Hlynur Stefánsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实证研究（9个实验组、4,218次运行）系统评估了合成时间序列增强方法。研究发现效果高度依赖模型架构：通道混合模型（如TimesNet、iTransformer）大多受益，而通道独立模型（如DLinear、PatchTST）普遍表现下降。仅Seasonal-Trend生成器在测试基准上表现可靠，课程切换策略则造成显著性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据在语言模型训练中已广泛应用，但在时间序列预测中的作用机制尚不清晰，缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 大规模实证研究，涵盖5种架构、4种合成信号、7个数据集，共4,218次实验运行。

Result: 通道混合模型在大多数试验中受益于合成增强；通道独立模型表现持续下降。平均而言，增强在67%的试验中造成性能下降。仅Seasonal-Trend生成器可靠有效，硬课程切换导致MSE增加24%。低资源设置下TimesNet仅用10% Weather数据加合成增强即可超越全数据基线。

Conclusion: 使用合成数据增强时应：(1)选择通道混合架构；(2)采用渐进式退火调度；(3)低资源增强需考虑架构和数据集特异性。

Abstract: Synthetic data has transformed language model training, yet its role in time series forecasting remains poorly understood. We present a large-scale empirical study: nine experiment groups, 4,218 runs systematically evaluating synthetic time series augmentation across five architectures, four synthetic signals and seven datasets. The effect is sharply architecture-conditional: channel-mixing models (TimesNet, iTransformer) benefit in the majority of trials, while channel-independent models (DLinear, PatchTST) are consistently degraded. In selected low-resource settings the gains are striking: TimesNet trained on only 10\% of Weather data with synthetic augmentation surpasses the full-data baseline (4 of 16 sparsity-dataset combinations). Averaged across all architectures, augmentation hurts in 67\% of trials. We further find that only the Seasonal-Trend generator reliably helps across the tested benchmarks, and that hard curriculum switching is actively harmful (+24\% MSE degradation). These results provide concrete, actionable guidelines on how to use synthetic data: use synthetic augmentation with channel-mixing architectures, use gradual annealing schedules, and treat low-resource augmentation as architecture- and dataset-dependent. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/hugoiscracked/synthetic-ts/tree/main}

</details>


### [390] [Optimal Transport for LLM Reward Modeling from Noisy Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06036)
*Licheng Pan,Haochen Yang,Haoxuan Li,Yunsheng Lu,Yongqi Tong,Yinuo Wang,Shijian Wang,Zhixuan Chu,Lei Shen,Yuan Lu,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SelectiveRM是一种基于最优传输理论的奖励模型去噪框架，通过Joint Consistency Discrepancy对齐分布，并引入Mass Relaxation机制（部分传输）自主排除噪声样本，在理论上优化了干净风险的更紧上界，实验验证其优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF中的奖励模型易受噪声偏好数据影响。现有方法依赖同质噪声假设，无法捕捉语言偏好的复杂性；传统训练目标会过拟合错误，导致模型性能下降。

Method: 提出SelectiveRM框架，包含两个核心组件：1) Joint Consistency Discrepancy：对齐模型预测分布与偏好数据分布；2) Mass Relaxation机制：通过部分传输放松严格的质量守恒约束，使模型能自主排除与语义一致性矛盾的噪声样本。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，SelectiveRM显著优于现有最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: SelectiveRM从理论和实验两方面验证了其有效性，为RLHF中的奖励模型去噪提供了一种基于最优传输的优雅解决方案。

Abstract: Reward models are fundamental to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), yet real-world datasets are inevitably corrupted by noisy preference. Conventional training objectives tend to overfit these errors, while existing denoising approaches often rely on homogeneous noise assumptions that fail to capture the complexity of linguistic preferences. To handle these challenges, we propose SelectiveRM, a framework grounded in optimal transport. We first devise a Joint Consistency Discrepancy to align the distribution of model predictions with preference data. Furthermore, to address the limitation of strict mass conservation which compels the model to fit outliers, we incorporate a Mass Relaxation mechanism via partial transport. This enables the autonomous exclusion of samples with noisy preference that contradict semantic consistency. Theoretically, we demonstrate that SelectiveRM optimizes a tighter upper bound on the unobserved clean risk. Extensive experiments validate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [391] [Requests of a Feather Must Flock Together: Batch Size vs. Prefix Homogeneity in LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06046)
*Saksham Rathi,Preeti,Mythili Vutukuru*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理中的KV缓存访问效率问题，提出 Feather 调度器利用强化学习动态平衡批大小与前缀同质性，并设计CHT数据结构加速前缀检测。实验表明该方案在vLLM和SGLang中可获得2-10倍吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的自回归token生成因需要"attend to"所有先前token的KV缓存而受内存约束。现有最优推理引擎的前缀感知调度器仅通过最大化批内前缀重用来减少KV缓存内存占用，但未在更小、更同质的批上停止批形成以获得更好性能；此外，现有调度器依赖radix-tree遍历进行共享前缀检测，产生的CPU开销常与GPU执行时间相当。

Method: 提出Feather：一个基于强化学习的前缀感知调度器，学习批大小与前缀同质性之间的最优权衡；引入Chunked Hash Tree (CHT)：一种轻量级数据结构，用于快速前缀检测和高效请求选择，避免了昂贵的树遍历操作。

Result: 在vLLM和SGLang中集成后，Feather相比现有调度器实现2-10倍端到端吞吐量提升；在无足够前缀共享的工作负载下表现不低于现状；通过减少KV缓存访问总次数超越了具有相同目标的前缀感知注意力内核的性能。

Conclusion: Feather通过RL学习和CHT数据结构，有效解决了前缀感知调度中批大小与前缀同质性之间的权衡问题，在vLLM和SGLang中实现了2-10倍的端到端吞吐量提升，且在无前缀共享的工作负载下不劣于现有方案。

Abstract: Auto-regressive token generation in large language models is memory-bound because it requires "attending to" key and value tensors (KV cache) of all previous tokens. Prior work aims to improve the efficiency of this decode process by batching multiple requests together, and maximizing batch size subject to GPU memory constraints. The key observation of our work is that with prefix-sharing workloads, smaller, prefix-homogeneous batches -- where all requests share a common prefix -- can achieve higher decode throughput than larger, heterogeneous batches, due to better spatial and temporal locality during KV cache accesses. However, prefix-aware schedulers in state-of-the-art inference engines maximize prefix reuse within a batch only to reduce KV cache memory footprint, but do not stop batch formation at smaller homogeneous batches that could have performed better. Further, we show that shared prefix detection in existing schedulers relies on radix-tree traversals, incurring substantial CPU overhead that is often comparable to GPU execution time. This paper presents Feather, a prefix-aware scheduler that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn the optimal tradeoff between batch size and prefix homogeneity. We also introduce Chunked Hash Tree (CHT), a lightweight data structure that enables fast prefix detection and efficient request selection for the RL scheduler, avoiding expensive tree traversals. We integrate Feather into vLLM and SGLang, and our evaluation shows that Feather achieves 2--10$\times$ higher end-to-end throughput as compared to existing schedulers, while doing no worse than the status quo when the workload does not have enough prefix sharing. Feather achieves these gains by reducing the total number of KV cache accesses, surpassing the performance of prefix-aware attention kernels that have the same goal.

</details>


### [392] [TFM-Retouche: A Lightweight Input-Space Adapter for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06047)
*Duong Nguyen,Mohammed Jawhar,Nicolas Chesneau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TFM-Retouche是一种轻量级输入空间残差适配器，通过在输入空间学习残差校正来对齐输入数据与预训练模型的归纳偏置，从而在不修改TFM内部架构的情况下实现任务适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFM）的归纳偏置在推理时是固定的，适配到特定数据集通常需要昂贵的全量微调或需要针对每种TFM内部架构定制的PEFT方法（如LoRA），且权重空间微调是否能提升准确性和校准效果尚存争议。

Method: TFM-Retouche采用输入空间残差适配方式，学习小型残差校正来对齐输入数据与预训练模型的归纳偏置。适配器通过冻结的TFM进行端到端训练，并包含训练后身份保护机制，当适配在验证集上无帮助时回退到未修改的TFM。

Result: 在TabArena-Lite（51个数据集，涵盖二分类、多分类和回归任务）上，基于TabICLv2的TabICLv2-Retouche以轻量级任务调优和集成策略在排行榜上位列第一，相比冻结的TabICLv2基础模型Aggregate Elo提升+56，并位于预测质量与训练/推理时间的帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: 输入空间残差适配是一种有效的、与架构无关的TFM适配范式，能够在保持高效性的同时显著提升表格基础模型的任务适应性。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs), such as TabPFN-2.6, TabICLv2, ConTextTab, Mitra, LimiX, and TabDPT, achieve strong zero-shot performance through in-context learning, but their inductive biases remain fixed at inference time. Adapting a pretrained TFM to a specific dataset or task typically requires either full fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive, or parameter-efficient tuning methods (PEFT) such as LoRA, which must be tailored to the internal architecture of each TFM. Furthermore, the evidence on whether weight-space fine-tuning improves accuracy or calibration is mixed \citep{tanna_exploring_2026,rubachev_finetuning_2025}. We introduce TFM-Retouche, a lightweight input-space residual adapter that is architecture-agnostic by design with respect to the frozen TFM backbone. TFM-Retouche learns a small residual correction in the input space to align the input data with the inductive biases of the pretrained model. The adapter is trained end-to-end through the frozen TFM, with a post-training identity guard that falls back to the unmodified TFM whenever adaptation does not help on held-out validation. On TabArena-Lite (51 datasets spanning binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression), TabICLv2-Retouche -- the framework instantiated on TabICLv2 -- is the top-ranked method on the leaderboard with light per-task tuning and ensembling, lifting aggregate Elo by +56 over the frozen TabICLv2 base and sitting on the Pareto front of predictive quality versus both training and inference time.

</details>


### [393] [When No Benchmark Exists: Validating Comparative LLM Safety Scoring Without Ground-Truth Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06652)
*Sushant Gautam,Finn Schwall,Annika Willoch Olstad,Fernando Vallecillos Ruiz,Birk Torpmann-Hagen,Sunniva Maria Stordal Bjørklund,Leon Moonen,Klas Pettersen,Michael A. Riegler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出无基准比较安全评分框架，通过工具有效性链在缺乏真实标签时验证安全评估。SimpleAudit在挪威语安全场景中表现优异(AUROC 0.89-1.00)，并在公共部门采购中验证实用性。核心发现：安全评估结果不可简化为单一排名，需同时报告多维度指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当特定语言、行业或监管领域的标记基准尚不存在时，如何比较候选语言模型的安全性成为难题。现有方法缺乏统一框架来评估和比较模型在这种情况下的安全表现。

Method: 提出"无基准比较安全评分"形式化框架，定义场景审计的契约条件。在固定场景包、评分规则、审计员、评判者、采样配置和重运行预算下保持有效。通过"工具有效性链"替代真实标签：控制安全vs消融对比的响应性、目标驱动方差主导审计员/评判者伪影、跨重运行稳定性。实现为SimpleAudit本地优先评分工具。

Result: SimpleAudit在挪威安全包上验证：安全与消融目标分离AUROC达0.89-1.00，目标身份是主导方差成分(η²≈0.52)，严重度分布在10次重运行后稳定。Petri框架支持两种工具。真实采购案例显示Borealis和Gemma 3的相对安全性随场景类别和风险度量而变化。

Conclusion: 在挪威公共部门采购案例中，更安全的模型取决于场景类别和风险度量。分数、匹配差值、关键率、不确定性及审计员和评判者必须一起报告，而非简化为单一排名。上游的工具差异主要体现在声明-契约执行和部署适配上。

Abstract: Many deployments must compare candidate language models for safety before a labeled benchmark exists for the relevant language, sector, or regulatory regime. We formalize this setting as benchmarkless comparative safety scoring and specify the contract under which a scenario-based audit can be interpreted as deployment evidence. Scores are valid only under a fixed scenario pack, rubric, auditor, judge, sampling configuration, and rerun budget. Because no labels are available, we replace ground-truth agreement with an instrumental-validity chain: responsiveness to a controlled safe-versus-abliterated contrast, dominance of target-driven variance over auditor and judge artifacts, and stability across reruns.
  We instantiate the chain in SimpleAudit, a local-first scoring instrument, and validate it on a Norwegian safety pack. Safe and abliterated targets separate with AUROC values between 0.89 and 1.00, target identity is the dominant variance component ($η^2 \approx 0.52$), and severity profiles stabilize by ten reruns. Applying the same chain to Petri shows that it admits both tools. The substantial differences arise upstream of the chain, in claim-contract enforcement and deployment fit. A Norwegian public-sector procurement case comparing Borealis and Gemma 3 demonstrates the resulting evidence in practice: the safer model depends on scenario category and risk measure. Consequently, scores, matched deltas, critical rates, uncertainty, and the auditor and judge used must be reported together rather than collapsed into a single ranking.

</details>


### [394] [When Brain Networks Travel: Learning Beyond Site](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06050)
*Yingxu Wang,Kunyu Zhang,Yanwu Yang,Thomas Wolfers,Yujie Wu,Siyang Gao,Nan Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CORE（Cross-site OOD Robust brain nEtwork），一个面向 fMRI 功能连接图跨站点分布外（OOD）泛化的统一框架：通过站点感知混淆解耦提取可复现的“人口骨架”连接，在骨架上以定长时序描述子刻画瞬态通路动力学并构建线图，再以先验引导的受试者自适应门控调制消息传递，在 ABIDE、REST-meta-MDD、SRPBS、ABCD 四个数据集的留一站点（LOSO）评测中全面优于 GCN/GAT/GIN、IRM/CORAL、GSAT/DisC/CEPG/DiSCO 以及多种脑网络专用基线，最高取得约 10.3% 的相对准确率提升，并在更换图谱（AAL-116 → CC200）后仍保持优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在 fMRI 脑网络分析（ASD、MDD、ADHD 分类）中已展现潜力，但在跨站点 OOD 场景下性能显著退化，原因有三：(1) 扫描仪参数与人口结构差异等站点条件化混淆在功能连接（FC）中诱发非病理性的“捷径”特征，模型易学习站点相关而非疾病相关的模式；(2) 现有 pooled/global 线性去混淆假设协变量—FC 关系跨站点不变，当协变量（如年龄）与某条 FC 边的关联随站点变化时，残差中仍留有站点偏置，污染诊断对比度并导致边的选择偏离病理依据；(3) 全扫描静态 FC 掩盖了扫描内的瞬态神经动力学，而完整动态 FC 序列维度高、长度随扫描时长与采样协议变化，难以在跨被试/跨站点间比较；(4) 仅依赖群体模式会忽略个体差异，仅依赖个体建模又会残留站点效应。核心问题是：如何同时化解站点条件化偏差、紧凑表达动态 FC、并在跨站点规律与受试者特异性之间取得平衡。

Method: 框架分三个阶段。(1) 站点感知混淆解耦：对每个源站点用 Huber 回归（IRLS，δ=1.345）逐边估计协变量效应与截距，标签系数 θ 被显式建模以保留诊断对比度（推理时无需标签）；对未见站点，用跨源一致性度量 u_e（各站点去混淆映射在源被试上的 L2 分歧）与归一化可靠性权重 α_e 聚合得到冻结的 (b̄_w, Γ̄_w) 做站点级校正。同时提出命题1证明 pooled 去混淆会在诊断对比度中引入 (Γ*_e−Γ_glob)^T D_e[q̃] 的残余偏置，而按站点去混淆可精确消除该项。(2) 跨站点骨架提取：在按站点残差化的 FC 上，用类别内 Huber 位置估计得到站点级诊断对比 d_e，取逐分量中位数形成站点平衡的共识对比 d_com（各站点等权，不受样本量影响），再以跨站点符号一致性 κ_j 与站点自助重采样（B=50）符号稳定性 π_j 配合幅值阈值 τ_E 筛选得到稀疏的“人口骨架” S（默认 τ_E 取训练站点 |d_com| 的 80 分位，η_E=0.75，ζ_E=0.70）。命题2给出“裕度稳定性”：当估计扰动 Δ_j 小于所依赖的最小裕度 m*_j 时，边在经验骨架与 oracle 骨架中的归属一致（由 Huber 位置估计的 ℓ∞ 非扩张性与加权中位数单调性保证）。(3) 瞬态通路建模：在骨架边上用滑窗（W=30, S_w=5）计算 Pearson 相关并做 Fisher-z 变换，压缩为时序波动性 s（标准差）与时序极差 f（max−min）两个与扫描长度无关的定长描述子，与去混淆静态 FC 拼接成 3 维节点特征 h_i,p^(0)；把共享 ROI 的骨架边组织为线图 G_line，邻接权重按共识对比绝对值的标准化先验 μ_0 相似度取 exp(−|μ_0,p−μ_0,p′|/Δ)，加自环并对称归一化。(4) 先验引导的受试者自适应门控：门控 logit 由节点局部特征与受试者全局上下文拼接经 MLP 得到，再加先验项 λμ_0,p（λ=0.3，温度 τ=1），门控在全部消息传递层中复用并同时用于读出（z_i = Σ g h / Σ g）；训练损失为交叉熵加软门预算正则 L = L_cls + β|Σg − K|（K=80，ABCD 为 150；β=5e-4）。骨干为两层 GCN（隐藏维 64），Adam lr 1e-3、weight decay 5e-4、batch 64、100 epoch，协变量 d=5（年龄、性别、头动、序列长度、TR，缺失用训练集中位数填补）。

Result: LOSO 主结果（Table 1）：CORE 在全部五个设定（ABIDE/AAL、ABIDE/CC200、REST-meta-MDD、SRPBS、ABCD）的 AUC 与 ACC 上均取得最优。ABIDE：AUC 65.65±6.42 / ACC 64.83±6.62（最佳基线 BrainOOD 63.82/59.66）；ABIDE-CC200：64.61±7.12 / 62.18±8.35；REST-meta-MDD：66.23±9.35 / 64.45±5.15（次优 LHDFormer 62.37/58.02）；SRPBS：92.35±7.04 / 87.31±10.52（DeCI 90.57/85.21）；ABCD：75.25±7.63 / 66.11±8.65（BrainOOD 72.77/64.36）。总体最高相对准确率提升 10.3%。t-SNE 显示 CORE 在 ABIDE 上对照组/ASD 分离更清晰。消融（w/o CD、w/o TP、w/o LG、w/o SG）在 ABIDE、REST-meta-MDD、SRPBS、ABCD 上均下降，说明站点感知去混淆、瞬态描述子、线图路径交互与门控各有贡献；其中 w/o TP 在 ABCD 上的 ACC 下降较小，说明门控收益在 AUC 上更明显。附录对照实验显示：手工的波动性+极差组合优于单独的波动性、MASD、GRU 编码与变化点分割；Subject-only 门控优于 Prior-only，二者结合最佳；CORE w/o TP 在 ABIDE/REST-meta-MDD 上仍超过代表性静态 FC 基线，说明性能并非仅来自时序信息；ID 设置下 CORE 同样取得最高平均 AUC（全部五个设定）并在三个数据集取得最高 ACC（ABIDE 两个图谱下 ACC 略低于 DeCI）。敏感性分析：ABIDE/REST-meta-MDD/SRPBS 在 K=80 附近最优（ABCD 随 K 增大仍在提升），滑窗 (30,5) 最优，骨架阈值 τ_E=80 分位、η_E=0.75、ζ_E=0.70 为最优默认值。可解释性：Top-10 正向骨架连接（下顶叶—角回、丘脑—颞叶、额中回—角回、扣带—枕叶、苍白球—中央旁小叶等）覆盖皮层—皮层下回路，与 ASD 默认网络/额顶、丘脑皮层、显著性网络、纹状体研究一致；100 次折-运行重采样下多数边选择频率高、符号一致性高（κ 0.84–0.94）。门控分析显示组内与组间余弦相似度差异极小（ΔS=0.0005），说明门控并非充当捷径分类器，而是先验共享权重叠加个体微调。效率上 CORE 每 epoch 训练时间（ABIDE 0.15s）快于 BrainOOD/BrainNetTF/AGMGC/XG-GNN，显存与轻量基线相当。

Conclusion: CORE 将站点感知去混淆（含可靠性加权聚合的未见站点校正）、以稀疏人口骨架为载体的定长瞬态通路描述与线图建模、以及先验引导的受试者自适应门控整合为一个统一框架，在四个真实多站点 fMRI 数据集的 LOSO 评测中稳定优于通用 GNN、通用 OOD、图 OOD 与脑网络专用基线，并具备图谱鲁棒性与可接受的计算开销。其理论价值在于两条命题：量化了 pooled 去混淆在诊断对比度上的残余偏置来源，并给出骨架筛选的裕度稳定性条件。局限与展望：可靠性加权只能减弱而非消除未见站点的残余偏置（站点级协变量仅在聚合去混淆处起作用）；时序描述子仍是手工设计的全局量，尚未利用采集参数差异；去混淆依赖协变量完整可用，作者提出未来将扩展到协变量不完备情形，并探索采集感知的时序描述子。

Abstract: Graph-based learning on functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has shown strong potential for brain network analysis. However, existing methods degrade under cross-site out-of-distribution (OOD) settings because site-conditioned confounders induce non-pathological shortcuts, while functional connectivity constructed by temporal averaging obscures transient neurodynamics, limiting generalization to unseen sites. In this paper, we propose Cross-site OOD Robust brain nEtwork (CORE), a unified framework for brain network learning across unseen sites. CORE first performs site-aware confounder decoupling to mitigate site-conditioned bias and extract a cross-site population scaffold of reproducible diagnostic connectivity edges. It then profiles transient pathway dynamics over this scaffold using lightweight temporal descriptors and organizes scaffold edges into a line graph for transferable pathway-level modeling. Finally, CORE introduces a prior-guided subject-adaptive gating mechanism that leverages scaffold-derived population priors while preserving subject-specific connectivity variability. Extensive experiments under leave-one-site-out evaluation on real-world datasets (ABIDE, REST-meta-MDD, SRPBS, and ABCD) show that CORE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 6.7% relative gain. Furthermore, CORE remains robust to atlas variations, maintaining performance gains across different brain parcellation schemes.

</details>


### [395] [Verifier-Backed Hard Problem Generation for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06660)
*Yuhang Lai,Jiazhan Feng,Yee Whye Teh,Ning Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VHG框架，通过在三玩家自我博弈中引入验证器，解决了LLM生成有效难题的难题。两个验证器变体（符号/LLM）在数学任务上均显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在解决科学和数学问题方面表现出色，但在生成有效、具有挑战性和新颖性的问题方面存在困难。现有方法依赖昂贵的人工专家或采用朴素的自我博弈范式，容易产生因奖励黑客而导致的无有效问题。

Method: 提出VHG框架，基于三玩家自我博弈（Setter-Solver-Verifier）：验证器评估问题有效性，解答器评估问题难度，两者共同约束生成器的奖励。具体实现包括两种验证器变体：硬符号验证器和软LLM验证器。

Result: 在不定积分任务和通用数学推理任务上的实验表明，VHG显著且清晰地超越了所有基线方法。

Conclusion: VHG通过引入验证器构建三玩家自我博弈机制，有效解决了LLM生成问题中的奖励黑客和无效问题难题，在不定积分和数学推理任务上显著优于所有基线方法。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities for solving scientific and mathematical problems, yet they struggle to produce valid, challenging, and novel problems - an essential component for advancing LLM training and enabling autonomous scientific research. Existing problem generation approaches either depend on expensive human expert involvement or adopt naive self-play paradigms, which frequently yield invalid problems due to reward hacking. This work introduces VHG, a verifier-enhanced hard problem generation framework built upon three-party self-play. By integrating an independent verifier into the conventional setter-solver duality, our design constrains the setter's reward to be jointly determined by problem validity (evaluated by the verifier) and difficulty (assessed by the solver). We instantiate two verifier variants: a Hard symbolic verifier and a Soft LLM-based verifier, with evaluations conducted on indefinite integral tasks and general mathematical reasoning tasks. Experimental results show that VHG substantially outperforms all baseline methods by a clear margin.

</details>


### [396] [Towards Generation-Efficient Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06053)
*Mingcheng Zhu,Yu Liu,Tingting Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）不确定性估计的低成本方法，挑战了"必须完成完整生成才能估计不确定性"的传统假设，提出了统一的"早期估计"框架，并在此框架下开发了两种新方法：基于部分生成前缀的Logit Magnitude和基于输入提示的MetaUE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗、金融等高风险应用中，LLM的幻觉问题难以被用户察觉，现有不确定性估计方法需要完整自回归生成，导致高昂的推理成本，亟需更高效的不确定性估计方案。

Method: (1) 建立统一框架，将不确定性估计形式化为LLM自回归生成过程的"早期估计"问题，按观察信息量组织现有方法；(2) 提出Logit Magnitude：利用top-M logit在早停生成前缀上估计不确定性；(3) 提出MetaUE：将基于生成的不确定性蒸馏为轻量级输入-only估计器。

Result: Logit Magnitude在多个通用和领域特定基准上表现优异，部分生成前缀通常足以实现有效的不确定性估计；MetaUE在多种设置下提供了具有竞争力的输入-only近似。

Conclusion: 有效的不确定性估计所需生成量比通常假设的更少，支持在更早阶段识别不可靠响应，为低成本LLM不确定性估计提供了理论基础和实践方案。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimation is important for deploying LLMs in high-stakes applications such as healthcare and finance, where hallucinations can appear fluent and plausible while being factually incorrect, making it difficult for users to judge whether an output should be trusted. Existing methods require one or more full autoregressive generations to estimate uncertainty, which introduces substantial inference cost and often delays uncertainty assessment. In this paper, we investigate whether effective uncertainty estimation can be achieved with partial generation or even input-only information. Specifically, we first develop a unified framework that formulates uncertainty estimation as an early estimation problem over the autoregressive generation process of LLMs. This framework organises existing and proposed estimators by the information they observe, ranging from multi-generation to input-only prediction, and clarifies the performance-cost trade-off underlying different uncertainty estimation methods. Building on this view, we study two largely underexplored low-cost settings: estimating uncertainty with part of the generation, and predicting uncertainty from the input prompt. We propose Logit Magnitude, which uses top-M logit evidence to estimate uncertainty from an early-stopped generation prefix, and MetaUE, which distils generation-based uncertainty into a lightweight input-only estimator trained with uncertainty scores. Extensive experiments on general and domain-specific benchmarks show that Logit Magnitude achieves strong performance, and partial generations of LLMs are often sufficient for effective uncertainty estimation. MetaUE further provides a competitive input-only approximation in several settings. These findings suggest that effective uncertainty estimation requires less generation than commonly assumed, enabling unreliable responses to be identified earlier.

</details>


### [397] [Towards Self-Explainable Document Visual Question Answering with Chain-of-Explanation Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06058)
*Kjetil Indrehus,Adrian Duric,Changkyu Choi,Ali Ramezani-Kebrya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoExVQA是一种自解释的文档视觉问答框架，通过链式解释设计实现可验证的推理过程。模型首先识别问题相关证据，再定位答案区域，最后仅从定位区域解码答案。该方法在PFL-DocVQA上实现SotA可解释DocVQA性能，ANLS提升12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DocVQA模型将问题相关证据与答案定位耦合，以黑盒方式运作，缺乏验证预测如何依赖视觉证据的手段。这限制了模型的可解释性和可信度。

Method: 提出CoExVQA框架，采用链式解释(Chain-of-Explanation)设计：(1)识别问题相关证据；(2)显式定位答案区域；(3)仅从定位区域解码答案。预测过程支持跨模态的直接检验和验证。

Result: 在PFL-DocVQA数据集上，将解码限制于定位证据后，达到可解释DocVQA的SotA性能，ANLS指标较当前可解释基线提升12%。

Conclusion: CoExVQA通过链式解释机制提供透明、可验证的预测，使推理过程可直接跨模态检验。

Abstract: Document Visual Question Answering (DocVQA) requires vision-language models to reason not only about what information in a document is relevant to a question, but also where the answer is grounded on the page. Existing DocVQA models entangle question-relevant evidence and answer localization and operate largely as black boxes, offering limited means to verify how predictions depend on visual evidence. We propose CoExVQA, a self-explainable DocVQA framework with a grounded reasoning process through a chain-of-explanation design. CoExVQA first identifies question-relevant evidence, then explicitly localizes the answer region, and finally decodes the answer exclusively from the grounded region. Prediction via CoExVQA's chain-of-explanation enables direct inspection and verification of the reasoning process across modalities. Empirical results show that restricting decoding to grounded evidence achieves SotA explainable DocVQA performance on PFL-DocVQA, improving ANLS by 12% over the current explainable baselines while providing transparent and verifiable predictions.

</details>


### [398] [Geometry-Aware Simplicial Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06061)
*Elena Xinyi Wang,Bastian Rieck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GSWL测试，将坐标信息融入单纯复形的颜色细化，解决了传统WL测试无法区分几何差异的问题，建立了几何感知消息传递方案表达能力上界，并与ECT结合提供了完整的几何表达能力特征和逼近框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WL测试及其单纯扩展(SWL)无法捕捉几何信息，无法区分具有相同连通性但不同嵌入的网格。

Method: 提出几何单纯Weisfeiler-Lehman (GSWL)测试，将顶点坐标融入颜色细化过程中。

Result: 证明了几何感知单纯消息传递方案的表达能力被GSWL上界限定；在任何固定有限族的几何单纯复形上，GSWL的区分能力可被这些方案匹配。

Conclusion: GSWL测试与ECT结合，为几何单纯复形提供了几何表达能力特征和逼近框架。实验验证了从组合到几何感知模型的清晰层次结构。

Abstract: The Weisfeiler--Lehman (WL) test and its simplicial extension (SWL) characterize the combinatorial expressivity of message passing networks, but they are blind to geometry, i.e., meshes with identical connectivity but different embeddings are indistinguishable. We introduce the Geometric Simplicial Weisfeiler--Lehman (GSWL) test, which incorporates vertex coordinates into color refinement for geometric simplicial complexes. In addition, we show that (i) the expressivity of geometry-aware simplicial message passing schemes is bounded above by GSWL, and (ii) that there exist parameters such that the discriminating power of GSWL is matched by these schemes on any fixed finite family of geometric simplicial complexes. Combined with the Euler Characteristic Transform (ECT), a complete invariant for geometric simplicial complexes, this yields a geometric expressivity characterization together with an approximation framework. Experiments on synthetic and mesh datasets serve to validate our theory, showing a clear hierarchy from combinatorial to geometry-aware models.

</details>


### [399] [Causal Reinforcement Learning for Complex Card Games: A Magic The Gathering Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06066)
*Cristiano da Costa Cunha,Ajmal Mian,Tim French,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MTG-Causal-RL是一个基于Magic: The Gathering的Gymnasium基准，包含3077维部分观测、478动作的掩码离散动作空间、5种竞争标准原型、3种奖励方案，以及一个手动的战略变量结构因果模型(SCM)。该基准将因果变量、SCM预测的干预效果和每因子信用追踪作为第一类指标，首次将因果归因、跨原型迁移和政策审计作为核心评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果强化学习缺乏基准测试，无法同时满足以下复杂系统的需求：序列决策、隐藏信息、大规模掩码动作空间、以及明确的因果结构。

Method: 提出CGFA-PPO（因果图-分解优势PPO）作为参考因果智能体，使用胜率的SCM父节点作为因子对齐的评论家目标，并引入干预校准损失。

Result: 掩码PPO和CGFA-PPO达到具有竞争力的同分布胜率并显著超越随机基线；因子校准轨迹和留一法迁移差距揭示了标量胜率无法呈现的诊断结构。

Conclusion: MTG-Causal-RL为因果RL、世界模型和LLM-agent研究提供了一个共享测试平台，能够同时研究：掩码动作空间下的因果归因、跨原型结构迁移、以及基于SCM的政策可审计性。

Abstract: Causal reinforcement learning (RL) lacks benchmarks for complex systems that combine sequential decision making, hidden information, large masked action spaces, and explicit causal structure. We introduce MTG-Causal-RL, a Gymnasium benchmark built on Magic: The Gathering with a 3,077-dimensional partial observation, a 478-action masked discrete action space, five competitive Standard archetypes, three reward schemes, and a hand-specified Structural Causal Model (SCM) over strategic variables. Every episode exposes causal variables, SCM-predicted intervention effects, and per-factor credit traces, making causal credit assignment, leave-one-out cross-archetype transfer, and policy auditability first-class metrics. We adapt a panel of reference baselines: random, heuristic, masked PPO, a causal-world-model PPO variant, and an architecture-matched scalar control. We propose Causal Graph-Factored Advantage PPO (CGFA-PPO) as a reference causal agent that uses SCM parents of win probability as factor-aligned critic targets with an intervention-calibration loss. All comparisons use paired seeds, paired-bootstrap confidence intervals, and Holm-Bonferroni correction within pre-registered families. Masked PPO and CGFA-PPO reach competitive in-distribution win rates and exceed the random baseline; per-factor calibration trajectories and leave-one-out transfer gaps expose diagnostic structure that scalar win rate alone cannot. We release the benchmark, reference-baseline results, and full evaluation protocol openly. By coupling a strategically rich, partially observed domain with an explicit causal interface and statistical protocol, MTG-Causal-RL gives causal-RL, world-model, and LLM-agent research a shared testbed for questions current benchmarks cannot pose together: causal credit assignment under masked action spaces, structural transfer across archetypes, and SCM-grounded policy auditability.

</details>


### [400] [Normalized Architectures are Natively 4-Bit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06067)
*Maxim Fishman,Brian Chmiel,Ron Banner,Daniel Soudry,Boris Ginsburg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: nGPT通过将权重和隐藏表示约束到单位超球面，增强了模型对低精度算术的鲁棒性，无需Hadamard变换或按张量缩放等干预即可实现稳定的NVFP4训练，在1.2B dense模型和高达3B/30B参数的MoE模型上验证有效，且随着隐藏维度增长优势递增。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练大语言模型需要4位精度以提高效率，但标准架构在低精度下需要额外干预（如Hadamard变换和逐张量缩放）来维持模型质量。

Method: 提出nGPT架构，将权重和隐藏表示约束到单位超球面，利用点积在不同架构中的信号累积差异实现鲁棒性。

Result: 在1.2B dense模型和混合（Mamba-Transformer）MoE模型（最高3B/30B参数）上验证了稳定端到端NVFP4训练，无需额外干预。

Conclusion: nGPT的超球面约束增强了元素乘积间的弱正相关性，使信号在隐藏维度上constructively累积，而噪声继续平均消散，从而获得更高的有效信噪比和更平坦的损失景观。该效应随隐藏维度增长而增强，暗示在大规模场景下优势更大。

Abstract: Training large language models at 4-bit precision is critical for efficiency. We show that nGPT, an architecture that constrains weights and hidden representations to the unit hypersphere, is inherently more robust to low-precision arithmetic. This removes the need for interventions-such as applying random Hadamard transforms and performing per-tensor scaling calculations-to preserve model quality, and it enables stable end-to-end NVFP4 training. We validate this approach on both a 1.2B dense model and hybrid (Mamba-Transformer) MoE models of up to 3B/30B parameters. We trace this robustness to the dot product: while quantization noise remains largely uncorrelated in both standard and normalized architectures, the signal behaves differently. In nGPT, the hypersphere constraint enhances weak positive correlations among the element-wise products, leading to a constructive accumulation of the signal across the hidden dimension while the noise continues to average out. This yields a higher effective signal-to-noise ratio and a flatter loss landscape, with the effect strengthening as the hidden dimension grows, suggesting increasing advantages at scale. A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/anonymous452026/ngpt-nvfp4

</details>


### [401] [PRISM: Iterative Cross-Modal Posterior Refinement for Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06073)
*Trimble Chang,Yihang Liu,Mingjing Han,Han Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Dynamic text-attributed graphs (DyTAGs) provide a powerful framework for modeling evolving systems in which node semantics and time-dependent interactions are tightly coupled. Recently, multimodal learning has emerged as a promising yet underexplored direction for enhancing DyTAG representation learning. However, existing methods typically rely on rigid modality partitions and one-shot fusion strategies, which limit their ability to capture the intrinsic and evolving dependencies between node semantics and interaction behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PRISM}, an iterative cross-modal posterior refinement framework for DyTAG representation learning. PRISM organizes DyTAG information into semantic and behavioral modalities, providing a more intrinsic alternative to carrier-level modality partitions. Instead of fusing the two modalities in a single step, PRISM learns a refinement trajectory that progressively transforms semantic priors into behavior-conditioned posterior states through cross-modal interaction with behavioral evidence. Extensive experiments on DTGB benchmark datasets show that PRISM achieves strong performance on temporal link prediction and destination node retrieval tasks. Further ablation studies validate the effectiveness of semantic--behavioral modeling and iterative posterior refinement.

However, existing methods typically rely on rigid modality partitions and one-shot fusion strategies, which limit their ability to capture the intrinsic and evolving dependencies between node semantics and interaction behaviors. ### [402] [Understanding diffusion models requires rethinking (again) generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06077)
*Pierre Marion,Yu-Han Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文认为理解扩散模型的泛化需要超越经典统计学习理论和监督学习中的"良性过拟合"范式的新理论框架。扩散模型中记忆化与泛化是不相容的——完全记忆训练集的模型只能生成复制品而非新数据。文章呼吁研究重心从解释"扩散模型为何不记忆化"转向探究"模型在前记忆化阶段实际学到了什么"，并通过CIFAR-10数据集进行实证研究来支持这一立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典统计学习理论和监督学习中发展出的"良性过拟合"范式无法有效解释扩散模型的泛化现象。在扩散模型中，对训练数据的记忆化与生成新样本本质上是不相容的，这要求建立全新的理论框架来理解其泛化机制。

Method: 对CIFAR-10数据集上训练的扩散模型进行实证研究，将发现归纳为具体的开放性问题。

Result: 尽管记忆化与生成新数据在理论上不相容，但实际扩散模型仍表现出泛化能力。研究揭示了容量限制、优化过程的隐式正则化以及架构归纳偏置等因素可能共同作用于此现象。

Conclusion: 领域研究应从解释"扩散模型为何不记忆化"转向探究"模型在前记忆化阶段实际学习什么"。需建立新理论框架，并通过实证研究提出关键开放问题以推动对该领域的理解。

Abstract: This position paper argues that understanding generalization in diffusion models requires fundamentally new theoretical frameworks that go beyond both classical statistical learning theory and the benign overfitting paradigm developed for supervised learning. In diffusion models, unlike in supervised learning, memorization of training data and generalization to novel samples are incompatible: a model that has fully memorized its training set generates copies rather than novel data. Several theoretical explanations for why practical diffusion models nevertheless generalize have been proposed, based on capacity limitations, implicit regularization from optimization, or architectural inductive biases, but their interactions remain unclear. We argue that the field should pivot from explaining why the diffusion models do not memorize to investigating what the model actually learns during pre-memorization phase. To highlight our stance, we conduct empirical study of diffusion models trained on CIFAR-10, and we distill the findings into concrete open questions that we believe are key to improve understanding of generalization in diffusion models.

</details>


### [403] [Fast Gauss-Newton for Multiclass Cross-Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06081)
*Mikalai Korbit,Mario Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将多类softmax交叉熵的广义Gauss-Newton(GGN)精确分解为true-vs-rest项和类内协方差项，提出Fast Gauss-Newton(FGN)仅保留前者作为正定下近似。FGN在二分类时精确，且可通过共轭梯度法高效求解，实验验证其在竞品质量集中或阻尼较大时表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多类softmax交叉熵中，完整的广义Gauss-Newton(GGN)曲率通过softmax协方差耦合所有输出logits，随着类别数增长，曲率向量乘积的缩放变得更加困难。

Method: 1) 将多类GGN精确分解为true-vs-rest项和类内协方差项；2) FGN仅保留前者，drop掉后者作为近似；3) 利用FGN曲率结构，将阻尼更新转化为等价的白化行空间系统；4) 使用共轭梯度法通过Jacobian-vector和vector-Jacobian乘积进行无矩阵求解。

Result: FGN在竞品质量集中或阻尼较大时最接近完整softmax GGN；随着被丢弃的类内协方差增大而偏离。通过针对机制实验和固定特征多类头的评估验证了分解预测。

Conclusion: FGN提供了一个实用的近似方案，在竞品质量集中或阻尼较大时效果最佳。该方法通过矩阵-free的共轭梯度求解，使得高类别数场景下的二阶优化变得可行。

Abstract: In multiclass softmax cross-entropy, the full generalized Gauss-Newton (GGN) curvature couples all output logits through the softmax covariance, making curvature-vector products harder to scale as the number of classes grows. We show that the standard multiclass GGN can be decomposed exactly into a true-vs-rest term and a positive semidefinite within-competitor covariance term. Fast Gauss-Newton (FGN) retains the first term and drops the second, yielding a positive semidefinite under-approximation of the multiclass GGN that is exact for binary classification. The derivation uses an exact true-vs-rest scalar-margin representation of softmax cross-entropy: the loss and gradient are unchanged, and the approximation enters only at the curvature level. Exploiting the FGN curvature structure, the damped update can be written as an equivalent whitened row-space system with one row per mini-batch example. We solve this system matrix-free by conjugate gradient using Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products of the scalar margin map. Targeted mechanism experiments and an evaluation on a fixed-feature multiclass head support the predictions from the decomposition: FGN stays closest to the full softmax GGN when competitor mass is concentrated or damping is large, and deviates as the dropped within-competitor covariance grows.

</details>


### [404] [Beyond Autoregressive RTG: Conditioning via Injection Outside Sequential Modeling in Decision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06104)
*Yongyi Wang,Hanyu Liu,Lingfeng Li,Bozhou Chen,Ang Li,Qirui Zheng,Xionghui Yang,Chucai Wang,Wenxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SlimDT通过将RTG信息从自回归token流中解耦并注入到状态表示中，将序列长度缩短三分之一，在D4RL基准上超越标准Decision Transformer并达到SOTA性能，实现计算效率与任务性能的双重提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策转换器（DT）将离线强化学习形式化为自回归序列建模，通过从回报待到（RTG）、状态和动作的token序列中预测动作取得了良好效果。然而，RTG是一个标量，概括了未来奖励信息，其信息量远少于典型的状态或动作向量，却消耗相同计算资源。更糟的是，Transformer的自注意力成本随序列长度呈二次增长，将RTG作为独立token会产生不必要的计算开销。

Method: SlimDT将RTG从自回归序列中移除，改为在序列建模步骤之前将RTG信息注入到状态表示中，使Transformer仅需处理紧凑的（状态，动作）序列，从而将序列长度缩短至原来的三分之一。

Result: 序列长度减少三分之一，推理效率直接提升。在D4RL基准测试中，SlimDT在多种任务上超越标准DT，并达到与现有最先进方法相当的性能水平。

Conclusion: SlimDT通过将稀疏的条件信号（RTG）与信息丰富的序列（状态-动作）解耦，实现了计算效率提升和任务性能提高的双重收益。SlimDT在D4RL基准测试中超越了标准DT，并达到了与现有最先进方法相当的性能水平。

Abstract: Decision Transformer (DT) formulates offline reinforcement learning as autoregressive sequence modeling, achieving promising results by predicting actions from a sequence of Return-to-Go (RTG), state, and action tokens. However, RTG is a scalar that summarizes future rewards, containing far less information than typical state or action vectors, yet it consumes the same computational budget per token. Worse, the self-attention cost of Transformers grows quadratically with sequence length, so including RTG as a separate token adds unnecessary overhead. We propose SlimDT, which removes RTG from the autoregressive sequence. Instead, we inject RTG information into the state representations before the sequential modeling step, allowing the Transformer to process only a compact (state, action) sequence. This reduces the sequence length by one-third, directly improving inference efficiency. On the D4RL benchmark, SlimDT surpasses standard DT across various tasks and achieves performance comparable to existing state-of-the-art methods. Decoupling a sparse conditioning signal from an information-rich sequence thus yields both computational gains and higher task performance.

</details>


### [405] [BoostLLM: Boosting-inspired LLM Fine-tuning for Few-shot Tabular Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06117)
*Yi-Siang Wang,Kuan-Yu Chen,Yu-Chen Den,Darby Tien-Hao Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been adapted to tabular prediction by serializing structured features into natural language, but their performance in low-data regimes remains limited compared to gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDTs). In this work, we revisit the boosting paradigm, traditionally associated with tree ensembles, and ask whether it can be applied as a general training principle for LLM fine-tuning. We propose BoostLLM, a framework that transforms parameter-efficient fine-tuning into a multi-round residual optimization process by training sequential PEFT adapters as weak learners. To incorporate tabular inductive bias, BoostLLM integrates decision-tree paths as a second input view alongside raw features; analysis reveals that the path view acts as a structured teacher in early training steps before the model shifts toward feature-driven representations. Empirically, BoostLLM achieves consistent improvements over standard fine-tuning across multiple LLM backbones and datasets, matching or surpassing XGBoost across a wide range of shot counts and outperforming GPT-4o-based methods with a 4B model. We further show that the framework scales: pairing with stronger tree models and extended boosting horizons yields additional gains under appropriate stabilization. These results suggest that boosting can serve as a general training principle for LLM fine-tuning, particularly in low-data regimes for structured data.

### [406] [Listwise Policy Optimization: Group-based RLVR as Target-Projection on the LLM Response Simplex](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06139)
*Yun Qu,Qi Wang,Yixiu Mao,Heming Zou,Yuhang Jiang,Yingyue Li,Wutong Xu,Lizhou Cai,Weijie Liu,Clive Bai,Kai Yang,Yangkun Chen,Saiyong Yang,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard approach for large language models (LLMs) post-training to incentivize reasoning capacity. Among existing recipes, group-based policy gradient is prevalent, which samples a group of responses per prompt and updates the policy via group-relative advantage signals. This work reveals that these optimization strategies share a common geometric structure: each implicitly defines a target distribution on the response simplex and projects toward it via first-order approximation. Building on this insight, we propose Listwise Policy Optimization (LPO) to explicitly conduct the target-projection, which demystifies the implicit target by restricting the proximal RL objective to the response simplex, and then projects the policy via exact divergence minimization. This framework provides (i) monotonic improvement on the listwise objective with bounded, zero-sum, and self-correcting projection gradients, and (ii) flexibility in divergence selection with distinct structural properties through the decoupled projection step. On diverse reasoning tasks and LLM backbones, LPO consistently improves training performance over typical policy gradient baselines under matched targets, while intrinsically preserving optimization stability and response diversity.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard approach for large language models (LLMs) post-training to incentivize reasoning capacity. Among existing recipes, group-based policy gradient is prevalent, which samples a group of responses per prompt and updates the policy via group-relative advantage signals. This work reveals that these optimization strategies share a common geometric structure: each implicitly defines a target distribution on the response simplex and projects toward it via first-order approximation. Building on this insight, we propose Listwise Policy Optimization (LPO) to explicitly conduct the target-projection, which demystifies the implicit target by restricting the proximal RL objective to the response simplex, and then projects the policy via exact divergence minimization. This framework provides (i) monotonic improvement on the listwise objective with bounded, zero-sum, and self-correcting projection gradients, and (ii) flexibility in divergence selection with distinct structural properties through the decoupled projection step. On diverse reasoning tasks and LLM backbones, LPO consistently improves training performance over typical policy gradient baselines under matched targets, while intrinsically preserving optimization stability and response diversity.

</details>


### [407] [SymDrift: One-Shot Generative Modeling under Symmetries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06140)
*Samir Darouich,Vinh Tong,Lluís Pastor-Pérez,Tanja Bien,Loay Mualem,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Generative modeling of physical systems, such as molecules, requires learning distributions that are invariant under global symmetries, such as rotations in three-dimensional space. Equivariant diffusion and flow matching models can incorporate such invariances effectively, even when trained on a non-invariant empirical distribution, but they typically rely on costly multi-step sampling. Recently, drifting models have emerged as an efficient alternative, enabling single-step generation and achieving state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling tasks. However, we show that drifting models face a symmetry-specific challenge, since an equivariant generator does not generally produce the same drifting field as the one obtained from the symmetrized target distribution. Addressing this issue would require expensive symmetrization of the empirical distribution. To avoid this cost, we propose SymDrift, a framework that makes the drifting field itself symmetry-aware. We introduce two complementary strategies: (i) a symmetrized drift in coordinate space based on optimal alignment, and (ii) a $G$-invariant embedding that removes symmetry ambiguity by construction. Empirically, SymDrift outperforms existing one-shot methods on standard benchmarks for conformer and transition state generation, while remaining competitive with significantly more expensive multi-step approaches. By enabling one-shot inference, SymDrift reduces computational overhead by up to 40$\times$ compared to existing baselines, making it promising for high-throughput applications such as virtual drug screening and large-scale reaction network exploration.

### [408] [Matrix-Valued Optimism is Matrix-Valued Augmentation: Additive Hybrid Designs for Constrained Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06141)
*Jiayi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了增广拉格朗日与乐观原始对偶方法在矩阵值校正层面的等价性，提出加性原理并利用设计自由度推导出闭式混合校正规则，实验验证了混合策略的有效性，但指出该方法在强病态问题上的固有局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增广拉格朗日方法和乐观原始对偶方法通过不同机制稳定等式约束优化：前者增加约束依赖的原始曲率，后者增加对偶记忆。现有关于标量参数等价性的工作需要推广到矩阵情形以统一理解并利用设计自由度。

Method: 通过将标量参数等价性推广到矩阵值校正情形，证明了对称矩阵参数的理想原始轨迹仅取决于校正矩阵的总和而非其在两通道间的分配方式，从而暴露了设计自由度。结合局部谱权重的矩阵校正分裂与步长选择方法，推导了闭式混合规则。

Result: 实验表明混合设计策略优于纯增广和纯乐观端点方法，能紧密跟踪网格搜索混合预言器，在轻度至中度病态条件下与一阶原始对偶基线方法具有竞争力。局限性在于精确抵消需要随约束雅可比矩阵病态性增加而增大矩阵校正量。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了增广拉格朗日与乐观原始对偶方法在矩阵值校正上的等价性框架，并提出了实用的混合设计规则，在约束雅可比矩阵病态程度为轻度至中度时具有良好的实用价值，但精确抵消能力随病态性增加而下降。

Abstract: Augmented Lagrangian and optimistic primal--dual methods stabilize equality-constrained optimization through seemingly different mechanisms: the former adds constraint-dependent primal curvature, while the latter adds dual memory. Recent work has shown that these mechanisms are equivalent for scalar parameters. We extend this equivalence to matrix-valued correction. We prove an additivity principle: for symmetric matrix parameters, the ideal primal trajectory depends only on the summed correction matrix, not on how it is split between augmented and optimistic channels. This exposes a design freedom: algebraically equivalent decompositions can have different finite-step feasibility because augmented correction affects primal curvature, whereas optimistic correction affects the scale of the dual memory correction. We formulate the resulting step-size-limited design problem and derive a closed-form hybrid rule that selects a matrix correction, splits it between the two channels, and chooses primal and dual steps using local spectral weights. Experiments on nonlinear equality-constrained problems with controlled constraint-Jacobian conditioning show that the hybrid design improves over pure augmented and pure optimistic endpoints, closely tracks a grid-search hybrid oracle, and is competitive with first-order primal--dual baselines under mild-to-moderate ill-conditioning. The experiments also identify the expected limitation: exact cancellation requires increasingly large matrix corrections as the constraint Jacobian becomes ill-conditioned.

</details>


### [409] [Unifying Goal-Conditioned RL and Unsupervised Skill Learning via Control-Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06145)
*Alireza Modirshanechi,Benjamin Eysenbach,Peter Dayan,Eric Schulz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The paper theoretically unifies goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) and mutual information skill learning (MISL) under control maximization, shows that three canonical GCRL formulations are inequivalent but share a goal-sensitivity interpretation, and proves that MISL objectives are bounded by formulation-specific downstream goal-sensitivities, providing theoretical foundation and practical guidance for RL pretraining.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Despite empirical success of unsupervised pretraining in GCRL, its theoretical foundations are poorly understood. It remains unclear why skills learned through MISL should support goal-reaching, complicated by the fact that both GCRL and MISL are umbrella terms with distinct criteria and objectives.

Method: Theoretical analysis unifying GCRL and MISL as instances of control maximization, proving inequivalence of three canonical GCRL formulations, and establishing bounds between MISL objectives and formulation-specific downstream goal-sensitivities.

Result: Three canonical GCRL formulations are fundamentally inequivalent (can induce incompatible optimal policies in the same environment). However, they share a common interpretation: well-performing goal-conditioned policies have goal-sensitive future trajectories. MISL objectives are bounded by formulation-specific downstream goal-sensitivities, establishing precise correspondence between MISL methods and downstream GCRL tasks.

Conclusion: MISL objectives can be matched to specific downstream GCRL tasks based on goal-sensitivity bounds, providing practical guidance for selecting pretraining objectives for specific downstream tasks.

Abstract: Unsupervised pretraining has driven empirical advances in goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), but its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In particular, an influential class of methods, mutual information skill learning (MISL), discovers behaviorally diverse skills that can later be used for downstream goal-reaching. However, it remains a theoretical mystery why skills learned through MISL should support goal-reaching. A subtle challenge is that both GCRL and MISL are umbrella terms: different GCRL tasks use distinct criteria for measuring goal-reaching performance, while different MISL methods optimize distinct notions of behavioral diversity. We address this challenge and unify GCRL and MISL as instances of control maximization. We identify three canonical GCRL formulations and prove that they are fundamentally inequivalent: they can induce incompatible optimal policies even in the same environment. Nevertheless, they all share a common interpretation: a well-performing goal-conditioned policy is one whose future trajectory is highly sensitive to the commanded goal, with the precise notion of sensitivity determined by the GCRL formulation. Noting that MISL objectives can be understood as measures of skill-sensitivity akin to goal-sensitivity, we show that MISL objectives are bounded by formulation-specific downstream goal-sensitivities. These bounds establish a precise correspondence between MISL methods and downstream GCRL tasks: for every GCRL formulation, there exists a matching MISL objective for which more diverse skills afford greater downstream goal sensitivity. Our results thus lay a theoretical foundation for RL pretraining and have important practical implications, such as suggesting which pretraining objectives to use when a user cares about a specific class of downstream tasks.

</details>


### [410] [AdaGamma: State-Dependent Discounting for Temporal Adaptation in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06149)
*Yaomin Wang,Jianting Pan,Ran Tian,Xiaoyang Li,Yu Zhang,Hengle Qin,Tianshu YU*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaGamma，一种在深度行动者-评论家框架中实现状态依赖折扣的实用方法。通过回报一致性目标防止退化，结合SAC和PPO验证了在连续控制任务和真实物流场景中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度强化学习方法使用固定折扣因子，无法适应不同状态的最优规划时域。状态依赖折扣虽具概念吸引力，但直接实现会导致训练不稳定和TD-error崩溃。

Method: AdaGamma提出了一种实用的深度行动者-评论家方法，核心创新包括：(1) 学习状态依赖的折扣函数；(2) 引入回报一致性目标作为正则化手段，防止目标操纵导致退化；(3) 理论分析了状态依赖折扣诱导的Bellman算子的基本适定性条件。

Result: AdaGamma成功集成到SAC和PPO框架中，在连续控制基准测试中取得一致改进，并在京东物流平台在线A/B测试中获得统计显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: AdaGamma通过将状态依赖折扣与回报一致性目标相结合，在深度强化学习中实现了一种既灵活又稳定的折扣机制。该方法在理论上完善了变折扣Bellman算子的适定性分析，在实践上验证了其在连续控制基准和真实物流平台上的有效性，为深度RL中的时域规划提供了一种新思路。

Abstract: The discount factor in reinforcement learning controls both the effective planning horizon and the strength of bootstrapping, yet most deep RL methods use a single fixed value across all states. While state-dependent discounting is conceptually appealing, naive deep actor--critic implementations can become unstable and degenerate toward TD-error collapse. We propose AdaGamma, a practical deep actor--critic method for state-dependent discounting that learns a state-dependent discount function together with a return-consistency objective to regularize the induced backup structure. On the theory side, we analyze the Bellman operator induced by state-dependent discounting and establish its basic well-posedness properties under suitable conditions. Empirically, AdaGamma integrates into both SAC and PPO, yielding consistent improvements on continuous-control benchmarks, and achieves statistically significant gains in an online A/B test on the JD Logistics platform. These results suggest that state-dependent discounting can be made effective in deep RL when coupled with a return-consistency objective that prevents degenerate target manipulation.

</details>


### [411] [Entropy-Regularized Adjoint Matching for Offline RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06156)
*Abdelghani Ghanem,Mounir Ghogho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ME-AM是一种将最大熵对抗匹配与混合行为先验相结合的离线强化学习框架，通过Mirror Descent熵最大化缓解流行度偏差，同时扩展几何支撑以实现对分布外高奖励区域的探索，在保持流匹配模型表达性的同时解决了传统方法的核心限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有QAM方法虽通过连续伴随方法稳定策略优化，但存在两个根本性限制：流行度偏差（popularity bias）会压制低密度区域的高奖励动作，以及支撑绑定（support binding）限制了对离分布区域的探索。现有残差高斯策略等解决方案会重新引入单峰分布的表达性瓶颈。

Method: ME-AM提出两个核心机制：(1) 基于Mirror Descent的熵最大化目标，通过对抗流行度偏差使策略能够从低密度高奖励区域提取最优动作；(2) Mixture Behavior Prior（混合行为先验），在数学上扩展了流向量的几何支撑，使模型能够探索分布外的高奖励区域，同时保持生成向量场的绝对连续性。

Result: 实验表明，ME-AM在多种稀疏奖励连续控制环境中达到或超越当前最优方法的性能。

Conclusion: ME-AM通过将最大熵原则与混合行为先验相结合，在不牺牲流匹配模型表达性的前提下，有效解决了离线强化学习中的流行度偏差和支撑绑定问题。该框架在稀疏奖励连续控制环境中展现出具有竞争力的性能，为将生成式流模型应用于离线RL提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Integrating expressive generative policies, such as flow-matching models, into offline reinforcement learning (RL) allows agents to capture complex, multi-modal behaviors. While Q-learning with Adjoint Matching (QAM) stabilizes policy optimization via the continuous adjoint method, it remains inherently bound to the fixed behavior distribution. This dependence induces a \textit{popularity bias} that can suppress high-reward actions in low-density regions, and creates a \textit{support binding} that restricts off-manifold exploration. Existing workarounds, such as appending \textit{residual} Gaussian policies, often re-introduce the expressivity bottlenecks associated with unimodal distributions. In this work, we propose \textit{Maximum Entropy Adjoint Matching} (ME-AM), a unified framework that addresses these limitations within the continuous flow formulation. ME-AM incorporates two mechanisms: (1) a Mirror Descent entropy maximization objective that mitigates the popularity bias to facilitate the extraction of optimal policies from offline datasets, and (2) a \textit{Mixture Behavior Prior} that mathematically broadens the geometric support to encompass out-of-distribution high-reward regions. By exploring this extended geometry, ME-AM identifies robust actions while preserving the absolute continuity of the generative vector field. Empirically, ME-AM demonstrates competitive or superior performance compared to prior state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods across a diverse suite of sparse-reward continuous control environments.

</details>


### [412] [One Algorithm, Two Goals: Dual Scoring for Parameter and Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06166)
*Xinrui Chen,Liu Yang,Ou Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: In Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuning, parameter and data selection are common strategies for reducing fine-tuning cost, yet they are typically driven by separate scoring mechanisms. When a parameter mask and data subset jointly determine restricted fine-tuning, this separation incurs redundant overhead and makes coordinated selection difficult. We cast parameter and data selection as two bilevel selection problems under a common validation objective and derive a shared local response-surrogate scoring rule. Under first- and second-order validation-improvement approximations, parameter importance and data utility emerge as column-wise and row-wise aggregations of a single gradient interaction matrix, yielding a closed-form row-column correspondence for co-extracting both signals. Building on this structure, we propose DualSFT (Dual-Selection Fine-Tuning), a one-shot dual-scoring algorithm that produces a parameter mask and data subset from shared gradient statistics. On 3B-9B LLMs, single-axis DualSFT variants strengthen target-task performance and stability-plasticity trade-offs within their comparison groups, while full DualSFT yields a more favorable joint-constrained trade-off than sequential hybrid baselines under matched budgets.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

When a parameter mask and data subset jointly determine restricted fine-tuning, this separation incurs redundant overhead and makes coordinated selection difficult. ### [413] [Mean Mode Screaming: Mean--Variance Split Residuals for 1000-Layer Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06169)
*Pengqi Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Scaling Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) to hundreds of layers introduces a structural vulnerability: networks can enter a silent, mean-dominated collapse state that homogenizes token representations and suppresses centered variation. Through mechanistic auditing, we isolate the trigger event of this collapse as Mean Mode Screaming (MMS). MMS can occur even when training appears stable, with a mean-coherent backward shock on residual writers that opens deep residual branches and drives the network into a mean-dominated state. We show this behavior is driven by an exact decomposition of these gradients into mean-coherent and centered components, compounded by the structural suppression of attention-logit gradients through the null space of the Softmax Jacobian once values homogenize.
  To address this, we propose Mean-Variance Split (MV-Split) Residuals, which combine a separately gained centered residual update with a leaky trunk-mean replacement. On a 400-layer single-stream DiT, MV-Split prevents the divergent collapse that crashes the un-stabilized baseline; it tracks close to the baseline's pre-crash trajectory while remaining substantially better than token-isotropic gating methods such as LayerScale across the full schedule. Finally, we present a 1000-layer DiT as a scale-validation run at boundary scales, establishing that the architecture remains stably trainable at extreme depth.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (ai_circuit_open). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

### [414] [In-Context Black-Box Optimization with Unreliable Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06187)
*Nicolas Samuel Blumer,Julien Martinelli,Samuel Kaski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究反馈辅助的上下文黑盒优化（FICBO），通过预训练Transformer模型结合历史观测和辅助反馈信号来改进候选点选择，并在合成和真实任务上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒优化中辅助反馈可能存在偏差或误导性，现有方法难以跨任务泛化且假设优化历史是唯一信号。本文旨在构建能感知多源反馈并自适应评估其可靠性的优化框架。

Method: 提出结构化反馈先验建模不同反馈源在访问性、相关性和失真程度上的差异，基于此预训练反馈感知Transformer；测试时通过对比观测目标值与辅助信号在上下文中估计源可靠性。

Result: FICBO在合成和真实任务中有效利用有价值反馈，同时对弱误导性源保持鲁棒，性能优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 该方法为反馈-informed优化提供了可解释的跨任务适应框架，模型能习得对测试时反馈源的感知能力。

Abstract: Black-box optimization in science and engineering often comes with side information: experts, simulators, pretrained predictors, or heuristics can suggest which candidates look promising. This information can accelerate search, but it can also be biased, input-dependent, or misleading. Feedback-aware BO methods typically handle one task at a time, limiting their ability to generalize over multiple sources of feedback. In-context optimizers address cross-task adaptation, but usually assume that optimization history is the only available signal at test time. We study feedback-informed in-context black-box optimization (FICBO), where a pretrained optimizer conditions on both the observed history and cheap auxiliary feedback for the current candidate set. We introduce a structured feedback prior that models how feedback sources vary in their access, relevance, and distortion relative to the true objective, and use it to pretrain a feedback-aware transformer. At test time, the model estimates source reliability in context by comparing observed objective values with auxiliary signals, improving query selection. On synthetic and real-world tasks, FICBO effectively exploits informative feedback while remaining robust to weak or misleading sources, improving over other baselines. Empirical investigations further illustrate how the model perceives test-time sources, offering insights into its interpretability and decision-making process.

</details>


### [415] [Constrained Contextual Bandits with Adversarial Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06190)
*Dhruv Sarkar,Abhishek Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究预算受限的对抗性上下文老虎机问题，在继续设置下同时控制遗憾值和预算约束违反。基于SquareCB框架提出模块化框架，利用在线回归预言机将约束问题规约为标准无约束问题，在对抗性上下文场景下获得优于先前工作的理论结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作主要针对随机上下文场景，而在实际应用中上下文可能具有对抗性；需要同时控制累积成本约束违反程度。

Method: 基于SquareCB框架，提出模块化框架，利用在线回归预言机(online regression oracles)，将约束问题规约为标准无约束上下文老虎机问题，通过自适应定义的替代奖励函数实现。

Result: 对于更一般的对抗性上下文获得改进的理论保证，并提供高效算法和简洁透明的分析。

Conclusion: 实验验证部分未在摘要中体现

Abstract: We study budget-constrained contextual bandits with adversarial contexts, where each action yields a random reward and incurs a random cost. We adopt the standard realizability assumption: conditioned on the observed context, rewards and costs are drawn independently from fixed distributions whose expectations belong to known function classes. We focus on the continuing setting, in which the algorithm operates over the entire horizon even after the budget for cumulative cost is exhausted. In this setting, the objective is to simultaneously control regret and the violation of the budget constraint. Building on the seminal $\mathsf{SquareCB}$ framework of Foster et al. [2018], we propose a simple and modular framework that leverages online regression oracles to reduce the constrained problem to a standard unconstrained contextual bandit problem with adaptively defined surrogate reward functions. In contrast to prior works, which focus on stochastic contexts, our reduction yields improved guarantees for more general adversarial contexts, together with an efficient algorithm with a compact and transparent analysis.

</details>


### [416] [Bandit Learning in General Open Multi-agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06202)
*Mengfan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了开放系统中的多臂老虎机学习问题，其中智能体可以随时进入和离开系统。文章提出了一个统一的问题框架，通过引入"预训练度"、"稳定性"和"全局动态遗憾"等新概念来刻画系统特性，并开发了具有可证明收敛保证的全局UCB算法。研究表明，遗憾主要由新智能体的预训练度线性决定，在稳定系统下由最优臂识别时间和智能体模式主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放系统老虎机研究存在结构性假设过强、与实际不符的问题。开放系统中智能体的进出行为导致内生非平稳性、信息累积模式复杂、遗憾尺度随时间范围增长，这些挑战需要新的学习范式来应对。

Method: 1) 构建统一开放系统老虎机问题框架，包含异构奖励和一般智能体模式；2) 提出三个核心概念：预训练度（衡量新智能体进入时携带的信息量）、稳定性（衡量新智能体对系统的冲击程度）、全局动态遗憾（比较所有活跃智能体累积期望奖励与时变最优臂的差距；3) 开发认证的全局UCB学习算法。

Result: 遗憾上界显示：进入不确定性通过预训练度线性影响遗憾；在稳定机制下，遗憾由识别持久最优臂所需时间及智能体模式共同决定。通过hard实例的下界证明了这些依赖关系的紧性。

Conclusion: 本文为开放系统老虎机学习提供了理论基础，证明了预训练度和稳定性是决定遗憾的关键因素，且相关依赖关系具有最优性。

Abstract: Recent developments in digital platforms have highlighted the prevalence of open systems, where agents can arrive and depart over time. While bandit learning in open systems has recently received initial attention, existing work imposes structural assumptions that are frequently violated in practice. A learning paradigm for general open systems creates fresh challenges: newly arriving agents induce endogenous non-stationarity; agent patterns determine how quickly information accumulates; and new agents make regret scale further with the time horizon. To this end, we formulate a unified open-system bandit problem with general dynamics, including heterogeneous rewards and general agent patterns. We introduce new concepts to capture the inherent complexities: the \emph{pre-training degree} of new agents quantifies how much information an agent carries upon entry, \emph{stability} measures the impact of new agents on the system, and \emph{global dynamic regret} compares the cumulative expected reward of all active agents with that of the varying optimal arms. We develop certified global-UCB learning methodologies with provable guarantees. Our regret bounds reveal that entry uncertainty enters linearly via the pre-training degree, while in stable regimes, regret is governed by the time needed to identify a persistent optimal arm, as well as by the agent patterns. We further show that these dependencies are tight via lower bounds in hard instances.

</details>


### [417] [Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06206)
*Muhammad Shahir Abdurrahman,Chun Deng,Azalia Mirhoseini,Philip Levis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Mixture of experts has emerged as the primary mechanism for making Large Language Models (LLMs) computationally efficient. However, in distributed settings, communicating token embeddings between experts is a significant bottleneck.
  We present the novel Federation of Experts (FoE) architecture. FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts. Between clusters, a sum synchronizes the post-attention residuals, which then drives routing and dispatch for the next MoE block. In a single-node setting, FoE completely eliminates all-to-all communication as all experts within a group are contained on the same GPU. In multi-node settings, FoE confines all-to-all communication to the intra-node fabric, thus significantly reducing communication overhead.
  An implementation of FoE finds that on LongBench, FoE significantly improves inference throughput and latency in both single-node and multi-node settings, reducing the end-to-end forward-pass latency by up to 5.2x, TTFT by 3.62x, and TBT by 1.95x. It does so while achieving comparable generation quality to a mixture of experts model of the same size and training configuration.

It does so while achieving comparable generation quality to a mixture of experts model of the same size and training configuration.
